क: क The first consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, and the first of the guttural letters, corresponding to K or C in can, designated by the latter in Sir WM. JONES'S system, but in this work by the former.

क m. (कः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 Of VIṢṆU. 3 Of KĀMADEVA. 4 Of fire. 5 Air or wind. 6 A title of YAMA. 7 The sun. 8 The soul. 9 A clever or dexterous man. 10 A king, a prince. 11 A knot or joint. 12 A peacock. 13 The mind. 14 The body. 15 Time. 16 Wealth, property. 17 Sound. 18 Light, splendor. n. (-कं) 1 The head. 2 Water. 3 Pleasure, happiness. 4 Hair. 5 A head of hair. pron. mfn. (कः का किम्) Who or what: see किम्. E. कै to sound, or कच to shine, &c. affix ड.
कंय्य: कंय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Happy. E. कं happiness, यस् aff.
कंय्यु: कंय्यु mfn. (-य्युः-य्युः-य्यु) Happy, prosperous. E. कं, and युस् aff.
कंश: कंश m. (-शः) A goblet: see कंस.
कंस: कंस m. (-सः) A proper name; KAṂSA king of Mathura the uncle and enemy of KṚṢṆA, by whom he was slain; as the foe of the deity, he is considered an Asura or demon. mn. (-सः-सं) 1 A goblet, a drinking vessel; also कंश and कांस्य. 2 A metal, tutanag or white copper; also bell metal. 3 A measure. E. कमु to desire, सः Uṇādi aff.
कंसक: कंसक n. (-कं) A mineral substance, (a salt of iron?) used as an application to the eyes: see पुष्पकासीस. E. कंस, and क affix of similarity; of similar white colour.
कंसकार: कंसकार m. (-रः) A worker in pewter or white brass. E. कंस and कार who makes.
कंसजित्: कंसजित् m. (-जित्) A title of KṚṢṆA. E. कंस, and जित् who conquers.
कंसहन्: कंसहन् m. (-हा) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. हन् from हन, to kill; the destroyer of KAṂSA.
कंसाराति: कंसाराति m. (-तिः) KṚṢṆA, or VIṢṆU in that character. E. कंस, and अराति an enemy, the foe of KAṂSA; hence also कंसारि and other similar epithets: see the preceding.
कंसास्थि: कंसास्थि n. (-स्थि) Tutanag, white copper, any alloy of tin and copper. E. कंस white metal, and अस्थि bone, fig. substance.
कंसिक: कंसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of bellmetal, &c. E. कंस, and ठन् aff.
कंसीय: कंसीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit for or relating to a cup. E. कंस, and छ aff.
कंसोद्भवा: कंसोद्भवा f. (-वा) A fragrant earth: see तुवरी.
कक: कक r. 1st cl. (ककते) 1 To be proud. 3 To be unsteady. 4 To be thirsty. (इ) ककि (कंकते) To go.
कक्ख: कक्ख r. 1st cl. (कक्खति) To laugh. to laugh, at or deride: see कख.
कक्ख (ए) r. 1st cl. (कक्खति) To laugh, to laugh at, to deride.
ककन्द: ककन्द m. (-न्दः) Gold. E. कनी to shine, affix द, and the initial repeated.
ककुञ्जल: ककुञ्जल m. (-लः) A bird, the Cātaka.
ककुत्स्थ: ककुत्स्थ m. (-त्स्थः) A prince, the grandson of IKṢVĀKU, and ancestor of RĀMA. E. ककुद् an emblem of royalty, and स्थ who resides.
ककुद्: ककुद् f. (-त्) or ककुद mn. (-दः-दं) 1 The hump on the shoulders of the Indian bull. 2 An ensign or symbol of royalty, as the white parasol, &c. 3 Chief, pre-eminent. 4 The peak or summit of a mountain. E. क happiness, कु to sound, affixes क्विप् and तुक्; त becomes द; or with a final vowel, taking an additional affix अच्.
ककुद्मत्: ककुद्मत् m. (-द्मान्) 1 A bull. 2 A mountain. f. (-द्मती) The hip and loins. E. ककुद् a bull's hump, &c. affix मतुप्.
ककुद्मिकन्या: ककुद्मिकन्या f. (-न्या) A river. E. ककुद्मिन् a mountain, कन्या a daughter.
ककुद्मिन्: ककुद्मिन् mfn. (-द्मी-द्मिनी-द्मि) 1 Peaked. 2 Humped. m. (-द्मी) 1 A mountain. 2 A bull. E. ककुद, and मिनि aff.
ककुन्दर: ककुन्दर n. (-रं) The cavities of the loins: see कुकुन्दर.
ककुभ्: ककुभ् f. (-प्) 1 Space, region or quarter, as east, west, &c. 2 Beauty, splendor. 3 Unornamented hair, or the hair hanging  down as a tail. 4 A wreath of Champaka flowers. 5 A Rāgiṇī or personified mode of music. 6 A Śāstra or sacred treatise. E. क wind, स्कुभ to spread, क्विप् affix and the स is dropped; or कक to be proud, उभ् aff.
ककुभ: ककुभ m. (-भः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna, Rox.) 2 A part of a lute, the belly, a wooden vessel covered with leather placed under its neck to render the sound deeper, or a crooked piece of wood at the end of the lute. 3 One of the Rāgas or personified musical modes. f. (-भा) 1 Space, region, quarter: see ककुभ्. 2 One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music. E. ककुभ् space, and अच् affix; or क wind, स्कुभ spread, क affix and स rejected, &c.
ककुभादनी: ककुभादनी f. (-नी) A kind of perfume: see नली.
ककेरुक: ककेरुक m. (-कः) A worm in the stomach.
कक्कोल: कक्कोल m. (-लः) A perfume, a plant bearing a berry, the inner part of which is a waxy and aromatic substance. n. (-लं) The berry, -possibly the fruit of the Cocculus Indicus. E. कक to be proud, with क्विप् affix, कुल to accumulate, अच् affix; also with कन् added कक्कोलक (-कः-कं.)
कक्खट: कक्खट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Hard, solid. f. (-टी) Chalk. E. कक्ख to deride, अटन् affix, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्; also खक्खट.
कक्खटपत्रक: कक्खटपत्रक m. (-कः) A plant of the fibres of which a kind of rope is made, (Corchorus olitorius, Rox.) E. कक्खट hard, पत्र a leaf, and कन् aff.
कक्ष: कक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The armpit. 2 A spreading creeper, a climbing plant. 3 Grass. 4 Dry grass. 5 A wood, a forest. 6 A forest of dead trees, a dry wood. 7 A private or inner chamber or part of a house. 8 Sin. 9 A buffalo. 10 The side or flank. 11 (In astronomy,) The orbit of a planet, or the circle anciently termed a deferent. 12 A gate. 13 The beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) mf. (-क्षः-क्षा) 1 A wall. 2 The end of the lower garment, which after the cloth is carried round the body, is brought up behind, and tucked into the waistband. f. (-क्षा) 1 An elephant's rope, the string round his neck, also his girth. 2 A woman's girdle or zone. 3 An enclosure, a part or division of an edifice. 4 A part of a car. 5 Objection or reply in argument. 6 Similarity, parity. 7 Emulation, rivalship. 8 The jeweller's weight, the Ratti. 9 Painful boils in the armpit, side, shoulder, &c. n. (-क्षं) A constellation, a star: see कक्ष्या, कच्छ, काञ्चि, &c. E. कष to hurt or kill, स Uṇādi affix, fem. टाप्.
कक्षरुहा: कक्षरुहा f. (-हा) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) E. कक्ष an enclosure, and रुह what grows.
कक्षशाय: कक्षशाय m. (-यः) A dog. E. कक्ष an inner room, शाय who sleeps.
कक्षान्तर: कक्षान्तर n. (-रं) The inner or private apartment. E. कक्ष and अन्तर interior.
कक्षापट: कक्षापट m. (-टः) A cloth passed between the legs to cover the privities. E. कक्षा a girdle, and पट a cloth.
कक्षावत्: कक्षावत् m. (-वान्) The name of a saint. E. कक्षा a reply, and मतुप् aff.
कक्षावेक्षक: कक्षावेक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A doorkeeper. 2 A guard of the queen's apartments. 3 Keeper of a royal garden. 4 A painter. 5 A poet. 6 A debauchee. 7 Eagerness of feeling, strength of sentiment. E. कक्षा an enclosure, and अबेक्ष to see, वुन् aff.
कक्ष्य: कक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) The cup or receptacle of a balance. f. (-क्ष्या) 1 The girth of an elephant, of rope or leather. 2 A woman's girdle or zone. 3 The enclosure of an edifice; that is, either the wall, &c. so enclosing, or the court or chamber constituting the enclosure. 4 The inner apartment of a palace. 5 Similarity. 6 Effort, exertion. 7 An upper garment. 8 A shrub, yielding the black and red berry, that serves as a jeweller's weight; the Ratti or Gunja, (Abrus precatorius.) E. कक्ष the flank, &c. यत् affix; see कक्ष.
कख: कख r. 1st cl. (ए) कखे (कखति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride; also कक्ख and खक्ख q. v.
कख्या: कख्या f. (-ख्या) An enclosure, a division of a large building: see कक्ष्या. E. कख to deride, यत् affix, and टाप्.
कग: कग r. 1st cl. (ए) कगे (कगति) To perform any action: the meaning of this root is not given in many lists, from its application being indefinitely various.
कङ्क: कङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A heron. 2 YAMA or death. 3 A false or pretended Brahman. 4 A title of YUDHIṢṬHIRA, from his assuming the disguise of a Brahman. 5 A man of the second or military tribe. 6 One of the eighteen division of the continent. 7 The brother of KAṂSA. 8 A kind of mango. f. (-ङ्का) 1 A daughter of UGRASENA. 2 A sort of sandal. E. ककि to go, अच् aff.
कङ्कट: कङ्कट m. (-टः) Mail, defensive armour. E. ककि to go, Uṇādi affix अटन्, and with कन् added कङ्कटक.
कङ्कण: कङ्कण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 A bracelet or ornament of the wrist. 2 A string or ribbon tied round the wrist. 3 An ornament or trinket. 4 A crest. f. (-णी) A small bell or tinkling ornament; also किङ्किणी and कङ्कणीका. E. कं happily, agreeably, कण to sound, or the reiterative form of कण and अच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
कङ्कणीका: कङ्कणीका f. (-का) See कङ्कणी. E. कण to sound in the reiterative form, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
कङ्कत: कङ्कत mfn. (-तः-तिका or -ती-तं) A comb, an instrument for cleaning the hair. m. (-तः) A tree. E. ककि to go, अतच् affix, fem. ङीष्, or कन् added in the fem. form.
कङ्कत्रोट: कङ्कत्रोट m. (-टः) A kind of fish commonly Kankila, (Esox Cancila, HAM.) E. कङ्क a heron, and त्रोटि, the throat; whose long snout resembles the beak of a heron; also कङ्कत्रोटि.
कङ्कत्रोटि: कङ्कत्रोटि m. (-टिः) A kind of fish: see the preceding; also जलसूचि.
कङ्कपत्र: कङ्कपत्र m. (-त्रः) An arrow. E. कङ्क, and पत्र leaf, (feather.)
कङ्कमाला: कङ्कमाला f. (-ला) Beating time by clapping the hands: see करताली.
कङ्कमुख: कङ्कमुख m. (-खः) A pair of tongs. n. (-खं) A sort of forceps. E. कङ्क, and मुख the mouth; heron-mouthed.
कङ्कर: कङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Vile, bad. n. (-रं) Buttermilk mixed with water. see कञ्जर. E. क implying bad, or कं water, कर what does or makes.
कङ्करोल: कङ्करोल m. (-लः) A small tree, (Alangium hexapetalum:) see निकोचक; the word in the dialects Kāṅkarol is applied to a species of gourd, (Momordica mixta.)
कङ्कलोद्य: कङ्कलोद्य n. (-ड्यं) A kind of drug.
कङ्कशत्रु: कङ्कशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum:) see शालपर्णी. E. कङ्क a heron, and शत्रु an enemy.
कङ्कशाय: कङ्कशाय m. (-यः) A dog. E. कङ्क a heron, and शाय sleeping, sleeping like a heron, from शीङ् and घञ् aff.
कङ्का: कङ्का f. (-ङ्का) Scent of the lotus.
कङ्काल: कङ्काल m. (-लः) The skeleton. E. ककि to go, कालच् aff.
कङ्कालमालिन्: कङ्कालमालिन् m. (-ली) A title of ŚIVA. E. कङ्काल, माला, a necklace, and इनि affix; whose necklace is formed of bones.
कङ्कु: कङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 The brother of KAṂSA. 2 A sort of Panic: see कङ्गु. E. ककि to go, उ aff.
कङ्कुष्ट: कङ्कुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A medicinal earth, described as of two colours, one of a silvery and one of a gold colour, or one of a light and one of a dark yellow.
कङ्केरु: कङ्केरु m. (-रुः) A kind of crow. E. कङ्क an imitative sound, ईर to send, to utter, उ aff.
कङ्केलि: कङ्केलि m. (-लिः) The Asoka tree, (Jonesia asoca;) also कङ्केल्लि.
कङ्केल्ल: कङ्केल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A kind of potherb, (Chenopodium esculentum, Rox.) see वास्तुक.
कङ्केल्लि: कङ्केल्लि m. (-ल्लिः) A tree, (Jonesia asoca, Rox.)
कङ्ख: कङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) Enjoyment, fruition. E. कखि to deride, अच् aff.
कङ्गु: कङ्गु f. (-ङ्गुः) A kind of Panick seed, (Panicum Italicum;) several varieties of it are cultivated, and form articles of food for the poor. E. क water, अगि to go, कु affix; also with ऊङ् affix कङ्गू, and with कन् added कङ्गुका.
कङ्गुनी: कङ्गुनी f. (-नी) A sort of Panick: see the last.
कङ्गुनीपत्रा: कङ्गुनीपत्रा f. (-त्रा) A kind of grass.
कच: कच r. 1st cl. (कचते) 1 To bind. 2 To shine. 3 To sound. (इ) कचि r. 1st cl. (कञ्चते) 1 To shine. 2 To bind; also काचि.

कच m. (-चः) 1 The hair. 2 A proper name, the son of VṚHASPATI. 3 Binding or a binding. 3 A cicatrix, a dry or healed sore. 5 A cloud. f. (-चा) 1 A female elephant. 2 Beauty, brilliance. E. कच to bind, &c. अच् affix, fem. टाप्.
कचङ्गन: कचङ्गन n. (-नं) A free market, a place of sale that pays no duty or custom.
कचङ्गल: कचङ्गल m. (-लः) The ocean. E. कच a cloud, अङ्ग the body, and ल what takes or receives.
कचप: कचप m. (-पः) 1 Grass. 2 A leaf. E. कच a cloud, and प what drinks.
कचपक्ष: कचपक्ष m. (-क्षः) Much or ornamented hair. E. कच hair, and पक्ष, in this combination, abundance; similar compounds are made with पाश and हस्त, कचपाश, कचहस्त; also with केश hair, as केशपक्ष.
कचमाल: कचमाल m. (-लः) Smoke. E. कच a cloud, and माला a necklace, ड affix; also खतमाल.
कचाकु: कचाकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) 1 Ill disposed, wicked. 2 Intolerable, difficult to be borne. m. (-कुः) A snake.
कचाचित: कचाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having long or dishevelled hair. E. कच, and अचित not gathered.
कचु: कचु f. (-चुः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia and other kinds, many of which are cultivated for food:) see कच्ची.
कच्चर: कच्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Dirty, foul. 2 Soiled, spoiled by dirt. 3 Vile, wicked, bad. n. (-रं) Buttermilk diluted with water. E. कुत् bad, vile, चर what goes or is, from चर with अच् affix; कत् is substituted for कत्, and the त changed.
कच्चित्: कच्चित् ind. 1 A particle implying wish or desire, (may it be so;) also introducing a kind enquiry, (I hope that it is so, &c.) 2 A particle implying an alternative, whether, whether or not. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and चित् aff.
कच्छ: कच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) Contiguous to water, (land, &c.) m. (-च्छः) 1 Marshy ground, a marsh, a morass. 2 Ground bordering water or watery soil, as the bank of a river, the margin of a lake or tank, a mound or causeway, &c. 3 Level land skirting mountains. 4 A tree, the timber of which is used for making furniture, &c. commonly Tūn, (Cedrela Tunna, Rox.) 5 Another tree, (Hibiscus Populneoides.) 6 A part of a boat. mf. (-च्छः-च्छा) The hem of a garment tucked into the waistband: see कक्ष. f. (-च्छा) 1 A plant, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) see वाराही. 2 A cricket. E. क water, छो to cut or break, क affix; or कच to bind, छ aff.
कच्छटिका: कच्छटिका f. (-का) The end or hem of a lower garment or cloth gathered up behind, and tucked into the waistband; also कक्षा and कच्छाटिका.
कच्छप: कच्छप m. (-पः) 1 A turtle, a tortoise. 2 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures. 3 An attitude in wrestling. 4 A flat kind of still. f. (-पी) 1 A female tortoise, also a small one. 2 A kind of lute, also the lute of SARASVATĪ. 3 A cutaneous disease, wart or blotch. E. कच्छ a morass, and प who cherishes, who inhabits watery places: the lute, &c. are so named from being similar in shape to the tortoise.
कच्छपिका: कच्छपिका f. (-का) 1 A pimple, a blotch or wart. 2 A wart accompanying gonorrhoea. E. कच्छप a tortoise, कन् added, fem. form.
कच्छभू: कच्छभू f. (-भूः) Marshy ground, a swamp, a morass. E. कच्छ, and भू land.
कच्छरुहा: कच्छरुहा f. (-हा) A kind of grass, Dūrvā or Dūb, (Agrostis linearis, Lin. Panicus dactilon, Rox.) E. कच्छ marshy ground, and रुह what grows.
कच्छान्त: कच्छान्त m. (-न्तः) The border of a lake or stream. E. कच्छ, and अन्त term.
कच्छु: कच्छु f. (-च्छुः) Itch, formation of watery pustules on the hands, &c. E. कष to hurt, उ affix; also कच्छू.
कच्छुघ्नी: कच्छुघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A vegetable, (Trichosanthes.) E. कच्छु, and ध्नी what removes.
कच्छुर: कच्छुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Scabby, itchy. 2 Unchaste, libidinous. f. (-रा) 1 A plant, (a species of Hedysarum?) 2 Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.) 3 Another plant: see शठी. E. कच्छ itch or scab, and र aff.
कच्छू: कच्छू f. (-च्छूः) Scab or itch. E. कष to injure, ऊ Uṇādi affix, and छ substituted for ष.
कच्छूमती: कच्छूमती f. (-ती) Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.) E. चच्छू itch, and मतुप् affix; producing an itching upon application to the skin.
कच्छोटिका: कच्छोटिका f. (-का) The fastening of the lower garment: see कच्छटिका.
कच्वी: कच्वी f. (-च्ची) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia and other kinds, several of which are cultivated for food;) also written कचु.
कज: कज r. 1st cl. (कजति) To be disturbed or confused with joy, pride, or sorrow.
कज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Watery, aquatic, produced in or by water. n. (-जं) A lotus. E. क water, and ज born.
कज्जल: कज्जल m. (-लः) 1 A cloud. n. (-लं) Lampblack, considered as a collyrium, being applied upon the eyelashes or eyelids, medicinally or ornamentatively; also sulphuret of lead or antimony, when so used. f. (-ली) Sulphuret of mercury, Æthiop's mineral. f. (-ला or -ली) A kind of fish, (Cyprinus atratus,) or any kind peculiar to stagnant waters, whence the name. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and जल water or juice, as the moisture of the collyrium, &c.
कज्ज्वल: कज्ज्वल n. (-लं) Lampblack, especially considered as an application to the eyes: see the preceding. E. कत bad, and ज्वल flame.
कज्ज्वलध्वज: कज्ज्वलध्वज m. (-जः) A lamp. E. कज्ज्वल, and ध्वज a sign; also कज्जलध्वज.
कज्ज्वलरोचक: कज्ज्वलरोचक mn. (-कः-कं) The wooden stand or tripod on which the lamp is placed, a candlestick. E. कज्ज्वल and रुच to shine; affixes घञ् and कन्.
कञ्चट: कञ्चट m. (-टः) A plant: see लाङ्गली, (Commelina salicifolia.) n. (-टं) Another species of the same, (Commelina Bengalensis.) E. कं water, and चट to divide; alluding to the habits of the plant.
कञ्चड: कञ्चड m. (-डः) A plant, (Commelina Bengalensis): see the preceding.
कञ्चार: कञ्चार m. (-रः) The sun. E. कं heaven, and चर to go, affix अण्.
कञ्चिका: कञ्चिका f. (-का) 1 The branch of a bamboo. 2 A small boil.
कञ्चुक: कञ्चुक m. (-कः) 1 The skin of a snake. 2 Armour, mail. 3 A bodice or jacket. 4 Cloth, clothes. 5 A kind of drawers or short breeches. f. (-की) The name of a plant. E. कचि to bind or shine, affix उकन्.
कञ्चुकालु: कञ्चुकालु m. (-लुः) A snake. E. कञ्चुक a serpent's skin, and आलुक poss. aff.
कञ्चुकिन्: कञ्चुकिन् m. (-की) 1 An attendant on the women's apartments. 2 A libidinous man, a debauchee. 3 A serpent. 4 Agallochum. 5 Barley. 6 A sort of pulse, (Chenna.) E. कञ्चुक armour, &c. इनि aff.
कञ्चुलिका: कञ्चुलिका f. (-का) A bodice or jacket.
कञ्ज: कञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Produced in or from water. m. (-ञ्जः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The hair. n. (-ञ्जं) 1 Nectar, the food of the immortals. 2 A lotus. E. कं happiness, water, &c. and ज what is born or produced.
कञ्जक: कञ्जक m. (-कः) A kind of bird, the Mayana: see कञ्जन.
कञ्जज: कञ्जज m. (-जः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. कञ्ज a lotus, and ज born.
कञ्जन: कञ्जन m. (-नः) 1 The Mayana or Maina, (Gracula religiosa.) 2 A name of KANDARPA, the deity of love. E. कचि to go, युच् aff.
कञ्जर: कञ्जर m. (-रः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The sun. 3 The belly. 4 An elephant. E. कञ्ज a lotus, &c. ऋ to hate or injure, अच or घञ् affix कञ्जार, the pen. made short; also derived by some from कजि, a Sautra root, to produce or grow, and अर Uṇādi aff.
कञ्जल: कञ्जल m. (-लः) The Maina: see कञ्जन.
कञ्जार: कञ्जार m. (-रः) 1 Muni or holy sage. 2 BRAHMĀ, &c. see कञ्जर.
कञ्जिका: कञ्जिका f. (-का) A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica:) see ब्रह्मयष्टिका.
कट: कट r. 1st cl. (कटति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To live with difficulty. (इ) कटि (कण्टति) To go. (ए) कटे (कटति) 1 To rain. 2 To encompass, to cover or screen. (ई) कटी (कटति) To go or approach: with प्र prefixed, verb 10th cl. (प्रकटयति) To appear, to become apparent or manifest.

कट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) An agent in any action. mf. (-टः-टी) 1 The hip. 2 The hollow above the hip or the loins, also the hip and loins. m. (-टः) 1 The temples of the elephant. 2 A mat. 3 A twist of straw or grass. 4 A screen of the same. 5 A corpse. 6 A time or season. 7 Much, excessive. 8 Grass. 9 A place where dead bodies are burnt or buried, a place of sepulture. 10 A hearse, a bier, a bed, &c. used for conveying a dead body. 11 An annual plant. 12 A thin piece of wood, a plank. f. (-टी) Long pepper. E. कट to rain or encompass, अच् affix, fem. ङीष्; also कटि.
कटक: कटक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The side or ridge of a hill or mountain. 2 Table land. 3 Sea salt. 4 A ring placed as an ornament upon an elephant's tusk. 5 A bracelet of gold, shell, &c. 6 A zone. 7 A royal metropolis. 8 A city or town. 9 A village. 10 A house or dwelling. 11 A camp. 12 An army. 13 A circle. 14 A wheel. E. कट to encompass, कन् Uṇādi aff.
कटकिन्: कटकिन् m. (-की) A mountain. E. कटक land on a hill, &c. and इनि aff.
कटखादक: कटखादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An eater, one who eats voraciously. m. (-कः) 1 A glass vessel, a tumbler or bowl. 2 A crow. 3 A jackall. E. कट much, or a corpse, खाद to eat, affix वुन्.
कटङ्कट: कटङ्कट m. (-ठः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. कट a mat, &c. कट who goes, खच् aff.
कटन: कटन n. (-नं) Roof or thatch of a house.
कटपूटन: कटपूटन m. (-नः) A kind of goblin.
कटप्रू: कटप्रू m. (-प्रूः) 1 A name of MAHĀDEVA. 2 A kind of demigod, one of the class of Vidyādharas. 3 A Rākṣasa, an imp or demon. 4 Gambling, playing with dice. 5 A worm. E. कट much, प्र to go, क्विप् affix, and the final is made long.
कटप्रोथ: कटप्रोथ m. (-थः) The buttocks: see कटिप्रोथ.
कटभङ्ग: कटभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Gleaning, plucking or gathering corn by the hand. 2 Royal misfortune, as deposure, defeat, &c. E. कट, &c. भञ्ज to break, अच् aff.
कटभी: कटभी f. (-भी) 1 A plant, (Heartpea, Cardiaspermum halicacabum.) 2 Another creeper, (Clitoria ternata.) E. कट to encompass, and भज to serve, ड and ङीष् affs.
कटमालिनी: कटमालिनी f. (-नी) Wine or any vinous liquor.
कटम्ब: कटम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A kind of musical instrument. 2 An arrow. E. कट to go, and अम्ब Uṇādi aff.
कटम्बरा: कटम्बरा f. (-रा) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. कट to surround, अच् affix; what invests the body, as sickness; वृ to screen or defend, मुम् inserted, and अच् and टाप् affixes; also कटम्भरा.
कटम्भरा: कटम्भरा f. (-रा) 1 A plant, (Poederia fetida.) 2 A medicinal plant, कटुकीः see the preceding. 3 A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.) 4 A female elephant. 5 Red arsenic. 6 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides:) see मुर्व्वा. 7 Hog-weed. E. as before, भृ to nourish, &c.
कटव्रण: कटव्रण m. (-णः) A name of BHĪMASENA, one of the five Pāṇḍava brothers. E. कट much, व्रण who wounds.
कटशर्करा: कटशर्करा f. (-रा) A plant: see गाङ्गेष्टी.
कटस्थल: कटस्थल n. (-लं) 1 The hip and loins. 2 An elephant's temples. E. कट, and स्थल place; also कटभू, &c.
कटाकु: कटाकु m. (-कुः) A bird. E. कट to go, काकु Uṇādi aff.
कटाक्ष: कटाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A leer, a glance or side look. E. कट to go, and अक्षि the eye.
कटाक्षावेक्षण: कटाक्षावेक्षण n. (-णं) Casting lewd or amorous glances, ogling. E. कटाक्ष a leer, and अवेक्षण looking.
कटाग्नि: कटाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 A fire of grass or straw. 2 Straw, &c. investing a criminal who is to be burnt and set on fire. E. कठ, and अग्नि fire.
कटायन: कटायन n. (-नं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
कटार: कटार m. (-रः) A libidinous man, a lecher.
कटाह: कटाह m. (-हः) 1 A shallow boiler for oil or butter. 2 A frying pan. 3 A winnowing basket. 4 A turtle's shell. 5 A young buffalo whose horns are just appearing. 6 A Dvīpa or division of the known continent, so called. 7 Hell, the infernal regions. 8 A well. E. कट much, &c. हन to destroy, with आङ् prefixed, and ड aff.
कटि: कटि mf. (-टिः-टी) 1 The hip. 2 The buttocks. 3 An elephant's cheek. E. कट to go, कि affix, fem. ङीष्; see कट and कटिप्रोथ.
कटितट: कटितट n. (-टं) The loins, the hip. E. कटि, and तट shore.
कटित्र: कटित्र m. (-त्रः) 1 An ornament of small bells worn round the loins. 2 A cloth so worn. 3 Armour for the hip and loins. E. कटि the hip, and त्र what preserves, from त्रै with ड aff.
कटिदेश: कटिदेश m. (-शः) The loins. E. कटि and देश place.
कटिन्: कटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) 1 Matted, screened. 2 Loined, having handsome loins, &c. m. (-टी) An elephant. E. कट an elephant's temples, &c. इनि pos. aff.
कटिप्रोथ: कटिप्रोथ m. (-थः) The buttocks. E. कटि the hip or loins, and प्रोथ to be equal to; also written कटप्रोथ, कटीप्रोथ, and severally कटि and प्रोथ.
कटिरोहक: कटिरोहक m. (-कः) The rider of an elephant, as distinct from the driver, the person that sits upon the loins. E. कटि the loins, रुह to mount, and वुञ् aff.
कटिल्लक: कटिल्लक m. (-कः) A species of the balsam apple, (Momordica charantia.) E. कट to go, &c. इल्ल affix कन् added; also कठिल्लक.
कटिशीर्षक: कटिशीर्षक m. (-कः) The hip and loins, or the hollow above the hip. E. कटि, शीर्ष the head or superior part, कन् aff.
कटिशृङ्खला: कटिशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A girdle of small bells. E. कटि the loins, and शृङ्खला a chain.
कटिसूत्र: कटिसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A female zone or waist-band. E. कटि the loins, and सूत्र a thread.
कटी: कटी f. (-टी) See कटि and कट.
कटीतल: कटीतल m. (-लः) A crooked sword, a sabre or scymitar.
कटीर: कटीर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The cavity of the loins, or the iliac regions. m. (-रः) 1 Mons veneris. 2 A cave. E. कट to go, and ईरन् Uṇādi aff.
कटीरक: कटीरक m. (-कः) The posteriors. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कटु: कटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः or -ट्वी-टु) 1 Pungent. 2 Envious. 3 Fierce, impetuous, hot. 4 Fragrant. 5 Bad scented, ill smelling. 6 Displeasing, disagreeable. m. (-टुः) 1 Pungency or a pungent taste. 2 A flower, (Michelia champaca.) 3 Camphor. 4 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes.) n. (-टु) 1 An improper action, an act which ought not to have been done. 2 Blaming, reviling, scandal. f. (-टुः) 1 The name of a medicinal plant; also कटुका and कटुकी. 2 A plant which bears a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. 3 Mustard. E. कट to go, &c. and उ Uṇādi aff.
कटुक: कटुक m. (-कः-की) 1 A plant, the bark and seed of which have an acrid and bitter taste, and are used in medicine for worms, dysentery, &c. (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 2 Gigantic swallow wort, (Colotropis gigantea.) 3 A fragrant kind of grass. 4 Mustard. 5 A gourd: see पटोल. f. (-का or -की) A medicinal plant, used as a sedative and laxative; also कटुरोहिणी. n. (-कं) A compound of three pungent substances, as black pepper, long pepper, and dry ginger: see त्रिकटु. E. कटु pungent, and कन् aff.
कटुकन्द: कटुकन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) 1 A plant, (Morunga guilandina, and Hyperanthera.) 2 Ginger, the fresh root or the plant. 3 Garlic. E. कटु, and कन्द a root; having a pungent root.
कटुकालावु: कटुकालावु m. (-वुः) A bitter gourd. E. कटुक pungent and acrid, अलावु a gourd.
कटुकीट: कटुकीट m. (-टः) A gnat or musquito. E. कटु, and कीट an insect.
कटुकीटक: कटुकीटक m. (-कः) A gnat or musquito. E. कटु fierce, and कीटक a worm.
कटुक्वाण: कटुक्वाण m. (-णः) A bird, jacana, (Parra goensis.) E. कटु disagreeable, क्वाण sound.
कटुग्रन्थि: कटुग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) Ginger, the root. E. कटु pungent, and ग्रन्थि joint.
कटुच्छद: कटुच्छद m. (-दः) The name of a plant; also तगर. E. कटु, and छद a leaf: having a pungent leaf.
कटुता: कटुता f. (-ता) 1 Pungency, sharpness. 2 Testiness, irritability. E. कटु, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कटुत्वं.
कटुतिक्तिका: कटुतिक्तिका f. (-का) A bitter gourd. E. कटु, and तिक्त bitter, कन् affix with the fem. form.
कटुतुम्बी: कटुतुम्बी f. (-म्बी) See the preceding. E. कटु pungent, here meaning bitterly so, and तुम्बी a gourd.
कटुत्रय: कटुत्रय n. (-यं) The aggregate of three spices, ginger, and long and black pepper. E. कटु, and त्रय three.
कटुनिष्प्लाव: कटुनिष्प्लाव m. (-वः) Grain not inundated. E. कटु, and निष्प्लाव, non-inundation.
कटुपत्र: कटुपत्र m. (-त्रः) A medicinal plant, (Oldenlandia biflora.) E. कटु pungent, and पत्र leaf.
कटुफल: कटुफल m. (-लः) A sort of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. कटु, and फल fruit.
कटुभद्र: कटुभद्र n. (-द्रं) Ginger either fresh or dry. E. कटु, and भद्र auspicious.
कटुर: कटुर n. (-रं) Buttermilk. E. कटु, and रा to give, affix ड.
कटुरव: कटुरव n. (-वः) A frog. E. कटु, and रव sound.
कटुरोहिणी: कटुरोहिणी f. (-णी) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. कटु pungent, and रोहिणी that grows.
कटुवार्ताकी: कटुवार्त्ताकी f. (-की) A variety of solanum. E. कटु, and वार्त्ताकी the egg plant.
कटुवार्त्ताकी: कटुवार्त्ताकी f. (-की) A variety of solanum. E. कटु, and वार्त्ताकी the egg plant.
कटुवीजा: कटुवीजा f. (-जा) Long pepper. E. कटु, and वीज seed.
कटुस्नेह: कटुस्नेह m. (-हः) The mustard seed plant, (Sinapis dichotoma.) E. कटु, and स्नेह oily substance: yielding a pungent oil.
कटूत्कट: कटूत्कट n. (-टं) Ginger. E. कटु, and उत्कट best, and with कन् added कटूत्कटक.
कटोल: कटोल m. (-लः) A man of an inferior and degraded tribe, a Caṇḍāla, a Pariah, &c. 2 A pungent flavour. E. कट to go, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also कटोलक.
कटोलवीणा: कटोलवीणा f. (-णा) A kind of lute played by the common people. E. कटोल a Caṇḍāla, and वीणा a lute.
कट्टार: कट्टार m. (-रः) A weapon, a dagger.
कट्फल: कट्फल m. (-लः) A small tree found in the north-west of Hindustan, the bark and seeds of which are used in medicine, and as aromatics; the fruit also is eaten; the common name is Kayaphal. f. (-ला) 1 A plant, (Gmelina arborea, Rox.) 2 The egg plant, &c. E. कट् instead of कटु acrid, and फल fruit, fem. affix टाप्.
कट्वङ्ग: कट्वङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 A name of DILĪPA a king of Ayodhya. E. कटु pungent, &c. अङ्ग bark, body, &c.
कट्वर: कट्वर n. (-रं) 1 Sauce, condiment. 2 Buttermilk. 3 The skim or whey of curds. E. कट to rain, &c. वरच् aff.
कठ: कठ r. 1st cl. (कठति) To live in distress. (इ) कठि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कण्ठति-ते कण्ठयति) 1 To grieve. 2 To recollect. With उद् prefixed, to regret or miss, to lament, to bewail.

कठ m. (-ठः) 1 The name of a Muni or saint. 2 A note or simple sound. 3 A portion of the Yajur Veda. 4 A Mantra or mystical prayer. 5 A Brahman. 6 A Brahman versed in the Vedas, especially in the Rig Veda. 7 A student of the same. 8 Trouble, distress. f. (-ठी) The wife of a Brahman. E. कठ to be confused, and अप् aff.
कठधूर्त: कठधूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A BRAHMAN skilled in the Kaṭha branch of the Vedas. E. कठ, and धूर्त्त cunning.
कठधूर्त्त: कठधूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A BRAHMAN skilled in the Kaṭha branch of the Vedas. E. कठ, and धूर्त्त cunning.
कठमर्द: कठमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कठ distress, मर्द्द who dissipates.
कठमर्द्द: कठमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कठ distress, मर्द्द who dissipates.
कठर: कठर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard. E. कठ trouble, and र from रा to take or give, affix ड.
कठश्रोत्रिय: कठश्रोत्रिय m. (-यः) A BRAHMAN who has studied the Kaṭha portion of the Vedas. E. कठ, and श्रोत्रिय a BRAHMAN.
कठाध्यापक: कठाध्यापक m. (-कः) A teacher of the Kaṭha portion of the Veda. E. कठ, and अध्यापक a teacher.
कठिञ्जर: कठिञ्जर m. (-रः) A plant worshipped by the Hindus, commonly Tulsi, (Ocymum sanctum, or sacred basil.) E. कठिन hard, and जृ to destroy, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
कठिन: कठिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Hard, solid. 2 Unkind, severe. 3 Paralysed, rendered stiff or rigid. 4 Difficult, obscure. nf. (-नं-ना) An earthen vessel. f. (-ना) A sweetmeat made with refined sugar. (-नी or निका) Chalk. E. कठ to be confounded, and इनच् Uṇādi affix, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्.
कठिनता: कठिनता f. (-ता) 1 Firmness, hardness. 2 Severity. 3 Difficulty, obscurity. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कठिनत्वं.
कठिनपृष्ठ: कठिनपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A tortoise. E. कठिन, and पृष्ठ back; also कठिनपृष्ठक.
कठिनहृदय: कठिनहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Hardhearted, cruel, unkind. E. कठिन, and हृदय the heart.
कठिनान्तःकरण: कठिनान्तःकरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Harsh, cruel, severe. E. कठिन, and अन्तःकरण disposition.
कठिल्ल: कठिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A plant, (Momordica charantia:) see कटिल्ल.
कठिल्लक: कठिल्लक m. (-कः) 1 A plant: see the preceding. 2 A name of Tulasi or holy basil. 3 Hogweed. E. कन् added to the preceding: see कटिल्ल and कटिल्लक.
कठेर: कठेर m. (-रः) A needy or distressed man, a pauper. E. कठ to be distressed, and एरक् Uṇādi aff.
कठोर: कठोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hard, solid. 2 Severe, cruel. 3 Full, complete, full-grown. 4 Full, (as the moon.) E. कठ to be distressed, &c. आरन् Uṇādi affix; also कठोल.
कठोरता: कठोरता f. (-ता) 1 Hardness, firmness. 2 Severity, rigor. E. तल्, added to the preceding; also कठोरत्वं with त्व aff.
कड: कड r. 1st and 6th cls. (कडति) To be confused or disturbed by pleasure or pain, to be proud or mad, (the roots differ in some of the inflections.) (इ) कडि r. 1st cl. (कण्डते) The same as the preceding; also r. 1st and 10th cls. (कण्डति, कण्डयति) 1 To break off a part, to tear, to separate or detach. 2 To remove the chaff or husk of grain, &c. 3 To preserve.
कड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Ignorant, stupid. E. कड to be perplexed, अच् aff.
कडक: कडक n. (-कं) Sea salt obtained by evaporation. E. कड to separate, वुन् aff.
कडङ्कर: कडङ्कर m. (-रः) Straw, the stalks of various sorts of pulse, &c. E. कड made, कृ to make, खच् affix; also कडङ्गर.
कडङ्करीय: कडङ्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be fed with straw. E. कडङ्कर, and छ affix; also with यत्, कडङ्कर्प्य; and from कडङ्ग, कडङ्गरीय.
कडङ्ग: कडङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A spirituous liquor, a kind of rum. E. कड to be intoxicated, अङ्ग aff.
कडङ्गर: कडङ्गर m. (-रः) Straw, chaff. E. कड, रक affix, अङ्गच् inserted.
कडत्र: कडत्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel. E. गड to distil, अत्रन् Uṇādi affix, and क substituted for ग; also कलत्र.
कडम्ब: कडम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 The stalk of a potherb. 2 The end or point. E. कड to separate, &c. अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.
कडम्बी: कडम्बी f. (-म्बी) A potherb, (Convolvulus repens:) see कलम्बी.
कडार: कडार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Tawny. m. (-रः) 1 Tawny, (the colour.) 2 A servant. E. कड to be confused, आरण् aff.
कडितुल: कडितुल m. (-लः) A sword, a scymitar, a sacrificial knife.
कड्ड: कड्ड r. 1st cl. (कड्डति) To be rough, to be harsh or severe: the pen. is originally द.
कण: कण (म) r. 1st cl. (कणति) 1 To sound. 2 To cry as in distress. (ऋ) कण r. 1st cl. (कणति) To go or approach. r. 10th cl.  (कणयति) To wink, to cover or close the eye with the lids or lashes.

कण mf. (-णः-णी or -णिका) 1 Small, minute. 2 An atom, a minute particle. m. (-णः) 1 An eye of corn. 2 The spark or facet of a gem. 3 A spark of fire. 4 A drop of water, &c. f. (-णा) 1 Cummin seed. 2 Long pepper. 3 A kind of fly, (कुम्भीरमक्षिका) the crocodile fly? E. कण to contract, अच् affix fem. टाप् or ङीष्.
कणजीर: कणजीर n. (-रः) A white kind of cummin seed. E. कण small, and जीर cummin.
कणजीरक: कणजीरक n. (-कं) Small cummin seed. E. कण minute, and जीरक cummin.
कणभक्षक: कणभक्षक m. (-कः) A kind of bird. E. कण pepper, and भक्षक who eats.
कणाटीन: कणाटीन m. (-नः) A wagtail. E. कण little, अट to go, and ईनच् aff.
कणाटीर: कणाटीर m. (-रः) A wagtail; also कणाटीरक.
कणाद: कणाद n. (-दः) 1 The name of a Muni, also called Kaśyapa: the author of the Vaiśeṣika philosophy. 2 A goldsmith. E. कण a little, and अद to eat, referring to the abstemiousness of the saint; or आदा to take, alluding to the proverbial dishonesty of the artificer.
कणिक: कणिक m. (-कः) 1 A small particle, as a crystal, an eye of corn, &c. 2 An enemy. 3 Whirling round a set of lamps at sacrificial ceremonies. 4 The heart of wheat, commonly Suji, sharps or semoule. f. (-का) 1 An atom, a small particle. 2 Small, minute: see कण. 3 A plant, (Premna spinosa:) see गणिकारिका. 4 A kind of rice. E. कण small, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted, fem. affix टाप्.
कणित: कणित n. (-तं) A cry or sound uttered through pain. E. कण to sound, affix क्त.
कणिश: कणिश n. (-शं) An ear or spike of corn. E. कण small, &c. affix श.
कणीक: कणीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Small, diminutive. E. कण to be small, ईकन् Uṇādi affix; it is also written कनीक, and कणिक.
कणीचि: कणीचि f. (-चिः) 1 A creeper in flower. 2 A cart. 3 The Abrus precatorius. E. कण to wink, ईचि Uṇādi aff.
कणीयस्: कणीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very small. 2 Young, younger. E. कण small, and ईयसुन् superlative affix; also कनीयस्.
कणेर: कणेर m. (-रः) A tree, (Cascaria ovata, &c.) f. (-रा) 1 A courtezan. 2 A she-elephant. E. कण to go, एर affix, or with एरु affix अणेरु.
कण्टक: कण्टक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A thorn. 2 A paltry foe. 3 A fish bone. 4 Horripilation, or the erection of the hair of the body. 5 Any annoyance or source of vexation. 6 A term in the Nyāya philosophy, implying refutation of argument, detection of error, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A workshop, a manufactory. 2 Fault, defect. 3 The point of a pin or needle. 4 A fish or marine monster, the symbol of KĀMADEVA: see मकर. 5 A bamboo. E. कटि to divide, वुन् aff.
कण्टकद्रुम: कण्टकद्रुम m. (-मः) The Śālmali or silk cotton tree. E. कण्टक, and द्रम a tree.
कण्टकफल: कण्टकफल m. (-लः) 1 The Jaka or bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) 2 Another plant: see गोक्षुर. 3 The castor oil tree. 4 The Datura. E. कण्टक a spike, and फल fruit; the term is applicable to any plant, the fruit of which is invested with a hairy or thorny coat; also कण्टकिफल.
कण्टकभुज्: कण्टकभुज् m. (-भुक्) A camel. E. कण्टक, and भुज who eats.
कण्टकमर्द्दन: कण्टकमर्द्दन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 What treads down or extracts thorns. 2 What bridles or suppresses disturbances, annoyances, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Beating down thorns. 2 Suppressing disturbances, &c. E. कण्टक, and मर्द्दन trampling on.
कण्टकश्रेणी: कण्टकश्रेणी f. (-णी) A porcupine. E. कण्टक, and श्रेणी a row.
कण्टकागार: कण्टकागार m. (-रः) A porcupine. E. कण्टक, and आगार a house.
कण्टकारिका: कण्टकारिका f. (-का) A sort of prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. कण्टक a thorn, ऋ to go, अण् affix, कन् added with the feminine termination; also कण्टकारी.
कण्टकारी: कण्टकारी f. (-री) 1 A prickly nightshade: see the preceding. 2 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 3 Another plant, commonly Buïñchi, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) E. as before.
कण्टकाल: कण्टकाल m. (-लः) 1 The bread-fruit tree or Jaka: see कण्टकफल. 2 A species of the coral tree, (Erythrina Indica.) E. कण्टक a thorn, आला to take, affix ड.
कण्टकाशन: कण्टकाशन m. (-नः) A camel. E. कण्टक, and अशन food; whose food is of thorns, thistles, &c.; also कण्टकभुज्, &c.
कण्टकाष्ठील: कण्टकाष्ठील m. (-लः) A kind of fish, one which has many bones. E. कण्टक, अस्थि a bone, and ईलच् aff.
कण्टकिज: कण्टकिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Produced from a fish. 2 Borne by the mimosa tree. E. कण्टकिन. and ज born.
कण्टकिन्: कण्टकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) 1 Thorny, prickly. 2 Vexatious, annoying. m. (-की) 1 A fish. 2 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.) 3 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4 A bamboo. 5 The jujube. E. कण्टक a thorn or small bone, and इनि poss. aff.
कण्टकिफल: कण्टकिफल m. (-लः) The Indian bread fruit tree or Jaka, (Artocarpus integrifolia:) see कण्टकफल; also कण्टकीफल.
कण्टकिल: कण्टकिल m. (-लः) A thorny kind of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa, Rox.)
कण्टकोद्धरण: कण्टकोद्धरण n. (-णं) 1 Weeding, extracting thorns, &c. 2 Removing annoyances. 3 Extirpating thieves, rogues, &c. or all national or public nuisances. E. कण्टक, and उद्धरण extracting.
कण्टपत्र: कण्टपत्र m. (-त्रः) A plant, commonly Buïñchi, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) and कण्टपत्रक.
कण्टफल: कण्टफल m. (-लः) 1 The jack tree. 2 The Datura plant. 3 The castor oil plant. E. कण्ट for कण्टक a thorn or spike, फल fruit: see कण्टकफल.
कण्टल: कण्टल m. (-लः) The Babul, a tree yielding a species of gum arabic, (Acacia Arabica.) the branches are prickly, whence the name. E. कण्ट for कण्टक a thorn, and ल from ला to take or have.
कण्टाफल: कण्टाफल m. (-लः) The Jaca or Jack tree: see कण्टकफल.
कण्ठ: कण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा) or -ण्ठी-ण्ठं 1 The throat. 2 Sound, especially guttural sound. 3 Near, proximate. m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) 2 The space of an inch from the edge of the hole in which sacrificial fire is deposited. f. (-ण्ठी) 1 A rope or leather round the neck of a horse. 2 A necklace, a collar. E. कण to sound, ठ Uṇādi affix, fem. Affix. टाप् or ङीष्.
कण्ठकूणिका: कण्ठकूणिका f. (-का) The Vīṇā or Indian lute. E. कण्ठ the throat, कूण to sound, and ठक् affix; sounding like the larynx.
कण्ठग: कण्ठग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Extending to the throat or swallow. E. कण्ठ, and ग what goes.
कण्ठतलासिका: कण्ठतलासिका f. (-का) The leather or rope passing round the neck of a horse.
कण्ठनीलक: कण्ठनीलक m. (-कः) A torch, a whisp of lighted straw, &c.
कण्ठपाशक: कण्ठपाशक m. (-कः) 1 A halter. 2 A rope passing round an elephant's neck. E. कण्ठ, and पाशक a fetter.
कण्ठभूषा: कण्ठभूषा f. (-षा) A collar or short necklace. E. कण्ठ the throat, and भूषा an ornament.
कण्ठमणि: कण्ठमणि m. (-णिः) A jewel worn on the throat. E. कण्ठ, and मणि a gem.
कण्ठलग्न: कण्ठलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Fastened or suspended round the throat. 2 Clinging to, embracing. E. कण्ठ, and लग्न attached to.
कण्ठलता: कण्ठलता f. (-ता) 1 A collar. 2 A horse's halter. E. कण्ठ, and लता a creeper.
कण्ठसज्जन: कण्ठसज्जन n. (-नं) Hanging on or round the throat. E. कण्ठ, and सज्जन equipping.
कण्ठस्थ: कण्ठस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Sticking in the throat. 2 Being in or upon the throat. 3 Guttural. 4 Having by rote, ready to repeat. E. कण्ठ, and स्थ what stays.
कण्ठागत: कण्ठागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come in to the throat, (breath, &c.) E. कण्ठ, and आगत come.
कण्ठाग्नि: कण्ठाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A bird. E. कण्ठ, and अग्नि fire, and figuratively digestive faculty; digesting in the throat or gizzard.
कण्ठाल: कण्ठाल m. (-लः) 1 A boat. 2 A hoe, a spade. 3 War. 4 An esculent root, (Arum.) 5 A camel. f. (-ला) A churning vessel. E. कण्ठ the throat, अल to ornament, &c. अच् aff.
कण्ठावसक्त: कण्ठावसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Embracing, clinging to the neck. E. कण्ठ, and अवसक्त fastened to.
कण्ठिका: कण्ठिका f. (-का) A necklace of one string or row. E. कण्ठी and कन् aff.
कण्ठीरव: कण्ठीरव m. (-वः) 1 A lion. 2 An elephant in rut. 3 A pigeon. E. कण्ठ the throat, and रव sound.
कण्ठेकाल: कण्ठेकाल m. (-लः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कण्ठे in the throat, काल black, black-necked; see नीलकण्ठ.
कण्ठ्य: कण्ठ्य mfn. (-ण्ठ्यः-ण्ठ्या-ण्ठ्यं) Guttural, belonging to the throat, pronounced from the throat, &c. E. कण्ठ and यत् aff.
कण्डन: कण्डन n. (-नं) Threshing, separating the chaff from grain. f. (-नी) A wooden bowl or mortar, in which the cleaning or threshing of grain is performed. E. कडि to divide, ल्युट् affix, fem. do. ङीष्.
कण्डरा: कण्डरा f. (-रा) A principal vessel of the body, a large artery, vein, &c. E. कडि to divide, अरन् aff.
कण्डु: कण्डु f. (-ण्डुः) 1 The itch, itching. 2 Scratching: see कण्डू.
कण्डू: कण्डू n. (ञ्) कण्डूञ् Sautra root, (कण्डूयति-ते) 1 To itch. 2 To scratch.
कण्डू f. (-ण्डूः) 1 The itch, itching. 2 Scratching. E. कण्डूञ् to itch, affix क्विप्; also with the final short, कण्डु.
कण्डूकरी: कण्डूकरी f. (-री) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. कण्डू itching, and कर what makes, ङीप् aff.
कण्डूघ्न: कण्डूघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Cassia, (fistula.) E. कण्डू, and घ्न what destroys.
कण्डूति: कण्डूति f. (-तिः) 1 Itching, the itch. 2 Scratching. E. कण्डू and क्तिन् affix; also कण्डू, कण्डूयन, &c.
कण्डूयत्: कण्डूयत् mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत्) Scratching, rubbing. E. कण्डू to itch, शतृ aff.
कण्डूयन: कण्डूयन n. (-नं) 1 Itching. 2 Scratching; also कण्डूया and कण्डू. E. as before, affixes यक् and ल्युट्.
कण्डूयनक: कण्डूयनक m. (-कः) A tickler, one who tickles or scratches. E. कण्डूयन and क who makes.
कण्डूया: कण्डूया f. (-या) 1 Itching. 2 Scratching. E. कण्डू to itch, affixes यक् and टाप्.
कण्डूरा: कण्डूरा f. (-रा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. कण्डू itching, and रा what makes, from रा to take or give, affixes क and टाप; alluding to the irritating property of the leaves of this plant.
कण्डूल: कण्डूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Itchy, having the itch. m. (-लः) A esculent root, (Arum.) E. कण्डू and ला to have, ड aff.
कण्डोल: कण्डोल m. (-लः) 1 A basket, a safe, any place in which provisions are kept. 2 A camel. E. कडि to divide, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added कण्डोलक.
कण्डोलक: कण्डोलक m. (-कः) A safe, a store room: see the preceding.
कण्डोलवीणा: कण्डोलवीणा f. (-णा) A vulgar lute. E. कण्डोल here implying a Cāṇḍāla, and वीणा the Vīṇā or Indian lute; also कटोलवीणा and कण्डोली.
कण्ड्वोघ: कण्ड्वोघ m. (-घः) A caterpillar. E. कण्डु itching, and ओघ an abode.
कण्व: कण्व m. (-ण्वः) The name of a celebrated Muni or saint. n. (-ण्वं) Sin. E. कण to sound, क्वन् Uṇādi aff.
कत: कत m. (-तः) 1 The name of a Muni or saint. 2 The clearing nut plant. E. कै to sound, अत Uṇādi aff.
कतक: कतक m. (-कः) The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum:) one of the seeds of this plant being rubbed upon the inside of the water jars used in Bengal, occasions a precipitation of the earthy particles diffused through the water.
कतम: कतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Which, (of many.) E. किम् and डतमच् aff.
कतमाल: कतमाल m. (-लः) A name of AGNI or fire; this word is perhaps a corruption: see कचमाल and खतमाल.
कतर: कतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Which, (of two,) whether. E. किम् and डतरच् aff.
कति: कति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 How many. 2 How much. E. किम् what, and डति aff.
कतिचित्: कतिचित् ind. 1 In any way, in some way. 2 For some time. E. कति how many, and चित् aff.
कतिथ: कतिथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) What, how much. E. थुक् added to कति.
कतिपय: कतिपय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 How many. 2 A certain number, so many.
कतिपयथ: कतिपयथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) What, how much. E. थक् added to कतिपयथ.
कतिविध: कतिविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Of how many sorts. 2 Of various kinds. E. कति, and विध sort.
कत्तृण: कत्तृण n. (-णं) 1 A fragrant grass. 2 A plant, commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) E. कत् for कुत् bad, तृण grass.
कत्तोय: कत्तोय n. (-यं) Wine or vinous spirit. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and तोय water.
कत्थ: कत्थ r. 1st cl. (कत्थते) 1 To praise or celebrate. 2 To flatter or coax. 3 To boast.
कत्र: कत्र r. 10th cl. (कत्रयति) To loosen, to slacken, to remove.
कत्सवर: कत्सवर n. (-रं) The shoulder, the shoulder blade.
कथ: कथ r. 10th cl. (कथयति) To speak, to tell.
कथक: कथक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A narrator, a relator, one who recites a story, or who publicly reads and expounds the Purāṇas, &c. 2 One who speaks or tells. mf. (-कः-का) The speaker of a prologue or a monologue. 2 A professional story teller. E. कथ to speak, to relate, वुन् aff.
कथङ्कथिक: कथङ्कथिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An interrogant, one who asks or questions. E. कथम् how, कथ to speak, ठक् aff.
कथङ्कथिकता: कथङ्कथिकता f. (-ता) A question, asking, enquiring. E. तल् affix of the abstract added to the preceding.
कथङ्कथित: कथङ्कथित m. (-तः) An interrogant, one who questions. E. कथम् how, कथित said.
कथञ्चन: कथञ्चन ind. In some way, in any way, by any means. E. कथम् and चन aff.
कथञ्चित्: कथञ्चित् ind. In any way, by some means or other. E. कथम् and चित् aff.
कथन: कथन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Talkative. n. (-नं) Saying, narrating, relating. E. कथ to say, &c. युच् or ल्युट् aff.
कथनीय: कथनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be said, to be told or declared. E. कथ to tell, अनीयर् affix; also with तव्य, कथितव्य, and with यत्, कथ्य.
कथन्ता: कथन्ता f. (-ता) Enquiry, question, demand. E. कथ to speak, भश् aff.
कथम्: कथम् ind. 1 A particle of interrogation, (how, what.) 2 Also implying mode, (how, in what manner.) 3 A particle of amazement or surprise, 4 Of pleasure, 5 Of abuse, 6 Of interrogation, implying doubt. E. किम् what, and थमु aff.
कथा: कथा f. (-था) A feigned story, a tale or fable. E. कथ to tell, &c. अङ् and टाप् affs.
कथानुराग: कथानुराग m. (-गः) Attention, taking pleasure in a discourse. E. कथा, and अनुराग inclination.
कथाप्रबन्ध: कथाप्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) A narrative, a tale, a fiction. E. कथा, and प्रबन्ध connexion.
कथाप्रसङ्ग: कथाप्रसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Talkative, talking much and foolishly. 2 Half-witted, foolish. 3 A conjuror, a dealer in antidotes, &c. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Talking, conversation, speaking to or with. 2 Rumour, report. E. कथा a fable, and प्रसङ्ग who relates.
कथाप्राण: कथाप्राण m. (-णः) 1 An actor, the speaker of a prologue or monologue, the introducer or a drama. 2 A professed story teller. E. कथा, and प्राण life, livelihood.
कथायोग: कथायोग m. (-गः) Conversation, talk, discourse. E. कथा, and योग uniting.
कथारम्भ: कथारम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Narration, narrative, story telling. 2 Beginning of a story. E. कथा, and आरम्भ beginning, &c.
कथाविरक्त: कथाविरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Reserved, taciturn, disliking conversation. E. कथा, and विरक्त disliking.
कथासंग्रह: कथासंग्रह m. (-हः) A collection of tales or fables. E. कथा, and संग्रह collection.
कथिक: कथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A story teller by profession, a narrator, a relator. E. कथा a tale, and ठक् aff.
कथित: कथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, told, related. E. कथ to tell, क्त aff.
कथितपद: कथितपद n. (-दं) Repetition, tautology. E. कथित said, पद a word.
कथोद्घात: कथोद्घात m. (-तः) The opening of a drama, by the character that first enters overhearing and repeating the last words of the prelude. E. कथा, and उद्घात beginning.
कथोपकथन: कथोपकथन m. (-नं) 1 Conversation, conference. 2 Narration. E. कथा, and उपकथन speaking.
कथोपाख्यान: कथोपाख्यान n. (-नं) Narration, narrative, relation, telling a story. E. कथा, and उपाख्यान telling.
कथ्य: कथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) To be spoken or said. E. कथ and यत् aff.
कद: कद or (-इ.) कदि r. 1st cl. (कदते and कन्दते) 1 To be confused, to suffer mentally, to grieve. 2 To confound. 3 To kill or hurt; also कदि, (कंदति) 1 To call. 2 To cry or shed tears.
कद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. क water, and द what gives.
कदक: कदक m. (-कः) An awning. E. कद a cloud, and क what makes; yielding a shade as a cloud; also fem. कदका and कदकी.
कदक्षर: कदक्षर n. (-रं) A bad letter. E. कत् for कुत् and अक्षर a letter.
कदध्वन्: कदध्वन् m. (-ध्वा) A bad road. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and अध्वन a road.
कदन: कदन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, destroying. 2 Sin. 3 War. E. कद to kill or injure, affix ल्युट्.
कदन्न: कदन्न n. (-न्नं) Bad food. E. कत् for कुत् bad, अन्न food.
कदम्ब: कदम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A plant, commonly Kadamba (Nauclea kadamba.) 2 The mustard seed plant, (Sinapis dichotoma.) 3 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratum:) see देवताडक. 4 Turmeric. n. (-म्बं) A multitude, an assemblage or collection. E. कद to confound, &c. अम्बच् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added कदम्बक.
कदम्बद: कदम्बद m. (-दः) Mustard seed plant: it seems to be a variety of reading for कदम्बक, q. v.
कदम्बपुष्पी: कदम्बपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, the flowers, of which resemble those of the Kadamba, commonly called Muṇḍīrī. E. कदम्ब, and पुष्प a flower, fem. affix ङीष्; also with टाप्, कदम्बपुष्पा.
कदम्बवायु: कदम्बवायु m. (-युः) A fragrant breeze. E. कदम्ब the plant, and वायु wind.
कदम्बानिल: कदम्बानिल m. (-लः) 1 A fragrant breeze. 2 Spring. E. कदम्ब, and अनिल wind.
कदर: कदर m. (-रः) 1 A white sort of mimosa. 2 A corn, a callosity. 3 A saw. 4 An iron goad for an elephant. n. (-रं) Coagulated milk. E. क water, &c. दृ to tear, अच् aff.
कदर्थ: कदर्थ (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Useless. 2 Unmeaning. E. कत् for कुत्, and अर्थ object.
कदर्थित: कदर्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Despised, disdained, rejected. 2 Rendered useless. E. कत् for कुत् bad, अर्थित sought.
कदर्थीकृत: कदर्थीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Despised, disdained. 2 Rendered useless and unavailing. E. कदर्थ and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
कदर्य: कदर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Avaricious, miserly. 2 Little, insignificant, mean. 3 Bad, disagreeable. m. (-र्य्यः) A miser. E. कत् bad, vile, and अर्य्य possessor.
कदर्य्य: कदर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Avaricious, miserly. 2 Little, insignificant, mean. 3 Bad, disagreeable. m. (-र्य्यः) A miser. E. कत् bad, vile, and अर्य्य possessor.
कदर्यत्व: कदर्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Avarice. 2 Insignificance. 3 Badness. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, कदर्य्यता.
कदर्य्यत्व: कदर्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Avarice. 2 Insignificance. 3 Badness. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, कदर्य्यता.
कदल: कदल mf. (-लः-ली) 1 The plaintain tree, (Musa sapientum.) 2 Another plant, (Pistia stratiotes:) see पृष्णी. f. (-ला) The silk cotton tree; also (-ली-लिका) 1 A kind of deer, the hide of  which is used as a seat, &c. 2 A flag, a banner. 3 A flag carried by an elephant. E. क water, air, &c. दल to pierce, to divide, &c. affix अच्, and टाप् or ङीष् fem. aff.
कदलक: कदलक m. (-कः) The plaintain or banana tree: see the preceding. E. कन् added to कदल.
कदलीक्षता: कदलीक्षता f. (-ता) 1 A sort of cucumber. 2 A fine woman.
कदश्व: कदश्व m. (-श्वः) A hack, a bad horse. E. कत् for कुत्, and अश्व a horse.
कदा: कदा ind. When, at what time. E. किम् what, दा aff.
कदाकार: कदाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Ill formed, ugly. E. कत् for कुत्, and आकार form.
कदाख्य: कदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) A plant, commonly Kurh or Kudh, (Costus speciosus.) E. कत् bad, आख्या name, ill named: having a bad name or reputation.
कदाचन: कदाचन ind. Sometime or other, ever; नकदाचन never.
कदाचार: कदाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wicked, abandoned, following evil practices. E. कत् for कुत्, आचार observance.
कदाचित्: कदाचित् ind. Sometimes, at sometime or other, ever; नकदाचित् never.
कदापि: कदापि ind. Sometimes, now and then. E. कदा when, अपि certainly.
कदुष्ण: कदुष्ण mfn. (ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Tepid, warm. n. (-ष्णं) Warmth, gentle warmth. E. कत् instead of कुत् bad, inferior, उष्ण heat.
कद्रु: कद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) Tawny. f. (-द्रुः) The wife of KAŚYAPA the saint, and mother of the Nāgas or the serpent race, inhabiting the regions below the earth. m. (-द्रुः) Tawny, (the colour.) E. कभ to desire, डु affix, and र inserted; the final of the radical is irregularly changed to द; fem. affix ऊञ्.
कद्रुपुत्र: कद्रुपुत्र m. (-त्रः) A serpent. E. पुत्र a son, joined to the preceding; also other compounds of similar import, as कद्रुसुत, &c.
कद्रुसुत: कद्रुसुत m. (-तः) A serpent: see the preceding.
कद्वद: कद्वद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Speaking ill, inaccurately, indistinctly, &c. 2 Vile, base, contemptible. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and वद who speaks.
कन: कन (इ ञि) ञिकनी r. 1st cl. (कनति) 1 To shine. 2 To desire or love. 3 To go or approach.
कनक: कनक n. (-कं) Gold. m. (-कः) 1 The name of a tree which bears red flowers, (Butea frondosa:) see पलाश. 2 Thorn apple, (Datura metel, &c) 3 Another plant, (Mesua ferrea:) see नागकेशर. 4 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) see काञ्चनाल. 5 A black sort of agallochum. 6 A shrub yielding a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) E. कन to shine, अक Uṇādi aff.
कनकक्षार: कनकक्षार m. (-रः) Borax. E. कनक, and क्षार flux.
कनकटङ्क: कनकटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A golden hatchet. E. कनक, and टङ्क a hatchet.
कनकदण्डक: कनकदण्डक n. (-कं) The royal parasol. E. कनक gold, दण्ड a staff, and कन् affix; golden-sticked.
कनकपराग: कनकपराग m. (-गः) Gold dust. E. कनक, and पराग pollen.
कनकपल: कनकपल m. (-लः) A Pala, a weight of gold and silver equal to sixteen Māṣas, or about 280 grains troy: see पल. E. कनक, and पल a Pala.
कनकभङ्ग: कनकभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A piece of gold. E. कनक, भङ्ग what is broken off.
कनकमय: कनकमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden, consisting or made of gold. E. कनक and मयट् aff.
कनकरस: कनकरस m. (-सः) Yellow orpiment. E. कनक, and रस juice.
कनकसूत्र: कनकसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A gold cord. E. कनक, and सूत्र string.
कनकस्थली: कनकस्थली f. (-ली) A gold mine, golden soil. E. कनक, and स्थल place.
कनकाचल: कनकाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Sumeru. E. कनक, and अचल a mountain; the golden mountain.
कनकाध्यक्ष: कनकाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The treasurer or superintendant of the gold. E. कनक, and अध्यक्ष a superintendant.
कनकालुका: कनकालुका f. (-का) A golden jar or vase. E. कनक, आलु a water jar, कन् and टाप् added.
कनकाह्व: कनकाह्व m. (-ह्वः) A tree with golden or yellow blossoms, (Mesua ferrea.) E. कनक, and आह्वा appellation.
कनन: कनन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) One-eyed. E. कन to shine, युच् aff.
कनिष्ठ: कनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Small, little. 2 Younger, younger born. 3 Young. f. (-ष्ठा) The little finger. E. कन् to shine, &c. and इष्ठच् affix, or कण small, the ण being changed, or कन substituted for युवन् and अल्प.
कनिष्ठता: कनिष्ठता f. (-ता) The state of being younger or smaller. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कनिष्ठत्वं.
कनी: कनी f. (-नी) A girl, a maiden. E. कन to shine, अच् and ङीष् affs.
कनीक: कनीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Very small: see कणिक.
कनीचि: कनीचि f. (-चिः) 1 A creeping plant which bears flowers. 2 The Gunja, a shrub bearing a red and black berry, (Abrus precatorios.) 3 A cart. E. कनी to shine, ईचि Uṇādi affix; also according to some कणीचि.
कनीनक: कनीनक m. (-कः) The caruncula lacrymalis. f. (-निका) 1 The pupil of the eye. 2 The little finger. E. कन to shine, ईकन् affix, कन added; also with ङीष् only कनीनी.
कनीनी: कनीनी f. (-नी) 1 The little finger. 2 The pupil of the eye.
कनीयस्: कनीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very young, youngest. 2 Very small, least. 3 Younger born, a younger brother or sister. E. कण small, ईयसुन् affix, the ण being changed; or कन to shine, &c.: or कन substituted for युवन् and अल्प.
कनीयस: कनीयस n. (-सं) Copper. E. कन to shine, ईयसच् aff.
कनेर: कनेर f. (-रा) 1 A female elephant. 2 A harlot.
कन्त: कन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Happy. E. कं and त aff.
कन्ति: कन्ति mfn. (-न्तिः-न्तिः-न्ति) Happy. E. कम् and ति aff.
कन्तु: कन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) Happy. m. (-न्तुः) 1 KĀMADEVA, the deity of love. 2 The heart, as the seat or faculty of perception and feeling. E. कम to desire, तु Uṇādi affix; or कं and तु possessive aff.
कन्था: कन्था f. (-न्था) 1 A rag, a patched cloth or garment, a quilt of grass. 2 A wall: this word in composition may be used as neuter, if the compound imply a town in the province of Usināra, as सोसिमकन्थं.
कन्थाधारण: कन्थाधारण n. (-णं) Wearing a garment of patch-work, the practice of some Yogis. E. कन्था, and धारण wearing.
कन्थाधारिन्: कन्थाधारिन् mf. (-री) A Yogi, a religious mendicant. E. कन्था, and धारिन् who wears.
कन्द: कन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) 1 A bulbous or tuberous root. 2 One of an esculent sort, (Arum campanulatum.) 3 Garlic. m. (-न्दः) 1 A cloud. 2 An affection of the feminine organ, considered as a fleshy excrescence, but apparently prolapsus uteri. E. कदि to wet, &c. अच् affix, or कं water, and दा to give.
कन्दट: कन्दट n. (-टं) The white esculent water lily.
कन्दमूल: कन्दमूल n. (-लं) A radish. E. कन्द, and मूल root.
कन्दर: कन्दर mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) 1 An artificial or natural cave. 2 A glen, a defile, a valley. m. (-रः) A hook for driving an elephant with. n. (-रं) Dry ginger. E. क water, or the head, and दृ to divide, to pierce, अप् aff.
कन्दराकर: कन्दराकर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. कन्दर a cave, आकर having, making.
कन्दराल: कन्दराल m. (-लः) A plant, (Hibiscus populneoides.) 2 A species of fig tree, (Ficus venosa:) see प्लक्ष. 3 The walnut tree. E. कन्दरा a cave, and लक्ष् affix; growing in desolate places: also with कन् added, कन्दरालक.
कन्दरालक: कन्दरालक m. (-कः) A species of fig tree: see the preceding.
कन्दर्प: कन्दर्प m. (-र्पः) A name of the deity KĀMA, the CUPID of the Hindu mythology. E. कं BRAHMĀ, दर्प to inflame, अच् affix; the inflamer even of the first of the gods; corresponding in this respect with his Grecian prototype. f. (-र्पा) One of the presiding female deities of the Jainas.
कन्दर्पज्वर: कन्दर्पज्वर m. (-रः) Passion, desire. E. कन्दर्प, and ज्वर fever.
कन्दल: कन्दल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 The cheek, or the cheek and temple. 2 A portent, a natural phoenomenon supposed to announce evil. 3 A new shoot or spring. 4 A low minute tone. 5 Reproach, censure. m. (-लः) 1 Gold. 2 War, battle. f. (-ली) 1 A species of deer of which the hide is used. 2 A sort of tree, the banana: see कदली. 3 A flag. E. कन्द a root, &c. and ल from ला to take, fem. affix ङीप्.
कन्दलित: कन्दलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Budden, blown. 2 Put forth, emitted. E. कन्दल a bud, इतच् aff.
कन्दवर्द्धन: कन्दवर्द्धन m. (-नः) An esculent root. E. कन्द, and वर्द्धन increasing.
कन्दशूरण: कन्दशूरण m. (-णः) A sort of Arum, (A. campanulatum.) E. कन्द, and शूरण the same.
कन्दसंज्ञ: कन्दसंज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Prolapsus uteri, see कन्द. E. कन्द a root, and संज्ञा a name, affix ड; every संज्ञा or name for a bulbous root, being a term for this complaint.
कन्दसार: कन्दसार n. (-रं) The garden or grove of INDRA.
कन्दालु: कन्दालु m. (-लुः) An esculent root, a sort of Arum.
कन्दिन्: कन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Having a bulbous root. m. (-न्दी) A sort of Arum, (A. campanulatum, or any similar bulb.) E. कन्द and इनि aff.
कन्दु: कन्दु mfn. (-न्दुः-न्दुः-न्दु) 1 A boiler, a saucepan or other cooking utensil of iron. 2 An oven or vessel serving for one. E. स्कन्द to go, उ Uṇādi affix, and the initial स rejected.
कन्दुक: कन्दुक m. (-कः) A ball of wood or pith for playing with. n. (-कं) A germ. E. कदि to cry, to call, &c. उ affix, and कन् added.
कन्दुपक्व: कन्दुपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Parched, roasted, (as grain,) fried, &c. dressed without water. E. कन्दु, and पक्व dressed.
कन्दोट: कन्दोट m. (-टः) The white esculent water lily. n. (-टं) The blue lotus.
कन्ध: कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A cloud. E. कं water, and ध from धा to have.
कन्धर: कन्धर mf. (-रः-रा) The neck. m. (-रः) A cloud. E. कं water or the head, and धर having, from धृञ्, affix खच्.
कन्धि: कन्धि m. (-न्धिः) The ocean. f. (-न्धिः) The neck. E. क water or the head, धा to have, कि aff.
कन्न: कन्न n. (-न्नं) Fainting, falling in a fit or state of insensibility: in some copies this word is read कल्ल.
कन्यका: कन्यका f. (-का) 1 A girl, a maiden. 2 A daughter. 3 The Socotrine aloe, (Aloes perfoliata.) E. कन्या A girl, कन् pleonastic affix, fem. affix, टाप्: see कन्या and कन्याका.
कन्यकाच्छल: कन्यकाछल n. (-लं) Beguiling a maiden, seduction, betrayal. E. कन्यका, and छल deceit.
कन्यकाछल: कन्यकाछल n. (-लं) Beguiling a maiden, seduction, betrayal. E. कन्यका, and छल deceit.
कन्यकाजात: कन्यकाजात m. (-तः) The son of an unmarried woman. E. कन्यका, and जात born.
कन्यकापति: कन्यकापति m. (-तिः) A daughter's husband. E. कन्यका, and पति a husband.
कन्यस: कन्यस m. (-सः) 1 A younger brother. f. (-सा) The little finger: see कनिष्ठ.
कन्या: कन्या f. (-म्पा) 1 A girl nine years old, a virgin. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 The sign of the zodiac, Virgo. 4 The socotrine aloe (Aloe perfoliata.) 6 Large cardamoms. 6 A species of metre of four lines, with four syllables in each. 7 A parasite plant. E. कन to shine, Uṇādi affix यक्, fem. टाप्.
कन्याका: कन्याका f. (-का) A young girl or virgin: see कन्या and कन्यका.
कन्याकुब्ज: कन्याकुब्ज m. (-ब्जः) Kanyākubja or Kinnoge, an ancient city of great note, in the north of Hindustan, known to classical geography as Canogyza: the name also applies to its dependencies or the surrounding district; also कान्यकुब्ज. E. कन्या a girl, and कुब्ज round-shouldered, crooked; the etymology alludes to a legend relating to the one hundred daughters of KUŚANĀBHA the king of this city, who were all rendered crooked by Vāyu, for non-compliance with his licentious desires.
कन्याग्रहण: कन्याग्रहण n. (-णं) Taking a girl in marriage. E. कन्या, and ग्रहण taking.
कन्याट: कन्याट m. (-टः) The middle of a house; the inner or private apartments. E. कन्या a girl, अट to go, and अच् aff.
कन्यादान: कन्यादान n. (-नं) 1 Giving a girl in marriage. 2 Receiving the same. E. कन्या, and दान gift, or आदान acceptance.
कन्यादातृ: कन्यादातृ m. (-ता) A father, one who gives a girl in marriage. E. कन्या, and दातृ donor.
कन्यादूषक: कन्यादूषक m. (-कः) 1 A violator or defiler of a virgin. 2 A calumniator of a girl. E. कन्या, and टूषक who defiles; also कन्यादूषिन् (-षी.)
कन्यादूषण: कन्यादूषण n. (-णं) 1 Defiling a virgin. 2 Calumniating a girl. E. कन्या, and दूषण spoiling.
कन्यादोष: कन्यादोष m. (-षः) A blemish in a virgin, disease, bad repute, &c. E. कन्या, and दोष fault.
कन्यापति: कन्यापति m. (-तिः) A daughter's husband: see कन्यकापति.
कन्यापाल: कन्यापाल m. (-लः) 1 A dealer in slave girls. 2 The father of a daughter. E. कन्या, and पाल who cherishes.
कन्यापुत्र: कन्यापुत्र m. (-त्रः) The offspring of an unmarried daughter. E. कन्या, and पुत्र a son.
कन्याप्रदान: कन्याप्रदान n. (-नं) Giving a daughter in marriage. E. कन्या, and प्रदान a gift.
कन्याराम: कन्याराम m. (-मः) A Bauddha or Jaina saint. E. कन्या a girl, रम to please, affix घञ्.
कन्यावेदिन्: कन्यावेदिन् m. (-दी) A son-in-law. E. कन्या, and वेदिन् who knows.
कन्याशुल्क: कन्याशुल्क n. (-ल्कं) The purchase money of a maiden, money given to the bride's father. E. कन्या, and शुल्क tax.
कन्यासमुद्भव: कन्यासमुद्भव m. (-वः) The son of an unmarried girl. E. कन्या, and समुद्भव born.
कन्याहरण: कन्याहरण n. (-णं) Carrying off a girl, rape, ravishment. E. कन्या, and हरण taking.
कन्यिका: कन्यिका f. (-का) A young girl, a virgin: see कन्यका.
कन्युष: कन्युष n. (-षं) The hand below the wrist.
कप: कप (इ) कपि r. 1st cl. (कंपते) To shake, to tremble: with अनु prefixed, to feel tenderness or compassion, to pity.
कपट: कपट mn. (-टः-टं) Fraud, deceit, cheating, circumvention. E. क. BRAHMĀ, पट to go, अच् affix; what extends even to BRAHMĀ; or क the head, and पट a covering, screening the head as it were. f. (-टी) A measure equal to the capacity of the hollows of the two hands joined.
कपटता: कपटता f. (-ता) Deceitfulness. E. तल् added to कपट्; also with त्व, कपटत्वं.
कपटप्रबन्ध: कपटप्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Fraud, trick, fraudulent plot or contrivance. E. कपट, and प्रबन्ध procedure.
कपटलेख्य: कपटलेख्य n. (-ख्यं) A forged document, a false or fraudulent statement. E. कपट, and लेख्य a writing.
कपटवेश: कपटवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Masked, disguised, assuming a false dress or appearance. m. (-शः) Disguise. E. कपट, and वेश costume.
कपटवेशिन्: कपटवेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Disguised, in masquerade. E. कपटवेश and इनि aff.
कपटिक: कपटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A rogue, a cheat, fraudulent, dishonest. E. कपट and ठक् aff.
कपटिन्: कपटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Fraudulent, dishonest, a cheat, &c. E. कपट and इनि aff.
कपर्द: कपर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 The braided hair of ŚIVA. 2 A small shell used as a coin, a Cowri. 3 A name of ŚIVA. E. क water, (that of the Ganges,) पृ in the deriv. form, nourishing, and द from दा to give; or क happiness, &c. which will apply to both senses; also with कन् added कपर्द्दक.
कपर्द्द: कपर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 The braided hair of ŚIVA. 2 A small shell used as a coin, a Cowri. 3 A name of ŚIVA. E. क water, (that of the Ganges,) पृ in the deriv. form, nourishing, and द from दा to give; or क happiness, &c. which will apply to both senses; also with कन् added कपर्द्दक.
कपर्दिन्: कपर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A name of ŚIVA. E. कपर्द्द his braided hair, and इनि aff.
कपर्द्दिन्: कपर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A name of ŚIVA. E. कपर्द्द his braided hair, and इनि aff.
कपाट: कपाट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) A door, the leaf or pannel of a door. E. क the head or wind, पट to go, अण् affix; also कबाट.
कपाटघ्न: कपाटघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A thief, a house-breaker. n. कपाट, and घ्न who breaks.
कपाटसन्धि: कपाटसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) 1 The junction of the leaves of a door. 2 A mode of multiplying, (in arithmetic.) E. कपाट, and सन्धि junction.
कपाल: कपाल m. (-लः-लं) 1 The skull, the cranium. 2 Either half of a water jar. 3 Any flat bone. 4 A beggar's bowl. 5 Multitude, assemblage, collection. 6 A species of leprosy. 7 A treaty of peace on equal terms. E. कपि to tremble, and कालन् Uṇādi affix; or क the head, and पाल what cherishes or protects.
कपालनालिका: कपालनालिका f. (-का) A sort of pin or spindle for winding cotton, thread, &c.
कपालभृत्: कपालभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of MAHĀDEVA. E. कपाल a skull, and भृत् who cherishes; being represented with a necklace of skulls.
कपालसन्धि: कपालसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) Treaty of peace on equal terms. E. कपाल, and सन्धि peace.
कपालिका: कपालिका f. (-का) 1 The tartar of the teeth. 2 A potsherd. E. कपाल and कन् aff.
कपालिन्: कपालिन् m. (-ली) 1 A title of ŚIVA. 2 A man of low caste, from a Brahman mother and fisherman father. f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ. E. कपाल a skull, इनि affix; and ङीष् fem. do.
कपि: कपि m. (-पिः) 1 An ape or monkey. 2 The monkey HANUMĀN. 3 A title of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 4 Incense, storax or impure benzoin. 5 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 6 A kind of Bonduc or Bonducella. E. कपि to tremble, इ Uṇādi affix, the nasal rejected.
कपिकच्छु: कपिकच्छु f. (-च्छुः) Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.) E. कपि a monkey, and कच्छु itching; also with final vowel long कपिकच्छू.
कपिकच्छुरा: कपिकच्छुरा f. (-रा) Cowach: see the preceding.
कपिकन्दुक: कपिकन्दुक n. (-कं) The skull, the cranium. E. कपि, and कन्दुक a ball.
कपिचूत: कपिचूत m. (-तः) A tree, (Spondias mangifera:) see आम्रातक. E. कपि, and चूत the mango tree, the monkey's mango.
कपिज: कपिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born of a monkey, &c. m. (-जः) Incense, benzoin. E. कपि, and ज born.
कपिञ्जल: कपिञ्जल m. (-लः) 1 A bird, the francoline partridge. 2 The Chataka.
कपितैल: कपितैल n. (-लः) Benzoin or storax. E. कपि, and तैल oil.
कपित्थ: कपित्थ m. (-त्थः) The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantum.) E. कपि, and त्थ from स्था to stay or abide; the residence of apes.
कपित्थपर्णी: कपित्थपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, commonly कपित्थानी, the leaves of which are compared to those of the preceding.
कपित्थानी: कपित्थानी f. (-नी) A plant: see the preceding.
कपित्थास्य: कपित्थास्य m. (-स्यः) A kind of monkey. E. कपित्थ, and आस्य a face; having a roundish face, in shape like the wood apple.
कपिध्वज: कपिध्वज m. (-जः) A name of ARJUNA. E. कपि a monkey, and ध्वज a sign; having a monkey as his symbol, his ensign or arms.
कपिप्रभु: कपिप्रभु m. (-भुः) A name of the first RĀMA. E. कपि, and प्रभु master; general of the monkey force with which he invaded Laṅkā or Ceylon.
कपिप्रिय: कपिप्रिय m. (-यः) The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. E. कपि and प्रिय beloved.
कपिरथ: कपिरथ m. (-थः) A title of RĀMA. E. कपि and रथ a car; having been carried by his monkies.
कपिल: कपिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tawny. m. (-लः) 1 KAPILA, a celebrated Muni or saint, the founder of the Sāṃkhya system of philosophy: the son of KĀRDDAMA by DEVAHŪTI, and according to some, an avatāra of VIṢṆU. 2 A title of AGNI the deity of fire. 3 A dog. 5 Tawny, (the colour.) f. (-ला) 1 The female elephant of the south-east. 2 A kind of Sisu, or timber tree so  called: see शिंशपा. 3 A sort of perfume: see रेणुका. 4 The aloe plant. 5 A fabulous cow, celebrated in the Purāṇas. 5 The common leech. E. कभ to desire, इलच् Uṇādi affix, and प substituted for म; or कपि a monkey, and ल to take, &c. being of such a colour.
कपिलद्युति: कपिलद्युति m. (-तिः) A name of SŪRYA or the sun. E. कपिल, and द्युति light; being of a dull red or tawny hue.
कपिलद्राक्षा: कपिलद्राक्षा f. (-क्षा) The brown or tawny grape. E. कपिल, and द्राक्षा a grape.
कपिलद्रुम: कपिलद्रुम m. (-मः) The name of a perfume or sweet scented wood: see काक्षी.
कपिलधारा: कपिलधारा f. (-रा) 1 The Ganges. 2 A holy place, a place of pilgrimage.
कपिलाश्व: कपिलाश्व m. (-श्वः) A title of the god INDRA. E. कपिल tawny, and अश्व horse; such being the colour of INDRA'S steed.
कपिलोह: कपिलोह n. (-हं) Brass. E. कपि for कपिल brown, and लोह iron.
कपिल्लिका: कपिल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, which bears a seed resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis.)
कपिवक्त्र: कपिवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A name of NĀRADA, a saint and philosopher, and friend of KṚṢṆA. E. कपि, and वक्त्र a face; the saint having a face like a monkey.
कपिवल्ली: कपिवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. E. कपि, and वल्ली a pedicle; that being invested with a downy coat, resembling the hair of an ape.
कपिश: कपिश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Brown, of a brown colour. m. (-शः) 1 Brown, (the colour,) a compound of black and yellow. 2 Incense, styrax or coarse benzoin. f. (-शी) A spirit, a sort of rum. f. (-शा) The mother of the demons called Piśācas. E. कपि an ape, and शः affix; of the colour of an ape.
कपिशाञ्जन: कपिशाञ्जन m. (-नः) A title of ŚIVA.
कपिशायन: कपिशायन m. (-नः) 1 A deity. 2 A sort of spirit or rum. E. कपिशा, affix फक्.
कपिशापुत्र: कपिशापुत्र m. (-त्रः) A Piśāca, an imp or goblin. E. कपिशा the mother of these beings, and पुत्र a son.
कपिशित: कपिशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Embrowned, made brown or dusky red. E. कपिश and इतच् aff.
कपिशीका: कपिशीका f. (-का) Spirituous liquor. E. कपिश, and ईकन् affix: see कपिश.
कपिशीर्ष: कपिशीर्ष n. (-र्षः) The upper part or coping of a wall. E. कपि, and शीर्ष the head; a monkey's head.
कपिशीर्षक: कपिशीर्षक n. (-कं) Vermilion, the red sulphuret of mercury.
कपिस्थल: कपिस्थल n. (-लं) A place frequented by monkies. E. कपि, and स्थल place.
कपीज्य: कपीज्य m. (-ज्यः) A plant, (a species of mimusops:) see क्षीरिका. E. कपि, and इज्य respected, liked: a favourite plant with the monkies; also कपीज्यक.
कपीतन: कपीतन m. (-नः) 1 A tree bearing an acid fruit, (Spondias mangifera:) see आम्रातक. 2 Another tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्दभाण्ड. 3 A species of Mimosa, (Mimosa sirisha, Rox.) 4 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 5 The betel nut tree, (Areca faufel or Catechu.) 6 The name of another plant, (Crataeva marmelos.) E. कपि an ape, and तन what spreads; sheltering or feeding monkies; the vowel is made long irregularly.
कपीन्द्र: कपीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A name of the celebrated monkey HANUMĀN. 2 Also of SUGRĪVA, &c. E. कपि, and इन्द्र the chief.
कपुष्टिका: कपुष्टिका f. (-का) A patch of hair on each side of the head. E. क the head, पुष्टि cherishing, कन् aff.
कपुच्छल: कपुच्छल n. (-लं) Hair hanging down to the ground. E. क the head, पुच्छ a tail, and ल what resembles.
कपोत: कपोत m. (-तः) 1 A dove or pigeon, especially the spotted necked pigeon. 2 A bird in general. E. कब to tinge, to be of various hues, आतच् Uṇādi affix, ब changed to प.
कपोतक: कपोतक n. (-कं) Antimony. E. कपोत, and कन् affix, implying resemblance, (in colour.)
कपोतचरणा: कपोतचरणा f. (-णा) A perfume: see नली.
कपोतपालिका: कपोतपालिका f. (-का) A dove cot, an aviary or pigeon house. E. कपोत a bird, &c. पाल to nourish, and वुन् affix, fem. termination टाप्; also with the affixes अण and ङीप्, कपोतपाली.
कपोतसार: कपोतसार n. (-रं) Antimony. E. कपोत, and सार essence.
कपोताङ्घ्रि: कपोताङ्घ्रि f. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A perfume: see नली. E. कपोत, and अङ्घ्रि a foot; of a red colour, like the claw of a pigeon.
कपोताभ: कपोताभ m. (-भः) A pale or dirty white colour. E. कपोत, and आङ् before भा to shine, affix ड; of the colour of a pigeon.
कपोतारि: कपोतारि m. (-रिः) A hawk, a falcon. E. कपोत, and अरि an enemy.
कपोतिका: कपोतिका f. (-का) A done. E. कपोत a pigeon, कन् affix fem. form.
कपोल: कपोल m. (-लः) A cheek. f. (-ली) The forepart of the knee, the knee-cap or pan. E. कपि to quiver, and ओलच् Uṇādi aff.
कपोलकाष: कपोलकाष m. (-षः) The elephant's temples and cheeks. E. कपोल, and काष a touchstone; being of the like dark colour.
कपोलभित्ति: कपोलभित्ति m. (-त्तिः) The temples and cheek, the upper part of the face. E. कपोल, and भित्ति a wall.
कपोलराग: कपोलराग m. (-गः) Colour or flush in the cheek. E. कपोल, and राग colour.
कपोलफलक: कपोलफलक f. (-कः) The cheek. E. कपोल, and फलक a plank.
कप्याख्य: कप्याख्य m. (-ख्यः) Incense. E. कपि, and आख्या aff.
कफ: कफ m. (-फः) 1 Phlegm, one of the three humours of the body. 2 Watery froth or foam in general. E. क water, and फल to bud or flower, ड aff.
कफकर: कफकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Producing phlegm. E. कफ, and कर what makes.
कफकूर्चिका: कफकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Saliva, spittle. E. कफ, and कूर्च्चिका cream.
कफकूर्च्चिका: कफकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Saliva, spittle. E. कफ, and कूर्च्चिका cream.
कफघ्न: कफघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing phlegm, antiphlegmatic, (an epithet of many plants, &c.) E. कफ, and घ्न what destroys.
कफणि: कफणि mf. (-णिः-णी) The elbow. E. क pleasure, फण to go, इन् and ङीष् affixes; also कफोणि.
कफनाशन: कफनाशन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Antiphlegmatic. E. कफ, and नाशन destroying.
कफवर्द्धक: कफवर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Exciting phlegm. E. कफ, and वर्द्धक what increases.
कफवर्द्धन: कफवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Exciting phlegm. m. (-नः) The name of a plant; also पिण्डीतगर. E. कफ phlegm, वृध to augment, and ल्युट् aff.
कफारि: कफारि m. (-रिः) Ginger. E. कफ, and अरि foe.
कफिन्: कफिन् mfn. (-फी-फिनी-फी) Phlegmatic. m. (-फी) An elephant. E. कफ and इनि aff.
कफेलू: कफेलू mfn. (-लूः-लूः-लु) Phlegmatic, causing or exciting phlegm. E. कफ, लू from ला to take or give, and कू Uṇādi affix; the deriv. is irr.
कफोणि: कफोणि mf. (-णिः-णी) The elbow. E. क pleasure, स्फुर् to go, &c. इन् and ङीष् affixes; the form is irregular: see कफणि.
कब: कब (ऋ) कबृ r. 1st cl. (कबते) 1 To colour, to tinge with various hues. 2 To praise.
कबन्ध: कबन्ध mn. (-न्धः-न्धं) A headless trunk, especially retaining vitality. n. (-न्धं) Water. m. (-न्धः) 1 A name of RĀHU. 2 Also of a demon destroyed by RĀMA. 3 The belly. E. कं the head, and बध to injure, to lop, affix अच्; also कं water, and बन्ध binding, attaching.
कबन्धता: कबन्धता f. (-ता) Headlessness, decapitation. E. कबन्ध and तल् affix; also with त्व, कबन्धत्व.
कबित्थ: कबित्थ m. (-त्थः) The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.
कबिल: कबिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tawny, (of such a hue.) m. (-लः) Tawny, (the colour:) see कपिल.
कम: कम (उ) कमु r. 1st cl. (कामयति) To desire: this root is irregular.
कम्: कम् ind. 1 Water. 2 The head. 2 Happiness or happily. 4 An expletive. E. कम to desire, विच् aff.
कमठ: कमठ mn. (-ठः-ठं) 1 A water jar, especially one made of a hollow gourd or cocoanut, and used by ascetics. m. (-ठः) 1 A turtle, a tortoise. 2 A bamboo. 3 The name of a Daitya or demon. 4 A porcupine. f. (-ठी) A female tortoise, a small one. E. कम to desire, &c. अठः Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
कमण्डलु: कमण्डलु mn. (-लुः-लु) An earthen or wooden water pot, used by the ascetic and religious student. 2 The waved-leaf fig tree: see प्लक्ष. E. क BRAHMĀ or water, and मण्ड ornament or essence, ल from ला to get or give, and डु aff.
कमन: कमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Libidinous, desirous. 2 Beautiful, desirable. m. (-नः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 KĀMA or love. 3 A tree, (Jonesia asoca.) E. कम to desire, affix युच् or ल्युट्.
कमनच्छद: कमनच्छद m. (-दः) A heron. E. कमन beautiful, and च्छद plumage.
कमनीय: कमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Pleasing, beautiful, desirable. E. कम and अनीयर् affix of the future participle, to be desired.
कमनीयता: कमनीयता f. (-ता) 1 Loveliness, beauty. 2 Desirableness. E. तल् added to the last, or with त्व, कमनीयत्वं.
कमन्ध: कमन्ध m. (-न्धः) Water. see कबन्ध; also according to some, this is an orthographical compound, of कं and अन्ध, both synonyms of water.
कमर: कमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Desirous, lustful. E. कम and अरन् Uṇādi aff.
कमल: कमल n. (-लं) 1 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphaea nelumbo.) 2 Water. 3 Copper. 4 A medicament, a drug. 5 The bladder. m. (-लः) A species of deer. f. (-ला) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 An excellent woman. E. कम् water, and अल what adorns, or कम to desire, with कलच् aff.
कमलच्छद: कमलच्छद m. (-दः) 1 A heron: see कङ्क. 2 Petal of the lotus. E. कमल, and छद a leaf.
कमलाकर: कमलाकर m. (-रः) A lake &c. where lotuses abound. E. कमल, and आकर a mine.
कमलासन: कमलासन m. (-नः) An epithet of BRAHMĀ. E. कमल a lotus, and आसन seat or abode.
कमलिनी: कमलिनी f. (-नी) A number of lotus flowers, or a place abounding with them. E. कमल, इनि and ङीष् affs.
कमलोत्तर: कमलोत्तर n. (-रं) Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) E. कमल, and उत्तर best, excellent.
कमा: कमा f. (-मा) Beauty, radiance. E. कम to desire, अङ् and टाप् affs.
कमितृ: कमितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Lustful, desirous, cupidinous. E. कम to desire, तृच् affix; and इ inserted.
कम्प: कम्प m. (-म्पः) Tremour, trembling, shaking. E. कपि to shake, and अच् affix; also कम्पन, &c.
कम्पन: कम्पन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Trembling, unsteady, shaken. n. (-नं) Trembling, quivering. m. (-नः) The dewy season. (Nov.-Dec. E. कपि to tremble, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.
कम्पमान: कम्पमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Trembling. E. कपि to tremble, शानच् aff.
कम्पलक्ष्मन्: कम्पलक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Air, wind. E. कम्प trembling, and लक्ष्मन् mark or sign.
कम्पाक: कम्पाक m. (-कः) Wind, air. E. काकुन् affixed to कपि.
कम्पान्वित: कम्पान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trembling, agitated. E. कम्प, and अन्वित possessed of.
कम्पित: कम्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaking, shaken, trembling. (-तं) Trembling, a trembling, a tremor. E. कपि and क्त aff.
कम्पिल: कम्पिल m. (-लः) A plant: see रोचनी: see काम्पिल्ल; also कम्पिल्ल and कम्पील.
कम्प्र: कम्प्र mfn. (-म्प्रः-म्प्रा-म्प्रं) Trembling, shaken. E. कपि, and रः aff.
कम्ब: कम्ब r. 1st cl. (-कम्बति) To go, to move.
कम्बर: कम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Variegated. m. (-रः) Variegated, (the colour.)
कम्बल: कम्बल m. (-लः) 1 A blanket. 2 A chief of the Nāgas or serpents. 3 A small worm. 4 A dewlap. 5 An upper cloth or garment. 6 A sort of deer. n. (-लं) Water. E. कम to desire, कलः Uṇādi affix, and ब inserted; or कम् the head, water, &c. and बल to be strong, affix अच्.
कम्बलकारक: कम्बलकारक m. (-कः) Woollen cloth manufacturer. E. कम्बल, and कारक who makes.
कम्बलवाह्यक: कम्बलवाह्यक n. (-कं) A kind of carriage, covered with a coarse blanket or woollen cloth, and drawn by oxen. E. कम्बल and बह to bear, affixes ण्यत् and कन्.
कम्बालायिन्: कम्बालायिन् m. (-यी) A sort of kite.
कम्बि: कम्बि f. (-म्बिः) 1 A ladle or spoon. 2 A shoot, a branch or joint of a bamboo. E. कम to desire, बिन् affix, or with ङीष् added, कम्बी.
कम्बु: कम्बु mfn. (-म्बुः-म्बू-म्बु) Speckled, variegated. mn. (-म्बुः-म्बु) 1 A conch, a shell. m. (-म्बुः) 1 A bracelet, a ring. 2 A bivalve shell. 3 An elephant. 4 The neck. 5 A vein or tubular vessel of the body, &c. E. कम्ब to go, उ affix, or कम to desire; the form is irr.
कम्बुक: कम्बुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A mean person. m. (-कः) A conch. f. (-का) A tree, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. कन् added to the last.
कम्बुग्रीवा: कम्बुग्रीवा f. (-वा) A neck marked with three lines like a shell, and considered to be indicative of exalted fortune. E. कम्बु a shell, and ग्रीवा the neck.
कम्बू: कम्बू mfn. (-म्बूः-म्बू-म्बु) A thief, a plunderer. m. (-म्बूः) A bracelet. E. कम to desire, ऊ Uṇādi affix, and बुक् inserted.
कम्बोज: कम्बोज m. (-जः) 1 The name of a country in the north of India, Camboja or Camboya. 2 A kind of shell. 3 A description of elephant: see काम्बोज.
कम्भारी: कम्भारी f. (-री) A plant, (Gmelina arborea.) E. कम water, भार a burthen, ङीष् affix; also गम्भारी.
कम्भु: कम्भु n. (-म्भु) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. कं water, भू produced.
कम्र: कम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) 1 Desirous, cupidinous. 2 Beautiful, desirable. E. कम to desire, रन् aff.
कयस्था: कयस्था f. (-स्था) A medicinal plant, commonly Kākoli: also कायस्था, or more accurately, perhaps, वयस्था.
कर: कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what does, makes or causes, as किङ्करः A servant, who does any thing; भयङ्करः frightful, what causes fear; उपकरः who gives aid; अपकरः who does ill, &c. m. (रः) 1 A ray of light, a sun or moonbeam. 2 Royal revenue, toll, tax, impost, &c. 3 The hand. 4 Hail. 5 An elephant's trunk. E. कृञ् to do, &c. ट or अप् aff.
करक: करक mf. (-कः-का) Hail. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The water pot of the student or ascetic. 2 The shell of the cocoanut hollowed to form a vessel. m. (-कः) 1 The pomegranate tree. 2 Toll, tax. 3 A particular sort of bird. 4 A plant, (Galedupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्च. 5 A tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. कन् added to the preceding, or कृ to injure, &c. and वुन् aff.
