करकण्ठक: करकण्ठक m. (-कः) The finger nail. कर the hand, and कण्ठक a thorn.
करकमल: करकमल n. (-लं) The hand, especially of a lover, a mistress, &c. E. कर, and कमल a lotus; also similar compounds, as करपद्मं, करपङ्कज, करपल्लव, &c.
करकलश: करकलश m. (-शः) The hand hollowed to receive water. E. कर, and कलश a ewer.
करकाम्भस्: करकाम्भस् m. (-म्भाः) The cocoanut tree, (Cocos nucifera.) E. करक the shell, and अम्भस् the water, the nut containing a serous fluid.
करकुद्मल: करकुद्मल n. (-लं) A finger. E. कर, and कुद्मल a bud.
करकोष: करकोष m. (-षः) The hollow of the hand. E. कर, and कोष receptacle.
करग्रह: करग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Marriage. 2 Levying or gathering a tax. 3 A tax gatherer. 4 Taking the hand. E. कर, and ग्रह taking: one part of the ceremony of marriage is the placing of the right hand of the bride with the palm uppermost, in the right hand of the bridegroom; also करग्राह.
करग्रहण: करग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Levying or gathering a tax. 2 Taking the hand. 3 Marriage. E. कर, and ग्रहण taking.
करग्राहिन्: करग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 1 Levying a tax. 2 Taking the hand. E. कर, and ग्राहिन् who takes.
करघर्षण: करघर्षण m. (-णः) The churning stick. n. (-णं) Rubbing the hands together. E. कर the hand, and घर्षण rubbing.
करघर्षिन्: करघर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) The churning stick. E. कर the hand, घृष to rub, णिनि aff.
करङ्क: करङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 The head. 2 A cocoanut hollowed so as to form a cup or vessel. 3 Any bone of the body. 4 A kind of sugar cane. E. कृ to send or throw, &c. अंक aff.
करङ्कशालि: करङ्कशालि m. (-लिः) A sort of sugar cane.
करङ्गण: करङ्गण n. (-णं) A market or fair. E. कर tax, and गण collection, &c.
करच्छद: करच्छद m. (-दः) The teak tree. E. कर, and च्छद a leaf.
करज: करज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in or from a hand, a ray, &c. m. (-जः) 1 A finger nail. 2 The name of a timber tree, commonly Karanja, (Galendupa arborea, Rox.) n. (-जं) A perfume, commonly Nakhi, resembling a nail in appearance. E. कर the hand, and ज produced; or कं pleasure, रञ्ज to colour, &c. अच affix: see the next.
करजाल: करजाल n. (-लं) A pencil of rays, a stream of light. E. कर, and जाल multitude.
करञ्ज: करञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) The name of a plant, commonly Karanja, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.) E. क water, and रञ्ज to colour, अच् affix: see करज.
करञ्जक: करञ्जक m. (-कः) 1 Karanja: see the preceding. 2 Another plant, (Verbesina scandens, Rox.) see भृङ्गराज. E. कन् added to the foregoing.
करट: करट m. (-टः) 1 A crow. 2 An elephant's cheek. 3 Safflower or carthamus. 4 A man of a low or degraded profession. 5 The first Śrāddha or ceremony performed in honour of a deceased relation. 6 An atheist, an unbeliever, an oppugner of the doctrines of the Vedas. 7 A musical instrument, (Castanets?) f. (-टा) A cow difficult to be milked. E. क pleasure, &c. रट to sound, and अच् affix; or कृ to do, and अटन् Uṇādi aff.
करटक: करटक m. (-कः) A crow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
करटिन्: करटिन् m. (-टी) An elephant. E. करट and इनि aff.
करटु: करटु m. (-टुः) The numidian crane. E. कर् for कुत् bad, अट to go, and डु aff.
करण: करण n. (-णं) 1 An instrument or means of action. 2 Making, doing. 3 Action, act. 4 Cause, motive. 5 Business, occupation, as trade, &c. 6 An organ of sense. 7 The body. 8 The mind or heart. 9 A field. 10 Grain. 11 The posture, abstinence, &c. of an ascetic. 12 Copulation, (seu modus coeundi.) 13 The usage or practice of the writer caste. 14 Acting, dramatic action. 15 Song, singing. 16 The particular business of any tribe or cast. 17 Plaistering, spreading any thing with the hand. 18 A Karaṇa, an astrological division of time; the Karaṇas are eleven: 7 moveable and 4 fixed, and two are equal to a lunar day; or the time during which the moon's motion from the sun amounts to 6°. 19 (In grammar) The instrumental case, or noun in that case. m. (-णः) A man of a mixed class, the son of a Śūdra woman by a Vaiśya; or, according to some, of an outcast Kṣetriya, by a Kṣetriya female; the occupation of this class is writing, accounts, &c. a writer, a scribe. f. (-णी) 1 A woman of the same caste. 2 (In arithmetic, &c.) A surd or irrational quantity. E. कृ to do, to act, &c. ल्युट् aff.
करणत्राण: करणत्राण n. (-णं) The head. E. करण an organ of sense, and त्राण preserving.
करणत्व: करणत्व n. (-त्वं) Instrumentality, mediate agency. E. त्व added to करण.
करणनियम: करणनियम m. (-मः) Suppression or restraint of the organs of sense. E. करण, and नियम restraint.
करणि: करणि f. (-णिः) Doing, making, effecting. E. कृ to do, अनि affix; also with कन added करणिका.
करणीय: करणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be done or made. E. कृ to do, अनीयर् aff.
करण्ड: करण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A basket or covered box of bamboo wicker work. 2 A bee-hive, a honey-comb. 3 A sword. 4 A sort of duck. 5 An aquatic weed, (Vallisneria.) E. कृ to do, अण्डन् Uṇādi aff.
करण्डिन्: करण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) A fish in general. E. करण्ड Vallisneria, and इनि aff.
करतल: करतल n. (-लं) The palm of the hand. E. कर, and तल lower part.
करतलधृत: करतलधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held in the hand. E. करतल, and धृत held.
करतलस्थ: करतलस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Held in the hand, what is in or under the hand. E. करतल, and स्थ what is.
करताल: करताल nf. (-लं-ली) 1 A musical instrument, a cymbal. 2 Beating time by clapping the hands. E. कर the hand, ताल musical time, and ङीष् aff.
करतोया: करतोया f. (-या) The Karatoyā river, a river in the north-east of Bengal. E. कर the hand, and तोय water: at the wedding of ŚIVA and PĀRVATĪ, the water which had been poured into the hand of the former, constituted, upon its being thrown on the ground, the source of this river.
करद: करद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Subject to tax or duty. 2 Tributary. 3 Who gives his hand, &c. E. कर, and द who gives.
करदक्ष: करदक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Handy, dexterous, ready. कर, and दक्ष clever.
करदीकृत: करदीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subjugated, made tributary. E. करद, and कृत made with च्चि augment.
करधृत: करधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held, supported by the hand. E. कर, and धृत held.
करनिहित: करनिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held in the hand. E. कर, and निहित placed.
करपत्र: करपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A saw. 2 Splashing water about while bathing, playing or gamboling in water. E. कर, and पत्र a leaf; being in the hand as a leaf.
करपत्रवत्: करपत्रवत् m. (-वान्) The palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.) E. करपत्र a saw, and मतुप् affix, the spatha being compared to a saw.
करपत्रिका: करपत्रिका f. (-का) Playing with water, gamboling in it, splashing it about; also करपत्र, करपात्र and करपत्रिक.
करपर्ण: करपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A species of castor oil tree. E. कर, and पर्ण a leaf.
करपल्लव: करपल्लव m. (-वः) A finger. E. कर, and पल्लव a shoot.
करपात्र: करपात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The hand hollowed so as to hold any thing. 2 The throwing of water in sport. E. कर, and पात्र a cup.
करपाल: करपाल (-लः) A sword, a scymitar. E. कर the hand, and पल protecting, or with बल to be strong, करबाल.
करपालिका: करपालिका f. (-का) 1 A cudgel, a short club or wooden sword. 2 A sword or one edged knife. E. कर the hand, पाल to nourish, ण्वुल् affix, and the fem. termination.
करपुट: करपुट m. (-टं) Joining the palms of the hands to shew respect. 2 The hands joined and hollowed to receive anything. E. कर, and पुट् a bag.
करपृष्ठ: करपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Back of the hand. E. कर, and पृष्ठ back.
करप्रचेय: करप्रचेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be held, to be taken hold of. 2 To be collected by taxes. E. कर, and प्रचेय to be accumulated.
करप्राप्त: करप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Held in hand, got, secured. E. कर, and प्राप्त obtained.
करबाल: करबाल n. (-लः) 1 A finger nail. 2 A sword, a scymitar: see करपाल.
करबालिका: करबालिका f. (-का) A small sword, &c. see करपालिका.
करभ: करभ m. (-भः) 1 The metacarpus, the hand from the wrist to the root of the fingers. 2 A young camel or any young animal. 3 A young elephant. 4 A perfume, commonly Nakhi. f. (-भी) A she camel. E. कृ to reject, अभच Uṇādi affix: see कलभ.
करभप्रिया: करभप्रिया f. (-या) A plant, a sort of Hedysarum. E. करभ, and प्रिय fond of; folder for camels.
करभिन्: करभिन् m. (-भी) An elephant. E. करभ and इनि aff.
करभीर: करभीर m. (-रः) A lion. E. करभ a young animal, and ईर who destroys.
करभूषण: करभूषण n. (-णं) A bracelet, an ornament worn round the wrist. E. कर the hand, and भूषण an ornament.
करमट्ट: करमट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The betel nut tree: see गुवका.
करमरिन्: करमरिन् m. (-री) A prisoner, a captive.
करमर्द: करमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A small tree bearing an acid fruit, commonly Karonda or Karinda, (Carissa carondas.) E. कर the hand, and मृद to destroy, अण् affix; what is plucked by the hand; also with कन् affix, करमर्द्दक and fem. with ङीष् affix करमर्द्दी.
करमर्द्द: करमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A small tree bearing an acid fruit, commonly Karonda or Karinda, (Carissa carondas.) E. कर the hand, and मृद to destroy, अण् affix; what is plucked by the hand; also with कन् affix, करमर्द्दक and fem. with ङीष् affix करमर्द्दी.
करमाल: करमाल m. (-लः) Smoke, probably an error or corruption for खतमाल.
करमाला: करमाला f. (-ला) The hand used as a rosary, the joints of the fingers corresponding to the beads. E. कर, and माला a rosary.
करमुक्त: करमुक्त n. (-क्तं) A missile weapon, but thrown by the hand, a dart, a javelin, &c. E. कर, and मुक्त released.
कराग्रपल्लव: कराग्रपल्लव m. (-वः) A finger. E. कर and अग्र to the point, पल्लव a shoot.
करम्ब: करम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 1 Mixed, intermingled. 2 Set, inlaid. m. (-म्बः) Flour or meal mixed with curds: see करम्भ. E. कृ to do, अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.
करम्बित: करम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Intermingled, mixed, blended, &c. 2 Pounded, reduced to grains or dust. 2 Set, inlaid. E. करम्ब and इतच् aff.
करम्भ: करम्भ m. (-म्भः) A cake, flour or meal mixed with curds. E. क water, and रभि to send, &c. अच् affix, also with कन् added करम्भक; also with रवि to sound, &c. करम्ब, &c. as above.
कररुद्ध: कररुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Stopped by the hand, held tight or fast. E. कर, and रुद्व stopped.
कररुह: कररुह m. (-हः) A finger nail. E. कर the hand, and रुह to grow, to rise, affix क.
करर्द्धि: करर्द्धि m. (-र्द्धिः) A small musical instrument used for marking time, (a castanet,) or clapping the hands together for that purpose. E. कर the hand, ऋद्धि property.
करवालिका: करवालिका f. (-का) A small club, &c. see करबालिका.
करवी: करवी f. (-वी) The leaf of the Asafoetida plant, Hingupatri: see कवरी and कारवी.
करवीर: करवीर m. (-रः) 1 A fragrant plant, (Oleander or Nerium odorum.) 2 The name of a demon. 3 A sword or scymitar. 4 A  cemetery, a place for burning or interring the dead. f. (-रा) Red arsenic. (-री) 1 A name of ADITI, the mother of the gods. 2 A good cow. 3 A woman who has borne a son, a mother. E. कर here said to mean a root, वीर to become evident, and अच् affix, or कर hand, वि prefixed to ईर to go, &c. affix क.
करवीरक: करवीरक m. (-कः) 1 A sword. 2 A poison, the poisonous root of the Oleander. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
करशाखा: करशाखा f. (-खा) A finger. E. कर the hand, and शाखा a branch.
करशीकर: करशीकर m. (-रः) Water expelled by an elephant's trunk. E. कर his trunk, and शीकर drizzling rain.
करशूक: करशूक m. (-कः) A finger nail. E. कर the hand, and शूक the beard of corn.
करशोथ: करशोथ m. (-थः) OEdematous swelling of the hands. E. कर, and शोथ swelling.
करहाट: करहाट m. (-टः) 1 The fibrous root of a lotus. 2 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. क water, and रह to abandon, करह a lotus, अट what goes, or by what it goes; or कर the hand, हट to illuminate or adorn, and अण् aff.
करहाटक: करहाटक m. (-कः) The name of a tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
कराघात: कराघात m. (-तः) A thump, a blow with the hand. E. कर, and आघात a blow.
करामर्द्ध: करामर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A fruit tree, (Carissa carondas:) see करमर्द्ध.
करामुक: करामुक m. (-कः) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta, Rox.) see कृष्णपाक.
कराम्लक: कराम्लक m. (-कः) A fruit tree, (Carissa carondas.)
करायिका: करायिका f. (-का) A bird, a small kind of crane.
करारोट: करारोट m. (-टः) A finger ring. E. कर the hand, रुट to shine, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्.
कराल: कराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Great, large. 2 High, lofty. 3 Formidable, terrible. 4 Having projecting teeth. m. (-लः) Rosin, pitch, or a mixture of oil and the resin of the Śāl tree. n. (लं) A dark kind of Tulasī or Basil. f. (-ला) A kind of swallow wort, commonly Ananta-mul, (Hemisdemus Indicus). see शारिवा. f. (-ली) One of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire. E. कर the hand, &c. ला with आङ् prefixed to take, and क affix; or कर, and अल to be able, &c. affix अण्, fem. do टाप् or ङीष्.
करालक: करालक m. (-कः) A sort of Basil, the dark kind.
करालकर: करालकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Having a large trunk, (an elephant.) 2 Having a powerful arm or hand. E. कराल, and कर a hand.
करालम्ब: करालम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) One who stretches out his hand to support or pick up another, &c. E. कर, and अलम्ब what supports.
करालम्बन: करालम्बन n. (-नं) Extending the hand, taking by the hand, helping, sustaining. E. कर, and आलम्बन supporting.
करालवदन: करालवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of hideous aspect, ugly, frightful. f. (-ना) A form or emanation of DURGA. E. कराल, and वदन countenance; also करालानन, करालमुखः, &c.
करालित: करालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Afraid of, alarmed by or at. 2 Rendered formidable. 3 Magnified. E. कराल and इतच्.
करिकणवल्ली: करिकणवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A species of pepper, (Piper chavya.) E. करिकण elephant-pepper, वल्ली a vine.
करिकुम्भ: करिकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) The frontal globe of an elephant. E. करि, and कुम्भ the same.
करिकुसुम्भ: करिकुसुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A fragrant powder prepared from the flowers of the Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea;) also करिकुसुम्भक.
करिगर्जित: करिगर्ज्जित n. (-तं) The roaring of elephants. E. करिन् an elephant, and गर्ज्जित sounding, thundering.
करिगर्ज्जित: करिगर्ज्जित n. (-तं) The roaring of elephants. E. करिन् an elephant, and गर्ज्जित sounding, thundering.
करिचर्मन्: करिचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) An elephant's hide. E. करिन्, and चर्म्मन् skin.
करिचर्म्मन्: करिचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) An elephant's hide. E. करिन्, and चर्म्मन् skin.
करिज: करिज m. (-जः) A young elephant. E. करि an elephant, and ज born.
करिदन्त: करिदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 An elephant's tusk. 2 Ivory. E. करिन् and दन्त a tooth.
करिदारक: करिदारक m. (-कः) A lion. E. करि an elephant, दृ to tear or rend, ण्वुल affix; or with युच् affix करिदारण.
करिन्: करिन् m. (-री) An elephant. E. कर the proboscis of this animal, and इनि aff.
करिपिप्पली: करिपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant bearing a pungent fruit, (Pothos officinalis, Rox.) E. करि, and पिप्पली long-pepper; Elephantpepper; considered by native writers as a large species of that condiment; also गजपिप्पली, &c.
करिपोत: करिपोत m. (-तः) A young elephant, one under ten years old. E. करि, and पोत a young animal; also करिशावक.
करिबन्ध: करिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The post to which an elephant is tied. E. करि, and बन्ध a binding.
करिमाचल: करिमाचल m. (-लः) A lion. E. करि, मा splendor, and चल to go; the lion being considered as the natural enemy and destroyer of the elephant.
करिमुख: करिमुख m. (-खः) A title of GAṆEŚA. E. करि, and मुख a face: this deity being represented with an elephant's head.
करियादस्: करियादस् n. (-दः) A water elephant, a hippopotamus. E. करि, and यादस् any aquatic animal.
करिर: करिर m. (-रः) The shoot of a bamboo: see करीर.
करिशावक: करिशावक m. (-कः) A young elephant under five years old; according to some, also until ten years. E. see करिपोत, शावक meaning a young animal.
करिष्ठ: करिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Doing much. E. कर who does, इष्ठन् aff.
करिष्यत्: करिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Doing, (with a future sense,) about to do. E. कृ to do, शतृ affix of the future.
करिष्यमाण: करिष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) About to do, going to do. E. कृ to do, शानच् affix of the future.
करीन्द्र: करीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A large, or a war or state elephant. 2 INDRA'S elephant. E. करि, and इन्द्र chief.
करीयस्: करीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Who does much. E. कर who does, ईयसुन् aff.
करीर: करीर mn. (-रः-रं) The shoot of a bamboo; also करिर. m. (-रः) 1 A thorny plant, described as growing in desarts, and fed upon by camels, commonly Karit, (Capparis aphylla, Rox.) 2 A water jar. f. (-रा or री) 1 The root of an elephant's tusk. 2 A cricket, a small grasshopper, &c. E. कृ to injure, to throw. or send, &c. and ईरण् aff.
करीरिका: करीरिका f. (-का) The root of an elephant's tusk: see करीरी.
करीष: करीष mn. (-षः-षं) Dry cowdung. E. कृ to throw, send, &c. and ईषन् Uṇādi aff.
करीषङ्कषा: करीषङ्कषा f. (-षा) A strong wind, a gale. E. करीष, कष to disturb, खच् aff.
करीषाग्नि: करीषाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A fire of dry cowdung. E. करीष, and अग्नि fire; this substance is very generally used as fuel in Hindustan.
करुण: करुण mf. (-णः-णा) Tenderness, pity, compassion, the feeling or sentiment. adv. (-णं) Pitifully, in distress. m. (-णः) 1 Sorrow, affliction, one of the eight sentiments. 2 The name of a fruit tree, the pamplemousse, (Citrus decumana.) 3 A Jina or Jaina saint. E. कृ to send or cast, उनन् Uṇādi aff.
करुणात्मक: करुणात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Compassionate, tender-hearted. E. करुणा आत्म self, कन् added.
करुणापर: करुणापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Compassionate, tender. E. करुणा, and पर excellent.
करुणामल्ली: करुणामल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Double jasmin: see नवमल्ली.
करुणामय: करुणामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Gentle, compassionate. E. करुणा and मयट् aff.
करुणार्द्र: करुणार्द्र mfn. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्र) Tender-hearted, soft, sensitive. E. करुणा, and आर्द्र moist.
करुणाविप्रलम्भ: करुणाविप्रलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Grief of separation with the uncertainty of meeting again, fears occurring in absence. E. करुणा sorrow, and विप्रलम्भ separation.
करुणावेदिता: करुणावेदिता f. (-ता) Charitableness, kindliness. E. करुणा, वेदिन् who knows, तल् aff.
करेट: करेट m. (-टः) A finger nail. E. कर, and इट to go, अच् aff.
करेटु: करेटु mf. (-टुः) The numidian crane. E. क for कुत् bad, or क water, and रेट to sound, उ aff.
करेणु: करेणु mf. (-णुः) A male or female elephant. m. (-णुः) A plant: see कर्णिकार. E. कृ to do, &c. ण्णु Uṇādi affix; also with a final long vowel, करेणू.
करेणुभू: करेणुभू m. (-भूः) The name of a Muni or saint; also पालकाप्य.
करेणुवर्य: करेणुवर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A large or powerful elephant. E. करेणु, and वर्य्य excellent.
करेणुवर्य्य: करेणुवर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A large or powerful elephant. E. करेणु, and वर्य्य excellent.
करेणुसुत: करेणुसुत m. (-तः) The name of a Muni.
करेणू: करेणू mf. (-णूः) A male or female elephant: see करेणु.
करोट: करोट mf. (-टः or टी) The bones of the head, the scull. E. क the head, रुट to oppose, to defend, &c. affixes अच् and इन् or ङीष्.
करोत्कर: करोत्कर m. (-रः) 1 A bundle of rags. 2 A heavy tax. E. कर, and उत्कर plenty.
करोदक: करोदक n. (-कं) Water held in, or poured into the hand. E. कर, and उदक water.
कर्क: कर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं) 1 White. 2 Good, excellent. m. (-र्कः) 1 A white horse. 2 A mirror. 3 A water jar. 4 A crab. 5 A sign of the zodiac, (Cancer.) 6 Fire. 7 A long gourd. 8 Beauty. E. कृ to do, &c. कः Uṇādi aff.
कर्कचिर्भिटी: कर्कचिर्भिटी f. (-टी) A small cucumber. E. कर्क, and चिर्भिटी the same.
कर्कट: कर्कट m. (-टः) 1 A crab. 2 The sign of the zodiac, (Cancer.) 3 A kind of bird, the numidian crane. 4 A long gourd: see तुम्बी. 5 The fibrous root of the lotus. 6 The curved end of the beam of a balance, to which the strings supporting the scale are attached. 7 A compass. 8 The radius of a circle. f. (-टा) A plant, commonly Kurkavali, (Momordica mixta.) (-टी) 1 A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus, Rox.) 2 The fruit of the silk cotton tree. 3 A snake. 4 A water jar. E. कर्क a Sautra root, to laugh or smile, and अटन् affix, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
कर्कटक: कर्कटक m. (-कः) A crab. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कर्कटशृङ्गिका: कर्कटशृङ्गिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Kāṅkarasriṅgī: see the next.
कर्कटशृङ्गी: कर्कटशृङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, the fruit of which is compared to the claw or feelers or a crab, the horn of a goat, &c. see अजशृङ्गी. E. कर्कट, शृङ्ग a horn, इनि and ङीष् affixes.
कर्कटाख्या: कर्कटाख्या f. (-ख्या) See the preceding. E. कर्कट, and आख्या an appellation.
कर्कटि: कर्कटि f. (-टिः) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus:) see कर्कट.
कर्कन्धु: कर्कन्धु mf. (-न्धुः-न्धूः) A tree, the jujube: see the next.
कर्कन्धू: कर्कन्धू mf. (-न्धूः) The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. कर्क excellent, धा to have, and कु Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ऊञ्.
कर्कर: कर्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard, firm. n. (-रं) Stone, limestone. especially the nodule found in Bengal under the name of Kankar. m. (-रः) A mirror. f. (-री) A small water jar. E. कर्क beauty, from कर्क to smile, र from रा to give, fem. affix ङीष्.
कर्कराक्ष: कर्कराक्ष m. (-क्षः) A wagtail. E. कर्कर a mirror, and अक्ष an eye: bright-eyed.
कर्कराङ्ग: कर्कराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A gallinule. E. कर्कर firm, and अङ्ग body.
कर्कराटु: कर्कराटु m. (-टुः) A glance, a side look.
कर्कराटुक: कर्कराटुक m. (-कः) The numidian crane: see कर्करेटु.
कर्करान्धक: कर्करान्धक m. (-कः) A blind well, one of which the mouth is overgrown with grass, &c. so as to be hidden.
कर्कराल: कर्कराल mn. (-लः-लं) A curl, a ringlet.
कर्करी: कर्करी f. (-री) A water jar with a spout.
कर्करीका: कर्करीका f. (-का) A small water jar. E. कॄ to scatter, in the reiterative form, and ईकः Uṇādi aff.
कर्करेट: कर्करेट n. (-टं) The hand curved as a claw or half moon, for the purpose of grasping any thing. E. कर्कर hard, firm, इट to go, to be, affix अप्.
कर्करेटु: कर्करेटु mf. (-टुः) The numidian crane: see करेटु. E. कर्कश hard, &c. रेट to sound, deriv. irr.
कर्कश: कर्कश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Violent. 2 Hard. 3 Intangible. 4 Cruel. 5 Unfeeling, unmerciful. 6 Harsh, unkind. 7 Miserly. m. (-शः) 1 A plant, commonly Sunda rocani, (Crinum?) 2 A kind of cassia, (Cassia esculenta.) 3 Sugar cane. 4 A sword, a scymitar. f. (-शी) Wild jujube; also कर्क्कशिका. E. कृ to injure, विच् affix, कश with the same meaning, and अच्, highly injurious: or कर्क्क a Sautra root, and शः aff.
कर्कशच्छद: कर्कशच्छद m. (-दः) 1 A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 2 A kind of gourd, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. कर्कश hard, and छद a leaf.
कर्कशवाक्य: कर्कशवाक्य n. (-क्यं) Harsh or contumelious speech. E. कर्श, and वाक्य speech.
कर्कसार: कर्कसार n. (-रं) Flour or meal mixed with curds. E. कर्क, and सार essence.
कर्कारु: कर्कारु m. (-रुः) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.) E. कव white, ऋ to go, or to be, उण् affix; also कर्कारु.
कर्कारुक: कर्कारुक m. (-कः) A plant, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
कर्केतर: कर्क्केतर m. (-रः) A kind of gem or precious stone.
कर्क्केतर: कर्क्केतर m. (-रः) A kind of gem or precious stone.
कर्कोट: कर्कोट m. (-टः) One of the principal serpents or Nāgas of Pātāla.
कर्कोटक: कर्कोटक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Ægle marmelos:) see मालूर. 2 A Nāga or serpent: see the preceding. 3 A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia:) in this sense; also कर्कोटिका. 5 Sugar cane.
कर्कोटकी: कर्कोटकी f. (-की) A plant, a Ghosha with yellow flowers: see घोष.
कर्घ: कर्घ r. 1st cl. (कर्घति) To go, to move.
कर्चूर: कर्चूर m. (-रः) A plant, (Curcuma reclinata, Rox.) n. (-रं) Gold: see कर्बूर.
कर्चूरक: कर्चूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet:) see कर्बूरक.
कर्ज: कर्ज r. 1st cl. (कर्जति) To pain or make uneasy.
कर्ण: कर्ण r. 10th cl. (कर्णयति) To pierce or bore: with the prefix आङ्, समा, (सम् and आङ्) or उप, to hear or listen.

कर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The ear. 2 KARṆA a prince, sovereign of Aṅgadeśa, and elder brother, by the mother's side, to the Pāṇḍu princes, being the son of SŪRYA by KUNTĪ, before her marriage with PĀṆḌU. 3 The helm or rudder of a vessel. 4 (In prosody,) A spondee, a foot of two long syllables. 5 (In geometry,) The hypothenuse of a triangle, or the diagonal of a tetragon. 6 A plant, (Cassia fistula.) 7 A kind of swallow wort, (Colotropis gigantea.) E. कर्ण to hear, घञ् affix; or कृ do, &c. न Uṇādi aff.
कर्णकण्डु: कर्णकण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) Itching of the ear. E. कर्ण, and कण्डु itching.
कर्णकीटी: कर्णकीटी f. (-टी) 1 An insect or worm with many feet, and of a reddish colour, (Julus cornifex.) 2 A small centipede. E. कर्ण the ear, and कीट an insect, being supposed to attack the ear especially.
कर्णक्ष्वेड: कर्णक्ष्वेड m. (-डः) An affection of the ear, a roaring or constant noise in it. E. कर्ण, and क्ष्वेड a buzzing in the ear.
कर्णग: कर्णग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Hanging on the ear, next to the ear. 2 Extending to the ear. E. कर्ण, and ग what goes.
कर्णगूथ: कर्णगूथ m. (-थः) The wax of the ear. E. कर्ण, and गूथ foeces, excrement.
कर्णगोचर: कर्णगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Capable of being heard, perceptible to the ear. E. कर्ण, and गोचर perceptible.
कर्णग्राह: कर्णग्राह m. (-हः) A helmsman. E. कर्ण, and ग्राह who holds.
कर्णग्राहवत्: कर्णग्राहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a helmsman. E. कर्णग्राह, and मतुप् aff.
कर्णच्छिद्र: कर्णछिद्र n. (-द्रं) The outer auditory passage. E. कर्ण, and छिद्र hole.
कर्णछिद्र: कर्णछिद्र n. (-द्रं) The outer auditory passage. E. कर्ण, and छिद्र hole.
कर्णजप: कर्णजप m. (-पः) An informer. E. कर्ण, and जप who whispers; also कर्णेजप.
कर्णजलूका: कर्णजलूका f. (-का) 1 An insect, (Julus.) 2 A small centipede: see कर्णकीटी. E. कर्ण; and जलूका a leech.
कर्णजलौकस्: कर्णजलौकस् f. (-काः) A worm: see the preceding; also कर्णजलौका.
कर्णजलौका: कर्णजलौका f. (-का) A kind of insect, (Julus cornifex, &c.) 2 A small centipede; also कर्णजलौकस् and कर्णजलूका.
कर्णजाह: कर्णजाह n. (-हं) The root of the ear. E. कर्ण, and जाह affix in this sense.
कर्णजित्: कर्णजित् m. (-जित्) A title of ARJUNA. E. कर्ण, and जित् conqueror; KARṆA. having taken the part of the Kurus, was killed by ARJUNA in the great battle between them and the Pāṇḍus.
कर्णताल: कर्णताल m. (-लः) The flapping of an elephant's ears. E. कण, and ताल tune.
कर्णदर्पण: कर्णदर्पण m. (-णः) An ear-ring, an ornament of the ear. E. कर्ण, and दर्पण a mirror.
कर्णदुन्दुभि: कर्णदुन्दुभि f. (-भिः) A kind of worm: see कर्णकीटी. E. कर्ण, and दुन्दुभि a sort of drum; making a noise in the ear like a drum.
कर्णधार: कर्णधार m. (-रः) A pilot, a helmsman. E. कर्ण the helm, धृञ् to have or hold, and अण् aff.
कर्णनाद: कर्णनाद m. (-दः) Ringing in the ear. E. कर्ण, and नाद sound.
कर्णन्दु: कर्णन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A woman's ear-ring: see कर्णान्दु and कर्णेन्दु.
कर्णपाक: कर्णपाक m. (-कः) Inflammation of the outer ear. E. कर्ण, and पाक ripening.
कर्णपाली: कर्णपाली f. (-ली) An ornament of the ear, a garland or string of jewels pendent from it. E. कर्ण, and पाल to cherish.
कर्णपुर: कर्णपुर m. (-रः) The capital of KARṆA, the ancient name of Bhāgalpur. E. कर्ण, and पुर city; also कर्णपुर् f. (-पूः)
कर्णपूर: कर्णपूर m. (-रः) 1 A tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) 2 The blue lotus. 3 An ear-ring. 4 The Asoka tree. E. कर्ण, and पूर to make full, to complete.
कर्णपूरक: कर्णपूरक m. (-कः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.) E. कर्णपूर an ear-ring, and कन् resembling, like the large round drop or pendant of a Hindustani ear-ring.
कर्णप्रतिनाह: कर्णप्रतिनाह m. (-हः) A disease of the ear, suppression of the excretion or wax, which is supposed to have dissolved and pass by the nose and mouth. E. कर्ण, and प्रतिनाह suppression.
कर्णफल: कर्णफल m. (-लः) A sort of fish, (Ophiocephalus kurrawey.) E. कर्ण, and फल fruit.
कर्णमद्गुर: कर्णमद्गुर m. (-रः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus unitus.) E. कर्ण, and मद्गुर a sheat fish.
कर्णमल: कर्णमल m. (-लः) The excretion or wax of the ear. E. कण, and मल dirt.
कर्णमुकुर: कर्णमुकुर m. (-रः) 1 An ornament of the ear. 2 An ear-ring. E. कर्ण, and मुकुर a mirror; reflecting its beauty.
कर्णमोटी: कर्णमोटी f. (-टी) A name of DEVĪ or DURGĀ in one of her forms or incarnations. E. कर्ण the ear, मुठ to rub, घञ् and ङीप् affixes; this is sometimes written कर्णमोटि.
कर्णलतिका: कर्णलतिका f. (-का) The lobe of the ear. E. कर्ण, लता a creeping plant, कन् added.
कर्णवंश: कर्णवंश m. (-शः) An elevated platform. E. कर्ण, and वंश a bamboo.
कर्णवत्: कर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having ears. 2 Long eared. 3 Having a helm. E. कर्ण and मतुप् aff.
कर्णवर्जित: कर्णवर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Earless. m. (-तः) A snake. E. कर्ण, and वर्जित deprived.
कर्णविद्रधि: कर्णविद्रधि f. (-धिः) Ulceration of the ear. E. कर्ण, and विद्रधि a sore.
कर्णवेध: कर्णवेध m. (-धः) 1 Boring the ears: as a religious ceremony it is performed where there are three sons, to prevent one of them from dying. 2 Piercing the ear in general. E. कर्ण, and वेध piercing.
कर्णवेधनिका: कर्णवेधनिका f. (-का) An instrument for perforating the ear. E. कर्ण, विध to pierce, ल्युट् and ङीष् affixes, with कन् added, and the fem. termination टाप्.
कर्णवेष्टक: कर्णवेष्टक n. (-कं) An ear-ring: see the next.
कर्णवेष्टन: कर्णवेष्टन n. (-नं) An ear-ring. E. कर्ण, and वेष्टन surrounding.
कर्णशष्कुली: कर्णशष्कुली f. (-ली) The outer part of the ear, the cartilage and depressions leading to the auditory passage. E. कर्ण, and शष्कुल the hollows of the ear.
कर्णशूल: कर्णशूल n. (-लं) Ear-ache. E. कर्ण, and शूल pain.
कर्णश्रव: कर्णश्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Audible, loud. E. कर्ण, and श्रव hearing.
कर्णसंस्राव: कर्णसंस्राव m. (-वः) Discharge of pus from the ear. E. कर्ण, and संस्राव suppuration.
कर्णस्राव: कर्णस्राव m. (-वः) Discharge of ichorous matter from the ear. E. कर्ण, and स्राव running.
कर्णस्फोटा: कर्णस्फोटा f. (-टा) A sort of creeper. E. कर्ण, and स्फोट a boil.
कर्णाट: कर्णाट m. (-टः) A country, Karṇāṭa, whence the modern Karnatic: the name however was anciently applied to the central districts of the peninsula, including Mysūr. f. (-टी) 1 One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes, the bride of the Rāga MĀLAVA. 2 A plant. E. कर्ण the ear, a prince, &c. and अट to go, affix अच्.
कर्णानुज: कर्णानुज m. (-जः) A name of Yudhiṣṭhira, the elder brother of the five Pāṇḍu princes. E. कर्ण, and अनुज younger born; the younger brother of KARṆA.
कर्णान्तिक: कर्णान्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Near or close to the ear. E. कर्ण, and अन्तिक near.
कर्णान्दु: कर्णान्दु f. (-न्दुः) 1 An ornament of the ear. 2 An ear-ring: see the next, and कर्णेन्दु.
कर्णान्दू: कर्णान्दू f. (-न्दूः) An ornament of the ear, an ear-ring, &c. E. कर्ण, and अन्दू a chain.
कर्णारा: कर्णारा f. (-रा) An instrument for perforating the ear. E. कर्ण the ear, ऋ to go, अच् and टाप् affs.
कर्णारि: कर्णारि m. (-रिः) A name of ARJUNA. E. कर्ण, and अरि an enemy.
कर्णालङ्कार: कर्णालङ्कार m. (-रः) An ear-ring, an ornament of the ear. E. कर्ण and अलङ्कार ornament; also कर्णालङ्किया, कर्णालङ्कृति, &c.
कर्णास्फाल: कर्णास्फाल m. (-लः) The flapping of an elephant's ear. E. कर्ण, and आस्फाल with the same import.
कर्णिक: कर्णिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Having large or long ears. 2 Having ears. 3 Having a helm. m. (कः-) A steersman. f. (-का) 1 An ear-ring or ornament of the ear. 2 The pericarp of a lotus. 3 The middle finger. 4 The tip of an elephant's trunk. 5 A fruit stalk. 6 A pen or small brush. 7 A plant, (Premna spinosa, &c.) see अग्निमन्थ. E. कर्णं the ear, &c. इक affix; or कन् and टाप् aff.
कर्णिकाचल: कर्णिकाचल m. (-लः) The fabulous mountain Sumeru. E. कर्णिका the seed vessel of a lotus, and अचल a mountain, Meru being in the centre of the world, the divisions of which are delineated as the leaves of a lotus; also other compounds, as कर्णिकाद्रि, &c.
कर्णिकार: कर्णिकार m. (-रः) 1 The name of a tree, commonly Kaniyar, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) 2 A sort of Cassia, (Cassia fistula.) 3 The pericarp of a lotus. E. कर्णिका an ornament of the ear, ऋ to go, अण् affix; also with कन् added कर्णिकारक.
कर्णिकिन्: कर्णिकिन् m. (-की) An elephant. E. कर्णिका the tip of his trunk, and इनि aff.
कर्णिन्: कर्णिन् mfn. (-र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) 1 Having an ear, relating to the ear, &c. 2 Long eared. 3 Barbed, (as an arrow.) 4 Having a helm. m. (-र्णी) 1 The name of a mountain, one of the seven principal ranges of the mountains, dividing the universe. 2 The side of the neck, the part near the ear. 3 A steersman. f. (-णिनी) A disease of the uterus, prolapsus or polypus uteri. E. कर्ण, and इनि aff.
कर्णिल: कर्णिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Long eared. E. कर्ण and इलच् aff.
कर्णीरथ: कर्णीरथ mf. (-थः-था) A covered car, or according to some, a litter for the conveyance of women, &c. borne on men's shoulders. E. कर्णी the part near the ear, and रथ a carriage.
कर्णीसुत: कर्णीसुत m. (-तः) A name of KAṂSA the enemy of KṚṢṆA. E. कर्णी the mother of this prince, and मुत a son.
कर्णेजप: कर्णेजप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) An informer, a tale bearer. E. कर्णे in the ear, and जप to recite in a low voice, अच् aff.
कर्णेन्दु: कर्णेन्दु f. (-न्दुः) 1 A semicircular ornament of the ear. 2 An earring. E. कर्ण, and इन्दु the moon, a crescent, &c. see कर्णान्द.
कर्त: कर्त्त r. 10th cl. (कर्त्तयति) To slacken or unloose, to remove; also कत्र and कर्त्र.
कर्त्त: कर्त्त r. 10th cl. (कर्त्तयति) To slacken or unloose, to remove; also कत्र and कर्त्र.
कर्तन: कर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting, cutting off or in pieces. 2 Spinning cotton or thread. f. (-नी) Scissors. E. कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.
कर्त्तन: कर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting, cutting off or in pieces. 2 Spinning cotton or thread. f. (-नी) Scissors. E. कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.
कर्तरिका: कर्त्तरिका f. (-का) 1 A knife. 2 A small sword or cutlass. 3 A hunter's knife or sword, a couteau de chasse. 4 A scissors. E. कर्त्तरी, and कन् added.
कर्त्तरिका: कर्त्तरिका f. (-का) 1 A knife. 2 A small sword or cutlass. 3 A hunter's knife or sword, a couteau de chasse. 4 A scissors. E. कर्त्तरी, and कन् added.
कर्तरी: कर्त्तरी f. (-री) 1 A scissors or shears. 2 A knife. 3 A small sword or cutlass. E. कृत to cut, अरन् affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
कर्त्तरी: कर्त्तरी f. (-री) 1 A scissors or shears. 2 A knife. 3 A small sword or cutlass. E. कृत to cut, अरन् affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
कर्तव्य: कर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be done or made. 2 What ought to be done. E. कृ to make, तव्य aff.
कर्त्तव्य: कर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be done or made. 2 What ought to be done. E. कृ to make, तव्य aff.
कर्तव्यता: कर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Necessity, obligation, propriety, fitness. E. कत्तव्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix कर्त्तव्यत्वं.
कर्त्तव्यता: कर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Necessity, obligation, propriety, fitness. E. कत्तव्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix कर्त्तव्यत्वं.
कर्तित: कर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, cut off. E. कृत to cut, क्त aff.
कर्त्तित: कर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, cut off. E. कृत to cut, क्त aff.
कर्तिष्यत्: कर्त्तिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Intending or wishing to cut. E. कृत to cut, शतृ affix of the future participle; also कर्त्तिष्यमाण (-णः-णा-णं) with शानच् aff.
कर्त्तिष्यत्: कर्त्तिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Intending or wishing to cut. E. कृत to cut, शतृ affix of the future participle; also कर्त्तिष्यमाण (-णः-णा-णं) with शानच् aff.
कर्तुकाम: कर्त्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous or intending to do. E. कत्तुम् to do, काम desire, the final of the first rejected.
कर्त्तुकाम: कर्त्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous or intending to do. E. कत्तुम् to do, काम desire, the final of the first rejected.
कर्तृ: कर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) 1 An agent, a doer, a maker, one who makes or does. 2 One who practices what he knows. m. (-र्त्ता) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 (In grammar,) The active noun, the nominative case. E. कृ to do, and तृच् affix: it may also be read कर्त्तृ.
कर्त्तृ: कर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) 1 An agent, a doer, a maker, one who makes or does. 2 One who practices what he knows. m. (-र्त्ता) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 (In grammar,) The active noun, the nominative case. E. कृ to do, and तृच् affix: it may also be read कर्त्तृ.
कर्तृक: कर्त्तृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An agent, one who does any thing. E. कन् added to the last.
कर्त्तृक: कर्त्तृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An agent, one who does any thing. E. कन् added to the last.
कर्तृकत्व: कर्त्तृकत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, action. E. कर्त्तृक and त्व aff.
कर्त्तृकत्व: कर्त्तृकत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, action. E. कर्त्तृक and त्व aff.
कर्तृका: कर्त्तृका f. (-का) A small sword. E. कृत to cut, कृन् aff.
कर्त्तृका: कर्त्तृका f. (-का) A small sword. E. कृत to cut, कृन् aff.
कर्तृत्व: कर्त्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, the act or property of an agent. E. कर्त्तृ, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix कर्त्तृता.
कर्त्तृत्व: कर्त्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, the act or property of an agent. E. कर्त्तृ, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix कर्त्तृता.
कर्तृवाच्य: कर्त्तृवाच्य m. (-च्यः) (In grammar,) The active voice. E. कर्त्तृ agent, and वाच्य to be said.
कर्त्तृवाच्य: कर्त्तृवाच्य m. (-च्यः) (In grammar,) The active voice. E. कर्त्तृ agent, and वाच्य to be said.
कर्त्र: कर्त्र r. 10th cl. (कर्त्रयति) To unloose, to remove: see कर्त्त.
कर्त्री: कर्त्री f. (-र्त्री) A scissors. E. कृत to cut, तृच् and ङीष् affs.
कर्द: कर्द r. 1st cl. (कर्दति) To grumble, as the bowels; to caw as a crow; or to make any such noise.
कर्द m. (-र्दः) Mud, clay. E. कर्द to sound ill, अच् aff.
कर्दट: कर्दट m. (-टः) 1 The fibrous root of the lotus. 2 Mud, dirt. 2 Any aquatic weed, as Vallisneria, &c. E. कर्द mud, and अट what goes.
कर्दन: कर्दन n. (-नं) Grumbling of the bowels, borborygmi. E. कर्द to make such a noise, and ल्युट् aff.
कर्दम: कर्दम m. (-मः) 1 Mud, mire, clay. 2 Sin. 3 A Prajāpati, the son of BRAHMĀ by CHĀYĀ, and he father of Kapila: (this personage appears to be an innovation in Hindu mythology.) f. (-मी) A plant. n. (-मं) Flesh. E. कर्द to sound badly, and अम Uṇādi aff.
कर्दमाटक: कर्दमाटक m. (-कः) A receptacle for filth, a sewer, a necessary. E. कर्दम filth, अट to go, and वुन् aff.
कर्पट: कर्पट m. (-टः) Old and patched or ragged garments. E. कृप to be able, and अटन् aff.
कर्पटधारिन्: कर्पटधारिन् m. (री) A religious mendicant, a Fakir, a beggar in patched or ragged clothes, or sometimes with merely a cloth to cover the privities. E. कर्पट as above, धृ to have, and णिनि affix; also कर्पटिक and कर्पटिन्.
कर्पटिन्: कर्पटिन् m. (-टी) See कर्पटधारिन्. This and the two preceding words may also be used in three genders, meaning, beggar in general, or any one in beggarly raiment.
कर्पर: कर्पर m. (-रः) 1 The skull, the cranium. 2 An iron saucepan or frying pan. 3 A kind of weapon. 4 The Glomerous fig tree: see उडुम्बर. f. (-री) A collyrium extracted from the Amomum authorhiza, Rox. E. कृप to be able, अरन् aff.
कर्पराल: कर्पराल m. (-लः) A tree, described as a Pīlu growing in the hills. E. कर्पर the skull, &c. and अल to adorn, अण् aff.
कर्पराश: कर्पराश m. (-शः) Sand, gravel, a sandy soil.
कर्परिकातुत्थ: कर्परिकातुत्थ n. (-त्थं) A collyrium extracted from the Amomum authorhiza: see कर्परा. E. कर्परिका for कर्परी, and तुत्थ any collyrium.
कर्पास: कर्पास mn. (-सः-सं) Cotton. f. (-सी) The cotton tree; also कार्पासी. E. कृ to do, &c. पास Uṇādi aff.
कर्पूर: कर्पूर mn. (-रः-रं) Camphor. E. कृप to be able, ऊरः Uṇādi aff.
कर्पूरक: कर्पूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet, Rox.) see कर्ब्बूरक and कचूरक.
कर्पूरतिलका: कर्पूरतिलका f. (-का) One of DURGĀ'S female attendants or confidantes: see जया. E. कर्पूर camphor, and तिलक the sectarial spot on the forehead; having the Tilaka of camphor.
कर्पूरतैल: कर्प्पूरतैल n. (-लं) Camphor liniment. E. कर्प्पूर, and तैल oil.
कर्प्पूरतैल: कर्प्पूरतैल n. (-लं) Camphor liniment. E. कर्प्पूर, and तैल oil.
कर्पूरनालिका: कर्प्पूरनालिका f. (-का) Rice dressed with spices, camphor and ghee.
कर्प्पूरनालिका: कर्प्पूरनालिका f. (-का) Rice dressed with spices, camphor and ghee.
कर्पूरमणि: कर्प्पूरमणि m. (-णिः) A white mineral used medicinally. E. कर्प्पूर, and मणि a gem.
कर्प्पूरमणि: कर्प्पूरमणि m. (-णिः) A white mineral used medicinally. E. कर्प्पूर, and मणि a gem.
कर्ब: कर्ब r. 1st cl. (कर्बति) To go, to move or approach.
कर्बुदार: कर्बुदार m. (-रः) 1 Mountain ebony: see कोबिदार. 2 Blue barleria: see नीलझिण्टी.
कर्बुर: कर्बुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Variegated, of a spotted or variegated color. f. (-रा) 1 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 A sort of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum:) see वर्वरा. f. (-री) A name of the goddess DURGĀ. n. (-रं) 1 Gold. 2 Water. 3 Datura, (the fruit.) (-रः) 1 A demon, an imp or goblin. 2 A variegated colour. 3 A plant, (Curcuma reclinata, Rox.) see शठी. 4 Sin. 5 Rice growing amidst inundation. E. कब to tinge or dye, उरच् Uṇādi affix and र inserted, or कर्ब to go, &c. and उरन् affix, also long, कर्बुर; it is also often read with the dental ब, but perhaps erroneously.
कर्बूर: कर्बूर mn. (-रः-रं) Gold. m. (-रः) 1 A species of curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.) 2 Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) 3 A demon. f. (-रा) A leech. n. (-रं) Yellow orpiment, see कर्बुर and कर्बूरक.
कर्बूरक: कर्बूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet, Rox.) E. कन् added to the preceding: also कचूरक.

कर्मन्: कर्म्मन् mn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Action in general. 2 The object of an action. 3 The subject of action in grammar, considered of three kinds, प्राप्य or व्याप्य when it is simple, as ग्रामं गच्छति he goes to the village; सूर्य्यं पश्यति he sees the sun; विकार्य्य when change of form is implied, as सुवर्णं कुण्डलं करोति gold forms the ear-ring; and निर्वर्त्य when some new product is evolved, as कटं करोति he makes a mat; पुत्रं प्रसूते she bears a son. 4 The objective noun. 5 Action specific, moral duty, the obligation imposed by peculiarities of tribe, occupation, &c. 6 Natural, active property, as maturity, of heat; support, of earth; dispersion, of wind, &c. 7 Religious action, as sacrifice, ablution, &c. especially as originating in the hope of future recompense, and as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of spirit. 8 (In Logic,) Substantial action or motion of five kinds, upwards, downwards, extension, contraction, and going in general. 9 Action or act involving retribution or reward, virtue, vice, &c. 10 Fate, the certain consequence of previous acts. E. कृञ् to do, मनिन् aff.

कर्ष: कर्ष mn. (-र्षः-र्षं) A weight of gold or silver, a Karṣa equal to sixteen Māṣas; this, according to the ancient division of five Rattis to the Māṣa, would make the Karṣa equal to about 176 grains troy; in common use, eight Rattis are given to the Māṣa, and the Karṣa is therefore about 280 grains troy: see मास and रक्तिक. m. (-षः) 1 Drawing, dragging, pulling. 2 Ploughing. 3 Attracting. 4 Beleric myrobalan: see विभीतक. E. कृष to plough, अच् aff.

कर्षण: कर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Ploughing, cultivating the ground. 2 Pulling. dragging. 3 Attracting. E. कृष to plough, ल्युट् aff.
कर्षणि: कर्षणि f. (-णिः) A dishonest woman. E. कृष and अनि aff.

कर्षफल: कर्षफल m. (-लः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. कर्ष the same, and फल fruit.

कर्षित: कर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drawn. 2 Attracted. 3 Ploughed. E. कृष to draw, क्त aff.
कर्षिन्: कर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-षि) 1 What pulls or draws. 2 What ploughs or furrows. 3 Attractive, what attracts. f. (-णी) 1 A medicinal sort of moon plant: see क्षीरिणी. 2 The bit of a bridle. E. कृष to plough, &c. णिनि aff.
कर्षू: कर्षू m. (-र्षूः) 1 A fire of dried cowdung. 2 Agriculture, cultivating, cultivation. 3 Livelihood. f. (-र्षूः) 1 A river. 2 A canal. 3 A shallow trench for receiving the sacrificial fire. E. कृष to plough, &c. Uṇādi affix ऊ.

कल: कल r. 1st cl. (कलति) To sound. 1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कालयति) To throw or cast, to send; also 1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कलयति) 1 To go. 2 To count or reckon: with आङ् prefixed, 1 To take. 2 To bind or tie; with परि, To keep in mind, to think or remember; with वि, To maim, to separate a part, to make defective; with सम, To sum up, to add.

कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Crude, undigested. 2 Weak. m. (-लः) 1 A low or soft tone, as humming, buzzing, &c. 2 The Śāl tree. 3 In poetry, time equal to four mātras or instants. n. (-लं) 1 Semen virile. 2 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba) f. (-ला) 1 A small part of any thing. 2 A digit or one sixteenth of the moon's diameter. 3 A division of time, equal to thirty Kāṣas or about eight seconds. 4 The 60th part of one thirtieth of a zodiacal sign, a minute of a degree. 5 Interest on a capital. 6 Any practical art, mechanical or fine, sixty-four such are enumerated, as carpentering, architecture, jewellery, farriery, acting, dancing, music, medicine, poetry, &c. 7 The menstrual discharge. 8 A boat. 9 Fraud, deceit. E. कल to sound, to count, &c. (-अच्) affix; or क pleasure, and ल what gives, from ला to bring, &c.
