कलञ्ज: कलञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) An animal struck with a poisoned weapon.
कलट: कलट n. (-टं) The that of a house; other works read this कुटक q. v.
कलता: कलता f. (-ता) Melody, music. E. कल, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कलत्वं.
कलत्र: कलत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The hip and loins. 2 A wife. 3 A royal citadel, a strong hold or fastness. E. गड to distil, &c. अत्रच् affix, क is substituted for ग, and ड and ल are interchangeable: see कडत्र; or कल weak, feeble, and त्र, from त्रै to preserve, affix ड.
कलधूत: कलधूत n. (-तं) 1 Gold. 2 Silver: see the next.
कलधौत: कलधौत n. (-तं) 1 Gold. 2 Silver. 3 A low or pleasing tone; also कलधूत.
कलधौतलिपि: कलधौतलिपि f. (-पिः) 1 A streak of gold. 2 Illumination of a manuscript with gold. E. कलधौत, and लिपि writing.
कलध्वनि: कलध्वनि m. (-निः) 1 The turtle dove. 2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 3 A peacock. 4 A low sweet tone. E. कल, and ध्वनि a sound.
कलन: कलन n. (-नं) 1 A spot, a stain. 2 An offence, fault, defect. 3 Murmuring, sounding. 4 An embryo or the first vestige of the foetus. m. (-नः) A sort of cane. f. (-ना) 1 Subjection, submission. 2 Chattering, talking. 3 Shedding, emitting. E. कल to count, ल्युट् aff.
कलन्दर: कलन्दर m. (-रः) A man of a mixed caste.
कलन्दिका: कलन्दिका f. (-का) Knowledge, intelligence, wisdom in general.
कलभ: कलभ m. (-भः) 1 A young elephant: see कल. 2 The Datura plant. E. कल to cast, अभच् Uṇādi affix; or according to some authorities कृ to cast, अभच् affix, making करभ, and र is then changed to ल.
कलम: कलम m. (-मः) 1 Rice which is sown in May and June, and ripens in December or January; a white rice growing in deep water: see शालि. 2 A pen, a reed for writing with. 3 A thief, a rogue. E. कल to count, &c. and अमः Uṇādi aff.
कलम्ब: कलम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 An arrow. 2 The stalk of a potherb. 3 The Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba:) see कदम्ब. n. (-म्बं) Calumba root, (Menispermum calumba.) f. (-म्बी) or m. and f. (-म्बः-म्बी) A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus repens, &c.) see कडम्बी. E. कड to delight, अम्बच् affix, ल substituted for ड, fem. affix ङीष्; also कलम्बक.
कलम्बिका: कलम्बिका f. (-का) 1 A potherb: see the preceding. E. कन् added to कलम्बी. 2 The nape of the neck. E. क the head, and लबि to be, to rest, ण्वुल aff.
कलम्बू: कलम्बू f. (-म्बूः) A potherb: see कलम्बी the fem. affix being ऊञ्.
कलयत्: कलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Computing, calculating. E. कल to count, शतृ aff.
कलरव: कलरव m. (-वः) 1 A dove, a pigeon. 2 The Indian cuckoo. 3 A low or pleasing tone, a humming, buzzing, &c. E. कल a low tone, and रव what utters.
कलल: कलल mn. (-लः-लं) The womb, the uterus; according to some, the embryo one month after conception. E. कल to reckon, अलच् aff.
कललज: कललज m. (-जः) Resin, the extract of the Śāl tree.
कललजोद्भव: कललजोद्भव m. (-वः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. कललज, and उद्भव birth.
कलविङ्क: कलविङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A sparrow. 2 A plant, (Echites antidysenterica:) see कलिङ्कक. 3 A spot, a stain. 4 A white Chowri. E. कल a low tone, chirping, &c. वकि to go, &c. अच् affix, the deriv. is irr; also कलविङ्कक.
कलश: कलश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) An earthen water pot; also कलस, कलशि, &c. E. क water, लश to labour, क aff.
कलशि: कलशि f. (-शिः) 1 A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.) 2 A water jar. E. क water, लश to labour, &c. कि affix; also कलशी and कलसि.
कलशी: कलशी f. (-शी) 1 A plant. 2 A water jar: see the preceding, and कलश.
कलस: कलस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) A water jar: see कलश. m. (-सः) 1 A measure, a Droṇa: see द्रोण. 2 A rounded pinnacle or ball on the top of a temple. f. (-सी) A plant: see कलशि, &c.
कलसीसुत: कलसीसुत m. (-तः) A name of the saint AGASTYA: see घटोद्भव and अगस्त्य.
कलसोदधि: कलसोदधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. कलस, and उदधि the same.
कलस्वर: कलस्वर n. (-रं) A low musical sound. E. कल, and स्वर a note.
कलह: कलह mn. (-हः-हं) 1 War, battle. 2 Strife, contention. m. (-हः) 1 The sheath of a sword, a scabbard. 2 A road, a way. 3 Deceit, falsehood. 4 Violence without murderous weapons, abuse, beating, kicking, &c. E. कल a pleasing sound, and ह what destroys, from हन with ड aff.
कलहंस: कलहंस m. (-सः) 1 A drake, or according to some, a teal. 2 A gander. 3 Another bird, (Gallinula porphyria.) 4 BRAHM or the Supreme Being. 5 An emperor. 6 A species of the Atijagatī metre. E. कल pleasing sound, and हंस a goose.
कलहकार: कलहकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Contending with, fighting. 2 Quarrelsome, turbulent. E. कलह, and कार who makes.
कलहकारिन्: कलहकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Assailing, contending or fighting with. 2 Quarrelsome, fractions, turbulent. E. कलह, and कारिन् who makes.
कलहप्रिय: कलहप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Quarrelsome. m. (-यः) NĀRADA. f. (-या) The Maina, a bird. E. कलह, and प्रिय fond of.
कलहान्तरिता: कलहान्तरिता f. (-ता) An appeased wife, one who has been angry and is sorry for it. E. कलह strife, अन्तरित covered, &c. fem. affix टाप्.
कलहापहृत: कलहापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken by force. E. कलह, and अपहृत taken away.
कलाकुशल: कलाकुशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Skilled in the elegant arts; singing, dancing, &c. E. कला, and कुशल clever.
कलाकेलि: कलाकेलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Gay, frolicsome, wanton. m. (-लिः) A name of KĀMA or love. E. कला deceit, and केलि who sports.
कलाङ्कुर: कलाङ्कुर m. (-रः) 1 A crane. 2 A name of KAṂSA.
कलाचिका: कलाचिका f. (-का) The fore arm, the arm below the elbow; also कलाची.
कलाद: कलाद m. (-दः) A goldsmith: see कणाद. E. कला an art, and दा to give, ड aff.
कलानिधि: कलानिधि m. (-धिः) The moon. E. कला a digit, निधि a treasure; containing many digits.
कलानुनादिन्: कलानुनादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A bee, but particularly one of a very large kind. 2 A sparrow. 3 The Cātaka, a bird so called. E. कल a buzz, &c. अनुनद to sound, णिनि aff.
कलान्तर: कलान्तर n. (-रं) Interest, profit. E. कला a part, अन्तर over.
कलाप: कलाप m. (-पः) 1 An ornament in general. 2 A zone, a string of bells worn by women round the wrist. 3 A peacock's tail. 4 Assemblage, multitude. 5 A quiver. 6 The moon. 7 A clever and intelligent man. 8 The name of a grammar of the Sanscrit language, ascribed to the god KĀRTTIKEYA. 9 A village where the destroyer KALKI is to be born. 10 A poem written in one metre. E. कला an art, a division of time, &c. आप to obtain, and अण् aff.
कलापक: कलापक m. (-कः) A rope on an elephant's neck. n. (-कं) 1 A number of verses in one metre. 2 A series of four stanzas on one subject. 3 A loan to be repaid when the peacocks spread their tails. E. कलाप and वुन् aff.
कलापिन्: कलापिन् m. (-पी) 1 A peacock. 2 The Indian cuckoo. 3 Waved leaf fig tree. 4 The author of the Kalāpa grammar. f. (-नी) 1 The moon. 2 A species of cyperus. E. कलाप a peacock's tail, &c. इनि aff.
कलापूर्ण: कलापूर्ण m. (-र्णः) The moon. E. कला a digit, and पूर्ण filled, complete.
कलाभृत्: कलाभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 The moon. 2 An artist, a mechanic, &c. E. कला a digit, &c. and भृत् who cherishes.
कलामक: कलामक m. (-कः) A kind of rice ripening in the cold season: see कलम.
कलाम्बि: कलाम्बि f. (-म्बिः) Lending, a loan: see the next.
कलाम्बिका: कलाम्बिका f. (-का) Lending, a loan. E. कल a part, and अम्ब to go, वुन् aff.
कलाय: कलाय m. (-यः) The name of various leguminous seeds, chiefly of the order Phaseolus, particular kinds of pulse or vetches. E. क wind, ला to bring or give, and युक् aff.
कलायखञ्ज: कलायखञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) One who trembles and totters as he walks. E. कलाय, and खञ्ज a wagtail.
कलायन: कलायन m. (-नः) A tumbler, a dancer, but especially one who dances or walks on a sharp edge, as the edge of a sword, &c. E. कला a part, and अयन going.
कलालाप: कलालाप m. (-पः) A bee, &c. E. कल buzz, and आलाप speech.
कलावत्: कलावत् m. (-वान्) A name of Candra or the moon. f. (-ती) 1 A celestial lute or Vīṇā. 2 The mother of RĀDHĀ. 3 An Apsaras. 4 A mystical ceremony, initiation of the Tāntrika student, in which the goddess DURGĀ is supposed to be transferred from the water jar to the body of the novice. E. कला a digit, or कल a sweet tone, and मतुप् aff.
कलाविकल: कलाविकल m. (-लः) A sparrow: see कलविङ्क.
कलाहक: कलाहक m. (-कः) A musical instrument; also काहल.
कलि: कलि m. (-लिः) 1 The fourth age of the world, according to the Hindus; the iron age, or that of vice: the commencement of the Kali-yug or age, is placed 3,101 years anterior to the Christian aera, so that in A. D. 1830, the Kali year is 4,931, the number of its years is 432,000, at the expiration of which, the world is to be destroyed. 2 The age personified. 3 War, battle. 4 Strife, dissension. 5 An arrow. 6 Beleric myrobalan. f. (-लिः or ली) An unblown flower: see कलिका. E. कल to count or reckon, इन् Uṇādi aff.
कलिका: कलिका f. (-का) 1 An unblown flower. 2 The bottom or peg of a lute. E. कल to count, इन् affix कलि, and with ङीष्, कली as above; again, कन् pleonastic affix, and टाप् fem. do.
कलिकापूर्व: कलिकापूर्व्व n. (-र्व्वं) Acts leading to future consequences, not connected with those of a previous birth. E. कलिका a bud, अपूर्व्व not preceding.
कलिकापूर्व्व: कलिकापूर्व्व n. (-र्व्वं) Acts leading to future consequences, not connected with those of a previous birth. E. कलिका a bud, अपूर्व्व not preceding.
कलिकार: कलिकार m. (-रः) 1 A plant bearing a nut, which is used as a febrifuge, (Grey bonduc:) see पूर्तिकरञ्ज. 2 The fork-tailed shrike. 3 Another bird, a small one with a yellow head, (Loxia philippensis.) 4 A name of NĀRADA. f. (-री) A poisonous plant: see लाङ्गली. E. कलि strife, &c. कृञ् to make, affix अण्; also with कन् added कलिकारक.
कलिकारक: कलिकारक m. (-कः) 1 Grey bonduc; also कलिमारक. 2 The name of NĀRADA a divine sage, and great mischief maker: see कलिकार.
कलिङ्ग: कलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The febrifuge nut plant, (Caesalpinia bonduccella.) 2 The fork-tailed shrike, (Lanius forficatus, Lath.) 2 The name of a country; the name Kaliṅga is applied in the Purāṇas to several places, but it especially signifies a district on the Coromandel coast, extending from below Cuttack to the vicinity of Madras, (in this sense, like some other names of countries, it is usually confined to the plural number, (-ङ्गाः) confounding the place with the people inhabiting it. nf. (-ङ्गं-ङ्गा) A medicinal seed, that of Echites antidysenterica. f. (-ङ्गा) 1 A woman of a good shape. 2 A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum:) see त्रिवृत्. E. कलि strife, &c. ग from गम to go, खच् aff.
कलिङ्गक: कलिङ्गक m. (-कः) The seed of the Coraiya, (Echites antidysenterica): see इन्द्रयव.
कलिञ्ज: कलिञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A mat, a screen of grass, a tāti, &c.
कलित: कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gained, acquired. 2 Known, understood. 3 Numbered, reckoned. 4 Separated, divided. 4 Made, done. 6 Held, laid hold of. 7 Sounded indistinctly, buzzed, murmured, &c. E. कल to count, &c. affix क्त.
कलिद्रुम: कलिद्रुम m. (-मः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica,) also कलि, the tree of strife; being supposed to be the favorite haunt of imps or goblins.
कलिन्द: कलिन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 The sun. 2 A mountain. 3 Beleric myrobalan. E. कलि strife, दा to give, खश् aff.
कलिन्दकन्या: कलिन्दकन्या f. (-न्या) The Yamunā. E. कलिन्द the sun or a mountain, कन्या daughter.
कलिन्दनन्दिनी: कलिन्दनन्दिनी f. (-नी) The Yamunā or Jumna river. E. कलिन्द the name of a mountain, part of the Himālaya range, and नन्दिनी a daughter; the source of the river being in the mountain Kalinda.
कलिन्दशैलजाता: कलिन्दशैलजाता f. (-ता) The Yamunā river: see the preceding. E. कलिन्दशैल the mountain, and जाता born; also कलिन्दसू, कालिन्दी, &c.
कलिप्रिय: कलिप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Quarrelsome, mischievous, mischief making. m. (-यः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 NĀRADA. E. कलि strife, and प्रिय fond of.
कलिमारक: कलिमारक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bonduccella:) see पूतिकरञ्ज. E. कलि strife, मृ to destroy or remove, affixes अण् and कन्; some copies read कलिकारक.
कलियुग: कलियुग n. (-गं) The Kali, the present or iron age: see कलि. E. कलि, and युग an age.
कलिल: कलिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Impervious, impenetrable. 2 Mixed, blended. E. कल to count, &c. इलच् Uṇādi aff.
कलुक्क: कलुक्क m. (-क्कः) A musical instrument; a cymbal. f. (-क्का) 1 A tavern. 2 A meteor.
कलुष: कलुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Turbid, foul, muddy. 2 Wicked, bad. mf. (-षः-षी) A buffalo. n. (-षं) 1 Sin. 2 Wrath. E. कल to go, &c. उषन् Uṇādi aff.
कलुषत्व: कलुषत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Foulness, turbidness. 2 Opacity. 3 Agitation, trouble, anger. E. कलुष foul, &c. त्व affix; also with तल्, कलुषता.
कलुषयोनि: कलुषयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Of impure origin. E. कलुष, and योनि womb.
कलुषित: कलुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Defiled, contaminated. 2 Foul, impure. 3 Wicked. E. कलुष and इतच् aff.
कलुषिन्: कलुषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) 1 Foul, impure. 2 Depraved, wicked. 3 Defiled. E. कलुष and इनि aff.
कलेवर: कलेवर n. (-रं) The body. E. कल semen, and वर best; formed from the seminal fluid; the termination of the ablative is retained.
कलोत्ताल: कलोत्ताल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) High, sharp. E. कल, and उत्ताल loud, high sounding.
कल्क: कल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्का-ल्कं) Sinful, wicked. mn. (-ल्कः-ल्कं) 1 Sediment, the deposit of oil, ghee, &c. 2 Dirt, filth. 3 Ordure, faeces. 4 Sin. 5 Hypocrisy. 6 Pride. 7 The beleric myrobalan. 8 The wax of the ear. 9 Levigated powder. E. कल to count, &c. कः Uṇādi aff.
कल्कि: कल्कि m. (-ल्किः) A name of VIṢṆU, in his future capacity of destroyer of the world, the tenth and last Avatāra or descent of the deity, in the four ages or Kalpa. E. कल to count, कि aff.
कल्किन्: कल्किन् mfn. (-ल्की-ल्किनी-ल्कि) 1 Foul, turbid, having sediment, 2 Dirty. 3 Wicked. m. (-ल्की) The last descent of VIṢṆU; see the preceding. E. कल्क and इनि aff.
कल्प: कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) In composition; Like, but with a degree of inferiority. m. (-ल्पः) 1 A Śāstra or sacred work; one of the six Vedāṅgas, and comprehending the description of religious rites. 2 A day and night of BRAHMĀ, a period of  4,320,000,000 solar-sydereal-years or years of mortals, measuring the duration of the world, and as many, the interval of its annihilation. 3 A destruction of the world. 4 A sacred precept, practice prescribed by the Vedas for effecting certain consequences. 5 Propriety, fitness. 6 Optionality, alternative, doubt. 7 Resolve, purpose, any act of determination. 8 One of the trees of INDRA'S paradise or Svarga. E. कृष to be able, घः affix, ऋ is changed to अल्.
कल्पक: कल्पक m. (-कः) A barber. E. कृप to cut, बुन् aff.
कल्पक्षय: कल्पक्षय m. (-यः) The destruction of all things, the end of the world. E. कल्प, and क्षय destruction.
कल्पद्रुम: कल्पद्रुम m. (-मः) A fabulous tree, one granting every thing desired. E. कल्प purpose, and द्रुम a tree; also कल्पद्रु, कल्पवृक्ष, &c.
कल्पन: कल्पन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting. 2 Making, manufacturing. 3 Making as a poem or tale, inventing, composing. nf. (नं-ना) 1 Inference. 2 Invention, fabrication. 3 Caparisoning or decorating an elephant. (-नी) A scissors or shears. E. कृप to be able, &c. ल्यु or ल्युट् affixes, and consequently टाप् or ङीप् fem. do.
कल्पनीय: कल्पनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be made or contrived. 2 To be substituted or supplied. E. कृप to be able, अनीयर् affix; also कल्प्य and कल्पितव्य.
कल्पवायु: कल्पवायु m. (-युः) The wind that is to blow at the end of all things. E. कल्प, and वायु wind.
कल्पवृक्ष: कल्पवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) One of the fabulous trees of INDRA'S heaven; a tree which yields whatever may be desired. E. कल्प purpose, and वृक्ष a tree.
कल्पादि: कल्पादि m. (-दिः) The beginning of a Kalpa, the renovation of all things. E. कल्प, and आदि beginning.
कल्पान्त: कल्पान्त m. (-न्तः) The destruction of the world, the end of the Kalpa, or four ages of its existence. E. कल्प the period, and अन्त the end.
कल्पान्तस्थायिन्: कल्पान्तस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lasting, permanent. E. कल्पान्त, and स्थायिन् what stays.
कल्पित: कल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, fabricated, artificial. 2 Composed, invented. 3 Arranged, put in order. 4 Prepared at once, put together extempore. 5 Brought, conducted. 6 Inferred. m. (-तः) An elephant armed or caparisoned for war. E. कृप to be able, &c. क्त aff.
कल्पितार्धं: कल्पितार्धं mfn. (-र्धः-र्धा-र्धं) One for whom or what a respectful offering is prepared. E. कल्पित made, and अर्ध an offering.
कल्प्य: कल्प्य mfn. (-ल्प्यः-ल्प्या-ल्प्यं) 1 To be made or contrived. 2 To be substituted. E. कृप to be able, यत् aff.
कल्मष: कल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Dirty, foul. m. (-षं) A kind of hell, a division of the infernal regions. n. (-षं) 1 Sin. 2 The hand below the wrist. E. कर्म्म virtuous or pious action, षो to destroy and क affix; the form is irr.
कल्माष: कल्माष mfn. (-षः-षा or षी-षं) Of a mixed or variegated colour. m. (-षः) 1 A variegated colour. 2 A mixture of black and white. 3 Black. 4 A demon or goblin. f. (-षी) The spotted cow of Jamadagni, the giver of all desires. E. कल to go, &c. क्विप् affix, कल्, मष to injure, अण् affix माष; what injures or triumphs over other colours.
कल्माषकण्ठ: कल्माषकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कल्माष black, and कण्ठ throat; form irr.
कल्माषपाद: कल्माषपाद m. (-दः) The name of a king, also SAUDĀSA, transformed to a Rākṣasa by VASIṢṬHA. E. कल्माष, and पाद a foot.
कल्य: कल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Ready, prepared, armed. 2 Healthy, free from sickness. 3 Clever, dexterous. 4 Deaf and dumb. 5 Auspicious, (speech or discourse.) 6 Counselling, monitory. 7 Sound, perfect, free from mental or bodily imperfections. n. (-ल्यं) 1 The dawn or break of day. 2 Yesterday. 3 Tomorrow. nf. (-ल्यं-ल्या) 1 Spirituous liquor. 2 Congratulation, good wishes, annunciation of good tidings. f. (-ल्या) Emblic myrobalan: see हरीतकी. E. कल to count, &c. यक् aff.
कल्यजग्धि: कल्यजग्धि f. (-ग्धिः) The morning meal, breakfast. E. कल्य dawn, and जग्धि eating.
कल्यत्व: कल्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Health. 2 Recovery, convalescence. E. कल्य being well, and त्व affix of the abstract; also कल्यता with तल् aff.
कल्यपाल: कल्यपाल m. (-लः) A distiller. E. कल्य vinous liquor, and पाल who nourishes; also with कन् added, कल्यपालक.
कल्यवर्त: कल्यवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Breakfast. E. कल्य, and वर्त्त, from वृत to be or abide, affix घञ्.
कल्यवर्त्त: कल्यवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Breakfast. E. कल्य, and वर्त्त, from वृत to be or abide, affix घञ्.
कल्याण: कल्याण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Happy, well, right, prosperous, lucky. f. (-णी) 1 A cow. 2 A leguminous shrub, (Glycine debilis.) n. (-णं) 1 Good fortune, happiness, prosperity. 2 Gold. E. कल्य, healthy, &c. अ to be, to sound, अण् aff.
कल्याणकर: कल्याणकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Propitious, auspicious, conferring good fortune, &c. E. कल्याण, and कर what makes.
कल्याणकृत्: कल्याणकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) 1 Virtuous, good. 2 Propitious, lucky. E. कल्याण, and कृत् who does.
कल्याणचार: कल्याणचार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Following virtuous courses. 2 Lucky, fortunate. E. कल्याण, चर to go, अण् aff.
कल्याणधर्मन्: कल्याणधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Good, virtuous. E. कल्याण, धर्म्म duty, अनिच्.
कल्याणधर्म्मन्: कल्याणधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Good, virtuous. E. कल्याण, धर्म्म duty, अनिच्.
कल्याणपञ्चमीक: कल्याणपञ्चमीक m. (-कः) A fortnight which has the fifth lunation lucky. E. कल्याण, पञ्चमी the fifth, and कन् added.
कल्याणवचन: कल्याणवचन n. (-नं) Friendly speech, good wishes. E. कल्याण, and वचन speech.
कल्याणवीज: कल्याणवीज m. (-जः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum hirsutum.) E. कल्याण, and वीज seed.
कल्याणाचार: कल्याणाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Virtuous, following good practices. E. कल्याण, and आचार rule.
कल्याणिका: कल्याणिका f. (-का) Red arsenic. E. कल्याणी and कन् aff.
कल्याणिन्: कल्याणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) 1 Happy, lucky, prosperous. 2 Auspicious, propitious. E. कल्याण, and इनि aff.
कल्यापाल: कल्यापाल m. (-लः) A distiller. E. कल्या spirituous liquor, and पाल who preserves.
कल्ल: कल्ल r. 1st cl. (कल्लते) 1 To sound ill or indistinctly. 2 To sound. 3 To be mute.
कल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Deaf. E. कल्ल to sound indistinctly, affix अच.
कल्लत्व: कल्लत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Indistinct articulation, hoarseness. 2 Deafness. E. कल्ल to sound indistinctly, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix कल्लता.
कल्लोल: कल्लोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) An enemy, hostile, inimical. m. (-लः) 1 A surge, a billow. 2 Joy, happiness, pleasure. E. कल्ल to sound, ओलच् aff.
कव: कव (ऋ) कवृ r. 1st cl. (कवते) 1 To describe, (as a poet.) 2 To paint, to picture; also कब.
कवक: कवक m. (-कः) 1 A mouthful. 2 A fungus, a mushroom, &c. E. कु to sound, अक aff.
कवच: कवच mn. (-चः-चं) 1 Armour, mail. 2 A drum used in battle, a kettle drum. 3 An amulet, a charm. 4 A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्दभाण्ड. 5 The mystical syllable Hum, forming part of a Mantra, and considered as a preservative like armour; it is also inscribed on a Birch leaf, &c. and worn as an amulet; being carried about the person as a charm: see the next. E. कु to sound, अच् Uṇādi aff.
कवचपत्र: कवचपत्र n. (-त्रं) The Birch tree, commonly Bhojpatra: see भूर्जपत्र. E. कवच an amulet, and पत्र a leaf: see the last.
कवचहर: कवचहर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Wearing armour or amulets. m. (-रः) A boy, a child. E. कवच, and हृ to take, अच् or ट aff.
कवटी: कवटी f. (-टी) A door: see कवाट.
कवयी: कवयी f. (-यी) A kind of flat fish, commonly Kavay or Kay; remarkable for going by land from one spot to another, (Coiuscoboius, HAM.)
कवर: कवर sub. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A braid or fillet of hair. adj. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Mixed, intermingled, blended. 2 Set, inlaid. mn. (-रः-रं) 1 Salt. 2 Sourness or acidity. f. (-रा or -री) A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) (-री) The leaf of the asafoetida plant, Hingupatri. E. क the head, &c. वृ to screen, अच् affix, fem. do. टाप् or ङीष्
कवरकी: कवरकी f. (-की) A captive, a prisoner: see वन्दी.
कवरीभार: कवरीभार m. (-रः) A fine head of hair. E. कवरी, and भार a load; also कवरीभर.
कवरीभृत्: कवरीभृत् mfn. (भृत्) Wearing a fillet of hair. E. कवरी, and भृत् who has.
कवल: कवल m. (-लः) 1 A mouthful. 2 A kind of fish, commonly Baliya. 3 An astringent wash for cleaning the mouth, a gargle. E. क the head, water, &c. and वल to be strong, अच् aff.
कवलिका: कवलिका f. (-का) A piece of cloth over a sore, a bandage.
कवलित: कवलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. कवल nominal verb, to eat, and क्त aff.
कवस: कवस m. (-सः) Armour, mail. E. कु to sound, and अस Uṇādi affix; also कवच.
कवाट: कवाट sub. mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) A door, the leaf or pannel of the door. E. क wind, air, वट to exclude, and अण् affix; also कपाट.
कवाटवक्र: कवाटवक्र n. (-क्रं) A plant, commonly Kapāta venlu.
कवार: कवार m. (-रः) 1 A lotus. 2 A bird, (Tantalus falcinellus, BUC.) E. क water, वर to prefer, अण् aff.
कवि: कवि mfn. (-विः-विः or -वी-वि) Learned, wise. m. (-विः) 1 A poet. 2 The sun. 3 ŚUKRA, the regent of the planet Venus, and preceptor of the demons. 4 A name of VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa, the inventor of poesy. 5 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-विः-वी) The bit of a bridle, or the reins altogether; also कविका. E. कु to sound, to celebrate, and इन् Uṇādi aff.
कविक: कविक nf. (-कं-का) The bit of a bridle, or the reins altogether, (-का) A sort of fish, the Kay. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कविज्येष्ठ: कविज्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A name of VĀLMĪKI, author of the Rāmāyaṇa. E. कवि a poet, and ज्येष्ठ elder or superior.
कविता: कविता f. (-ता) 1 Poesy, poetical style or composition. 2 A poem. E. कवि, and तल affix; also with त्व affix, कवित्वं.
कवितावेदिन्: कवितावेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Wise, learned, a genius, a poet. E. कविता poetry, &c. वेदिन् who understands.
कविय: कविय mn. (-यः-यं) The bit of a bridle, or the reins. E. कु to sound, affix यः see कवि and कविक.
कविरामायण: कविरामायण m. (-णः) A name of VĀLMĪKI. E. कवि a poet, &c. and रामायण the epic poem so called; the poet of the Rāmāyaṇa.
कविलाशिका: कविलाशिका f. (-का) A musical instrument, a kind of lute.
कवीय: कवीय n. (-यं) The bit of a bridle, or the reins. E. कु to sound, छ affix; also कविय.
कवेल: कवेल n. (-लं) A lotus. E. क water, विल to send, &c. घञ् aff.
कवोष्ण: कवोष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Slightly warm, tepid. n. (-ष्णं) A slight warmth. E. कु indifferent, and उष्ण warm.
कव्य: कव्य n. (-व्यं) An oblation or offering of food to deceased ancestors. E. कु to sound or praise, यत् aff.
कव्यवाल: कव्यवाल m. (-लः) A class of the manes or deified ancestors. E. कव्य an offering to the manes, वा occasionally, and ल who receives.
कव्यवाहन: कव्यवाहन m. (-नः) Fire. E. कव्य, and वाहन vehicle; also कव्यवाह.
कश: कश r. 1st cl. (कशति-ते) To kill, to hurt.
कशा: कशा f. (-शा) 1 A whip. 2 Whipping, flogging. E. कश to hurt, अच् and टाप् affixes; also कष.
कशात्रय: कशात्रय n. (-यं) Three modes of whipping (a horse), good, bad, and middling. E. कषा, and त्रयम् three-fold.
कशार्ह: कशार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Deserving a whipping. E. कशा a whip, and अर्ह to be fit or proper.
कशिपु: कशिपु m. (-पुः) 1 Food. 2 Clothing. du. m. (-पूः) Food and clothing. E. कश to injure, to remove, (pain, hunger, &c.) पु affix, the form is irr.
कशेरु: कशेरु mn. (-रुः-रु) The back bone. f. (-रूः) A kind of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.) m. (-रुः) One of the nine divisions of Jambu Dvīpa. E. क sound, शृ to harm, ऊ or उ Uṇādi affix, and एरङ् substituted for the radical vowel.
कशेरुक: कशेरुक f. (-का) The back bone. n. (-कं) A sort of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
कशेरुस्: कशेरुस् n. (-रुः) A grass, (Scirpus kysoor:) see कशेरु.
कश्चन: कश्चन ind. Some body, a certain person; the first member of the compound is declinable, as कश्चन, कस्यचन, &c.
कश्चित्: कश्चित् ind. Some body, some one, a certain one: the first member of the compound is declinable, as कश्चित्, कस्मैचित् &c.
कश्मल: कश्मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Foul, dirty. m. (-लः) 1 Fainting, syncope. 2 Sin. E. कश to go, क्मलच् aff.
कश्मीर: कश्मीर m. (-रः) The name of a country, Kāṣmir. E. कश to go, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, and मुद inserted: see काश्मीर.
कश्य: कश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Deserving a whipping. n. (-श्यं) 1 Spirituous liquor. 2 A horse's flank. E. कश to beat, यत् aff.
कश्यप: कश्यप m. (-पः) 1 The name of a Muni or deified sage, the son of MARĪCI, and father of the gods, demons, animals, fishes, reptiles, &c. by the seventeen daughters of DAKṢA. 2 A kind of deer. 3 A sort of fish.
कश्यपनन्दन: कश्यपनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of GARUḌA The bird of VIṢṆU. E. कश्यप, and नन्दन a son, the son of KAŚYAPA.
कष: कष r. 1st cl. (कषति) 10th cl. (कषयुति) 1 To injure, to hurt, to destroy, to kill. 2 To try, to test: with नि, to try metals.
कष m. (-षः) The touchstone. f. (-षा) A whip; also कशा. E. कष to hurt, to test or try, अच् and टाप् affs.
कषण: कषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Unripe, immature. n. (-णं) 1 Touch or test of gold by the touchstone. 2 Rubbing, marking. E. कष to hurt, affix युच्.
कषपाषाण: कषपाषाण m. (-णः) A touchstone. E. कष and पाषाण a stone.
कषाकु: कषाकु m. (-कुः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. कष to injure, आकु Uṇādi aff.
कषाघात: कषाघात m. (-तः) A cut, a stroke with a whip. E. कषा and आघात a blow.
कषाय: कषाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Astringent. 2 Fragrant. 3 Red, dull red. 4 Brown, of a colour composed of red and yellow. mn. (-यः-यं) 1 An astringent flavour or taste. 2 A decoction or infusion. 3 Gum, resin, extract, exudation from a tree, &c. 4 Plastering, anointing. 5 Colouring or perfuming the person. 6 Attachment to worldly objects. m. (-यः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 Passion, emotion. f. (-या) A plant, a small sort of Hedysarum. E. कष to injure, आय aff.
कषायकृत्: कषायकृत् m. (-कृत्) Red. Lodh, a tree the bark of which is used in dyeing. E. कषाय red, कृत् what makes.
कषायचित्र: कषायचित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Dyed or stained of a dull red colour. E. कषाय, and चित्र painted.
कषायन्वित: कषायन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Astringent, harsh. E. कषाय, and अन्वित having.
कषायित: कषायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Prepared for dyeing or colouring. E. कषाय nominal verb, to astringe, and क्त aff.
कषायिन्: कषायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Yielding a resinous exudation. 2 Astringent. 3 Dyed of a red colour. 4 Worldly minded. m. (-यी) The Śāl tree. E. कषाय and इनि aff.
कषि: कषि mfn. (-षिः-षिः-षि) Injurious, mischievous. E. कष to hurt, and इन् aff.
कषिका: कषिका f. (-का) A bird in general. E. कष to hurt, and इकन् Uṇādi aff.
कषित: कषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hurt, injured. E. कष to hurt, क्त aff.
कषेरुका: कषेरुका f. (-का) The back bone, the spine: see कशेरुका.
कष्ट: कष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pained, suffering pain. 2 Impervious, impenetrable. n. (-ष्टं) Bodily pain or uneasiness. ind. (-ष्टं) An exclamation of regret or sorrow, ah, alas! E. कष to hurt, participial affix क्त.
कष्टकर: कष्टकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Giving pain or trouble. E. कष्ट, and कर what makes.
कष्टकारक: कष्टकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Causing trouble or annoyance. m. (-कः) The world. E. कष्ट pain, and कारक the maker, the cause.
कष्टश्रित: कष्टश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suffering pain or misfortune, undergoing hardships, performing penance. E. कष्ट and श्रित subjected to.
कष्टस्थान: कष्टस्थान n. (-नं) A bad or disagreeable place or site. E. कष्ट, and स्थान place, situation.
कष्टि: कष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Test, trial. 2 Pain, trouble. E. कष to hurt, क्तिन् aff.
कस: कस r. 1st cl. (कसति) To move, to go or approach: with वि prefixed, to open or expand as a flower, to blow. (इ) कसि r. 2nd cl. (कंस्ते) 1 To go. 2 To command. 3 To destroy: this root is also read by some authorities, कस (कस्ते) or कशि (कंष्टे.)
कस m. (-सः) A touchstone: see कष. f. (-सा) A whip: see कशा and कषा.
कसनोत्पाटन: कसनोत्पाटन m. (-नः) A plant, (Justicia, &c.) see वासक.
कसिपु: कसिपु m. (-पुः) Food, boiled rice: see कशिपु.
कसेरु: कसेरु m. (-रुः) A sort of grass: see कशेरु, &c.
कसेरुका: कसेरुका f. (-का) 1 A sort of grass. 2 The back bone: see कशेरुका.
कस्तीर: कस्तीर n. (-रं) Tin. E. कस् to go, deriv. irr.
कस्तुरिका: कस्तुरिका f. (-का) Musk; also कस्तूरी and कस्तूरिका.
कस्तूरी: कस्तूरी f. (-री) 1 Musk, the animal perfume so called, as brought from Kashmir, Napal, and western Asam or Butan, the latter is said to be the best. 2 A plant, (Hibiscus abelmoschus.) 3 Another plant, (Amaryllis zeylanica.) E. कस to go, and तूरच् affix; its scent going or spreading; the deriv. is irr.; also कन् being added, कस्तूरिका and कस्तुरिका as above.
कस्मल: कस्मल n. (-लं) 1 Fainting, syncope. 2 Sin: see कश्मल.
कस्वर: कस्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what goes or moves. E. कस to go, वरच् aff.
कल्हार: कल्हार n. (-रं) The white esculent water lily, (Nymphaea lotus.) E. क water, हार a necklace or ornament, and ल irregularly inserted.
कह्व: कह्व m. (-ह्वः) A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. क water, ह्वेञ् to call, &c. ड aff.
कांसीय: कांसीय n. (-यं) White copper: see the next.
कांस्य: कांस्य mn. (-स्यः-स्यं) A goblet, a drinking vessel. n. (-स्यं) 1 White copper or brass, queen's-metal, any amalgam of zinc and copper. 2 A musical instrument, a sort of gong or plate of bell-metal struck with a stick or rod. 3 A measure: see कंस, &c. E. कसि to injure, ण्यत् aff.
कांस्यकार: कांस्यकार m. (-रः) A brazier, a pewterer, a worker in white or bell-metal. E. कांस्य, and कार a workman.
कांस्यनील: कांस्यनील m. (-लः) Blue vitriol considered as a collyrium. E. कांस्य bell-metal, and नील blue or black; also written occasionally कांश्यनील.
काक: काक m. (-कः) 1 A crow. 2 A plant, (Ardisia solanacea?) 3 A lame man, a cripple, one whose legs are wanting or useless. 4 One of the divisions of the world or Dvīpas. 5 A measure. 6 Washing the head, bathing by dipping the head only into the water. 7 A sectarial mark, the Tilaka? 8 Shameless, arrogant. n. (-कं) 1 Modus coeundi. 2 A multitude or assemblage of crows. f. (-का) An appellation of several plants, as, 1 The common Bakapuṣpa: see वक, 2 Kakjhangi, (Leea hirta;) also in this sense काकी; 3 A medicinal plant, vulg. Kākoli; 4 The Ratti or Gunja, (Abrus precatorius;) 5 Opposite leaved fig tree: see उडुम्बर; 6 A potherb, (Solanum Indicum, &c.) see काकमाची. E. कै to sound, Uṇādi affix कन्; or क for कु bad, ill, and अक to go, &c.
काककङ्गु: काककङ्गु f. (-ङ्गुः) A kind of panick, (P. miliaceum.) E. काक, and कङ्ग another species of the same grass; the Kaṅgu of the crows.
काककला: काककला f. (-ला) A plant, (Leea hirta:) see काकजङ्घा.
काकघ्नी: काकघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A tree, said to be a large kind of Karanja, (Galedupa arborea.) E. काक, and घ्नी what kills.
काकचिञ्चा: काकचिञ्चा f. (-ञ्चा) The shrub which yields the red and black berry, used in India as a jeweller's weight, (Abrus precatorius:) see गुञ्जा. E. काक, and चिञ्चा extremity; the point being as black as a crow; also काकचिञ्चि and काकचिञ्ची.
काकच्छद: काकछद m. (-दः) 1 A wagtail. 2 Side locks of the head of hair. E. काक a crow, and छद plumage.
काकछद: काकछद m. (-दः) 1 A wagtail. 2 Side locks of the head of hair. E. काक a crow, and छद plumage.
काकच्छर्दि: काकछर्द्दि m. (-र्द्दिः) 1 A wagtail. 2 What is ejected by a crow. E. काक and छर्द्दि vomiting.
काकछर्द्दि: काकछर्द्दि m. (-र्द्दिः) 1 A wagtail. 2 What is ejected by a crow. E. काक and छर्द्दि vomiting.
काकजङ्घा: काकजङ्घा f. (-ङ्घा) A plant, (Leea hirta, Rox. Catalogue; elsewhere described as Leea aequata.) E. काक, and जङ्गा a thigh; compared to a crow's leg.
काकजम्बु: काकजम्बु f. (-म्बुः) A plant, commonly Bhuinjamb, (Ardisia solanacea:) see भूमिजम्बु; also काकजम्बू.
काकण: काकण n. (-णं) A leprosy with black and red spots, considered incurable. E. काक the Gunja berry, deriv. irr. also with कन्, affix काकणक.
काकणन्तिका: काकणन्तिका f. (-का) The Abrus precatorius: see काकचिञ्चा.
काकता: काकता f. (-ता) The state or nature of a crow. E. काक, and तल् affix; also काकत्वं.
काकतालीय: काकतालीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Accidental, unexpected, opportune. E. काक, and ताली the fruit of the palm: it alludes to a story of the fruit of the palm falling in the way of a crow.
काकतालीयवत्: काकतालीयवत् ind. Suddenly, opportunely. E. काकतालीय, and वत् like.
काकतालुकिन्: काकतालुकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Contemptible, vile. E. काक, तालु palate, कन् affix of similitude, and इनि aff.
काकतिक्ता: काकतिक्ता f. (-क्ता) The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा.
काकतिन्दुक: काकतिन्दुक m. (-कः) A kind of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa. Rox.) E. काक, and तिन्दुक ebony.
काकतुण्ड: काकतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A dark sort of Agallochum: see कालागुरु. f. (-ण्डी) 1 The Gunja plant. 2 A sort of brass. 3 A tree, commonly Kuwa dorī. E. काक, and तुण्ड face; of the colour of a crow.
काकतुण्डिका: काकतुण्डिका f. (-का) The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा.
काकध्वज: काकध्वज m. (-जः) Submarine fire, a personage in Hindu mythology: see और्व्व. E. काक, and ध्वज a banner, whose symbol is a crow.
काकनाशा: काकनाशा f. (-शा) A plant, commonly Vakapushpa: see वकपुष्प.
काकनासा: काकनासा f. (-सा) A plant: see काकजङ्गा; also काकनासिका.
काकनासिका: काकनासिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Leea hirta.) 2 Red Tëori. E. काक a crow, and नासिका a nose; the root being fancifully compared to the beak of the bird; also काकनासा and काकनासिकी.
काकपक्ष: काकपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The side locks of the head of hair; three or five on each side left when the head is first shaved, and which may be allowed to remain, especially in persons of the military cast. E. काक and पक्ष a feather, a wing, a crow's wing; the word is also used as an epithet of a warrior, a name of RĀMA, &c.
काकपीलु: काकपीलु m. (-लुः) A kind of ebony: see काकतिन्दुक; also with कन् added काकपीलुकः.
काकपुच्छ: काकपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. काक, and पुच्छ a tail; crow-tailed.
काकपुष्ट: काकपुष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The Koil or Kokil, as before. E. काक, and पुष्ट nourished; this bird, like the English cuckoo, being said to leave its eggs in the nests of other birds, as in that of the crow, &c.
काकफल: काकफल m. (-लः) The Nimb tree. E. काक, and फल fruit.
काकबन्ध्या: काकबन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) A woman that bears only one child.
काकभीरु: काकभीरु m. (-रुः) An owl. काक, and भीरु fearful; afraid of the crows.
काकमद्गु: काकमद्गु m. (-द्गुः) A water hen, a gallinule. E. काक, and मद्गु another kind of bird, a Shag; resembling a crow in colour.
काकमर्द: काकमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) The colocynth or bitter apple. E. काक, and मर्द्दक destroying; the fruit of which destroys crows; also काकमर्द्दक.
काकमर्द्द: काकमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) The colocynth or bitter apple. E. काक, and मर्द्दक destroying; the fruit of which destroys crows; also काकमर्द्दक.
काकमाचिका: काकमाचिका f. (-का) A plant: see the next word.
काकमाची: काकमाची f. (-ची) An esculent vegetable, commonly Gūrkamai, (Solanum Indicum.) E. काक, मच to respect, &c. अण् and ङीष् affixes; also with कन् and टाप् added, काकमाचिका.
काकमुद्गा: काकमुद्गा f. (-द्गा) A plant, commonly Mugani, according to some, a wild kind of bean. E. काक and मुद्ग Moong.
काकयव: काकयव m. (-वः) Barren corn, the ear of which has no grain. E. काक and यव barley.
काकरुक: काकरुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Naked. 2 Timid, fearful. 2 Poor, indigent. m. (-कः) 1 Fraud, deceit. 2 An owl. 3 A henpecked husband.
काकरुहा: काकरुहा f. (-हा) A parasite plant, (Epidendrum tesseloides, &c.) see वन्दा. E. काक and रुह what mounts; on which crows rest.
काकल: काकल n. (-लं) A jewel worn upon the neck. f. (-लिः or -ली) A low and sweet tone, the song of a bird, &c. E. का instead of कु diminutive, कल to sound, इन् or ङीप् aff.
काकलक: काकलक m. (-कः) An ornament of the neck. E. कन् added to the preceding.
काकलीद्राक्षा: काकलीद्राक्षा f. (-क्षा) A grape with a very small stone.
काकलीरव: काकलीरव m. (-वः) The Kokila. E. काकली a sweet tone, and रव sound.
काकशब्द: काकशब्द m. (-ब्दः) The cawing of a crow. E. काक, and शब्द sound.
काकशीर्ष: काकशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) A tree, commonly Vakapushpa: (Æschynomene grandiflora.) E. काक, and शीर्ष a head.
काकाङ्गा: काकाङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A plant, (Leea aequata.) E. काक, and अङ्ग form, body, टाप् affix; or with ङीष् affix, काकाङ्गी.
काकाञ्ची: काकाञ्ची f. (-ञ्ची) 1 A plant, (Leea aequata.) 2 An esculent vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.) E. काक, अञ्च to go, अच् and ङीप् affs.
काकादनी: काकादनी f. (-नी) The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा. E. काक, अदन food, ङीप् fem. aff.
काकार: काकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Scattering water. E. क water, क, to scatter; with आङ् prefixed, and अण् aff.
काकारि: काकारि m. (-रिः) An own. E. काक, and अरि a foe; whose enemy is the crow.
काकाल: काकाल m. (-लः) A raven. E. काक, and अल to be able, affix अच्.
काकिणी: काकिणी f. (-णी) 1 A cubit, the fourth part of a Daṇḍa or short pole. 2 The quarter of a Paṇa, a weight, or a tale of shells equal to twenty Cowries. 3 A quarter of a Māṣa, a weight of silver or gold. 4 A Ratti or small seed used as a weight. 5 A Cowri or shell used as a coin. E. कक to be unsteady, ल्युट् and ङीप् affixes; deriv. irr; also the dental न being substituted, काकिनी.
काकिल: काकिल m. (-लः) The central jewel in a necklace, &c. see काकल.
काकु: काकु f. (-कुः) 1 Change of voice in fear, grief, &c. 2 Muttering, murmuring. 3 The tongue. E. कक to deride, उण् affix, deriv. irr.
काकुत्स्थ: काकुत्स्थ m. (-त्स्थः) A name of RĀMA. 2 The name of a sovereign, also Purañjaya. E. ककुट् preeminent, अण् affix, and स्थ who stays or is.
काकुद: काकुद m. (-दः) The palate. E. ककुद् the head, and अण् aff.
काकेक्षु: काकेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. काक, and इक्षु sugar cane.
काकेन्दु: काकेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A species of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon.)
काकोचिक: काकोचिक m. (-कः) A kind of fish, commonly Caouchi; also काकोचि. (Cyprinus cachius, HAM.)
काकोडुम्बर: काकोडुम्बर m. (-रः) Opposite leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositifolia.)
काकोडुम्बरिका: काकोडुम्बरिका f. (-का) See the preceding. E. काक, and उडुम्बर glomerous fig, कन् affix, and the feminine termination; also काकोदुम्बरिका.
काकोदर: काकोदर m. (-रः) A snake. E. काक going ill or tortuously, (derived from का for कु, and अक to go,) and उदर the belly.
काकोल: काकोल mn. (-लः-लं) A poisonous substance of a black colour, or the colour of a raven, whence its name; possibly the berry of the Cocculus Indicus. n. (-लं) A division of the infernal regions or hell. (-लः) 1 A raven. 2 A potter. 3 A snake. 4 A boar. 5 A drug; as follows. f. (-ली) The name of a vegetable substance used in medicine, described as sweet and cooling, allaying fever, removing phlegm, &c.; it is said to be a root brought from Nepal or Morung. E. काक to be unsteady, &c. and ओलच् affix, deriv. irr.
काकोलूकिका: काकोलूकिका f. (-का) The natural enmity of the owl and crow. E. काक a crow, उलूक an owl, वुन् affix, implying enmity in this and similar compounds.
काक्ष: काक्ष r. 1st cl. (इ) काक्षि (कांक्षति) To desire; it is most frequently used with आङ् prefixed, in the same sense.

काक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Frowning, looking scornfully or in displeasure. m. (-क्षः) A glance, a wink or leer. n. (-क्षं) A frown, a look of displeasure. E. का for कु diminutive, or depreciative, and अक्षि the eye. f. (-क्षी) 1 A sort of trefoil, (Cytisus cajan.) 2 A perfume, a fragrant kind of earth. E. कक्ष a creeping plant, अण् and ङीप् affs.
काक्षीव: काक्षीव m. (-वः) A plant, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन. E. का for कु diminutive, and क्षीव to be intoxicated: see अक्षीव; also with कन् added काक्षीवक.
काग: काग m. (-गः) A crow: (in the dialects, a raven.) E. का an imitative sound, and ग who sings, from गै with ड or क aff.
काङ्क्षत्: काङ्क्षत् mfn. (-ङ्क्षन्-ङ्क्ष-न्ती-ङ्क्षत्) Wishing, desiring, hoping. E. काक्षि to desire, शतृ aff.
काङ्क्षा: काङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) Wish, inclination, desire. E. काक्षि to wish, अच् and टाप् affs.
काङ्क्षित: काङ्क्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. E. काक्षि to wish, क्त aff.
काङ्गा: काङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) Orris root. E. का bad, crooked, and अङ्ग body, shape.
काच: काच r. 1st cl. (इ) काचि (काचते) 1 To shine. 2 To bind.

काच m. (-चः) 1 Alkaline ashes, any salt of potash or soda in a glassy or crystalline state. 2 Crystal, quartz or glass, considered as a natural production, and used as a jewel or ornament. 3 A loop, a swinging shelf, a string so contrived as to hold or support burthens, &c. A disease of the eyes, affection of the optic nerve or gutta serena. n. (-चं) 1 Alkaline salt, black salt. 2 Wax. E. कच to shine or bind, घञ् aff.
काचक: काचक (-कः) 1 A stone. 2 Alkaline ashes, &c. see the preceding. E. कन added to the last.
काचकूपी: काचकूपी f. (-पी) A glass bottle. E. काच, and कूपी bottle.
काचघटी: काचघटी f. (-टी) A glass ewer. E. काच, and घटी a small jar.
काचन: काचन n. (-नं) An enclosure, a string or tape which ties a parcel or bundle or papers, &c. E. कच to tie, ल्युट् affix; also with कन् added काचनक m. (-कः.)
काचन ind. Some one, any one, (applied to feminine objects,) the first member is declinable. E. का fem. of किम, चन added.
काचनक: काचनक n. (-कं) A binding or rope for binding. E. कन् added to काचन.
काचनकिन्: काचनकिन् m. (-की) A writing, a written paper. E. काचनक a binding, and इनि aff.
काचभाजन: काचभाजन n. (-नं) A vessel of glass or crystal, a cup, a goblet, &c. E. काच, and भाजन a vessel.
काचमणि: काचमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal, quartz. E. काच, and मणि a gem.
काचमल: काचमल n. (-लं) Black salt or soda: see काचलवण. E. काच glass, and मल soil.
काचलवण: काचलवण n. (-णं) Black salt, a medicinal salt, prepared by calcining fossile salt and the fruit of the emblic myrobalan together. It consists chiefly or muriate of soda, with a small quantity of iron, lime and sulphur, and is a tonic aperient. E. काच alkaline ashes, and लवण salt.
काचवकयन्त्र: काचवकयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A glass retort. E. काच, and वकयन्त्र a retort.
काचसम्भव: काचसम्भव n. (-वं) Black salt: see the last. E. काच, and सम्भव produced.
काचसौवर्चल: काचसौवर्च्चल n. (-लं) Black salt: see काचलवण. E. काच, and सौवर्च्चल salt.
काचसौवर्च्चल: काचसौवर्च्चल n. (-लं) Black salt: see काचलवण. E. काच, and सौवर्च्चल salt.
काचस्थाली: काचस्थाली f. (-ली) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. काच glass, and स्थाली a goblet, &c. to which its colour is compared.
काचिघ: काचिघ m. (-घः) 1 A legume. 2 A rat. 3 Gold.
काचित्: काचित् ind. Some one, any one, (a female person or object,) the first member is declinable, as काञ्चित्, &c. E. का fem. of किम् and चित् aff.
काचित: काचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended by a swing or in a loop. E. काच a nominal root, to hang by a loop or in a swing, and क्त aff.
काचिम: काचिम m. (-मः) A tree considered as sacred, one growing near a temple, and an object or religious veneration or worship, &c.
काञ्चन: काञ्चन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Golden, of gold. n. (-नं) 1 Gold. 2 Wealth. 3 A filament of the lotus. m. (-नः) 1 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) 2 A tree bearing a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) 3 Another plant, (Mesua ferrea:) see नागकेसर. 4 Glomerous fig tree: see उदुम्बर. 5 Common thorn apple, (Datura metel.) f. (-नी) 1 Turmeric. 2 A yellow pigment. E. कचि to shine, &c. ल्युट् affix, the radical vowel lengthened; this etymology gives the meaning gold, the others refer to their colour, &c. in which they resemble the metal.
काञ्चनक: काञ्चनक m. (-कः) Mountain ebony, &c. n. (-कं) Yellow orpiment. E. काञ्चन gold, &c. and कन् affix, implying resemblance or identity.
काञ्चनकन्दर: काञ्चनकन्दर m. (-रः) A gold mine. E. काञ्चन, and कन्दर a cave.
काञ्चनकारिणी: काञ्चनकारिणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus:) see शतमूली.
काञ्चनगिरि: काञ्चनगिरि m. (-रिः) Mount Sumeru. E. काच्चन, and गिरि a mountain; the golden mountain.
काञ्चनचय: काञ्चनचय m. (-यः) A heap of gold. E. काञ्चन, and चय assemblage.
काञ्चनभू: काञ्चनभू f. (-भूः) 1 Gold dust. 2 A golden or yellow soil. E. काञ्चन, and भू soil.
काञ्चनमय: काञ्चनमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden. E. काञ्चन, and मयट् aff.
काञ्चनवप्र: काञ्चनवप्र m. (-प्रः) A hill or mound of gold. E. काञ्चन, and वप्र a mound.
काञ्चनसन्धि: काञ्चनसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) A treaty of friendship between two parties on equal terms. E. काञ्चन, and सन्धि alliance.
काञ्चनाल: काञ्चनाल m. (-लः) Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) E. काञ्चन gold, and अल to be able or like; some copies read काञ्चनार.
काञ्चनीया: काञ्चनीया f. (-या) A yellow pigment, commonly Gorocanā. E. काचि to shine, अनीयर् aff.
काञ्चिक: काञ्चिक n. (-कं) Sour gruel: see काञ्जिक.
काञ्ची: काञ्ची f. (-ञ्ची) 1 A woman's zone or girdle. 2 The name of an ancient city situated in the peninsula, and one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus. 3 A plant, (Abrus precatorious:) see गुञ्चा. E. काचि to bind or shine, इन or ङीष् affixes; whence also काञ्चि.
काञ्चीपद: काञ्चीपद n. (-दं) Mons veneris, the pubic region. E. काञ्ची the zone, and पद place, site.
काञ्जिक: काञ्जिक nf. (-कः-का) Sour gruel, the water of boiled rice in a state of spontaneous fermentation. E. क water, अञ्ज to go, &c. and affix इक; also the vowel being lengthened काञ्जीक, or without the final, काञ्जी.
काठ: काठ m. (-ठः) A stone, a rock. E. कठ to be hard, &c. अण् affix; also with कन् added, काठक.
काठक: काठक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) According to the Kaṭha portion of the vedas. E. कठ, and वुञ् aff.
काठिन: काठिन m. (-नः) The date fruit. n. (-नं) 1 Hardness. 2 Sternness. E. कठिन and अण aff.
काठिन्य: काठिन्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Hardness. 2 Difficulty, obscurity. 3 Sternness, severity. E. कठिन hard, and ष्यञ् aff.
काण: काण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) One-eyed, monoculous. m. (-णः) A crow. E. कण to sound, &c. अण् aff.
काणूक: काणूक m. (-कः) A crow. E. कण to sound, &c. and ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.
काणेय: काणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) One-eyed. E. काण, and ढक् aff.
काणेर: काणेर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) One-eyed. E. काण, and द्रक aff.
काण्ड: काण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 A stalk or stem. 2 The part of the trunk of a tree whence the branches proceed. 3 A cluster, a clump. 4 An arrow. 5 Opportunity, season. 6 Water. 7 A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.) 8 A multitude, a heap, a quantity. 9 A horse. 10 A chapter, a section. 11 The part in a sacrifice appropriated to different objects, as the gods or manes. 12 A long bone, a bone of the extremities. 13 Praise, flattery. 14 Private, privacy. 15 Low, vile, bad. 16 Sinful, wicked. E. कन to shine, &c. डः Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel made long.
काण्डकाण्डक: काण्डकाण्डक m. (-कः) A species of grass. E. काण्ड repeated.
काण्डकार: काण्डकार n. (-रं) The betle nut, the fruit of the areca.
काण्डगोचर: काण्डगोचर m. (-रः) An iron arrow. E. काण्ड a stem or stalk, and गोचर an object of sense: it is fired from a stock like the arrow of the cross bow.
काण्डणी: काण्डणी f. (-णी) A plant, commonly Rāmadūtī: see सूक्ष्मपर्णी.
काण्डतिक्तक: काण्डतिक्तक m. (-कः) A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.) E. काण्ड the stem, and तिक्त sharp, bitter, कन् added to this and similar compounds.
काण्डनील: काण्डनील m. (-लः) A plant with an astringent bark, commonly Lodh. E. काण्ड, and नील blue.
काण्डपट: काण्डपट m. (-टः) An outer tent, a screen surrounding a tent. E. काण्ड a stem, &c. and पट a cloth; also with कन् added काण्डपटकः.
काण्डपुष्प: काण्डपुष्प n. (-ष्पः) A small fragrant flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.) E. काण्ड the stem, and पुष्प flower; flowering from the stalk.
काण्डपृष्ठ: काण्डपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Of the military profession, a soldier. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 The husband of a Vaiśya female. 2 An adopted or any other than the natural son. n. (-ष्ठं) The bow of KĀMA. E. काण्ड an arrow, and पृष्ठ the back: see काण्डस्पृष्ठ.
काण्डभग्न: काण्डभग्न n. (-ग्नं) A fracture of either of the extremities. E. काण्ड, and भग्न breaking.
काण्डरुहा: काण्डरुहा f. (-हा) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. काण्ड the stem of a tree, and रुहा what ascends; hence it appears to be a creeper.
काण्डर्षि: काण्डर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi or divine saint of a peculiar class; Jaimini and others who teach a particular Kāṇḍa or section of Vedas. E. काण्ड a section, and ऋषि a saint.
काण्डवत्: काण्डवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Armed with an arrow, an archer. E. काण्ड an arrow, and मतुप् poss. aff.
काण्डसन्धि: काण्डसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) A knot, a joint in the stem of a tree, &c. E. काण्ड a stem, and सन्धि union.
काण्डस्पृष्ट: काण्डस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Of the military profession, living by arms, a soldier. E. काण्ड an arrow, &c. स्पृश to touch, and क्त aff.
काण्डहीन: काण्डहीन n. (-नं) A fragrant grass, a sort of cyperus: see भद्रमुस्तक. E. काण्ड a stem, and हीन deprived.
काण्डीर: काण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Armed with an arrow, an archer. m. (-रः) 1 A creeping plant, commonly Kāṇḍa Bel, (Momordica charantia.) 2 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) f. (-रा) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith): see मञ्जिष्ठा. E. काण्ड an arrow, a stem, &c. and ईरच् aff.
काण्डेक्षु: काण्डेक्षु n. (-क्षुः) 1 A plant, (Barleria longifolia.) 2 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum:) see काश. E. काण्ड, and ईक्षु sugar cane; having a similar stem.
कातर: कातर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Confused, perplexed, disordered. 2 Timid, gentle. m. (-रः) A large kind of fish, commonly Kātala, (Cyprinus catla, HAM.) E. का a little or badly, and तर what crosses.
कातरता: कातरता f. (-ता) Timidity, agitation. E. तल् added to कातर; also with त्व, कातरत्वं.
कातल: कातल m. (-लः) The name of a fish, commonly Kātala, (Cyprinus catla, HAM.) E. see कातर, र changed to ल.
कातीय: कातीय m. (-यः) 1 A name of KĀTYĀYANA. 2 A pupil of the same. E. कात्यायन with फक् affix and the middle syllable dropped; also कात्यायनीय.
कात्त्रयक: कात्त्रयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced from any bad triad. E. कत्त्रय, and ढकञ् aff.
कात्य: कात्य m. (-त्यः) The name of a saint; also कात्यायन. E. कत a proper name, and यञ् affix implying descent or lineage.
कात्यायन: कात्यायन m. (-नः) 1 The name of a celebrated lawgiver and divine sage. 2 An appellation of VARARUCI a poet. E. कात्य, and फक् pleonastic affix. f. (-नी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A middle- aged widow. E. ङीष् added to कात्यायन; the daughter of the saint KĀTYĀYANA, (DURGĀ,) or resembling the wife of a sage in dress and austerity, (the widow.)
कात्यायनीय: कात्यायनीय m. (-यः) A pupil of KĀTYĀYANA. E. कात्यायन, and फक् aff.
काथिक: काथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a story, told in it, &c. m. (-कः) A narrator. E. कथा and ठक् aff.
कादम्ब: कादम्ब n. (-म्बं) 1 A tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) 2 A drake, or, according to some, a teal. 3 An arrow. f. (-म्बा) A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī: see कदम्बपुष्प. E. अण् added to कदम्ब.
कादम्बक: कादम्बक m. (-कः) An arrow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कादम्बर: कादम्बर n. (-रं) The surface or skim of coagulated milk. m. (-रः) A spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the Kadamba. f. (-री) 1 Wine, spirituous liquor in general. 2 A name of SARASVATĪ. 3 The female Koil or Indian cuckoo. 4 The female of another bird, (Turdus salica, BUC.) E. कदम्ब the Kadamba flower, र what gains or gets, from रा, affix ड.
कादम्बरीवीज: कादम्बरीवीज n. (-जं) Ferment, yeast, whatever occasions fermentation. E. कादम्बरी, and वीज seed.
कादम्बर्य: कादम्बर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The Kādamba tree: see कादम्ब. E. कादम्बरी a spirit, and यत् aff.
कादम्बर्य्य: कादम्बर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The Kādamba tree: see कादम्ब. E. कादम्बरी a spirit, and यत् aff.
कादम्बिनी: कादम्बिनी f. (-नी) A long line of clouds. E. कादम्ब the Kādamba flower, इनि and ङीप् affixes, implying a multitude; the clouds being compared he large white flowers of the Nauclea cadamba.
कादाचित्क: कादाचित्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्की-त्कं) Produced sometimes, occasional, incidental. E. कदाचित् sometimes, with कन् added, and अण् aff.
काद्रवेय: काद्रवेय m. (-यः) A Nāga or serpent of the race that is supposed to people the lower regions. E. कद्रु the mother of these beings, and ढक् aff.
कानक: कानक n. (-कं) The seed of the croton.
कानन: कानन nf. (-नं-नी) 1 A forest, a grove. 2 The face of BRAHMĀ. 3 A house. E. कनि to shine, in the causal form, and ल्युट् affix, or क BRAHMĀ, and आनन a face.
काननारि: काननारि m. (-रिः) The Śami or Śain tree, (Mimosa albida:) see समी. E. कानन, and अरि enemy; injurious to a wood; being a thorny tree.
कानीन: कानीन mf. (-नः-नी) The son or daughter of a young and unmarried woman. m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA. 2 Also of KARṆA, (being both born of mothers who were unmarried.) E. कन्या a virgin or young girl, changed to कनीन् and अण् aff.
कान्त: कान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Pleasing, agreeable. 2 Lovely, beautiful. 3 Dear, beloved. m. (-न्तः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA. 2 The moon. 3 A husband. 4 Spring. 5 A precious stone; in which case it is compounded with सूर्य्य, चन्द्र or अयस्, as सूर्य्यकान्त a crystal lens, &c. f. (-न्ता) 1 A wife, a mistress, any beloved or lovely woman. 2 A plant, commonly Priyangu: see प्रियङ्गु. 3 A grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) n. (-न्तं) 1 Iron. 2 Saffron. E. कम to desire, affix क्त.
कान्तता: कान्तता f. (-ता) Loveliness, beauty, splendor. E. कान्त pleasing, &c. तल् aff.
कान्तपक्षिन्: कान्तपक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A peacock. E. कान्त beautiful, पक्षिन् a bird.
कान्तपुष्प: कान्तपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Mountain ebony, &c. (Bauhinia variegata.) E. कान्त, and पुष्प flower.
कान्तलक: कान्तलक m. (-कः) A tree, the wood of which something resembles mahogany, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna, Rox.) E. कान्त, beauty, and र what gives, कन् added, and र changed to ल.
कान्ताङ्घ्रिदोहद: कान्ताङ्घ्रिदोहद m. (-दः) A tree, commonly Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.) E. कान्ता a woman, अङ्ग्नि a foot, and दोहद desire; the tree being supposed to blossom upon coming in contact with the foot of a handsome female.
कान्ताचरणदोहद: कान्ताचरणदोहद m. (-दः) The tree Aśoka: see the preceding.
कान्तायस: कान्तायस n. (-सं) Iron stone: see अयस्कान्त. E. कान्त, and अयस् iron, अण् added.
कान्तार: कान्तार mn. (-रः-रं) 1 A bad or difficult road. 2 A wood, a forest. 3 A hole, a cavity. m. (-रः) 1 A red variety of the sugar cane. 2 A bamboo. 3 Mountain ebony. n. (-रं) 1 A symptom or symptomatic disease. 2 A lotus. f. (-री) A sort of sugar cane. E. कान् for कञ्चित् any one, here meaning no one, तृ to go, in the causal form, अच् affix; allowing none to pass; or क pleasure, &c. अन्त end, and ऋ to go, अण् aff.
कान्तारक: कान्तारक m. (-कः) A sort of sugar cane. E. कान्त good, excellent, (juice,) ऋ to go, to gain, अण् and कन् affixes: see the preceding.
कान्तारग: कान्तारग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes into or in a wood. E. कान्तार, and ग who goes.
कान्ति: कान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Beauty, splendor, light. 2 Female beauty. 3 Wish, desire. 4 A lovely or desirable woman. 5 Personal decoration or embellishment. E. कम to desire or be desired, क्तिन् aff.
कान्तिकर: कान्तिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Beautifying, illumining, making handsome or splendid. E. कान्ति, and कर what makes.
कान्तिद: कान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Beautifying, illuminating. n. (-दं) Bile, the bilious humour. E. कान्ति light, splendor, &c. and द what gives.
कान्तिदायक: कान्तिदायक mfn. (-यकः-यिका-यकं) Beautifying, adorning. n. (-कं) A kind of Curcuma, from the root of which a yellow die is pared, (C. Zanthorhiza.) E. कान्ति beauty, &c. दायक distributor, giver.
कान्तिभृत्: कान्तिभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Handsome, beautiful. 2 Bright, shining. E. कान्ति, and भृत् what has.
कान्तिमत्: कान्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Splendid. 2 Beautiful. E. कान्ति, and मतुप् aff.
कान्तिहर: कान्तिहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Dimming, dulling, making dull or ugly. E. कान्ति, and हर what removes.
कान्दव: कान्दव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Roasted or baked, (in an iron pan or oven, as bread, cakes, &c.) E. कन्दु and अण् aff.
कान्दविक: कान्दविक m. (-कः) A baker. E. कान्दव baked bread, and ठक् aff.
कान्दिशीक: कान्दिशीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Flying, running away, put to flight. E. कदि to fear, घञ् and इन् affixed, कन्दि; शीक to go, to ooze, घञ् affix, कन्दिशीक; and again, अण् affix, कान्दिशीक.
कान्यकुञ्ज: कान्यकुञ्ज m. (-जः) A country, the modern Kanouj; also कन्यकुब्ज
कान्यजा: कान्यजा f. (-जा) A kind of perfume, commonly Nali.
कापटिक: कापटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Wicked, bad, perverse. 2 Fraudulent, dishonest. m. (-कः) 1 A student, a scholar. 2 A flatterer, a parasite. E. कपट fraud, &c. ठक् aff.
कापट्य: कापट्य n. (-ट्यं) Wickedness, fraud, dishonesty. E. कपट, and ष्यञ् aff.
कापथ: कापथ m. (-थः) A bad road. E. का for कु bad, vile, and पथिन् a road.
कापाल: कापाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Cranial, relating to the skull. m. (-लः) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) n. (-लं) A sort of leprosy. E. कपाल and अण् aff.
कापालिक: कापालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the skull. m. (-कः) A worshipper of ŚIVA of the left-hand order, characterised by carrying a half of the skull as a cup, drinking spirituous liquors, &c. E. कपाल, and ठञ् aff.
कापिल: कापिल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Of a tawny colour. m. (-लः) 1 A follower of the Sāṃkhya system of philosophy. E. कपिल the founder of the school, and अण् affix. 2 Tawny, (the colour.) E. अण् pleonastic, added to कपिल, q. v.
कापिश: कापिश n. (-शं) A spirituous liquor, wine. f. (-शी) A country. E. कपिश brown, and अण् aff.
कापिशायन: कापिशायन m. (-नः) 1 A deity. 2 A kind of vinous liquor. n. (-नं) Honey. f. (-नी) A grape. E. कपिश brown, or कापिशी a country, and ष्फक् aff.
कापिशेय: कापिशेय m. (-यः) A Piśāca, an imp or goblin. E. कपिश, and ढक् aff.
कापुरुष: कापुरुष m. (-षः) A mean contemptible man, a coward, a wretch. E. का for कु bad, vile, पुरुष a man.
कापुरुषत्व: कापुरुषत्व n. (-त्वं) Meanness, cowardliness. E. त्व added to the preceding: also with तल्, कापुरुषता.
कापेय: कापेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging to or relating to a monkey. E. कपि a monkey, and ढक् aff.
कापोत: कापोत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Of a dirty white colour. m. (-तः) 1 Natron, fossile alkali. 2 Antimony, considered as a collyrium or application to the eyes. 3 A pale or dirty white colour. n. (-तं) A flock of pigeons. E. कपोत a pigeon, &c. अण् aff.
कापोताञ्जन: कापोताञ्जन n. (-नं) Antimony, especially considered as a collyrium. E. कपोत a pigeon, and अञ्जन a collyrium.
काप्यकर: काप्यकर m. (-रः) A penitent, one who acknowledges his faults. E. का for कु bad, आप्य having obtained, and कर who does; from कृ and अच्.
काप्यकार: काप्यकार m. (-रः) 1 Avowal or confession of sin. 2 A penitent, one who confesses a crime. E. as before, affix अण्.
काफल: काफल m. (-लः) A bitter seed: see कट्फल. E. का bad, and फल fruit.
काम: काम m. (-मः) 1 KĀMA the Hindu Cupid or deity of love. 2 Wish, desire. 3 BALARĀMA the brother of KṚṢṆA. 4 The mango tree. f. (-मा) Love, desire. n. (-मं) 1 Semen virile. 2 An object of desire. 3 Willingly, voluntarily. 4 A particle of assent or agreement: see कामम्, ind. (in composition,) Following one's own desire, as कामवाद speaking what one lists; कामभक्ष eating whatever one likes; कामचार doing whatever one chooses; in law, a child previous to the imposition of the characteristic cord is all these. E. कम to desire, घञ् aff.
कामकला: कामकला f. (-ला) RATI the wife of KĀMA. E. काम, and कला a part.
कामकामिन्: कामकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Following the dictates of passion or desire. E. काम, and कामिन् desirous.
कामकार: कामकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Following one's inclinations. m. (-रः) Desire, the operation or influence of desire. E. काम, and कार act, who acts.
कामकारतस्: कामकारतस् ind. According to one's desires, following one's inclinations, indulging desire. E. कामकार and तसि aff.
कामकूट: कामकूट m. (-टः) 1 The paramour of a harlot, a cully. 2 Wanton caresses, harlotry. E. काम desire, and कूट a peak or summit.
कामकेलि: कामकेलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Libidinous, wanton. m. (-लिः) 1 Copulation. 2 Amorous sport. E. काम love desire, केलि play, sport.
कामग: कामग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Acting as one pleases. E. काम, and ग who goes.
कामगामिन्: कामगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going as one lists. E. काम the wish, and गामिन् who goes.
कामगुण: कामगुण m. (-णः) 1 Passion, affection. 2 An object of sense. 3 Completion, satiety, perfect enjoyment. E. काम desire, and गुण a quality or property.
कामङ्गामिन्: कामङ्गामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going as one lists. E. कामं at will, and गामिन् who goes.
कामचार: कामचार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Following one's own pleasure, unchecked, unrestrained. m. (-रः) Following one's own wishes or pleasure, sensuality, selfishness. E. काम, and चार practice.
कामचारतस्: कामचारतस् ind. According to one's own inclinations. E. तसि added to the last.
कामचारिन्: कामचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Desirous, libidinous. 2 Self-willed, m. (-री) 1 A sparrow. A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. E. काम desire, and चारिन् who goes, from चर with णिनि affix; also with ण्वुल् affix, कामचारक.
कामज: कामज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced or caused by passion or desire. m. (-जः) The son of KĀMA. E. काम, and ज born; also कामजनित, कामोत्पन्न, &c.
कामजान: कामजान m. (-नः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. काम, and जान what produces, from जन in the causal form, and घञ् affix; also read कामजनि.
कामठ: कामठ (-ठः) A tortoise. E. कमठ the same, अण् pleonasm.
कामतस्: कामतस् ind. 1 Willingly, consentingly. 2 Passionately. E. काम and तसि aff.
कामताल: कामताल m. (-लः) The Kokila, or Koïl, the Indian cuckoo. E. काम, and ताल a musical strain; the song of the Koïl being poetically considered as an incentive to love.
कामद: कामद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Giving what is wished, granting one's desires. f. (-दा) A fabulous cow, the cow of plenty. E. काम desire, and द what gives.
कामदुघा: कामदुघा f. (-घा) The cow of plenty. E. काम, and दुह to yield milk, affix कप्.
कामदुह्: कामदुह् f. (-धुक्) 1 The cow of plenty. E. काम, and दुह to give milk, क्विस् aff.
कामदूती: कामदूती f. (-ती) 1 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 The female koïl. E. काम desire, and दूती a messenger; also कामदूति and कामदूतिका.
कामध्वंसिन्: कामध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A name of ŚIVA. E. काम CUPID, and ध्वंसिन् an enemy.
कामन: कामन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lustful, libidinous, desirous. f. (-ना) Wish, desire. E. कम to desire, and युच् aff.
कामन्धमिन्: कामन्धमिन् m. (-मी) A brazier. E. काम willingly, ध्मा to blow, णिनि aff.
कामपत्नी: कामपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A name of RATI. E. काम KANDARPA, and पत्नी a wife.
कामपाल: कामपाल m. (-लः) A name of BALARĀMA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. E. काम KĀMA, and पाल who cherishes; being by one legend the paternal uncle of that deity.
कामप्रद: कामप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Granting what is desired. E. काम, and प्रद what yields.
कामबद्ध: कामबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound by love. n. (-द्धं) A wood. E. काम and बद्ध tied.
कामभक्ष: कामभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Eating any thing or every thing. E. काम, and भक्ष who eats.
कामभक्ष्य: कामभक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Eating any thing. E. काम, and भक्ष्य to be eaten.
कामम्: कामम् ind. A particle, 1 Of reluctant assent, (well, very well.) 2 Of assent, (willingly, readily.) 3 Of agreement, (very well, so be it.) 4 Of contempt or invidious remark. 5 Agreeably to desire, following the inclination: see काम.
काममह: काममह m. (-हः) The day of full moon in the month Chaitra, (March-April.) E. काम the deity, and मह worship; a festival in honour of KĀMA.
काममालिन्: काममालिन् m. (-ली) A name of GAṆEŚA.
कामयितृ: कामयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Libidinous, lustful, desirous. E. कम to desire, in the causal form, and तृच् aff.
कामरूप: कामरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) 1 Pleasing, beautiful. 2 Taking any or every shape at will. m. (-पः) A district lying east of Bengal, the western portion of Asam. E. काम desire, and रूप form or figure.
कामरूपिन्: कामरूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Pleasing, beautiful. 2 Taking any shape at will. m. (-पी) 1 A Vidyādhara, a kind of subordinate deity. 2 A pole cat. E. काम desire, will, रूप form, and इनि aff.
कामरेखा: कामरेखा f. (-खा) A harlot, a courtezan. E. काम desire, and रेखा a line.
कामल: कामल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Libidinous, cupidinous. mf. (-लः-ला) A complaint, jaundice, excessive secretion or obstruction of bile. m. (-लः) 1 Spring. 2 A dry and sterile soil. E. काम desire, ला to bring, ड aff.
कामलता: कामलता f. (-ता) 1 Membrum virile. 2 A plant, (Ipomaea quamoclit.) E. काम, and लता creeper.
कामलोल: कामलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Overcome with desire or passion. E. काम, and लोल agitated.
कामवल्लभ: कामवल्लभ m. (-भः) 1 The mango tree. 2 Spring. f. (-भा) Moonlight. E. काम, and वल्लभ friend.
कामवाद: कामवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Saying any thing at pleasure. E. काम, and वाद speech.
कामविहन्तृ: कामविहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Disappointing, preventing. E. काम, and विहन्तृ who destroys.
कामवृत्त: कामवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Licentious, dissipated, debauched. E. काम, and वृत्त practising.
कामवृद्धि: कामवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 A shrub, commonly Kāmaja, of supposed aphrodisial properties. 2 Increase of passion or desire. E. काम, and वृद्धि increase.
कामवृन्ता: कामवृन्ता f. (-न्ता) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. काम, and वृन्ता a flower stalk.
कामशर: कामशर m. (-रः) 1 The shaft of KĀMADEVA. 2 The mango. E. काम, and शर an arrow.
कामसंयोग: कामसंयोग m. (-गः) Attainment of desired objects. E. काम, and संयोग union.
कामसख: कामसख m. (-खः) 1 Spring. 2 The mango. E. काम and सखि a friend.
कामसुत: कामसुत m. (-तः) A name of ANIRUDDHA. E. काम, and सुत a son; also similar compounds, as कामपुत्र, &c.
कामहैतुक: कामहैतुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of one's own accord. E. काम, हेतु cause, वुञ् aff.
कामाग्नि: कामाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Passion, lust, violent desire. E. काम, and अग्नि fire.
कामाङ्कुश: कामाङ्कुश m. (-शः) 1 A finger nail. 2 Membrum virile. E. काम, and अङ्कुश shoot.
कामाङ्ग: कामाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) E. काम, and अङ्ग the body or form.
कामातुर: कामातुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) In love, affected by love or desire. E. काम, and आतुर diseased.
कामात्मन्: कामात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 1 Licentious, libidinous. 2 Desiring, wishing for. E. काम, and आत्मन् self.
कामात्मता: कामात्मता f. (-ता) 1 Passion, lust. 2 Wish, desire. E. कामात्म and तल् aff.
कामाधिष्ठित: कामाधिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Influenced or overcome by love. E. काम, and अधिष्ठित placed over.
कामाधिकार: कामाधिकार m. (-रः) 1 The influence of passion or desire. 2 The aspiration of the will. 3 The part of the Śāstra which relates to human wishes or desires. E. काम, and अधिकार superintendence.
कामानल: कामानल m. (-लः) Passion, lust, violent desire. E. काम, and अनल fire.
कामान्ध: कामान्ध m. (-न्धः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. काम, and अन्ध blind.
कामायुध: कामायुध n. (-धं) An arrow of KĀMADEVA. m. (-धः) 1 Membrum virile. 2 The mango tree. E. काम, and आयुध a weapon.
कामायुस्: कामायुस् m. (-युः) Name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. E. काम, and आयुस् life; existing at will.
कामारण्य: कामारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A handsome grove or wood. E. काम desirable, and अरण्य a forest.
कामारि: कामारि m. (-रिः) A mineral substance used in medicine, a sort of pyrites: see विटमाक्षिक. E. काम love, and अरि an enemy.
कामार्त: कामार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) In love, afflicted by love or passion. E. काम, and आर्त्त pained.
कामार्त्त: कामार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) In love, afflicted by love or passion. E. काम, and आर्त्त pained.
कामालु: कामालु m. (-लुः) A red sort of mountain ebony.
कामावसाय: कामावसाय m. (-यः) Coldness, stoicism, mortification or suppression of the passions. E. काम, and अवसाय destruction.
कामावसायिता: कामावसायिता f. (-ता) The power of suppressing desire, self-denial or mortification. E. कामावसायिन् and तल् affix, or with त्व, कामावसायित्व n. (-त्वं).
कामावसायितृ: कामावसायितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what suppresses or destroys passion or desire. E. काम, and अवसायितृ destroying.
कामावसायिन्: कामावसायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Destructive of love or desire, one who suppresses desire, &c. E. कामावसाय and इनि aff.
कामासक्त: कामासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Impassioned, in love, overcome with desire or passion. E. काम, and आसक्त attached.
कामासक्ति: कामासक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Passion, desire. E. काम, and आसक्ति attachment.
कामि: कामि m. (-मिः) A libidinous man, a lecher. f. (-मिः) A name of RATI the wife of KĀMA. E. कम to desire, कि affix; the pen. becomes long.
कामिक: कामिक m. (-कः) A kind of wild duck. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कामिता: कामिता f. (-ता) Love, desire. E. कामिन् and तल् affix; also with त्व, कामित्व.
कामिन्: कामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Impassioned, fond, loving, wanton. 2 Cupidinous, desirous. m. (-मी) 1 The moon. 2 A lover, an uxorious husband. 3 The ruddy goose. 4 A pigeon. 5 A sparrow. f. (-नी) 1 A loving or affectionate woman. 2 A timid woman. 3 A woman in general. 4 Spirituous liquor. 5 A climbing plant. E. कम to desire, and णिनि aff.
कामिनीश: कामिनीश m. (-शः) A plant, (Morunga guilandina, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन.
कामील: कामील m. (-लः) A kind of betel, commonly रामगुवाक. E. काम desire, ईलच् aff.
कामुक: कामुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Cupidinous, desirous, lustful, libidinous. m. (-कः) 1 A plant, Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.) 2 A creeping plant, (Gaertnera racemosa.) 3 A sparrow. 4 A bow. f. (-का) A woman desirous of wealth, food, &c. (-की) A woman libidinous or lustful. E. कम to desire, उकञ् affix, fem. टाप् or ङीष्.
कामोदक: कामोदक n. (-कं) Oblation of water to deceased friends, &c. exclusive of those for whom it is directed by law. E. काम will, and उदक water; being given according to the inclination of the giver.
कामोदा: कामोदा f. (-दा) A Rāgiṇī, one of the female personifications of the musical modes.
कामोपहत: कामोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overcome with passion or desire. E. काम, and उपहत struck.
काम्पिल: काम्पिल m. (-लः) A country believed to be situated in the north of India: see काम्पिल्ल, &c. f. (-ली) The capital city of that region.
काम्पिल्य: काम्पिल्य m. (-ल्यः) 1 A perfume, commonly Sunda Rocani. 2 A country: see the preceding; also काम्पिल्ल, &c.
काम्पिल्ल: काम्पिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 Sunda Rocani, a perfume and drug so called. 2 The name of a country said to be in the north-west of India. E. कपि to tremble or shake, इल्ल affix; also काम्पिल or काम्पील, काम्पिल्य, &c.
काम्पील: काम्पील m. (-लः) See काम्पिल and काम्पिल्ल; also काम्पीलक.
काम्बल: काम्बल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Clothed with a blanket, &c. m. (-लः) A car covered with a woollen cloth or blanket. E. कम्बल a blanket, अण् aff.
काम्बविक: काम्बविक m. (-कः) A dealer in shells, a vender of ornaments made of them, &c. E. कम्बु a shell, ठक् aff.
काम्बुका: काम्बुका f. (-का) A plant, (Physalis flexuosa:) see अश्वगन्धा.
काम्बोज: काम्बोज m. (-जः) 1 A native of Kāmboja, a foreign race going like the Yavanas, with the whole of the head shaved, one of the tribes originally Kṣatriya, but degraded by omission of the essential rites. 2 A horse of the breed of Kamboya or Kamboja. 3 A white mimosa. 4 A tree, commonly Punnag, (Rottleria tinctoria.) f. (-जी) 1 A plant, commonly Maṣāni: see माषपर्णी. 2 A white mimosa, as above. 3 The Gunja plant. E. कम्बोज Kamboja or Kamboya, a country in the north of India, अण and ङीष् affix: the plants, &c. being supposed indigenous to that district.
काम्य: काम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Agreeable, desirable, amiable. 2 Performed through the desire of some advantage, (a religious ceremony, &c.) 2 Optional, supererogatory, performed for some particular object, and opposed to the नित्यकर्म्म or fixed and indispensable observance. 4 Relating to desire, will, &c. 5 Done through lust or passion. E. काम desire, love, &c. and यत् aff.
काम्यगिर्: काम्यगिर् f. (-गीः) A pleasing sound, an agreeable speech or song. E. काम्य, and गिर् speech.
काम्यत्व: काम्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Supererogation, will, pleasure. 2 Love, desire. E. काम्य, and त्व affix; also with तल्, काम्यता.
काम्यदान: काम्यदान n. (-नं) 1 An acceptable or desirable gift. 2 A voluntary gift. E. काम्य, and दान a gift.
काम्यमरण: काम्यमरण n. (-णं) Voluntary death, suicide. E. काम्य, and मरण dying.
काम्याभिप्राय: काम्याभिप्राय m. (-यः) The purpose of deriving benefit from any act. E. काम्य, and अभिप्राय intention.
काम्ल: काम्ल mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं) Slightly acid, acidulous. E. का dimin. अम्ल sour.
काय: काय mn. (-यः-यं) The body. n. (-यं) 1 Part of the hand sacred to the creator; the root of the little finger. 2 Clarified butter or any oblation to BRAHMĀ. m. (-यः) 1 One of the eight modes of marriage, the same as प्राजापत्य. 2 Assemblage, collection. 3 A butt or mark, an object to be hit or attained. 4 Natural temperament of any thing or being. 5 A house, a habitation. 6 Principal, capital. E. क a name of BRAHMĀ, and अण् deriv.  affix, इ is added to क, and अय is substituted for the short vowel; proceeding from or relating to BRAHMĀ, &c.
कायक: कायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Belonging to the body. E. काय, and कन् added.
कायक्लेश: कायक्लेश m. (-शः) Bodily suffering, toil or pain. E. काय, and क्लेश distress.
कायचिकित्सा: कायचिकित्सा f. (-सा) Treatment of disease, administering medicines. E. काय, and चिकित्सा remedying.
कायबलन: कायबलन n. (-नं) Armour, mail. E. काय the body, and बलन protecting; from बल to be strong, affix ल्युट्.
कायमान: कायमान n. (-नं) A hut of grass or thatch. E. कै to sound, and शानच् aff.
कायस्थ: कायस्थ m. (-स्थः) 1 The Supreme Being. 2 A caste or tribe, or man of that tribe; the Kayeth or writer caste, proceeding from a Kṣatriya father and Śūdra mother. f. (-स्था) 1 Yellow myrobalan: see हरीतकी. 2 Emblic myrobalan. 3 A drug, commonly Kākoli. 4 A woman of the Kayeth caste. (-स्थी) The wife of a Kayeth or scribe. E. काय the body or house, and स्थ who stays, or resides.
कायाग्नि: कायाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The digestive faculty. E. काय, and अग्नि fire.
कायिक: कायिक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Corporeal, relating to the body. E. काय the body, and कन् or ठक् aff.
कायिकाष्टद्धि: कायिकाष्टद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Interest arising from service drawn from the body of an animal, (as a cow, &c.) pledged; or according to some, interest of which the payment does not affect the principal. E. कायिका corporal, &c. वृद्धि interest.
कार: कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what does any act, (but used chiefly in composition with other words:) the agent, a maker or doer; as कुम्भकार a potter, a maker of earthen vessels. स्वर्णकार a goldsmith, &c. m. (-रः) 1 Act, action. 2 Killing, slaughter. 3 Certainty. 4 Effort, exertion. 5 Religious austerity. 6 A heap of snow, or a mountain covered with it. 7 Tax, toll, royal revenue. 8 A master, a lord. f. (-रा) 1 A prison. 2 Binding, confinement. 3 A female messenger. 4 The part of a lute below the neck. 5 A female worker in gold, (हेमकारिका?) 6 Pain, affliction. E. कृञ् to make, to do, with घञ् or अण् affix, in the latter case the fem. affix is ङीष्.
कारक: कारक mfn. (-रकः-रिका-रकं) An agent, acting, doing, who or what does, acts, makes, &c. m. (-कः) A noun of action. n. (-कं) 1 Action, especially in grammar. 2 That part of grammar comprising all nouns which imply the agent, object, instrument, &c. or any thing except the simple and radical idea; it also includes the use and government of the cases or syntax. E. कृञ् to do, and ण्वुल् affix of agency.
कारकर: कारकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Working, doing work, acting as agent. E. कार, and कर who does.
कारकहेतु: कारकहेतु n. (-तुः) Efficient or active cause. E. कारक what produces, हेतु cause.
कारकुक्षीय: कारकुक्षीय m. (-यः) The name of a country, that of king SALVA; or plu. (-याः) The people of that country. E. कार a snowy mountain, कुक्ष the flank, and छ affix; being on the skirts of the Himāla ridge in the north-west of Hindustan.
कारज: कारज mfn. (-जः-जी-जं) Of or relating to the finger nail. m. (-जः) A young elephant. E. करज a nail, &c. अण् aff.
कारण: कारण n. (-णं) 1 Cause, motive, origin, principle: in logic, cause is of three kinds; Samavāyi, inherent or direct; Asamavāyi, proximate or indirect; and Nimitta, instrumental or incidental. 2 Action, agency. 3 Killing, injuring. 4 An organ of sense. 5 An instrument or means. 6 An element, elementary matter. 7 A deity, as the remote or proximate cause of creation. 8 A number of scribes. 9 A kind of musical instrument. 10 A sort of song, &c. see करण. 11 The origin of a story (of a play or poem.) f. (-णा) 1 Pain, agony. 2 Casting into hell. 3 An astronomical period. E. कृञ् to do or act, in the causal form, and युच् or ल्युट् affix, or करण and अण् added.
कारणकारण: कारणकारण n. (-णं) 1 A primary cause. 2 An elementary cause, an atom. E. कारण repeated.
कारणगुण: कारणगुण m. (-णः) An elementary or causal property. E. कारण, and गुण property.
कारणगुणोद्भवगुण: कारणगुणोद्भवगुण m. (-णः) A secondary or derivative property, as form, taste, smell, &c. produced by combinations of elementary or causal particles. E. कारणगुण, and उद्भवगुण produced property.
कारणत्व: कारणत्व n. (-त्वं) Causality, causation. E. त्व added to कारण, and त्व affix, or with तल्, कारणता.
कारणमाला: कारणमाला f. (-ला) A series or chain of events. E. कारण, and माला a wreath.
कारणवादिन्: कारणवादिन् m. (-दी) A complainant, a plaintiff. E. कारण the cause, and वादिन् who declares.
कारणशरीर: कारणशरीर n. (-रं) The inner rudiment of the body or causal frame, the seat of the soul. E. कारण, and शरीर body.
कारणाभाव: कारणाभाव m. (-वः) Absence of cause. E. कारण, and अभाव nonentity.
कारणिक: कारणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Investigating, trying, ascertaining the cause. 2 Causal, causative. E. कारण action, and ठक aff.
कारणोत्तर: कारणोत्तर n. (-रं) Special plea, denial of the cause of complaint, admission of the charge generally, but denial of the issue; as to a demand of debt, acknowledgment that it was incurred, but assertion that the loan has been repaid, &c. E. कारण् the cause, and उत्तर answer.
कारण्डव: कारण्डव mf. (-वः-वी) A sort of duck. E. करण्ड Vallisneria, अण् pleonastic aff.
कारण्डव्यूह: कारण्डव्यूह m. (-हः) A Buddha or sanctified being according to the Bauddhas. E. कारण्ड the same, वै to go, and ड aff.
कारन्धमिन्: कारन्धमिन् m. (-मी) 1 A brazier, a worker in mixed or white metal. 2 A mineralogist, an assayer. E. कारं work, and घमिन् who blows; from ध्मा to blow, and इनि aff.
कारम्भा: कारम्भा f. (-म्भा) A plant bearing a fragrant seed, commonly Priyangu. E. का for कु bad, आरम्भ beginning; very diminutive while young.
कारयत्: कारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing to do, conferring any power or authority to do, &c. कृ to do, causal form, शतृ aff.
कारयमाण: कारयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Doing what is appointed, carrying into effect what has been ordered. E. कृ to do, causal form, शानच् aff.
कारयितृ: कारयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Causing to act or do. E. कृ to do, causal form, तृच् aff.
कारव: कारव m. (-वः) A crow. E. क्वा an imitative sound, रव who sounds. f. (-वी) 1 A kind of Anise, (Anethum sowa.) 2 Another plant, (Celosia cristata.) 3 The asafoetida plant or its leaf, Hiṅguparṇī. 4 A kind of fennel, (Nigella Indica.) 5 A small gourd. E. क water, आङ् before रु to go, अण् and ङीप् affs.
कारवेल्ल: कारवेल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) E. कार certainty, and वेल्ल what goes; also with कन् added कारवल्लक.
कारस्कर: कारस्कर m. (-रः) 1 A medicinal plant. 2 A tree. E. कार toll, revenue, and कर what makes; स is inserted in this sense, for the sake of euphony.
कारस्कराटिका: कारस्कराटिका f. (-का) A centipede or worm resembling it, (Julus.) E. कारस्कर a tree, and अट what goes.
कारागार: कारागार n. (-रं) A gaol, a place of confinement. E. कारा confinement, and आगार a house.
कारागुप्त: कारागुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Captive, imprisoned, confined, a prisoner. E. कारा confinement, and गुप्त concealed.
कारावर: कारावर m. (-रः) A man of a mixed and low caste, a man born of a Niṣāda father and Vaidehi mother, employed in working in leather or hides. E. कार, and अवर low.
कारावेश्मन्: कारावेश्मन् n. (-श्म) A prison, a gaol. E. कारा confinement, and वेश्मन् a house.
कारि: कारि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) An artist, an artificer. f. (-रिः) Action, act, agency. E. कृञ to do, and इन् Uṇādi aff.
कारिका: कारिका f. (-का) 1 An actress, a dancing woman. 2 Action, agency. 3 Comment, gloss. 4 An art, a profession. 5 Sharp pain. 6 Interest at any stipulated rate. E. कृञ् to do, and वुन् affix, fem. termination टाप्, and इ substituted for the penultimate vowel.

कारितवत्: कारितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Making, doing. 2 Calling, appointing. E. कृ to do, क्तवतु aff.

कारीष: कारीष n. (-षं) A great quantity of dried cow-dung. E. करीष, and अण् aff.

कारुक: कारुक m. (-कः) An artisan, an artificer. E. कारु, and कन् added.
कारुचौर: कारुचौर m. (-रः) One who commits burglary.

कारूहस्त: कारूहस्त m. (-स्तः) The hand of the artisan or artificer. E. कारू, and हस्त hand.

कार्णच्छिद्रक: कार्णछिद्रक mfn. (-कः) A sort of well. E. कर्णछिद the opening of the ear, कन् affix of similitude, अण् added.
