कार्य्यवत्ता: कार्य्यवत्ता f. (-त्ता) Act, action. E. कार्य्यवत् and तल् affix; also कार्य्यवत्त्वं.
कार्यवश: कार्य्यवश m. (-शः) Necessary consequence. E. कार्य्य cause, and वश subjection to.

कार्यवस्तु: कार्य्यवस्तु n. (-न्तु) End, object. E. कार्य्य, and वस्तु thing, what is to be done.
कार्य्यवस्तु: कार्य्यवस्तु n. (-न्तु) End, object. E. कार्य्य, and वस्तु thing, what is to be done.
कार्यविपत्ति: कार्य्यविपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Failure, reverse, misfortune. E. कार्य्य, and विपत्ति misfortune.

कार्यसागर: कार्य्यसागर m. (-रः) Business, heavy business, weighty affairs. E. कार्य्य, and सागर ocean; also similar compounds, as कार्य्याब्धि &c.
कार्य्यसागर: कार्य्यसागर m. (-रः) Business, heavy business, weighty affairs. E. कार्य्य, and सागर ocean; also similar compounds, as कार्य्याब्धि &c.
कार्यसाधक: कार्य्यसाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Accomplishing any object. E. कार्य्य, and साधक what compleats.
कार्य्यसाधक: कार्य्यसाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Accomplishing any object. E. कार्य्य, and साधक what compleats.
कार्य्यसाधन: कार्य्यसाधन n. (-नं) Means of effecting any object, instrument, implement, aid. E. कार्य्य, and साधन means.
कार्यसिद्धि: कार्य्यसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Accomplishment, success, fulfilment of any object or purpose. E. कार्य्य, and सिद्धि success.
कार्य्यसिद्धि: कार्य्यसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Accomplishment, success, fulfilment of any object or purpose. E. कार्य्य, and सिद्धि success.
कार्यहन्तृ: कार्य्यहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Foiling, counteracting, opposing all one's aims. E. कार्य्य, and हन्तृ who destroys.
कार्य्यहन्तृ: कार्य्यहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Foiling, counteracting, opposing all one's aims. E. कार्य्य, and हन्तृ who destroys.
कार्याक्षम: कार्य्याक्षम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Unfit, incompetent, unable. E. काय्य, and अक्षम unable.
कार्य्याक्षम: कार्य्याक्षम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Unfit, incompetent, unable. E. काय्य, and अक्षम unable.
कार्यान्त: कार्य्यान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a business. E. कार्य्य, and अन्त end.
कार्य्यान्त: कार्य्यान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a business. E. कार्य्य, and अन्त end.
कार्यार्थ: कार्य्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 An object or purpose. 2 Application for employment. n. or ad. (-र्थं) 1 For the sake of any particular object. 2 To perform any work or duty. E. कार्य्य, and अर्थ object.
कार्य्यार्थ: कार्य्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 An object or purpose. 2 Application for employment. n. or ad. (-र्थं) 1 For the sake of any particular object. 2 To perform any work or duty. E. कार्य्य, and अर्थ object.
कार्यार्थसिद्धि: कार्य्यार्थसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) The accomplishment of any object or purpose. E. कार्य्यार्थ, and सिद्धि fulfilment.
कार्य्यार्थसिद्धि: कार्य्यार्थसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) The accomplishment of any object or purpose. E. कार्य्यार्थ, and सिद्धि fulfilment.
कार्यार्थिन्: कार्य्यार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 Having an object or purpose. 2 Applying for employment. E. कार्य्यार्थ, and इनि aff.
कार्य्यार्थिन्: कार्य्यार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 Having an object or purpose. 2 Applying for employment. E. कार्य्यार्थ, and इनि aff.
कार्यिक: कार्य्यिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having business, transacting business. 2 Seeking employment, &c. 3 Engaged in a suit at law. E. कार्य्य, and ठक् aff.
कार्य्यिक: कार्य्यिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having business, transacting business. 2 Seeking employment, &c. 3 Engaged in a suit at law. E. कार्य्य, and ठक् aff.
कार्यिन्: कार्य्यिन् mfn. (-र्य्यी-र्य्यिनी-र्य्यि) 1 Seeking for employment. 2 One who transacts business, active, assiduous. 3 Having an object. 4 A party to a suit, either as plaintiff or defendant. 5 Requiring an affix, &c. E. कार्य्य, and इनि aff.
कार्य्यिन्: कार्य्यिन् mfn. (-र्य्यी-र्य्यिनी-र्य्यि) 1 Seeking for employment. 2 One who transacts business, active, assiduous. 3 Having an object. 4 A party to a suit, either as plaintiff or defendant. 5 Requiring an affix, &c. E. कार्य्य, and इनि aff.
कार्येक्षण: कार्य्येक्षण n. (-णं) Superintendence of public affairs, &c. E. कार्य्य, and ईक्षण seeing.
कार्य्येक्षण: कार्य्येक्षण n. (-णं) Superintendence of public affairs, &c. E. कार्य्य, and ईक्षण seeing.
कार्य्योद्धार: कार्य्योद्धार m. (-रः) Discharge of any duty, performance of any act. E. कार्य्य, and उद्धार extrication.
काय्याद्युक्त: काय्याद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Engaged in any business, intent upon any object. E. कार्य्य, and उद्युक्त active.
कार्योद्योग: कार्य्योद्योग m. (-गः) Active engagement in any business. E. कार्य्य, and उद्योग exertion.
कार्य्योद्योग: कार्य्योद्योग m. (-गः) Active engagement in any business. E. कार्य्य, and उद्योग exertion.
कार्शनव: कार्शनव mfn. (-बः-वी-वं) Fiery, hot, glaring, relating to fire. E. कृशानु fire, अण् aff.
कार्श्य: कार्श्य m. (-र्श्यः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta:) see कार्श्य. n. (-र्ष्यं) Thinness, emaciation. E. कृश thin, ष्यञ् aff.
कार्श्मरी: कार्श्मरी f. (-री) A plant, commonly Gambhari: see काश्मरा.
कार्षक: कार्षक m. (-कः) A husbandman. E. कृष to draw furrows, क्वुन् Uṇādi affix, and the vowel made long.
कार्षापण: कार्षापण mn. (-णः-णं) A weight or measure of different values, as synonymous with Karṣa; it is of gold, weighing sixteen Māṣas, or about 176 grains; of silver, it is in value sixteen Paṇas of kowries, or in tale 1280 commonly termed a Kāhan: of copper it weighs eighty Rattis, or the same as of gold, about 176 grains; according to some, it is the same as a Pan of kowries, or in tale eighty. n. (-णं) Money, gold and silver. m. (-णः) A husbandman. E. कर्ष a Karṣa of silver, आपण custom, habit, and the vowel of कर्ष lengthened; also with कन् added कार्षापणकः see कर्षपण and कार्षिक.
कार्षापणवर: कार्षापणवर n. (-रः) The Karṣa of the lowest value. E. कार्षापण, and अवर low.
कार्षापणिक: कार्षापणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought, &c. with a Karṣa. E. कार्षापण, and टिठन् aff.
कार्षि: कार्षि f. (-र्षिः) 1 Ploughing, cultivation. 2 Drawing, attracting. E. कृष to draw, इन affix, and the vowel made long.
कार्षिक: कार्षिक m. (-कः) 1 A weight: see the preceding. 2 A husbandman. E. कर्ष a measure, ploughing, &c. and ठञ् aff.
कार्ष्ण: कार्ष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-र्ष्णी-र्ष्णं) 1 Black. 2 Of or belonging to the black antelope. m. (-र्ष्णः) The black antelope. E. कृष्ण, and अण् aff.
कार्ष्णायस: कार्ष्णायस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Made of black iron. E. कृष्णायस, and अण् aff.
कार्ष्णि: कार्ष्णि m. (-र्ष्णिः) A name of KĀMADEVA. E. कृष्ण the deity KṚṢṆA, and इञ् affix; the son of KṚṢṆA.
कार्ष्य: कार्ष्य m. (-र्ष्यः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. कृष to make furrows, ष्यञ् aff.
कार्ष्यवण: कार्ष्यवण n. (-णं) A forest of Śāl trees. E. कार्ष्य, and वन a wood, the final changed.
काल: काल r. 10th cl. (कालयति) To count time.

काल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Black, of a dark colour, dark blue especially, which is usually confounded with black. m. (-लः) 1 Time. 2 A name of YAMA, regent of the dead. 3 A black colour. 4 Death. 5 A form of ŚIVA. 6 The planet Saturn. 7 The Koïl. 8 Cassia fistula. 9 Resin. 10 A plant, a red kind of plumbago. n. (-लं) 1 Iron. 2 A black agallochum: see कालीयक. 3 A vegetable poison, perhaps the fruit of the Cocculus Indicus. f. (-ला) 1 Indigo, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 A black sort of Tëori. 5 Calonji, (Nigella Indica.) 4 Madder, (Rubia manjith.) (-ला or -ली) A name of the goddess DURGĀ the wife of ŚIVA. (-ली) 1 The wife of ŚANTANU a king. 2 One of the Mātṛs or divine mothers. 3 A female deity of the Bauddhas. 4 A row or succession of clouds. 5 Ink or blacking. 6 A worm or animalcule generated in the acetous fermentation of milk. 7 Abuse, censure, defamation. 8 Night. 9 Trumpet flower. (Bignonia suave-olens.) 10 One of the seven tongues or flames of fire. E. कल to count or reckon, &c. in the causal form, अच affix, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
कालक: कालक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Black, dark coloured. m. (-कः) 1 A freckle, a mark. 2 A water snake. f. (-का) The mother of a class of Asuras. n. (-कं) The liver. E. कल to reckon, (good or bad fortune,) वुञ् affix; or काल black, and कन् aff.
कालकण्ठ: कालकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A water fowl, a gallinule. 3 A sparrow. 4 A peacock. 5 A wagtail. 6 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa:) see असन. E. काल black, and कण्ट the throat.
कालकण्ठक: कालकण्ठक m. (-कः) A gallinule. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कालकचु: कालकचु f. (-चुः) A sort of Arum, (A. colocasia.) E. काल black, and कचु Arum.
कालकर्णिका: कालकर्णिका f. (-का) Misfortune, misery; also कालकर्णी.
कालकलाय: कालकलाय m. (-यः) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus max.) E. काल black, कलाय pulse.
कालकरण: कालकरण n. (-णं) Appointing a time. E. काल, and करण making.
कालकल्प: कालकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Like death, fatal, deadly. E. काल, and कल्प like.
कालकस्तूरी: कालकस्तूरी f. (-री) A plant, (Hibiscus abelmoschus.) E. काल black, and कस्तूरी musk; the seeds having a smell of musk when rubbed.
कालकारित: कालकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Effected or brought about by or in time. E. काल, and कारित occasioned.
कालकील: कालकील m. (-लः) A confused or mingled sound, a tumult; also कालकीलक m. (-कः)
कालकुण्ठ: कालकुण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A name of YAMA. E. काल time, and कुण्ठ confusing, distressing.
कालकुष्ठ: कालकुष्ठ m. (-ष्ठं) A sort of earth from the mountains.
कालकूट: कालकूट mn. (-टः-टं) A kind of poison. E. काल YAMA, कूठ to destroy, अप् affix; destroying even the regent of death.
कालकूटङ्कट: कालकूटङ्कट m. (-टः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कालकूट poison, and कट who takes.
कालकृत्: कालकृत् m. (-कृत्) The sun. E. काल time, and कृत् who makes; who marks the time; also कालकृत.
कालकृत: कालकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fixed, appointed, (as to time.) 2 Lent or deposited by a giver. 3 Produced or effected by time. m. (-तः) 1 The sun: see the preceding. 2 Time. E. काल, and कृत done.
कालक्षेप: कालक्षेप m. (-पः) Spending or passing time. E. काल, and क्षेप throwing away; also कालक्षेपन्.
कालखञ्जन: कालखञ्जन n. (-नं) The liver. E. काल black, and खजि to go, युच् aff.
कालखण्ड: कालखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The liver. E. काल black, and स्वण्ट part.
कालगन्ध: कालगन्ध m. न्धः) Kind of Cobra de copella: see अलगर्द.
कालग्रन्थि: कालग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A year. E. काल time, and ग्रन्थि a knot or joint.
कालचक्र: कालचक्र n. (-क्रं) 1 A cycle, a given revolution of time. 2 A period according to the Jainas, of twelve Aras: see अर.
कालञ्जर: कालञ्जर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The name of a rock in Bundelkhand, the modern Kallinjer. 3 The adjacent country  An assembly or collection of religious mendicants; Kallinjer is one of the places at which such assemblies meet, being enumerated in the Vedas amongst the Tapasyasthānas, or spots adapted to practices of austere devotion. f. (-रा or -री) An appellation of DURGĀ. E. काल in the second case, time or death, and जर who makes old, or causes to decay; irregularly deduced from the causal of जॄ to become old.
कालज्ञ: कालज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who knows times or seasons. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 An astrologer. 2 A cock. E. काल, and ज्ञ who knows.
कालदण्ड: कालदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The staff of death, death. E. काल, and दण्ड staff.
कालधर्म: कालधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Death, dying. 2 Influence of time, seasonableness, effects proper to the time or season. E. काल time, and धर्म्म virtue, property.
कालधर्म्म: कालधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Death, dying. 2 Influence of time, seasonableness, effects proper to the time or season. E. काल time, and धर्म्म virtue, property.
कालनियोग: कालनियोग m. (-गः) Fate, destiny. E. काल, and नियोग will.
कालनिर्यास: कालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) A fragrant and resinous substance, Bdellium: see गुग्गुल. E. काल black, and निर्य्यास an extract.
कालनिर्य्यास: कालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) A fragrant and resinous substance, Bdellium: see गुग्गुल. E. काल black, and निर्य्यास an extract.
कालनेमि: कालनेमि m. (-मिः) 1 A demon, the son of HIRAṆYAKAŚIPU. 2 A Rākṣasa described in the Rāmāyaṇa.
कालनेमिन्: कालनेमिन् m. (-मी) A demon: see कालनेमि.
कालनेमिरिपु: कालनेमिरिपु m. (-पुः) An epithet of KṚṢṆA. E. कालनेमि the name of a demon who undertook to destroy the deity in his youth, and रिपु the foe: see similar names.
कालनेमिहन्: कालनेमिहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU: see the preceding. E. कालनेमि, and हन who kills or destroys.
कालनेम्यरि: कालनेम्यरि m. (-रिः) See कालनेमिरिपु. E. as above, अरि a foe.
कालपक्व: कालपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Spontaneously ripened. E. काल, and पक्व matured.
कालपर्ण: कालपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A tree bearing dark coloured leaves, (Tabernae montana coronaria,) commonly Tagara: see तगर. E. काल black, and पर्ण a leaf.
कालपरिवास: कालपरिवास m. (-सः) Standing for a time, (as to get stale or fermented, &c.) E. काल, and परिवास abiding.
कालपाश: कालपाश m. (-शः) The noose of YAMA or death. E. काल, and पाश a noose.
कालपुरुष: कालपुरुष m. (-षः) 1 One of YAMA'S attendants or ministers. 2 An astrological figure of a man, with the positions of the constellations, &c. inscribed on different parts of the body for the purpose of predicting his fortunes; also कालनर, &c. E. काल black, and पुरुष a man.
कालपृष्ठ: कालपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) 1 The bow of KARṆA. 2 A bow in general. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 The black antelope. 2 A heron. E. काल black, and पृष्ठ the back; black-backed.
कालप्रभात: कालप्रभात n. (-तं) The sultry season, autumn, the two months following the rainy season. E. काल time, and प्रभात shining.
कालप्ररूढ: कालप्ररूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Over-blown, over-ripe. E. काल, and प्ररूढ blown.
कालबलन: कालबलन m. (-नः) Armour, mail. E. काल death, and बलन strengthening, defending; perhaps a wrong reading for कायबलन, q. v.
कालमान: कालमान m. (-नः) Black Tulasi; also read कालमाल.
कालमेशिका: कालमेशिका f. (-का) 1 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) 2 A black sort of Tëori, a plant so called, a species of convolvulus: see कालमेषिका.
कालमेषिका: कालमेषिका f. (-का) 1 Bengal madder. 2 Black Tëori: see त्रिवृता. E. काल black, मिष to possess, अन् and ङीष् affixes, and कन् added; or without this affix, कालमेषी; also being derived from मिश to sound, कालमेशिका and कालमेशी.
कालमेषी: कालमेषी f. (-षी) 1 A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) 2 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith:) see the preceding.
कालयवन: कालयवन m. (-नः) An Asura, an enemy of KṚṢṆA, destroyed by him by stratagem. E. काल black, यवन a Yavana.
कालयाप: कालयाप m. (-पः) 1 Procrastination, putting off, delaying. 2 Passing away time. E. काल, and या to go, causal form, घञ् affix; also with ल्युट्, कालयापनं; also यापः and यापनं.
कालरात्रि: कालरात्रि m. (-त्रिः) 1 A particular night, one which occurs on the 7th day of the 7th month of every 77th year; after such a period of life, a man is exempt from attention to the usual ordinances. 2 The last night of a Kalpa. 3 A dark night. 4 A form of Śakti or DURGĀ. E. काल black, time, and रात्रि a night: see भीमरथी.
काललवण: काललवण n. (-णं) A factitious and purgative salt, commonly Bitlaven or Bitnoben. E. काल black, and लवण salt.
काललोह: काललोह n. (-हं) Iron. E. काल black, and लौह a metal.
कालवृक्ष: कालवृक्ष (-क्षः) A kind of vetch: see कलिवृन्त. E. काल black, वृक्ष tree.
कालवृद्धि: कालवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Periodical interest, payable, monthly, &c. E. काल, and वृद्धि interest.
कालवृन्त: कालवृन्त m. (-न्तः) A kind of vetch, (Dolichos biflorus.) f. (-न्ती) Trumpet flower. E. काल black, and वृन्त stalk: see कुलत्थ.
कालवेला: कालवेला f. (-ला) A season at which any act is improper, half a. watch in every day. E. काल and बेला time.
कालशाक: कालशाक n. (-कं) A sort of potherb. E. काल black, शाक a potherb.
कालशेय: कालशेय n. (-यं) Buttermilk. E. कलशी a jar, and ढक् affix; produced in a jar or pitcher by churning; also कालसेय.
कालसंरोध: कालसंरोध m. (-धः) Lapse of a long period of time. E. काल time, संरोध impediment.
कालसदृश: कालसदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 1 Opportune, seasonable. 2 Deathlike. E. काल and सदृश like.
कालसम्पन्न: कालसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Dated, bearing a date. 2 Effected by time. E. काल, and सम्पन्न produced.
कालसर्प: कालसर्प m. (-र्पः) The black and most deadly variety of the cobra, (Coluber naga.) E. कास्त black, and सर्प a serpent.
कालसार: कालसार m. (-रः) The black antelope. n. (-रं) A sort of Sandal. E. काल black, and सार essence.
कालसूत्र: कालसूत्र n. (-त्रं) One of the twenty-one hells. E. काल from कल to count, a reckoning, and सूत्र a thread, a rule; also with कन added कालसूत्रक.
कालस्कन्ध: कालस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 A sort of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon, Rox.) 2 The Tamāla, a tree bearing dark blossoms. 3 Another plant: see जीवक. 4 The glomerous fig tree. E. काल black and स्कन्ध the trunk of a tree.
कालाकृष्ट: कालाकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Led to death or destruction, drawn to or by one's fate. 2 Produced or brought about by time. E. काल, and आकृष्ट attracted.
कालाक्षरिक: कालाक्षरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A scholar, a pupil. E. काल time, अक्षर a letter, and ठक् aff.
कालागुरु: कालागुरु n. (-रुः) A black kind of aloe wood or agallochum: see अगुरु. E. काल black, and अगुरु agallochum.
कालाग्नि: कालाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The fire that is to destroy the world. E. काल, and अग्नि fire.
कालाञ्जनी: कालाञ्जनी f. (-नी) A small shrub, used as a purgative.
कालात्यय: कालात्यय m. (-यः) Loss or destruction by lapse of time. E. काल, and अत्यय destruction.
कालानुनादिन्: कालानुनादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A large black bee. 2 A sparrow. 3 The francoline partridge. E. काल season, and अनुनादिन् who sings or sounds.
कालानुसारक: कालानुसारक n. (-कं) 1 A tree, commonly Tagara. 2 Yellow Sandal. E. काल, and अनुसार being like or conforming to.
कालानुसारि: कालानुसारि m. (-रिः) 1 Benzoin or benjamin. E. काल black, अनुसार resembling, being, and कि affix; also कालानुसार्य्य the affix being यत्.
कालानुसार्य: कालानुसार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Gum benjamin or benzoin. 2 A yellow fragrant wood from which a perfume is prepared. 3 A timber tree, commonly Sisu: see शिंशपा. 4 A tree, commonly Tagara. E. see the preceding; also with कन्, added कालानुसार्य्यक.
कालानुसार्य्य: कालानुसार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Gum benjamin or benzoin. 2 A yellow fragrant wood from which a perfume is prepared. 3 A timber tree, commonly Sisu: see शिंशपा. 4 A tree, commonly Tagara. E. see the preceding; also with कन्, added कालानुसार्य्यक.
कालान्तक: कालान्तक m. (-कः) YAMA, death. E. काल, and अन्तक destroyer.
कालान्तर: कालान्तर n. (-रं) 1 Interval, intermediate time. 2 Period, process of time. 2 A former or another time. E. काल, and अन्तर between, &c.
कालान्तरविष: कालान्तरविष m. (-षः) A poisonous animal, venomous only when enraged or alarmed, as a rat, &c. E. काल time, अन्तर after or at, and विष poison; having venom only at times.
कालान्तरावृत्त: कालान्तरावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Hidden or concealed by time. E. कालान्तर, and आवृत्त covered.
कालाप: कालाप m. (-पः) 1 A serpent's hood. 2 A demon, an imp or goblin. 3 A student of the Kalāpa grammar. E. कलाप, and अण aff.
कालायस: कालायस n. (-सं) Iron. E. काल, and अयस् iron, टच aff.
कालावधि: कालावधि m. (-धिः) A fixed or appointed time. E. काल, and अवधि limit.
कालाशौच: कालाशौच n. (-चं) Season of mourning or impurity. E. काल, and अशौच impurity.
कालिक: कालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to time. 2 Seasonable. 3 Of long standing. 4 Of a dark colour, black, blackish, &c. m. (-कः) The curlew. n. (-कं) A black kind of Sandal: see कालीयक. f. (-का) 1 Cloudiness, a multitude or succession of clouds. 2 A dark cloud threatening rain. 3 A fog or mist, &c. 4 The goddess GAURĪ. 5 A terrific goddess, a form of CAṆḌĪ or DURGĀ. 6 A female singer of Svarga. 7 Blackness, a black colour. 8 A fault or flaw in gold, &c. 9 Spirituous liquor. 10 A plant: see वृश्चिकपत्र. 11 A kind of potherb. 12 The branch of a cucumber plant. 13 Spikenard. 14 A line of hair extending to the navel. 15 A female crow. 16 Price of a commodity on credit, or a price to be paid at a fixed period, or by instalments. 17 Periodical interest paid by the month, &c. 18 An animalcule formed by the fermentation of milk. 19 Ink or blacking. 20 A small bird, commonly Śyāma. 21 A medicinal plant: see काकोलि. E. काल black, &c. ठक् or कन् affix.
कालिकता: कालिकता f. (-ता) Time, date, season. E. कालिक, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कालिकत्वं.
कालिङ्ग: कालिङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Produced in or belonging to the Kaliṅga country. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 An elephant. 2 A snake. 3 A species of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) 4 A sort of iron. f. (-ङ्गी) A gourd or cucumber. n. (-ङ्गं) The water melon. E. कलिङ्ग a country, and अण् aff.
कालिदास: कालिदास m. (-सः) The name of a celebrated poet, author of Śakuntalā, Vikramorvaśī, the Megha Dūta, the Raghu Vaṃśa, the Nalodaya and other poems: he was one of nine poets or gems of VIKRAMĀDITYA'S court, and is supposed to have flourished in the century preceding the Christian aera; the name is however applied to more persons than one, and seems, in some measure, to have been used as an honorary title; the works attributed to this author are amongst the most elegant compositions in the Sanskrit language. E. काली the goddess DURGĀ, and दास a slave, the final of काली being made short.
कालिदासक: कालिदासक m. (-कः) The poet KĀLIDĀSA: see the preceding. E. कन् added to कालिदास.
कालिनी: कालिनी f. (-नी) One of the lunar mansions: see आर्द्रा. E. काल time, affixes इनि and ङीष्.
कालिन्दी: कालिन्दी f. (-न्दी) The YAMUNĀ or JUMNA river. E. कलिन्द a mountain, part of the Himāla range, and the seat of the river's source, अण् aff.
कालिन्दीकर्षण: कालिन्दीकर्षण m. (-णः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. कालिन्दी the YAMUNĀ, and कर्षण the plougher; having diverted the stream into a new and devious channel, marked out by his ploughshare.
कालिन्दीभेदन: कालिन्दीभेदन m. (-नः) BALARĀMA. E. कालिन्दी, and भिद् to break, affix ल्युट्: see the preceding word.
कालिन्दीसू: कालिन्दीसू f. (-सूः) The wife of SŪRYA and mother of YAMUNĀ the personified river. E. कालिन्दी, and सू who bears, from सू to bear children, and क्विप् aff.
कालिन्दीसोदर: कालिन्दीसोदर m. (-रः) YAMA. E. कालिन्दी, and सोदर brother.
कालिमन्: कालिमन् m. (-मा) Blackness. E. काल black, इमनिच् aff.
कालिय: कालिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to time, &c. m. (-यः) A serpent destroyed by KṚṢṆA. E. काल, and घ aff.
कालीक: कालीक m. (-कः) A curlew, a sort of heron: see कालिक.
कालीची: कालीची f. (-ची) The court of judgment of YAMA, regent and judge of the dead.
कालीतनय: कालीतनय m. (-यः) A buffalo. E. काली the goddess, and तनय a son: i. e. a favourite.
कालीन: कालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Timely, seasonable, relating to time. E. काल, and ख aff.
कालीय: कालीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to time, to blackness, &c. n. (-यं) A dark kind of Sandal, or perhaps of Agallochum: see कालीयक. E. काल black, and छः aff.
कालीयक: कालीयक n. (-कं) 1 A yellow fragrant wood, perhaps a species of aloe wood. 2 A dark kind of Sandal wood. m. (-कः) A species of turmeric, (Curcuma zanthorhiza:) see दारुहरिद्रा. E. कन् added to the last, of a black or blackish hue; also कालीय, कालेय, &c.
कालुष्य: कालुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Foulness, dirtiness, turbidness, opacity. E. कालष, and यञ् aff.
कालेय: कालेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Belonging to the Kali age, &c. 2 Dark coloured. n. (-यं) 1 A yellow fragrant wood: see कालीयक and कालीयक. 2 The liver. m. (-यः) The name of a demon or imp. E. काल or कलि, and ढक् affix.
कालेयक: कालेयक m. (-कः) A sort of curcuma, (C. zanthorhiza, Rox.) see कालीयक. n. (-कं) A yellow fragrant wood. E. कन् added to the preceding word.
कालोत्पादित: कालोत्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Produced in due season. E. काल, उत्पादित engendered.
कालोप्त: कालोप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sown in due season. E. काल, and उप्त sown.
काल्प: काल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पी-ल्पं) 1 Preceptive, ritual. 2 Relating to a Kalpa or period so called. m. (-ल्पः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) E. कल्प a precept, and अण् affix; the plant forms a part of oblations offered upon certain occasions to fire; also with कन् added काल्यक.
काल्पक: काल्पक m. (-कः) Zedoary: see the preceding; also काल्यक.
काल्पनिक: काल्पनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Artificial, fabricated. 2 Fictitious, invented. E. कल्पना, and ठक् aff.
काल्य: काल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Timely, seasonable. n. (-ल्यं) Dawn, daybreak, see कल्य. f. (-ल्या) 1 A cow fit for the bull. 2 Pleasant or auspicious discourse: see कल्या. E. काल time, and यत् aff.
काल्याणिनेय: काल्याणिनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sprung from a virtuous or fortunate woman. E. कल्याणी, and ढक् affix, इनञ् inserted.
कावचिक: कावचिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to armour, armorial. n. (-कं) A multitude of men in armour. E. कवच armour, and ठञ् aff.
कावरुक: कावरुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fearful, henpecked. m. (-कः) An owl.
कावाद: कावाद m. (-दः) Indistinct sound. E. का for कु bad, वाद speech.
कावार: कावार n. (-रं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) f. (-री) An umbrella, a Catta, especially one without a stick, and worn like a broad brimmed hat. E. क the head, and आबार what covers or protects, from वृ to skreen, and घञ् aff.
कावृक: कावृक m. (-कः) 1 A gallinaceous fowl. 2 The ruddy goose. 3 A small singing bird, (Loxia philippensis:) see पीतमस्तक. E. क water, or क for कु bad, आङ्, before वृ to cover, and कक् aff.
कावेर: कावेर n. (-रं) Saffron, (Crocus sativus.) f. (-री) 1 A river in the Dekhin, the Kāverī. 2 A courtezan, a harlot. 3 Turmeric. E. कव to colour, एरक affix, and the radical vowel made long, fem. affix ङीष्.
काव्य: काव्य m. (-व्यः) A name of ŚUKRĀCĀRYA, the preceptor of the demons. f. (-व्या) 1 Understanding, intelligence. 2 A female fiend: see पूतना. 3 A Pitṛ of a particular order, the son of KAVI or ŚUKRA. n. (-व्यं) A poem, poetical composition. E. कवि a poet, &c. ञ्यत् derivative or pleonastic aff.
काव्यचौर: काव्यचौर m. (-रः) A plagiarist. E. काव्य a poem, and चौर a thief.
काश: काश (ऋ) काशृ r. 1st cl. (काशते) also (उ, ऋ) (उकाशृ) r. 4th cl. (काश्यते) 1 To shine. With निर् prefixed, To expel, 2 To hide or obscure; with प्र, To make or become manifest.

काश m. (-शः) 1 Cough, catarrh: see कास. 2 Sneezing. n. (-शं) 1 A species of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 2 Irritation in the throat. f. (-शी) Kāśi or Benares, the holy city so called. (-शी or -शा) Saccharum spontaneum, as above. E. कश to sound, in the causal form, अच् affix; or काश to shine, अच्, and ङीष् fem. aff.
काशक: काशक m. (-कः) A species of long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
काशाल्मलि: काशाल्मलि f. (-लिः) A kind of silk cotton tree. E. का bad, inferior, and शाल्मलि the Simul tree.
काशि: काशि f. (-शिः) Kāśi, a celebrated city and place of pilgrimage, the modern Benares. E. काश to shine, to be beautiful or renowned, and इन् Uṇādi affix; also काशीः see काश and काशिका, काशिकी.
काशिका: काशिका f. (-का) Kāśi or Benares: see the preceding.
काशिकाप्रिय: काशिकाप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of DHANVANTARI, as king of Benares. E. काशिका the city Kāśi, and प्रिय a friend; also काशिराज.
काशिन्: काशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 Having a cold or cough. 2 Shining, brilliant. E. काश cough, and इनि affix, or काश to shine, णिनि aff.
काशिराज: काशिराज m. (-जः) A name of DHANVANTARI or DIVODĀSA, a king of Benares, and an author of medical works; he is often confounded with his celestial namesake, the physician of the gods. E. काशि the city, and राज a king or ruler; also काशीराज.
काशिल: काशिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Made of kās grass, abounding with it, &c. E. काश, and इल aff.
काशीनाथ: काशीनाथ m. (-थः) A name of ŚIVA. E. काशी Kāśi or Benares, and नाथ lord or master.
काशीश: काशीश m. (-शः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 DIVODĀSA, or any king of Benares. n. (-शं) Sulphate of iron. E. काशी, and ईश lord.
काशूकार: काशूकार m. (-रः) The betel nut tree.
काश्मरी: काश्मरी f. (-री) A plant, commonly Gambhāri, (Gmelina arborea, Rox.) see गम्भारी. E. काश to shine, and अर affix, formative irr.; also कार्श्मरी and काश्मर्य्य.
काश्मर्य: काश्मर्य्य mn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्यं) Gambhāri, a plant: see the preceding. E. यत् added to काश्मरी.
काश्मर्य्य: काश्मर्य्य mn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्यं) Gambhāri, a plant: see the preceding. E. यत् added to काश्मरी.
काश्मीर: काश्मीर n. (-रं) 1 A plant with a tuberous root, a sort of costus, (Costus speciosus.) 2 A country, Kashmir, or in the plu. (-राः) its inhabitants. f. (-री) A tree, (Ficus elastica.) E. कश्मीर Kashmir, and अण् affix; produced in that place.
काश्मीरज: काश्मीरज n. (-जं) 1 A costus. 2 Saffron: see कश्मीर. f. (-जः) Atis or Betula: see अतिबिषा. E. काश्मीर and ज born; produced in Kashmir.
काश्मीरजन्मन्: काश्मीरजन्मन् n. (-न्म) Saffron. E. काश्मीर, and जन्मन् birth; produced in Kashmir.
काश्यप: काश्यप m. (-पः) 1 The name of a saint; also called KAṆĀDA, the son of KAŚYAPA. 2 A name of ARUṆA: see the next. 3 A sort of deer. 4 A tribe of Brahmans pretending to descend from KAŚYAPA. E. कश्यप a saint, and अण् affix of descent. n. (-पं) Flesh. E. काश्य spirituous liquor, and प from पा to drink or cherish.
काश्यपि: काश्यपि m. (-पिः) 1 A name of ARUṆA. 2 A name of GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU. E. कश्यप the saint, and इञ् affix of descent, being both sons of KAŚYAPA. f. (-पी) The earth. E. as before; alluding to a legend from the Purāṇas, in which PARAŚURĀMA, after the destruction of the Kṣatriya race, and performance of an Aśvamedha, presented the sovereignty of the world to his Guru, KAŚYAPA.
काश्यपेय: काश्यपेय m. (-यः) The sun. E. कश्यप the saint, and ढक् affix of descent, the son of KAŚYAPA.
काश्वरी: काश्वरी f. (-री) A plant: see काश्मरी.
काषाय: काषाय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Red, dyed of a reddish colour. E. कषाय, and अण् aff.
काष्ठ: काष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Wood. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 A quarter or region of the world, space, tract. 2 Place, site. 3 Limit, boundary. 4 A measure of time, the thirtieth part of a Kalā, or eighteen twinklings of the eye. 5 Excellence, superiority. 6 A plant, (Curcuma zanthorhiza, Rox.) E. काश to shine, Uṇādi affix क्यन्, श changed to ष, and थ after ष becomes ठ.
काष्ठक: काष्ठक n. (-कं) Aloe wood or agallochum. E. कन् added to काष्ठ wood.
काष्ठकदली: काष्ठकदली f. (-ली) The wild plantain. E. काष्ठ, and कदली a plantain; the fruit being hard and woody.
काष्ठकीट: काष्ठकीट m. (-टः) A small insect or worm found in decayed wood. E. काष्ठ wood, and कीट a worm.
काष्ठकुट्ट: काष्ठकुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A bird, a sort of woodpecker, (Picus Bengalensis.) E. काष्ठ, and कुट्ट to cut, अच् aff.
काष्ठकुद्दाल: काष्ठकुद्दाल m. (-लः) A kind of wooden shovel or scraper used for baling water out of a boat, or for scraping and cleaning its bottom, &c. E. काष्ठ wood, and कुद्दाल shovel; also with the first vowel long कूद्दाल, काष्ठकूद्दाल.
काष्ठखण्ड: काष्ठखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A stick, a spar, a piece of wood. E. काष्ठ, and खण्ड piece.
काष्ठतक्ष्: काष्ठतक्ष् m. (-ट्) A carpenter. E. काष्ठ wood, and तक्ष to cut or pare, affix क्विप्.
काष्ठतक्षक: काष्ठतक्षक m. (-कः) A carpenter: see the preceding. E. as before, वुन् aff.
काष्ठतन्तु: काष्ठतन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A small worm that is found in timber. E. काष्ठ wood, and तन्तु what spreads, from तन with तुन् aff.
काष्ठदारु: काष्ठदारु m. (-रुः) The Deodar tree, (Uvaria longifolia.)
काष्ठद्रु: काष्ठद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. काष्ठ, and द्रु a tree.
काष्ठमठी: काष्ठमठी f. (-ठी) A funeral pile. E. काष्ठ wood, and मठी a pile, an edifice.
काष्ठमय: काष्ठमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Wooden, made of wood. E. काष्ठ and मयट् aff.
काष्ठमल्ल: काष्ठमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A bier, a plank, &c. on which dead bodies are carried. E. काष्ठ wood, and मल्ल a vessel.
काष्ठलेखक: काष्ठलेखक m. (-कः) A small worm found in wood. E. काष्ठ, and लेखक who writes or inscribes.
काष्ठलोहिन्: काष्ठलोहिन् m. (-ही) A club, a short cudgel, especially if armed with iron. E. काष्ठ, लौह iron, and इनि aff.
काष्ठवत्: काष्ठवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having wood for fuel, &c. ind. Like a piece of wood. E. काष्ठ, and मतुप् or वति aff.
काष्ठागार: काष्ठागार m. (-रः) A wooden house or enclosure. E. काष्ठ, and आगार a house.
काष्ठाम्बुवाहिनी: काष्ठाम्बुवाहिनी f. (-नी) A wooden bucket or baling vessel: see अम्बुवाहिनी.
काष्ठिन्: काष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) 1 Of wood, wooden. 2 Having wood. E. काष्ठ, and इनि aff.
काष्ठीला: काष्ठीला m. (-ला) A large kind of Colotropis. f. (-ला) A plantain: see रम्भा. E. का for कु small, अस्थि bone or stalk, and ला to get or possess; क and टाप् affix; having a stem which is good for nothing.
कास: कास r. 1st cl. (ऋ) कासृ (कासते) 1 To make a bad sound, or one indicating disease; to cough. 2 To shine: see काश.

कास m. (-सः) 1 Cough, catarrh. 2 A species of reed or long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 3 Morunga, (Hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन. E. कास to cough, to make an unpleasant sound, अच् affix; also काश to shine, &c. see काश.
कासकुण्ठ: कासकुण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) Afflicted with cough. m. (-ण्ठः) YAMA.
कासघ्न: कासघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing or alleviating cough, pectoral. f. (-घ्नी) A sort of prickly nightshade: see कण्ठकारी. E. कास catarrh, and घ्न from हन् to kill, removing cough.
कासनाशिनी: कासनाशिनी f. (-नी) A thorny plant: see कर्कटशृङ्गी. E. कास catarrh, and नाशिनी removing, remedying.
कासमर्द: कासमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 A plant, (Cassia or Senna esculenta.) 2 An acid preparation, a mixture of tamarinds and mustard. E. काश or काश cough, and मर्द्द what destroys; also काशमर्द्द.
कासमर्द्द: कासमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 A plant, (Cassia or Senna esculenta.) 2 An acid preparation, a mixture of tamarinds and mustard. E. काश or काश cough, and मर्द्द what destroys; also काशमर्द्द.
कासमर्दन: कासमर्द्दन m. (-नः) A sort of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
कासमर्द्दन: कासमर्द्दन m. (-नः) A sort of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
कासर: कासर m. (-रः) A buffalo. E. क water, and आङ् prefixed to सृ to go, affix अप्; who frequents water, this animal being partial to marshy places.
कासार: कासार m. (-रः) A pond, a pool. E. क water, सृ to go, आङ् prefix, and घञ् affix, or कास to shine, आरन् Uṇādi aff.
कासारि: कासारि m. (-रिः) A plant, (Cassia esculenta:) see कासमर्द्द. E. कास cough, and अरि a foe.
कासालु: कासालु m. (-लुः) An esculent root, a sort of yam.
कासीस: कासीस n. (-सं) Green vitriol, green sulphate of iron. E. कास to go, ईसण् aff.
कासू: कासू f. (-सूः) 1 Indistinct speech. 2 Speech in general. 3 Understanding. 4 Devotion. 5 Light, lustre. 6 A sort of spear or lance. E. कस to go, to shine, or कास to make a bad sound, क Uṇādi aff.
कासूतरी: कासूतरी f. (-री) A short spear, a javelin. E. कासू, and ष्टरच् diminutive aff.
काहका: काहका f. (-का) A musical instrument: see काहला.
काहल: काहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Dry, withered. 2 Mischievous. 3 Large, excessive. f. (-ली) 1 One of the Apsarasas or courtezans of INDRA'S heaven. 2 The sound of any tube, pipe or musical instrument. (-ला) A young woman. mf. (-लः-ला) A horn, either a cow horn, or an instrument of that shape. m. (-लः) 1 A cock. 2 Sound in general. 3 A cat. n. (-लं) Indistinct speech. adv. Much, excessively. E. क pleasure, the head, &c. हल to plough or divide, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्.
कि: कि r. 3rd cl. (चिकेति) To know: with निर् prefixed, to attain certainly, to ascertain positively.
किंशारु: किंशारु m. (-रुः) 1 The beard of corn. 2 An arrow. 3 A heron. E. किं what, or sometimes, शृ to injure, &c. रुण् Uṇādi aff.
किंशुक: किंशुक m. (-कः) A tree bearing beautiful red blossoms, and hence often alluded to by the poets, (Butea frondosa;) also पलाश. E. किं what, something, शुक a parrot; its red flowers being of the colour of a parrot's beak.
किंशुलुक: किंशुलुक m. (-कः) A species of the Kiṃśuka: see the preceding.
किकि: किकि m. (-किः) A blue jay. E. कि an imitative sound; the word being repeated: or कै to emit a sound, and कि affix; also किकीदीवि, किकी, &c.
किकिदिवि: किकिदिवि m. (-विः) The blue jay. E. किकि an imitative sound, and दिव to play, कि affix; also in other forms किकि, किकिदिव, किकिदीवि, किकीदिवी.
किकीदिव: किकीदिव m. (-वः) See the preceding. E. as before, अच् aff.
किखि: किखि m. (-खिः) A monkey, an ape. f. (-खिः) A small jackal, a fox. E. कु to sound, डिखि aff.
किङ्कर: किङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) A servant. E. किं what or something, and कर who does.
किङ्किणि: किङ्किणि f. (-णिः or -णी) 1 A girdle of small bells, or any tinkling ornament. 2 An acid sort of grape. E. किं some, and किण an imitative sound, affix क, with इन् or ङीष् fem. affix; also with कन् added किङ्किणीका.
किङ्किर: किङ्किर m. (-रः) 1 The Indian cuckoo, the Koïl or Kokila. 2 A large black bee. 3 A horse. 4 KĀMADEVA. f. (-रा) Blood. n. (-रं) The frontal sinus of an elephant. E. किं something, कॄ to scatter, क aff.
किङ्किरात: किङ्किरात m. (-तः) 1 A name of KĀMADEVA. 2 A parrot. 3 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 4 A tree, (Jonesia asoka.) 5 A species of barleria: see भिण्ठी. E. किङ्कर as above, and अत who goes or is.
किङ्किरिन्: किङ्किरिन् m. (-री) A plant, commonly Buïñci, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.)
किञ्च: किञ्च ind. 1 An inceptive or continuative particle, (moreover, further, again.) 3 A particle of comprehension. E. किं what, च and.
किञ्चन: किञ्चन m. (-नः) A species of the Palāśa or Butea frondosa. ind. Somewhat, something.
किञ्चित्: किञ्चित् ind. 1 Something, somewhat. 2 A part, a little. E. किं what, चित to think, affix क्विप्.
किञ्चुलुक: किञ्चुलुक m. (-कः) A worm. E. किञ्चित् a little, and चल to go, or चुल to be high, वुन् affix, deriv. irr.; it is sometimes written किञ्चिलिक.
किञ्ज: किञ्ज n. (-ञ्जं) The filament of a lotus: see किञ्जल्क.
किञ्जल्क: किञ्जल्क m. (-लः) The filament of a lotus: see किञ्जल्क.

किञ्जल्क m. (-ल्कः) The filament of a lotus, great numbers of which surround the pericarp. n. (-ल्कं) The flower of the Mesua ferrea. E. किञ्चित् somewhat, जक to hide or cover, क affix, and the form irr.
किट: किट r. 1st cl. (केटति) 1 To go or approach. 2 To alarm or terrify. 3 To dread, to fear.
किटि: किटि m. (-टिः) A hog. E. किट to go, and कि affix; also किटि.
किटिभ: किटिभ m. (-भः) A bug. E. किटि a hog, भ who resembles, from भा to shine, affix ड.
किट्ट: किट्ट n. (-ट्टं) Excrement, excretion, dirt. E. किट to go, here implying to go out of, (the body, &c.) and क्त aff.
किट्टवर्जित: किट्टवर्जित n. (-तं) Semen virile. E. किट्ट dirt, &c. यर्जित deprived.
किट्टाल: किट्टाल m. (-लः) 1 A copper vessel. 2 Scoria, rust of iron, &c. E. किट्ट dirt, अल to be able, अच् aff.
किण: किण m. (-णः) 1 A wart, a mole. 2 A scar. 3 A corn, a callosity. 4 An insect found in wood.
किणि: किणि f. (-णिः) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्ग. E. किण् a scar, and कि affix; making scars; that is cicatrizing wounds, sores, &c.
किणिही: किणिही f. (-ही) Achyranthes aspera. E. किणि a sore, and ह what removes, fem. affix ङीष्.
किण्व: किण्व mn. (-ण्वः-ण्वं) Ferment, a drug or seed used to produce fermentation, in the manufacture of spirits from sugar, bassia, &c. n. (-ण्वं) Sin. E. कण to sound, &c. क्वन् Uṇādi affix, and the इ irregularly inserted: see कण्व.
कित: कित r. 1st cl. (चिकित्सति) 1 To cure, to administer remedies, to practise physic. 2 To remove, to destroy. 3 To chastise. 4 (Usually with वि prefixed,) To doubt; this root is regular. r. 3rd cl. (चिकेति) To know. r. 10th cl. (केतयति) 1 To dwell. 2 To desire; some authorities make it a regular root of the 1st cl. in these senses, and others deny its admitting of any conjugation.
कितव: कितव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 A gamester, a gambler. 2 A cheat, cheating, fraudulent. 3 Mad, crazy. 4 Mischievous, malicious. m. (-वः) 1 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) 2 A kind of perfume, commonly Rocanā. E. किं what, तव yours, (what is your stake or wager?) he who asks such a question, &c.
किन्तनु: किन्तनु m. (-नुः) An insect described as having eight legs and a very slender body, a species of spider. E. किं for किञ्चित् a little, and तनु the body.
किन्तमाम्: किन्तमाम् ind. Whether, either of any. E. किं, and तरप् with आमु added.
किन्तराम्: किन्तराम् ind. Whether, either of two. E. किं, and तरप् with आमु added.
किन्तु: किन्तु ind. 1 But. 2 Moreover, further. E. A compound particle of किं and तु disjunctive particle.
किन्तुघ्न: किन्तुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) One of the eleven periods called Karaṇas.
किन्धिन्: किन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) A horse: see किल्किन्.
किन्नर: किन्नर m. (-रः) 1 A demigod attached to the service of KUVERA, a celestial quirister or musician. 2 A kind of follower or attendant on a Jina or Jaina saint. f. (-री) A female Kinnara, or chorister. E. किं what, used contemptuously, (what kind of) नर a man: the Kinnara having, with the human figure, the head of a horse.
किन्नरेश: किन्नरेश m. (-शः) A name of KUVERA. E. किन्नर a Kinnara, and ईश master, lord; also other similar compounds, as किन्नरेश्वर.
किन्नु: किन्नु ind. 1 A particle of interrogation, (what?) 2 Doubt, (how, what?) 3 Comparison, (thus, as, like, how much less.) 4 Conjunction, (again, further.) 5 Place, location, and 6 Agency. E. किम्, and नु conjoined.
किम्: किम् ind. (किम् or किं) 1 What, how. 2 Either, or; a particle of doubt or interrogation. 3 A particle of contempt. The relative pronoun. mfn. (-कः-का-किं) What, who, which, expressing, 1 Doubt. 2 Interrogation. 3 Disdain. 4 Reproach, (as  in English, Who are you, &c.) 5 Kind, sort. E. कै to sound, डिमि Uṇādi aff.
किमर्थम्: किमर्थम् ind. What for, wherefore, why. E. किम्, and अर्थ object.
किमु: किमु ind. Either, or, whether, implying doubt or discrimination: see किम्.
किमुत: किमुत ind. 1 Either, or, whether, implying, 2 Doubt or discrimination. 3 Much, exceeding; a particle of magnitude or quantity. 4 An interrogative, how, what, &c. see किम्. E. किम् and the particle उत.
किम्पच: किम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Miserly, avaricious. E. किम् what, (nothing,) पच who cooks.
किम्पचान: किम्पचान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Miserly, niggardly, avaricious. E. किं what, used contemptuously, पच to cook, and शानच् affix, or with अच् only, किम्पचः see मितम्पच, &c.
किम्पाक: किम्पाक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mother-led, infantine, childish. m. (-कः) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Trichosanthes palmata; also Cucumis colocynthus.) E. किं depreciative, and पाक what is ripe or mature.
किम्पुरुष: किम्पुरुष m. (-षः) 1 A heavenly musician: see किन्नर. 2 A division of the universe, one of the nine Khaṇḍas or portions into which the world is divided, and described as the country between the Himācala and Hemakūṭa mountains. 3 A despicable or low man. E. किम् what, contemptuously, and पुरुष a man; also with the first vowel of that word lengthened, किम्पूरुष.
किम्पुरुषेश्वर: किम्पुरुषेश्वर m. (-रः) An epithet of KUVERA: see किन्नरेश.
किम्पूरुष: किम्पूरुष n. (-षं) The division of the world, called by this name: see किम्पुरुष.
किम्भरा: किम्भरा f. (-रा) A kind of perfume, commonly Nali: see नली.
किम्भूत: किम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) or n. only, (-तं) How, in what manner or degree, like what. E. किम्, and भूत become.
किम्वत्: किम्वत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Poor, mean, insignificant. E. किं a little, मतुप् possessive aff.
किम्वदन्ति: किम्वदन्ति f. (-न्तिः) Rumour, report. E. किम् what, वद to say, and झिच् Uṇādi affix, or with झच् and ङीष् affixes किम्वदन्ती.
किम्वा: किम्वा ind. Or, else, moreover. E. किम् what, वा or.
कियत्: कियत् mfn. (-यान्-यती-यत्) 1 How much, how many. ind. (यत्) 1 A little. 2 How much, used chiefly in composition; as कियत्काल how long, for a short time; कियदवधि or कियत्यर्य्यन्तं how far, or for a little way. E. किम् and वतुप् affix, and य is substituted for the व.
कियदेतिका: कियदेतिका f. (-का) Effort, vigorous and persevering exertions. E. कियत् used contemptuously, and इति from इदम् this, affix ठक्; (how great a task is this, that it should not be effected, &c.) इह here, being employed in place of इति, the word is written कियदेहिका.
कियद्दूर: कियद्दूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) For a short distance, a little way. E. कियत, and दूर far.
कियाह: कियाह m. (-हः) A horse of a red or bay colour.
किर: किर m. (-रः) A hog. E. कॄ to scatter, क affix; also किरि.
किरक: किरक m. (-कः) A scribe. E. कॄ to scatter, वुन् aff.
किरण: किरण m. (-णः) 1 A ray of light, a sun or moon beam. 2 The sun. E. क to scatter, (light,) and क्यु Uṇādi aff.
किरणमय: किरणमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Radiant, bright, refulgent. E. किरण and मयट् aff.
किरणमालिन्: किरणमालिन् m. (-ली) The sun. E. किरण, माला a garland, and इनि aff.
किरत्: किरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Scattering, spreading. 2 Lighting, shedding light. E. कॄ to scatter, शतृ aff.
किरात: किरात m. (-तः) 1 A savage, one of the barbarous tribes who inhabit woods and mountains and live by the chase, the Kirrhadoe of Arrian. 2 ŚIVA as a mountaineer opposed to ARJUNA, the account of which is the subject of the poem, the Kirātārjunīya. 3 A kind of gentian: see किराततिक्त. 4 A pigmy, a dwarf. 5 A groom, a horseman. f. (-ती) 1 The river GAṄGES or its goddess. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 A bawd, a procuress. 4 The celestial GAṄGES or river of Svarga. E. कॄ to scatter, (speech, &c.) and अत who goes; also किरातक.
किराततिक्त: किराततिक्त m. (-क्तः) A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta.) E. किरात a savage, तिक्त pungent, bitter.
किराताशिन्: किराताशिन् m. (-शी) A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. E. किरात a pigmy, and अशिन् who eats.
किराति: किराति f. (-तिः) A name of the GAṄGES. E. कॄ to scatter, (sound, &c.) to make a murmuring noise, अत who goes, and इन् aff.
किरातिनी: किरातिनी f. (-नी) Indian spikenard; see जटामांसी.
किरि: किरि m. (-रिः) A hog. E. कॄ to scatter, (dirt, &c.) and इ Uṇādi aff.
किरिटि: किरिटि n. (-टिः) The fruit of the marshy date tree.
किरीट: किरीट mn. (-टः-टं) A crest, a diadem. E. कॄ to scatter, (pearls, &c.) and कीटन् Uṇādi aff.
किरीटधारण: किरीटधारण n. (-णं) Wearing a tiara, assuming the crown. E. किरीट, and धारण bearing.
किरीटधारिन्: किरीटधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Crowned, having a tiara. m. (-री) A king. E. किरीट, and धारिन् who wears.
किरीटिन्: किरीटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Crested, crowned. m. (-टी) 1 A king. 9 A name of ARJUNA. E. किरीट a crest, and इनि aff.
किर्मी: किर्म्मी f. (-र्म्मी) The Palāśa tree: see पलाश. 2 A hall, a building, an apartment. 3 An image of gold. 4 A figure of iron. E. कृ to make, मन् and ङीप् affix, deriv. irr.
किर्म्मी: किर्म्मी f. (-र्म्मी) The Palāśa tree: see पलाश. 2 A hall, a building, an apartment. 3 An image of gold. 4 A figure of iron. E. कृ to make, मन् and ङीप् affix, deriv. irr.
किर्मीर: किर्म्मीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Variegated. m. (-रः) 1 The orange tree. 2 The name of a Rākṣasa or goblin. 3 A variegated colour. E. कॄ to scatter, ईरन् affix; and मुट् inserted.
किर्म्मीर: किर्म्मीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Variegated. m. (-रः) 1 The orange tree. 2 The name of a Rākṣasa or goblin. 3 A variegated colour. E. कॄ to scatter, ईरन् affix; and मुट् inserted.
किर्मीरजित्: किर्म्मीरजित् m. (-जित्) A name of BHĪMASENA one of the Pāṇḍu princes. E. किर्म्मीर a demon, and जित् who conquers.
किर्म्मीरजित्: किर्म्मीरजित् m. (-जित्) A name of BHĪMASENA one of the Pāṇḍu princes. E. किर्म्मीर a demon, and जित् who conquers.
किर्मीरत्वच्: किर्म्मीरत्वच् f. (-त्वक्) The orange tree. E. किर्म्मीर variegated, and त्वच् bark.
किर्म्मीरत्वच्: किर्म्मीरत्वच् f. (-त्वक्) The orange tree. E. किर्म्मीर variegated, and त्वच् bark.
किर्म्मीरभिद्: किर्म्मीरभिद् m. (-भित् or -भिद्) A name of BHĪMA: see किर्म्मीरजित्.
किर्मीरसूदन: किर्म्मीरसूदन m. (-नः) A name of BHĪMA: see the preceding.
किर्म्मीरसूदन: किर्म्मीरसूदन m. (-नः) A name of BHĪMA: see the preceding.
किल: किल r. 6th cl. (किलति) 1 To be or become white. 2 To play. r. 10th cl. (केलयति) To send, to throw or cast.

किल ind. An aptote signifying. 1 News, (so said, so reported.) 2 Likelihood, (probably, possibly.) 3 Conciliatory expression. 4 Assertion, certainty, (indeed, verily, assuredly.) 5 Falsehood, inaccuracy. E. किल to send or order, affix क.
किलकिञ्चित: किलकिञ्चित n. (-तं) Amorous agitation, weeping, laughing, being angry, being pleased, &c. in the society of a lover. E. किल play, sport, किं what, some, and चित collected.
किलकिला: किलकिला f. (-ला) Sound expressing joy, or the expression of pleasure by any sound or cry. E. किल play, sport, repeated.
किलाट: किलाट mf. (-टः-टी) Inspissated milk, curds or coagulated milk; it may be applied to cheese.
किलास: किलास m. (-सः) 1 A blotch, a scab. 2 A white leprous spot. E. किल to play, affix क; आस from आस to reject or throw, with अच् affix; or अस to be, with अण् aff.
किलासघ्न: किलासघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A sort of gourd, (Momordica mixta:) see काकरोल. E. किलास a blotch, and घ्न what removes.
किलासिन्: किलासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Having blotches. E. किलास, and इनि aff.
किलिञ्च: किलिञ्च mn. (-ञ्चः-ञ्चं) A thin plank: see the next.
किलिञ्ज: किलिञ्ज mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं) 1 A thin plank of green wood. 2 A mat: see the next; also read किलिञ्च.
किलिञ्जक: किलिञ्जक m. (-कः) A mat. 2 A screen or twist of grass or straw. E. किल to be white, इ added किलि, ज what overcomes, from जि with ड affix, and वुन् added; deriv. irr.
किलिम: किलिम m. (-मः) A tree, a kind of fir or pine, (Pinus deodar.) n. (-मं) Resin, the extract of the pine. E. किल to cast, किमन् aff.
किल्विन्: किल्विन् m. (-ल्वी) A horse; read also किन्धिन्.
किल्विष: किल्विष n. (-षं) 1 Sin. 2 Fault, offence. 3 Disease, sickness. E. किल to play or sport, टिषच् Uṇādi affix, and वुक inserted.
किल्विषिन्: किल्विषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wicked, culpable, criminal. E. किल्विष, and इनि aff.
किशल: किशल mn. (-लः-लं) A sprout, a shoot: see किसल.
किशलय: किशलय mn. (-यः-यं) A young shoot: see किसलय.
किशलयतल्प: किशलयतल्प m. (-ल्पः) A bed of young leaves, &c. E. किशलय, and तल्प a couch; also किशलयशय्या, किशलयशयनं, &c.
किशोर: किशोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Young, infantine. m. (-रः) 1 A colt. 2 The sun. 3 Benjamin, (Styrax benzoin.) 4 A youth, a lad, one from his birth to the end of his fifteenth year: a minor in law अजातव्यवहारः becoming, after his fifteenth year, subject to suits at law or जातव्यवहार. E. किम् what, used contemptuously, शृ to go, and ओरन् Uṇādi affix; also कन् added किशोरकः
किष्क: किष्क r. 10th cl. (किष्कयते) To kill, to injure.
किष्किन्ध: किष्किन्ध m. (-न्धः) A mountain in the south of India, in Mysore, the residence of the monkey prince BĀLĪ. f. (-न्धा) A cave in the mountain; also किष्किन्ध्य.
किष्किन्ध्य: किष्किन्ध्य m. (-न्ध्यः) The mountain Kiṣkindhya, situated in the peninsula in the northern part of Mysore, near the sources of the Pampā river, the territory of BĀLĪ the monkey, from whom it was conquered by RĀMA, and transferred to SUGRĪVA, another monkey chief. f. (-न्ध्या) A cave in the mountain of Kiṣkindhya, the peculiar residence of BĀLĪ; also किष्किन्ध.
किष्किन्ध्याधिप: किष्किन्ध्याधिप m. (-पः) A name of BĀLĪ, a monkey king slain by RĀMA. E. किष्किन्ध्य, and अधिप ruler.
किष्कु: किष्कु mfn. (-ष्कुः-ष्कुः-ष्कु) Vile, bad, contemptible. mf. (-ष्कुः) 1 A cubit. 2 A span. 3 The fore-arm. E. कै to sound, डिष्कु aff.
किष्कुपर्वन्: किष्कुपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) 1 Sugar cane. 2 A bamboo. 3 A reed, (Arundo tibialis.) E. किष्कु a span or cubit, and पर्व्वन् a joint.
किष्कुपर्व्वन्: किष्कुपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) 1 Sugar cane. 2 A bamboo. 3 A reed, (Arundo tibialis.) E. किष्कु a span or cubit, and पर्व्वन् a joint.
किसल: किसल mn. (-लः-लं) A sprout or shoot, the extremity of a branch bearing new leaves. E. किं diminutive, सल to go, अच affix; also किशल and किसलय.
किसलय: किसलय m. (-यः-यं) A sprout, a young shoot: see the preceding. E. as before, affix कयञ्; also किशलय.
कीकट: कीकट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) 1 Miserly, avaricious. 2 Poor, needy. m. (-टः) 1 A country, (Behar;) or m. plu. (-टाः) its inhabitants. 2 A horse. E. ककि to go, अटच् affix, deriv. irr.
कीकस: कीकस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Hard, firm. n. (-सं) A bone. m. (-सः) A worm, an insect. E. की derived from किम् what, a depreciating particle, before कस to go, affix अच्.
कीकसास्य: कीकसास्य m. (-स्यः) A bird in general. E. कीकस a bone, and आस्य face or mouth; alluding to the osseous structure of the beak.
कीकि: कीकि m. (-किः) A blue jay: see किकि.
कीचक: कीचक m. (-कः) 1 A bamboo whistling or rattling in the wind. 2 Any hollow bamboo. 3 A reed. 4 A Daitya or infernal demon so named. 5 A particular Rākṣasa or goblin. 6 A kind of tree. 7 A prince, the son of KEKAYA. E. चीक to touch, to sound, वुन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical consonants transposed.
कीचकजित्: कीचकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of BHĪMA. E. कीचक a goblin, and जित् who conquers.
कीचकनिसूदन: कीचकनिसूदन m. (-नः) BHĪMA: see the preceding.
कीचकभिद्: कीचकभिद् m. (-भित्) See the two words preceding.
कीट: कीट r. 11th cl. (कीटयति) 1 To tinge or colour. 2 To bind.
कीट m. (-टः) A worm, an insect. E. कीट to colour or dye, क aff.
कीटक: कीटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Harsh, hard, unfeeling. m. (-कः) 1 A worm, an insect. 2 A bard, a panegyrist, descended from a Kṣatriya father and Vaiśya mother. E. कीट a worm, and कन् aff.
कीटघ्न: कीटघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Sulphur. E. कीट a worm, and घ्न what destroys.
कीटज: कीटज n. (-जं) Silk. f. (-जा) Lac, an animal dye of a red colour. E. कीट a worm, and ज born.
कीटपक्षोद्भव: कीटपक्षोद्भव m. (-वः) The change from the chrysalis or larva to the butterfly. E. कीट, पक्ष a wing, and उद्भव evolution.
कीदृश्: कीदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Who or what like. E. किम् what, दृश to see, and क्विन् affix; also with कञ् affix; कीदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं.)
कीनाश: कीनाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 1 A labourer or cultivator of the soil. 2 Small, little. 3 Covetous, niggardly. 4 A slayer of cattle. m. (-शः) 1 A name of YAMA. 2 A particular monkey. E. की for का or कु bad, vile, नाश who destroys, the causal form of नश to destroy, with अच् aff.
कीर: कीर m. (-रः) 1 A parrot. 2 Kashmir. m. plu. (-राः) The people of Kashmir. n. (-रं) Flesh. E. की bad, vile, ईर to send or order, क aff.
कीरक: कीरक m. (-कः) 1 A tree. 2 A Buddha. 3 Obtaining, gaining. E. कन् added to the last.
कीरेष्ट: कीरेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 A tree, a species of mountain Pīlu: see अक्षोड. 2 The mango tree. E. कीर a parrot, and इष्ट wished, desired.
कीर्ण: कीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Covered, secreted, hidden. 2 Scattered, thrown, cast. 3 Injured, hurt. 4 Full. E. कॄ to scatter, affix क्त, formation irr.
कीर्णि: कीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 Scattering, throwing. 2 Covering, concealing. E. कॄ to scatter, क्तिन् aff.
कीर्तन: कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Saying, telling. 2 Repeating. 3 Celebrating, praising. f. (-ना) Fame, glory. E. कृत to praise or celebrate, युच् aff.
कीर्त्तन: कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Saying, telling. 2 Repeating. 3 Celebrating, praising. f. (-ना) Fame, glory. E. कृत to praise or celebrate, युच् aff.
कीर्तयत्: कीर्त्तयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Praising, celebrating. E. कृत to praise, शतृ aff.
कीर्त्तयत्: कीर्त्तयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Praising, celebrating. E. कृत to praise, शतृ aff.
कीर्ति: कीर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Fame, renown, glory. 2 Favour, approbation. 3 Sound. 4 Light, lustre. 5 Mud, dirt. 6 Diffusing, expansion. 7 One of the Mātṛkās or personified divine energies of KṚṢṆA. E. कृत to celebrate, क्तिन् aff.
कीर्त्ति: कीर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Fame, renown, glory. 2 Favour, approbation. 3 Sound. 4 Light, lustre. 5 Mud, dirt. 6 Diffusing, expansion. 7 One of the Mātṛkās or personified divine energies of KṚṢṆA. E. कृत to celebrate, क्तिन् aff.
कीर्तिकर: कीर्त्तिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Conferring fame. E. कीर्त्ति, and कर what makes.
कीर्त्तिकर: कीर्त्तिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Conferring fame. E. कीर्त्ति, and कर what makes.
कीर्तित: कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, asserted. 2 Known, notorious. 3 Celebrated, praised. E. कृत to celebrate, affix क्त.
कीर्त्तित: कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, asserted. 2 Known, notorious. 3 Celebrated, praised. E. कृत to celebrate, affix क्त.
कीर्तिभाज्: कीर्त्तिभाज् mfn. (भाक्) Celebrated, famous. m. (-भाक्) A name of DROṆĀCĀRYA, the military preceptor of the PĀṆḌUS and KURUS. E. कीर्त्ति fame, and भाज to serve or honour, affix क्विप्.
कीर्त्तिभाज्: कीर्त्तिभाज् mfn. (भाक्) Celebrated, famous. m. (-भाक्) A name of DROṆĀCĀRYA, the military preceptor of the PĀṆḌUS and KURUS. E. कीर्त्ति fame, and भाज to serve or honour, affix क्विप्.
कीर्तिमत्: कीर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Praised, famous, celebrated. n. (-मान्) The elder brother of VASUDEVA. E. कीर्त्ति, and मतुप् aff.
कीर्त्तिमत्: कीर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Praised, famous, celebrated. n. (-मान्) The elder brother of VASUDEVA. E. कीर्त्ति, and मतुप् aff.
कीर्तिशेष: कीर्त्तिशेष m. (-षः) Death, dying. E. कीर्त्ति fame, and शेष end.
कीर्त्तिशेष: कीर्त्तिशेष m. (-षः) Death, dying. E. कीर्त्ति fame, and शेष end.
कीर्त्त्य: कीर्त्त्य mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं) To be praised or celebrated. E. कृत to praise, क्यप aff.
कीर्मी: कीर्म्मी f. (-र्म्मी) A house for straw; also हेमपुत्री.
कीर्म्मी: कीर्म्मी f. (-र्म्मी) A house for straw; also हेमपुत्री.
कीर्यमाण: कीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Covered, bestrewed. E. कॄ to scatter, passive form, शानच् aff.
कीर्य्यमाण: कीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Covered, bestrewed. E. कॄ to scatter, passive form, शानच् aff.
कील: कील r. 10th cl. (कीलयति) To bind, to fasten, to stake, to pin.

कील mf. (-लः-ला) 1 Flame, lambent flame. 2 Small, minute. m. (-लः) 1 A stake, a pin, a bolt, a wedge, &c. 9 A lance, a pike. 2 A gnomon. 4 A weapon. 5 A post, a pillar. 6 The elbow. 7 A blow or punch with the elbow. 8 A blow, a thump; (in the three last senses some make this also fem.) 9 A post in a cow-house: see the next. E. कील to bind, and क aff.
कीलक: कीलक m. (-कः) A pillar for cows, &c. to rub themselves against, or one to which they are tied. 2 A pin, a bolt, a wedge. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कीलसंस्पर्श: कीलसंस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) A plant, the fruit of which yields a turpentinous substance that has been used in India as pitch, &c. commonly Gab; (Embryopteris glutinifera, Rox.) E. कील a bolt, सम् with, and स्पर्श touch, the fruit being invested with a hard coat.
कीलाल: कीलाल n. (-लं) 1 Water. 2 Blood. 3 Amṛta, the food of the gods. 4 Honey. E. कील flame, and अल what opposes, &c. or कील a stake, &c. and अल what adorns; from अल् with अण् aff.
कीलालधि: कीलालधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. कीलाल water, and धि what contains.
कीलालप: कीलालप m. (-पः) A Rākṣasa, a sort of goblin or imp. E. कीलाल blood, and प who drinks.
कीलित: कीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bound, tied, confined. 2 Pierced, transfixed. 3 Staked, impaled. 4 Pinned, fastened by a stake, &c. 5 Set up as a stake or pole. E. कील to bind, affix क्त.
कीश: कीश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Naked. m. (-शः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 The sun. E. क air, water, &c., ईश who has power over, and क aff.
कीशपर्ण: कीशपर्ण mf. (-र्णः-र्णी) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्गः also कीशपर्णक. m. (कः) E. कीश a monkey, पर्ण a leaf.
कु: कु r. 1st cl. (ङ) कुङ् (कवते) r. 2nd cl. (टु) टुकु (कौति) r. 6th cl. (शिं) कुशि (कुवते) r. 9th cl. (ञ) कुञ (कुनाति कुनीते.) 1 To sound, to sound indistinctly, to moan, to groan. 2 To cry as a bird, to coo, to hum as a bee, &c.

कु f. (-कुः) The earth. ind. A particle of depreciation, and implying, 1 Sin, guilt. 2 Reproach, contempt. 3 Diminution, littleness. 4 Prevention, hindrance, as कुपथ a bad road, &c. E. कु to sound, क्विप् affix, or कुङ to sound, with the affix ड.
कुक: कुक r. 1st cl. (कोकते) To take, to accept.
कुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Taking, accepting. E. कुक and क aff.
कुकर: कुकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Having a crooked or withered arm. 2 Wicked, acting wickedly. E. कु bad, and कर the hand; or कृ to do, ट aff.
कुकर्मन्: कुकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, bad. n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness, depravity, villainy. E. कु bad, कर्म्मन् act.
कुकर्म्मन्: कुकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, bad. n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness, depravity, villainy. E. कु bad, कर्म्मन् act.
कुकर्मकारिन्: कुकर्म्मकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wicked, depraved. E. कुकर्म्म, and कारिन् who does.
कुकर्म्मकारिन्: कुकर्म्मकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wicked, depraved. E. कुकर्म्म, and कारिन् who does.
कुकील: कुकील m. (-लः) A mountain. E. कु earth, and कील a pin or bolt.
कुकुद: कुकुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who gives a girl, decorated with fit ornaments and with the prescribed ceremonies, in marriage. E. कुक to take, and द who gives: see कूकुद.
कुकुन्दर: कुकुन्दर n. (-रं) or n. du. (-रे) The cavities of the loins. E. कुन्दर a hollow, a cave, from कु the earth, and दृ to rend or tear, कु bad, vile, prefixed; it is also written ककुन्दर.
कुकुभा: कुकुभा f. (-भा) One of the female personifications of music or Rāgiṇīs.
कुकुर: कुकुर m. (-रः) 1 A dog. 2 A branch of the Yadu race: see कुक्कुर. 3 A plant and perfume: see ग्रन्थपर्णी. m. plu. (-राः) A country: see दशार्ह. E. कुक to take, उरच् Uṇādi affix; also कुक्कुर.
कुकुराधिनाथ: कुकुराधिनाथ m. (-थः) KṚṢṆA. E. कुकुर a Yadu, and अधिनाथ chief.
कुकूणक: कुकूणक m. (-कः) Weakness of the eyes in infants.
कुकूल: कुकूल n. (-लं) A hole filled with stakes. 2 Conflagration of chaff. 3 Armour, mail. E. कु the earth, and कूल a bank, &c.
कुकृत्य: कुकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Wickedness, evil. E. कु, and कृत्य act.
कुकोल: कुकोल n. (-लं) The jujube: see कोलि.
कुक्कुट: कुक्कुट m. (-टः) 1 A cock. 2 A wild cock. 3 The offspring of a Śūdra or man of the fourth caste, by a Caṇḍāla woman. 4 A whisp of lighted straw, a firebrand. 5 A spark of fire. f. (-टिः or -टी) Hypocrisy, interested observance of religious duties. f. (-टी) 1 A hen. 2 A small house lizard. 3 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) E. कुक् taking, from कुक with क्विप् affix, and कुट to cut or scratch, with क affix; scratching up the earth, &c. or कु bad, कुट to cut, &c. and क inserted.
कुक्कुटक: कुक्कुटक m. (-कः) 1 A cock. 2 A wild cock. 3 A man of a mixed caste, one sprung from a Śūdra and the female of a barbarian. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कुक्कुटमण्डप: कुक्कुटमण्डप m. (-पः) A place where final emancipation may be attained; also मुक्तिमण्डप.
कुक्कुटमस्तक: कुक्कुटमस्तक n. (-कं) A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya.) E. कुक्कुट, and मस्तक head; to what the flower may be compared.
कुक्कुटव्रत: कुक्कुटव्रत n. (-तं) A religious observation, (worship of ŚIVA,) on the seventh of the light fortnight of Bhadra, by women, especially for the sake of obtaining offspring. E. कुक्कुट a fowl, and व्रत religious rite; alluding to the fruitfulness of the hen.
कुक्कुटशिख: कुक्कुटशिख m. (-खः) Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) E. कुक्कुट a cock, and शिख a crest; cockscomb.
कुक्कुटाण्ड: कुक्कुटाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A fowl's egg. E. कुक्कुटी, and अण्ड an egg.
कुक्कुटाभ: कुक्कुटाभ m. (-भः) A kind of snake, compared to a fowl, in some respects, perhaps from having a crest or comb. E. कुक्कुट a cock, and आभ who is or resembles, from भा to shine, prefix आङ् and affix क.
कुक्कुटाहि: कुक्कुटाहि m. (-हिः) A kind of snake: see the preceding.
कुक्कुभ: कुक्कुभ m. (-भः) 1 A wild cock, (Phasianus gallus.) 2 Varnish, oiling or oily gloss; also कुक्कुभक. m. (-कः) E. कुक् imitative sound, कु to utter sound, and भक् irr. aff.
कुक्कुर: कुक्कुर m. (-रः) A dog. n. (-रं) A vegetable perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla: see ग्रंथिपर्णी. f. (-री) A bitch. E. कुक to take, उरन् Uṇādi affix, and क inserted; also कुकुर.
कुक्कुवाच्: कुक्कुवाच् m. (-क्) A sort of deer.
कुक्ष: कुक्ष m. (-क्षः) The belly. E. कुष to extract, and सः affix; by which the foeces are excreted; also कुक्षि.
कुक्षि: कुक्षि m. (-क्षिः) The belly, the cavity of the abdomen. E. कुषि to extract, and क्मि affix; see the preceding.
कुक्षिम्भरि: कुक्षिम्भरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Voracious, gluttonous, filling or pampering the belly. E. कुक्षि the belly, भृ to nourish, affix स्वि.
कुक्षिरन्ध्र: कुक्षिरन्ध्र m. (-न्ध्रः) A reed. E. कुक्षि, and रब्ध्र a hole.
कुख्याति: कुख्याति f. (-तिः) Evil report, infamy. E. कु bad, and ख्याति fame.
कुङ्कुम: कुङ्कुम m. (-मः) Saffron, (Crocus sativus.) E. कुकि to take, and उमक् aff.
कुङ्कुमताम्र: कुङ्कुमताम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Red, coppery red. E. कुङ्कुम, and ताम्र copper.
कुङ्कुमरेणु: कुङ्कुमरेणु f. (-णुः) The dust or pollen of saffron. E. कुङ्कम, and रेणु dust.
कुङ्कुमाक्त: कुङ्कुमाक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Dyed or stained with saffron, orange, yellow. E. कुङ्कुम, and अक्त anointed.
कुङ्कुमाक्त mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Marked with saffron, dyed or stained of an orange colour. E. कुङ्कुम, and अङ्क a mark.
कुङ्कुमारुण: कुङ्कुमारुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Red, ruddy. E. कुङ्गुम, and अरुण purple.
कुच: कुच r. 1st cl. (कोचति) 1 To sound high, to utter a loud, shrill cry, as a bird. 2 To go. 3 To polish. 4 To touch. 5 To furrow or mark with lines. 6 To be crooked. 7 To write. 8 To oppose. 9 To contend. 10 To be restricted or confined, to contract. r. 6th cl. (शि) शिकुच. (कुचति) or with सं prefixed, (संकोचति or संकुचति) 1 To straiten, to narrow or contract. 2 To be straitened, to shrink, to contract. With उत् to bribe; with वि and आ, to expand.
कुच m. (-चः) A breast, a pap. E. कुच to bind or confine, क aff.
कुचकुम्भ: कुचकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) The female breast. E. कुच, and कुम्भ vase.
कुचण्डिका: कुचण्डिका f. (-का) A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides:) see मूर्व्वा.
कुचतट: कुचतट n. (-टं) The female breast. E. कुच, and तट bank.
कुचतटाग्र: कुचतटाग्र n. (-ग्रं) A nipple. E. कुचतट, and अग्र tip.
कुचन्दन: कुचन्दन n. (-नं) Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santolinus.) 2 Sappan or log wood: see पत्राङ्ग. 3 Saffron. 4 A leguminous plant, (Adenanthera pavonina.) E. कु bad, inferior, and चन्दन Sandal.
कुचफल: कुचफल m. (-लः) The pomegranate. E. कुच, and फल fruit of the shape of the breast.
कुचर: कुचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Censorious, detracting. 2 Following evil practices, low, vile, wicked. E. कु vile, and चर who goes.
कुचर्या: कुचर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Impropriety, wickedness. E. कु bad, चर्य्या practice.
कुचर्य्या: कुचर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Impropriety, wickedness. E. कु bad, चर्य्या practice.
कुचाग्र: कुचाग्र n. (-ग्रं) A nipple. E. कुच a breast, and अग्र point, end.
कुचाङ्गेरी: कुचाङ्गेरी f. (-री) Wood sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha:) see चाङ्गेरी.
कुचिक: कुचिक mf. (-कः-का) A kind of fish, in shape like an eel, commonly Kunchiya, (Unibranchapertura Cuchiya, Ham.)
कुचित: कुचित mf. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Closed, contracted. 2 Measured. E. कुच to contract, कितच् Uṇādi aff.
कुचेल: कुचेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Ill clothed, dressed in dirty or tattered garments. f. (-लः-ली) A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra:) see विद्धकर्णी. E. कु bad, and चेला a garment.
कुच्छ: कुच्छ n. (-च्छं) The white water lily.
कुज: कुज r. 1st cl. (उ) कुजु (कोजति) 1 To steal or rob. (इ) कुजि (कुञ्जति) To sound inarticulately.
कुज m. (-जः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 A demon; also called Naraka. 3 A tree. f. (-जा) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 Of SĪTĀ. E. कु the earth, and ज born, earth-born.
कुजम्भल: कुजम्भल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A housebreaker; also कुजम्भिल.
कुजम्भिल: कुजम्भिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A thief, a housebreaker; also कुजम्भल and कुजम्भर.
कुज्जिश: कुज्जिश m. (-शः) A sort of fish.
कुज्झटि: कुज्झटि f. (-टिः-टी) A fog or mist. E. कु the earth, and झट to be entangled, affix कि; also कुञ्झटिका.
कुज्झटिका: कुज्झटिका f. (-का) A fog or mist: see the preceding.
कुञ्च: कुञ्च r. 1st cl. (उ) कुञ्चु (कुंचति) 1 To go, to go to or towards. 2 To move crookedly. 3 To make crooked. 4 To be crooked. 5 To lessen, to make small. 6 To be or become small, to shrink as a substance. 7 To contract or draw in, (as the thoughts.) Some read this root कुचि, but needlessly.
कुञ्चन: कुञ्चन n. (-नं) 1 Curving, bending. 2 Contracting. 3 Contraction of the eyelids. E. कुञ्च to go crookedly, ल्युट् aff.
कुञ्चि: कुञ्चि f. (-ञ्चिः) A measure of quantity equal to eight handfuls. E. कुञ्च to be curved, इन् aff.
कुञ्चिका: कुञ्चिका f. (-का) 1 A plant bearing a red and black seed, used as a weight, (Abrus precatorius:) see गुञ्जा. 2 The branch or shoot of a bamboo. 3 A plant bearing a pungent seed, (Nigella Indica:) see कृष्णजीरक. 4 A fish, commonly Cunchiya, in shape like an eel and eaten as one, (Unibranchapertura cunchiya.) 5 A key. E. कुञ्च to go crookedly, &c. क्वुन् affix, with the fem. termination.
कुञ्चित: कुञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crooked, curved, bent. E. कुञ्च to go crookedly, affix क्त.
कुञ्ज: कुञ्ज mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं) 1 A place overgrown with creeping plants, a bower, an arbour. 2 An elephant's tusk or ivory. 3 The lower jaw. E. कु the earth, and ज produced, म inserted.
कुञ्जकुटीर: कुञ्जकुटीर m. (-रः) A bower, an arbour. E. कुञ्ज, and कुटीर a small house.
कुञ्जर: कुञ्जर m. (-रः) 1 An elephant. 2 (In composition,) Preeminent, as पुरुषकुञ्जर an excellent man. 3 Hair. 4 A country. f. (-रा or -री) 1 A female elephant. (-रा) 1 A plant, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 A shrub, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. कुञ्ज a tusk, an arbour, &c. and र what forms or possesses.
कुञ्जरपिप्पली: कुञ्जरपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant described as bearing a fruit which resembles long pepper: see गजपिप्पली.
कुञ्जराराति: कुञ्जराराति m. (-तिः) 1 The Śarabha, a fabulous animal. 2 A lion. E. कुञ्जर an elephant, and अराति an enemy.
कुञ्जरालुक: कुञ्जरालुक n. (-कं) A species of esculent root, a sort of yam.
कुञ्जराशन: कुञ्जराशन m. (-नः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. कुञ्जर an elephant, and अशन food.
कुञ्जल: कुञ्जल m. (-लः) Sour gruel: see काञ्जिक. E. कु bad, and जल water, form irr.
कुञ्जिका: कुञ्जिका f. (-का) Kalonji, (Nigella Indica:) see कुञ्चिका.
कुट: कुट (शि) r. 6th cl. (कुटति) 1 To make crooked. 2 To be or become crooked. 3 To be dishonest, to cheat or deceive. (इ) कुटि (कुण्टति) 1 To be stopped or obstructed, to be prevented from moving. 2 To confound or disorder from pain or grief: see कुडि r. 10th cl. (कुटयते कोटयति) 1 To cut: see त्रुट. 2 To heat: see कुट्ट.

कुट mn. (-टः-टं) 1 A water pot. mf. (-टः-टी) A house; also कुटि. m. (-टः) 1 A fort, a strong hold. 2 A tree: see कुठ. 6 A hammer, a mallet for breaking small stones. 4 A mountain. f. (-टी) 1 A kind of perfume, commonly Mura. 2 A bawd, a procuress or go-between. 3 A nosegay, a bundle or tuft of flowers or vegetables. E. कुठ to go crookedly, &c. कः aff.
कुटङ्क: कुटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A roof, a thatch. E. कुट a house, in the third case, and क what makes.
कुटङ्गक: कुटङ्गक m. (-कः) 1 An arbour formed by creeping plants overrunning a tree. 2 A roof or thatch. 3 A house, a small house, a hut or cottage: see कुटुङ्गक.
कुटच: कुटच m. (-चः) Coraya: see the next.
कुटज: कुटज m. (-जः) A medicinal plant, commonly Coraya, (Echites antidysenterica, Rox.) the seeds are used as a vermifuge: see इन्द्रयव. 2 A name of the saint AGASTYA, 5 Also of DROṆA a sage and warrior: see द्रोण. E. कूट a mountain peak, and ज what is produced; the vowel of कूट being made short.
कुटन्नक: कुटन्नक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass: see मुस्त.
कुटन्नट: कुटन्नट m. (-टः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) n. (-टं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. कुटन् being crooked, नट to dance or wave, and अच् aff.
कुटप: कुटप m. (-पः) 1 A saint, a divine sage or Muni. 2 A garden or grove near a house. 3 A measure of grain, &c. see कुडप. (-पं) A lotus. E. कुट a house, and प what nourishes.
कुटर: कुटर m. (-रः) A post round which the string passes that works the churning stick: see कुठर.
कुटरु: कुटरु n. (-रु) A tent, a house of cloth or canvas. E. कुट to be crooked, अरु Uṇādi aff.
कुटरुणा: कुटरुणा f. (-णा) A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
कुटल: कुटल n. (-लं) A roof, a thatch: see कुटङ्क.
कुटहारिका: कुटहारिका f. (-का) A female slave or servant. E. कुट a water pot, and हारिका who carries.
कुटि: कुटि mf. (-टिः-टिः or -टी) A house. m. (-टिः) 1 A tree. 2 The body. 3 Curvature, a curve. E. कुट to be crooked, इ Uṇādi aff.
कुटिचर: कुटिचर m. (-रः) A porpoise. E. कुटि a curve, चर who goes.
कुटित: कुटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crooked, bent. E. कुट to be curved, इतः Uṇādi affix; also कुटिल.
कुटितृ: कुटितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Being bent. 2 Acting dishonestly. E. कुट to be crooked, तृच् aff.
कुटिर: कुटिर n. (-रं) A hut, a cottage. E. कुटि a house, रा to be like, ड aff.
कुटिल: कुटिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Crooked, bent. 2 Dishonest, fraudulent. n. (-लं) Tin. f. (-ला) The name of a river, the Kuṭilā river, according to some, a name of the SARASVATĪ. E. कुट to be crooked, किलच् Uṇādi aff.
कुटिलगामिन्: कुटिलगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Tortuous, going crookedly, E. कुटिल, and गामिन् what goes.
कुटिलता: कुटिलता f. (-ता) 1 Crookedness. 2 Guile, dishonesty. E. कुटिल and तस्र् affix; also with त्व, कुटिलत्वं. n. (-त्वं)
कुटिलिका: कुटिलिका f. (-का) 1 A blacksmith's forge. 2 Crouching, coming stealthily as a hunter on his prey. E. कुटिल, and इकन् aff.
कुटीचक: कुटीचक m. (-कः) One who lives at his son's expense.
कुटीचर: कुटीचर m. (-रः) An ascetic of a particular order, one who consigns the care of his family to his son, and remains at home engaged solely in devotion. E. कुटी a house, and चर who goes.
कुटीर: कुटीर m. (-रः) A small house, a hut, a hovel. E. कुटी a house, and र aff.
कुटुङ्कक: कुटुङ्कक m. (-कः) 1 An arbour or bower, formed of creeping plants. 2 A thatch, a roof. 3 A hut, a cottage. 4 A creeper winding round a tree. E. कुट to be crooked, क affix, कुट and अङ्ग the body, with कन् added; the form is irr.; also कुटङ्कक.
कुटुम्ब: कुटुम्ब r. 10th cl. (कुटुम्बयते) To support a family.

कुटुम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A name. 2 A kinsman, a relation by descent. 3 A connexion, a relation by the mother's side by marriage, &c. 4 Offspring, progeny. 5 Family, race. E. कुटुम्ब to support a family, and अच् aff.
कुटुम्बक: कुटुम्बक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Being of one family. n. (-कं) A family, a kindred. E. कन् added to the last.
कुटुम्बव्यापृत: कुटुम्बव्यापृत m. (-तः) A provident and attentive father of a family. E. कुटुम्ब kindred, and व्यापृत one who manages.
कुटुम्बिता: कुटुम्बिता f. (-ता) Family connexion or union, living as one family. E. कुटुम्बिन्, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कुटिम्बित्व.
कुटुम्बिन्: कुटुम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) 1 A peasant, a cultivator of the soil. 2 One who supports or has a family. m. (-म्बी) A householder, a pater-familias. f. (-म्बिनी) 1 The wife of a householder and mother of a family, a matron. 2 A small shrub used in medicine, a kind of moon plant: see क्षीरिणी. E. कुटुम्ब kindred, &c. and इनि poss. aff.
कुटुम्बार्थ: कुटुम्बार्थ n. adj. (-र्थं) For the support or on account of a family. E. कुटुम्ब, and अर्थ object.
कुटुम्बौकस्: कुटुम्बौकस् n. (-कः) Apartments, &c. appropriated to the accommodation of relations, &c. E. कुटुम्ब kindred, and ओकस् a house.
कुटेर: कुटेर m. (-रः) A hut, a cottage. E. कुट to be crooked, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
कुट्ट: कुट्ट r. 10th cl. (कुट्टयति) 1 To cut, to divide. 2 To grind or pound. 3 To censure. 1st cl. (कुट्टति) 10th cl. (कुट्टयति) To heat, some make this root कुट.
कुट्टक: कुट्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What cuts. 2 What pounds or grinds. m. (-कः) 1 A power in arithmetic or algebra, a quantity such,  that a given number being multiplied by it, and the product added to a given quantity, the sum may be divisible without remainder by a given divisor. 2 A kingfisher. E. कुट्ट to pound, वुन् aff.
कुट्टकव्यवहार: कुट्टकव्यवहार m. (-रः) That branch of arithmetic which treats of the Kuṭṭaka: see the last. E. कुट्टक, and व्यवहार practice; also कुट्टकाध्याय or chapter.
कुट्टन: कुट्टन n. (-नं) 1 Pounding, grinding, cutting, dividing. 2 Abusing. f. (-नी) A bawd, a procuress, a go-between. E. कुट्ट to cut, ल्युट् and ङीष् affs.
कुट्टमित: कुट्टमित n. (-तं) One of the ten graces of women, affected repulse of a lover's caresses.
कुट्टाक: कुट्टाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) What cuts or divides. E. कुट्ट to cut, षाकन aff.
कुट्टार: कुट्टार m. (-रः) A mountain. n. (-रं) 1 Pleasure. 2 A blanket. adv. Only, merely. (केवले) This word is also written कुट्टीर and कुठार, but perhaps inaccurately.
कुट्टिन्: कुट्टिन् mfn. (-ट्टी-ट्टिनी-टि) What cuts or pounds. f. (-नी) A bawd, a procures. E. कुट्ट cutting, इनि aff.
कुट्टिम: कुट्टिम mn. (-मः-मं) 1 A jewel mine. 2 Ground smoothed and plastered. 3 Ground prepared for the site of a mansion. 4 A hut, a cottage. 5 The pomegranate. E. कुट्ट to cut or pierce, and इमच् aff.
कुट्टिहारिका: कुट्टिहारिका f. (-का) A female servant, a slave: see कुटहारिका.
कुट्टीर: कुट्टीर m. (-रः) A mountain: see कुट्टार.
कुट्मल: कुट्मल mn. (-लः-लं) An opening bud. n. (-लं) One of the hells in which sinners are punished, where they are bound with ropes. E. कुट to be curved, and क्मलच् Uṇādi affix, or कल affix, with मुट् inserted.
कुठ: कुठ (इ,) कुठि 1st cl. (कुण्ठति) To be idle. r. 10th cl. (कुण्ठयति) To surround; अप् is usually prefixed.
कुठ m. (-ठः) A tree. E. कु the earth, and स्था to abide, ड affix; earth-abiding; the deriv. is irregular, and is sometimes written कुट, derived from कुट to be crooked, to bend or wave, affix क.
कुठर: कुठर m. (-रः) The post round which the string of the churning stick winds: see कुटर. E. कुट to surround, करन् aff.
कुठाकु: कुठाकु m. (-कुः) A bird; the woodpecker. E. कुठ for कुट to cut, and आकुः Uṇādi aff.
कुठाटङ्क: कुठाटङ्क m. (-कः) An axe. E. कुठ a tree, आङ् prefixed to टकि to bind, and अच् aff.
कुठार: कुठार mf. (-रः-री) 1 An axe. 2 A sort of hoe or spade. m. (-रः) A tree. E. कुठ a tree, and ऋ to go, affix अण्.
कुठारिका: कुठारिका f. (-का) A small one or adze; also a similarly shaped instrument used in surgery for scarification. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कुठारु: कुठारु m. (-रुः) 1 A tree. 2 A monkey, an ape. 3 An armourer. E. कुठ a tree, ऋ to go, affix ञुण्.
कुठि: कुठि m. (-ठिः) 1 A mountain. 2 A tree. E. कुठ to surround, and इः Uṇādi aff.
कुठिक: कुठिक m. (-कः) A kind of costus, commonly, Cuṭh, (Costus speciosus.)
कुठेर: कुठेर m. (-रः) 1 A name of fire. 2 Tulasi or basil: see the next. E. कुठ to surround, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
कुठेरक: कुठेरक m. (-कः) 1 Holy basil, (Ocimum sanctum:) see पणास. 2 A white sort of the same, (Ocimum gratissimum.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
कुठेरज: कुठेरज m. (-जः) A white species of basil; also कुठेरक.
कुठेरु: कुठेरु m. (-रुः) The wind of a fan or Chowrie.
कुड: कुड (शि) r. 6th cl. (कुडति) 1 To play or act as a child, to trifle. 2 To eat. 3 To heap. (इ,) कुडि r. 1st cl. (कुंडति) 1 To confound or disorder with grief or pain. 2 To form, to make. 3 (कुण्डते) To burn, to heat. r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंडति कुण्डयति) To preserve.
कुडप: कुडप m. (-पः) A measure: see the next.
कुडव: कुडव m. (-वः) A measure of grain, wood, iron, &c. the fourth part of a Prastha, described by some as a vessel four fingers wide, and as many deep, and containing twelve Prakṛtis or handfuls: it is also said to contain thirteen and a half cubic Aṅgulas; or to be a finger and a half deep, and three fingers each length and breadth. In medicine it is equal to two Prakṛtis or thirty-two Tolakas. E. कुड to heap, कवन् affix; also कुडप and कुटप.
कुडि: कुडि m. (-डिः) The body. E. कुड to burn, इ Uṇādi aff.
कुडिका: कुडिका f. (-का) An earthen or wooden water pot used by ascetics.
कुडिश: कुडिश m. (-शः) A fish, commonly Kūrci, (Cyprinus curchius, HAM.)
कुडुप: कुडुप m. (-पः) The clasp or fastening of a necklace or bracelet.
कुड्मल: कुड्मल m. (-लः) A new bud: see कुट्मल.
कुड्मलित: कुड्मलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Budded, blossomed. 2 Cheerful, smiling, (as the countenance.) E. कुद्मल and इतच् aff.
कुड्य: कुड्य n. (-ड्यं) 1 A wall. 2 Anointing, plastering, 3 Eagerness, curiosity. E. कु to sound, and ड्यन् affix, or कुड to heap, &c. and क्यप् affix; also कूड्य.
कुड्यक: कुड्यक n. (-कं) A wall: see the preceding, कन् being added.
कुड्यच्छेदिन्: कुड्यच्छेदिन् m. (-दी) A thief, a housebreaker. E. कुड्य a wall, and छेदिन् who cuts or breaks.
कुड्यच्छेद्य: कुड्यच्छेद्य n. (-द्यं) An opening, a hole in a wall, a breach. E. कुड्य a wall, and छेट्ट्य to be broken.
कुड्यमत्स्य: कुड्यमत्स्य mf. (-त्स्यः-त्स्यी) A house lizard. E. कुड्य a wall, and मत्स्य a fish.
कुण: कुण r. 6th cl. (कुणति) 1 To sound. 2 To cherish, to support or aid with gifts, &c. 3 To be in pain. r. 10th cl. (कुणयति) 1 To converse with, to speak to or address. 2 To counsel or advise.
कुणप: कुणप mn. (-पः-पी-पं) Foul smelling, stinking. mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A dead body, a corpse. m. (-पः) 1 A stink, a foul smell. 2 A spear. f. (-पी) A small bird, a kind of Maina or Sārika: see विट्सारिका. E. क्वण to sound, कपन् affix, व is changed to its congener उ; sound proceeding from the corpse, &c. by the escape of the vital air, &c.
कुणाल: कुणाल m. (-लः) The name of a country. E. क्वण to sound, कालन् Uṇādi affix, व becomes उ.
कुणि: कुणि m. (-णिः) 1 A cripple with a crooked or withered arm, or without a hand or finger; कूणि. 2 The Tūn tree, (Cedrela tunna:) also तुणि. 3 A whitlow. E. कुण to sound, कि aff.
कुणिन्द: कुणिन्द m. (-न्दः) Sound, sounding. E. क्वण to sound, किन्दच् aff.
कुण्टक: कुण्टक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fat, corpulent. E. कुटि to be crooked, क्वन् aff.
कुण्ठ: कुण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) 1 Indolent, lazy, slow. 2 Stupid, foolish, a fool. E. कुठि to be slothful, &c. affix अच्.
कुण्ठक: कुण्ठक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A fool, stupid, ignorant. E. कन् added to the former.
कुण्ठित: कुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grasped, held. 2 Encircled. 3 Stupid. E. कुठि and क्त aff.
कुण्ड: कुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A son born in adultery, the son of a woman by another man than her husband, while the husband is alive. n. (-ण्डं) 1 A hole in the ground for receiving and preserving consecrated fire. 2 A pool, a well, a spring or basin of water, especially consecrated to some holy purpose or person. 2 A measure. mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) A pitcher. f. (-ण्डी) A student's water-pot, made of a hollow cocoanut, &c. E. कुडि to preserve, ड aff.
कुण्डकीट: कुण्डकीट m. (-टः) 1 A follower of the Cārvāka doctrine, or the tenets of those sects who deny the authority of the Vedas. 2 The son of a woman of the Brahminical tribe born in adultery, particularly with a man of an inferior caste. 3 A keeper of concubines, a man who has female slaves. E. कुण्ड a pool, &c. and कीट a worm, a reptile.
कुण्डकील: कुण्डकील m. (-लः) A low, vile man: see नागर.
कुण्डगोलक: कुण्डगोलक m. (-कः) Sour rice gruel: see काञ्जिक. E. कुण्ड a pitcher, गुड to preserve, ण्वुल् affix, ड is changed to ल.
कुण्डङ्ग: कुण्डङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An arbour, a bower. E. कुडि to preserve, अङ्गच् aff.
कुण्डपाय्य: कुण्डपाय्य m. (-य्यः) A sacrifice, an oblation. E. कुण्ड, and पाय्य to be imbibed.
कुण्डल: कुण्डल n. (-लं) 1 An earring. 2 A bracelet. 3 A fetter, a tie, a collar. f. (-ली) 1 Mountain ebony: see काञ्चन. 2 Gurūci, a plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची. 3 Cowach. E. कुडि to preserve, कलच् aff.
