कुण्डलधारण: कुण्डलधारण n. (-णं) Wearing earrings. E. कुण्डल, and धारण having.
कुण्डलधारिन्: कुण्डलधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wearing earrings. E. कुण्डल, and धारिन् who has.
कुण्डलिन्: कुण्डलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having an earring. m. (-ली) 1 A name of VARUṆA regent of the water. 2 A snake. 3 A peacock. 4 The spotted or painted deer. f. (-नी) 1 A Śakti or form of DURGĀ, worshipped by the Tāntrikas. 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 Curds boiled with Ghee and spices. E. कुण्डल an earring, and इनि affix; the rings on the snake, the eyes in the peacock's tail, &c., being compared to this ornament.
कुण्डाशिन्: कुण्डाशिन् m. (-शी) 1 A pander, a pimp. 2 One who is supported by a bastard. E. कुण्ड, अश to eat, and इनि aff.
कुण्डिका: कुण्डिका f. (-का) 1 A student's waterpot, the Kamandalu. 2 A pitcher. E. कुण्ड a pitcher, &c. कन् added with the fem. aff.
कुण्डिन: कुण्डिन n. (-नं) A city; also Vidarbhā, the capital of Vidarbha the father-in-law of Nala Rājā, apparently the modern Condavir. m. plur. (-नाः) The people of Kundina. m. (-नः) The name of a saint. E. कुडि to preserve, इनच् Uṇādi aff.
कुण्डिन्: कुण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) A bastard: see कुण्ड. E. कुण्ड and इनि aff.
कुण्डीर: कुण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Able, powerful. m. (-रः) A man.
कुतनु: कुतनु mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु) Deformed. m. (-नुः) A name of KUVERA. E. कु bad, vile, and तनु body, this deity being of a monstrous appearance, having three legs and but eight teeth.
कुतप: कुतप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Slightly hot, mild, tepid. mn. (-पः-पं) 1 The eighth Muhūrta or portion of the day, from the last Daṇḍa of the second watch to the first of the third or about noon; an eligible time for the performance of sacrifices to the manes. 2 A daughter's son. 3 A musical instrument. 4 A sort of blanket made of the hair of the mountain goat. 5 Sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) m. (-पः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 A twice born man, one of the three first classes. 4 A guest. 5 A sister's son. 6 An ox. E. कु the earth, and तप what warms, or कु diminutive, and तप heat; the sun being on the decline, &c.
कुतपसप्तक: कुतपसप्तक n. (-कं) A Śrāddha in which seven constituents occur, noon, a horn platter, a Nepal blanket, silver, sacrificial grass, sesamum and kine. E. कुतप, and सप्तक sevenfold.
कुतश्चन्: कुतश्चन् ind Anywhere, somewhere. E. चन added to कुतस्.
कुतश्चित्: कुतश्चित् ind. Somewhere or other. E. चित् added to कुतस्.
कुतस्: कुतस् ind. Implying interrogation, 2 How, what. 2 How, in what way, how should it be thus, &c. implying denial or concealment of knowledge. 3 Whence, from what place. E. कु for किम् what, and तसिल् aff.
कुतस्त्य: कुतस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Whence come, how happened. E. त्यप् added to the last.
कुतुक: कुतुक n. (-कं) 1 Eagerness, vehemence. 2 Desire, inclination. 3 Curiosity. E. कुत a particular sound, कै to emit sound, ड affix; also कौतुक.
कुतुप: कुतुप m. (-पः) A small leathern oil bottle. mn. (-पः-पं) The eighth hour of the day: see कुतप. E. कुतू as below, and उपच् aff.
कुतू: कुतू f. (-तूः) A leathern oil bottle. E. कु bad, and तन to spread, डु affix, and the final lengthened.
कुतूणक: कुतूणक m. (-कः) Weakness of the eyes in infants; also read कुकूणक.
कुतूहल: कुतूहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Excellent, best, praised, celebrated. 3 Surprising, wonderful. n. (-लं) Eagerness, vehemence, impetuosity. 2 Desire, inclination. 3 Curiosity. E. कु bad, तूल to send forth, क affix, and ह inserted; or कुतू an oil bottle, and हल to make lines or furrows; or कु the earth, and तुद to vex or tease; the etymologies however are all fanciful; the word is also written कौतूहल.
कुतूहलिन्: कुतूहलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Curious, inquisitive. 2 Eager, impatient. E. कुतूहल, and इनि aff.
कुतृण: कुतृण n. (-णं) An aquatic plant, water house-leek, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. कु bad, तृण grass.
कुत्र: कुत्र ind. Where, wherein, in what place. E. कु substituted for किं what, and त्रल् aff.
कुत्रचित्: कुत्रचित् ind. Somewhere. E. चित् added to कुत्र.
कुत्रापि: कुत्रापि ind. Wherever, somewhere. E. कुत्र, and अपि certainly.
कुत्स: कुत्स r. 10th cl. (कुत्सयते-ति) To despise, to abuse, to revile.
कुत्सन: कुत्सन n. (-नं) Abuse, contempt, reproach, reviling. E. कुत्स to revile, ल्युट् aff.
कुत्सला: कुत्सला f. (-ला) The indigo plant: see नीली.
कुत्सा: कुत्सा f. (-त्सा) Reproach, contempt, censure. E. कुत्स to despise, अङ् and टाप् affs.
कुत्सावादिन्: कुत्सावादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Censorious, abusive. E. कुत्स, and वादिन् who speaks.
कुत्सित: कुत्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Low, vile, contemptible, contemned, reviled, &c. n. (-तं) A grass, (Cyperus.) E. कुत्स to reproach, &c., and क्त aff.
कुथ: कुथ r. 4th cl. (-कुथ्यति) To stink. r. 9th cl. (कुथ्नाति) 1 To be distressed: see कुन्थ. (इ) कुथि r. 1st cl. (कुंथति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To afflict, to give pain. 3 To be afflicted, to suffer pain.
कुथ mf. (-थः-था) A painted or variegated cloth or blanket, serving as an elephant's housings. m. (-थः) Sacrificial or Kusa grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) E. कुथ to be connected, &c. अच् aff.
कुद: कुद r. 10th cl. (ऋ) कुदृ (कोदयति) To lie, to speak falsely: see कुद्र.
कुदाल: कुदाल m. (-लः) 1 Mountain ebony. 2 A kind of spade: see कुद्दाल.
कुदृष्टि: कुदृष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Having bad eyes. f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Heterodox doctrine, as that of the Sāṃkhyas, &c. 2 Weak sight. 3 Evil eye. E. कु bad, दृष्टि sight.
कुद्दार: कुद्दार m. (-रः) See the next; sometimes also written कुदार.
कुद्दाल: कुद्दाल m. (-लः) 1 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) also काञ्चन. 2 A kind of spade or hoe. E. कु the earth, and दल to divide, with उत् prefixed, and अण् affix, or with दॄ to divide, कुद्दार; also कुदाल, &c.
कुद्मल: कुद्मल n. (-लं) An opening bud: see कुड्मल.
कुद्य: कुद्य n. (-द्यं) A wall: see कुद्य.
कुद्र: कुद्र r. 10th cl. (इ) कुद्रि (कुंद्रयति) To speak falsely, to lie: some read this root कुदृ.
कुद्रङ्ग: कुद्रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A dwelling raised on a platform or scaffold. It is sometimes written कुद्रङ्क. E. कु the earth, and द्रङ्ग what goes.
कुद्रव: कुद्रव m. (-वः) A kind of grass, the grain of which is eaten by the poor, (Paspalum scrobiculatum;) also कोद्रव. E. कु the earth, and द्रु to be fixed, अच् aff.
कुध्र: कुध्र m. (-ध्रः) A mountain. E. कु the earth, ध्रु to be fixed, affix ड.
कुनख: कुनख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Having ugly nails. n. (-खं) A disease of the nails. E. कु bad, and नख a nail; also with इनि added, कुनखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि.)
कुनखिन्: कुनखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Having bad or diseased nails. E. कुनख, and इनि aff.
कुनट: कुनट m. (-टः) A sort of trumpet flower. f. (-टी) 1 Red arsenic. 2 Coriander. E. कु the earth, and नट to dance, to be; also कुलटी.
कुनलिन्: कुनलिन् m. (-ली) A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora:) E. कु bad, नल a stalk, and इनि aff.
कुनाभि: कुनाभि m. (-भिः) 1 A whirlwind. 2 KUVERA'S aggregate treasure: see निधि. E. कु the world, and नाभि the navel.
कुनाशक: कुनाशक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Javāsa: see यवास. E. कु the earth, and नाशक what injures.
कुनीति: कुनीति f. (-तिः) 1 Impolicy, misgovernment. 2 Ill conduct, misbehaviour. E. कु bad, नीति policy.
कुन्त: कुन्त mf. (-न्तः-न्ती) 1 A bearded dart, a lance. m. (-न्तः) 1 A species of grain, (Coix barbata, Rox.) 2 A small animal, an insect. 3 Passionateness. f. (-न्तिः or -न्ती) 1 The wife of PĀṆḌU, and mother of the three elder PĀṆḌAVA princes by as many gods. 2 The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 3 Bdellium, a fragrant resin. 4 The wife of a Brahman. E. कु bad, and अन्त end, destroying ill, enemies, &c. or क the head, and उन्द to give pain, त substituted for द, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्.
कुन्तल: कुन्तल m. (-लः) 1 Hair. 2 A drinking cup. 3 Barley. 4 A plough. 5 The name of a country in the north-west of the peninsula. m. plu. (-लाः) The people of that country, the inhabitants of Kuntala. E. कुन्त a dart, and ला to bring or gain, क aff.
कुन्तलिका: कुन्तलिका f. (-का) A butter-knife or scoop. E. कुन्तल a cup, &c. and इकन् aff.
कुन्थ: कुन्थ r. 9th cl. (कुथ्नाति) 1 To cling to, to twine round or be connected with. 2 To be distressed. 3 To suffer pain, want, &c.: see कुथ.
कुन्थु: कुन्थु m. (-न्थुः) 1 The seventeenth of the Jinas or deified Jaina saints. 2 One of the Jaina emperors of the world.
कुन्द: कुन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) A kind of jasmin, (J. multiflorum or pubescens.) m. (-न्दः) 1 A turner's lathe. 2 Olibanum, the resin of the Boswellia thurifera: see कुन्दरु. 3 One of KUVERA'S nine treasures. 4 The Nerium plant. E. कु to sound, दन Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted, or कु the earth, उन्द to hurt, and अण् affix; also with कन् added कुन्दक.
कुन्दम: कुन्दम m. (-मः) A cat. E. कु vile, (animals, as mice,) and दम who tames.
कुन्दर: कुन्दर m. (-रः) A sort of grass.
कुन्दिनी: कुन्दिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. कुन्द the jasmin, and इनि affix, fem. affix ङीप्; an assemblage like that of Kunda flowers, from the similar whiteness of the lotus.
कुन्दु: कुन्दु f. (-न्दुः) Frankincense or olibanum: see कुन्दुरु. m. (-न्दुः) A rat, a mouse. E. कु the earth, and दृ to tear or divide, डु aff.
कुन्दुरु: कुन्दुरु mf. (-रुः) The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, gum olibanum or frankincense. E. क BRAHMĀ, उन्द to moisten, (to bedew with incense in sacrifice,) रु affix, उक् inserted. m. (-रुः) A rat: see कुन्दु.
कुन्दुरुक: कुन्दुरुक mf. (-कः-की) The olibanum tree, commonly Salaī or Salae, (Boswellia thurifera.) m. (-कः) The gum. E. कन् possessive or pleonastic added to कुन्दुरु, fem. affix ङीष्.
कुप: कुप (इर) कुपिर r. 4th cl. (कुप्यति) To be angry, to be flushed with wrath. With प्र, to be very much enraged. r. 10th cl. (कोपयति) 1 To shine: see कूप. 2 To speak. (इ) कुपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंपति कुंपयति) 1 To spread. 2 To remember.
कुपङ्क: कुपङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A slough, a heap of filth and mud. E. कु vile, पङ्क mud.
कुपथ: कुपथ n. (-थं) 1 A bad road. 2 Immorality, profligacy. 3 Heterodox doctrine. E. कु bad, and पथिन् a road; also कापथ.
कुपथगामिन्: कुपथगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Wicked, going in a bad or wrong road. E. कुपथ, and गामिन् who goes; also कुपथग, कुपथचर, &c.
कुपथ्य: कुपथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) 1 Relating to a bad road, literally or figuratively. 2 Counter-indicated, improper, unwholesome, (as regimen, &c.) E. कु and पथ्य proper, &c.
कुपाणि: कुपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Crooked-handed, having a deformed or maimed hand. E. कु bad, and पाणि the hand.
कुपित: कुपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Incensed, angry, offended. E. कुप to be angry, क्त aff.
कुपितवायु: कुपितवायु m. (-युः) Flatulence or hypochondria. E. कुपित, and वायु wind.
कुपितान्तक: कुपितान्तक m. (-कः) Imminent or threatening death. E. कुपित, and अन्तक destroyer.
कुपिनिन्: कुपिनिन् m. (-नी) A fisherman. E. कुपिनी a net, and इनि aff.
कुपिनी: कुपिनी f. (-नी) A kind of net or snare, for catching small fish, made of bamboos or rushes. E. गुप to cover or conceal, इनि and ङीष् affixes; ग is changed to क.
कुपिन्द: कुपिन्द m. (-न्दः) A weaver. E. कुप or कुय to spread out, किन्दच् Uṇādi affix; also कुयिन्द.
कुपीलु: कुपीलु m. (-लुः) A sort of ebony tree. E. कु bad, पीलु a tree, so called.
कुपुत्र: कुपुत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A son of an inferior degree, as one adopted, &c. 2 A disobedient or wicked son. E. कु, and पुत्र a son.
कुपुरुष: कुपुरुष m. (-षः) 1 A low or vile man. 2 A poltroon. E. कु bad, and पुरुष a man.
कुपूय: कुपूय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Inferior, low, vile. E. कु bad, and पूय to divide, अच् aff.
कुप्य: कुप्य n. (-प्यं) Base metal, copper, brass, &c. or any metal except gold and silver. E. गुप to conceal or preserve, क्यप् affix; ग is changed irregularly to क.
कुप्यशाला: कुप्यशाला f. (-ला) A braziery, a foundery, a place where metallic vessels, &c. are made or sold. E. कुप्य base metal, शाला a dwelling, a shop, &c.
कुप्रिय: कुप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Low, vile, last, worst. E. कु reverse, and प्रिय beloved; disagreeable.
कुप्लव: कुप्लव m. (-वः) A weak or frail raft or float. E. कु, and प्लव a raft.
कुब: कुब r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) कुबि (कुम्बति-कुम्बयति) To cover, to hide, to clothe, to screen, &c.
कुबेर: कुबेर m. (-रः) The deity KUVERA: see कुवेर.
कुब्ज: कुब्ज mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं) Humpbacked, crooked. m. (-ब्जः) 1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्ग. 2 A scymitar. 3 A sort of fish, (Bola cuja, HAM.) E. कु the earth, or कु ill, badly, and उज to be straight, affix अच्.
कुब्जक: कुब्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Humpbacked. m. (-कः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa:) see वारिकण्टक. E. क water, and उब्ज to be straight, affix अच्, and कन् added, or कुब्ज and कन् aff.
कुब्जकण्टक: कुब्जकण्टक m. (कः) A white mimosa. E. कुब्ज, and कण्टक a thorn.
कुब्र: कुब्र n. (-ब्रं) 1 A forest. 2 A hole for sacrificial fire. 3 An earring. 4 A thread. 5 A cart. E. कुबि to hide, रक् Uṇādi aff.
कुब्रह्म: कुब्रह्म m. (-ह्मः) A degraded or contemptible Brahman, one who officiates for Śūdras. E. कु bad, ब्रह्मन् a Brahman, टच् affix; also retaining the final, कुब्रह्मन्.
कुभ: कुभ r. 10th cl. (इ) कुभि (कुम्भयति) To cover, to clothe, to veil or hide: see कुब.
कुमार: कुमार r. 10th cl. (कुमारयति) To play, especially as a child; also कुमाल.

कुमार m. (-रः) 1 A boy, one under five years of age. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 3 A prince, the heir apparent, and who is associated to the empire, (in theatrical language.) 4 A horseman, a cavalier. 5 A parrot. 6 One of the attendants on the twenty-four Jinas, and also a sanctified character amongst the Jaina sect. 7 A tree, (Tapia crataeva:) see वरुण. 8 A name of the Sindhu river or Indus. n. (-रं) Pure gold. f. (-री) 1 A young girl, one from ten to twelve years old, a virgin; or in the Tantras any virgin to the age of sixteen, or as long as menstruation has not commenced. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 The central part of the universe according to Hindu geography, Jambu Dvīpa or India. 4 The most southerly of the nine portions of the known continent, or of Jambu Dvīpa, the southern extremity of the peninsula, whence Cape Comorin or Kumāri. 5 The name of a river flowing from the mountain Sactiman. 6 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता. 7 Double jasmin. 8 The aloe tree, (Aloes perfoliata:) see घृतकुमारी. 9 The Śyāmā, a bird so named. E. कुमार to play as a child, affix अच् fem. affix ङीष्.
कुमारक: कुमारक m. (-कः) 1 A boy, a lad. 2 A tree: see वरुण. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कुमारघातिन्: कुमारघातिन् m. (-ती) The slayer of a child. E. कुमार, हन to kill, णिनि aff.
कुमारपाल: कुमारपाल m. (-लः) 1 A name of Rājā SĀLIVĀHANA. 2 Name of a king of Guzerat. E. कुमार a child, and पाल a cherisher.
कुमारभृत्या: कुमारभृत्या f. (-त्या) Care of a pregnant or lying-in woman, midwifery. E. कुमार a child, and भृत्या cherishing.
कुमारयु: कुमारयु m. (-युः) A prince. E. कुमार a prince, या to go or be, and उ Uṇādi aff.
कुमारवाहिन्: कुमारवाहिन् m. (-ही) A peacock. E. कुमार KĀRTTIKEYA, and वाहिन् what bears; this god being usually represented riding on a peacock.
कुमारसू: कुमारसू f. (-सूः) A name of GAṄGĀ, the river goddess. E. कुमार the god KĀRTTIKEYA, and सू a mother.
कुमारिका: कुमारिका f. (-का) 1 A girl from ten to twelve years old, or generally a virgin. 2 Double jasmin. 3 A division of the known continent. 4 Large cardamoms. 5 An insect, (Sphex Asiatica:) see कुमारी, कन् being added.
कुमाल: कुमाल r. 10th cl. (कुमालयति) To play as a child, &c.: see कुमार.
कुमालक: कुमालक m. (-कः) The name of a district, part of Malva: also termed Sauvīra.
कुमुद्: कुमुद् mfn. (-त् or द्) 1 Niggardly, avaricious. 2 Unkind, unfriendly. n. (-त् or -द्) 1 The esculent white water lily. 2 The red lotus. E. कु the earth, or bad, vile, मुद to be pleased, and क्विप् affix; also कुमुद.
कुमुद: कुमुद n. (-दं) 1 The white esculent water lily, (Nymphaea esculenta.) 2 The red lotus, (N. rubra.) 3 Silver. m. (-दः) 1 The elephant of the south-west quarter. 2 One of the monkey heroes of the Rāmāyaṇa. 3 One of the Nāga or serpent race. 4 A Dānava or infernal deity. 5 Camphor. f. (-दा) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea:) see गम्भारी. (-दी) A medicinal and aromatic shrub, commonly Kāyaphal. E. कु the earth, &c. मुद to be pleased, and क aff.
कुमुदबान्धव: कुमुदबान्धव m. (-वः) The moon. E. कुमुद a lotus, and बान्धव the friend; the white esculent lotus expanding its petals during the night, and closing them in the day time; hence other similar appellations of the moon, as कुमुदवन्धु, कुमुदप्रिय, &c.
कुमुदवती: कुमुदवती f. (-ती) A place abounding in water lilies, &c. see कुमुद्धती.
कुमुदाकर: कुमुदाकर m. (-रः) A number of water lilies or place abounding with them. E. कुमुद, and आकर a mine; also कुमुदवनं, कुमुदिनी, &c.
कुमुदावास: कुमुदावास m. (-सः) A pool abounding in lotuses. E. कुमुद, and आवास a residence.
कुमुदिक: कुमुदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Abounding with water lilies. E. कुमुद, and ठच् aff.
कुमुदिका: कुमुदिका f. (-का) A small tree, the seeds of which are aromatic, commonly Kāyaphal: see कुमुदी, and कट्फल.
कुमुदिनी: कुमुदिनी f. (-नी) A place abounding in lotuses, &c. see कुमुद्धती. E. कुमुद, इनि and ङीष् aff.
कुमुदिनीपति: कुमुदिनीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. कुमुदिनी, and पति lord: see कुमुदबान्धव.
कुमुदेश: कुमुदेश m. (-शः) The moon: see कुमुदबान्धव. E. कुमुद, and ईश a master.
कुमुद्वत्: कुमुद्वत् mfn. (-द्वान्-द्वती-द्वत्) A place abounding in the flowers of the Nymphaea esculenta. f. (-ती) 1 The same. 2 A multitude of lotus flowers. 3 The flexible stalk of a water lily. 4 A sort of water lily, (Menyanthes Indica or cristata.) E. कुमुद the water lily, and मतुप् poss. affix, or वति affix of comparison, fem. ङीष्.
कुमेरु: कुमेरु m. (-रुः) The southern hemisphere or pole, the region of the demons and Titans. E. कु, and मेरु the mountain where the gods reside.
कुमोदक: कुमोदक m. (-कः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. कु the earth, मुद to delight, वुन् aff.
कुम्बा: कुम्बा f. (-म्बा) An enclosure round a place of sacrifice, to prevent profane intrusion. E. कुवि to cover, to screen or conceal, अङ् and टाप् affs.
कुम्भ: कुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A small water jar. 2 The frontal globe on the upper part of the forehead of an elephant; there are two of these projections, which swell in the rutting season. 3 A sign of the zodiac, (Aquarius.) 4 A proper name, the nephew of Rāvaṇa considered as a Rākṣasa or demon. 5 The paramour of a harlot, a bully, a flash or fancy man. 6 A religious exercise, closing the nostrils and mouth, so as to suspend breathing. 7 A measure of grain equal to twenty Droṇas, a little more than three bushels and three gallons, or a Comb: some make it two Droṇas or sixty-four Seers. n. (-भं) 1 A fragrant resin or the plant which bears it, (Bdellium.) 2 A plant commonly Teöri: see त्रिवृत्. f. (-म्भी) 1 A pot, an earthen cooking vessel, a small jar. 2 Kāyaphal, a small tree, the seeds of which are used in medicine: see कट्फल. 3 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 4 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) (-म्भा) A harlot, a whore. E. कु the earth, or base, vile, &c. उम्भ to fill, and अण् or अच् affix, deriv. irr.
कुम्भक: कुम्भक m. (-कः) Stopping the breath by shutting the mouth and closing both nostrils with the fingers of the right hand. E. कन् added to the last.
कुम्भकर्ण: कुम्भकर्ण m. (-णः) The gigantic brother of RĀVAṆA. E. कुम्भ, and कर्ण the ear.
कुम्भकामला: कुम्भकामला f. (-ला) A bilious affection, a sort of jaundice.
कुम्भकार: कुम्भकार m. (-रः) 1 A potter. 2 A kind of wild fowl. f. (-री) 1 A mineral substance, used as an application to strengthen the eyes and beautify the eye lashes. 2 Red arsenic. 3 The wife of a potter. E. कुम्भ a jar, &c. and कार what makes, from कृ to make, and अण् aff.
कुम्भकारक: कुम्भकारक m. (-कः) A potter. f. (-रिका) 1 Collyrium. 2 A woman of the potter caste. E. कन् added to the last.
कुम्भतुम्बी: कुम्भतुम्बी f. (-म्बी) A large round gourd. E. कुम्भ, and तुम्बी a gourd.
कुम्भदासी: कुम्भदासी f. (-सी) A bawd, a procuress. E. कुम्भ a bully, and दासी a female slave.
कुम्भपदी: कुम्भपदी f. (-दी) A woman with an enlarged leg. E. कुम्भ, and पद् for पाद a foot, fem. affix ङीष्.
कुम्भपाद: कुम्भपाद m. (-दः) A man with an enlarged leg. E. कुम्भ, and पाद a foot.
कुम्भयोनि: कुम्भयोनि m. (-निः) 1 A name of AGASTYA, a saint so called. 2 Also of VAŚIṢṬHA; and, 3 Of DROṆA, the military preceptor of the Kurus and Pāṇḍus. E. कुम्भ a jar, and यानि a womb; born in a water jar, &c.
कुम्भला: कुम्भला f. (-ला) A plant, the flowers of which are compared to those of the Nauclea cadamba: see मुण्डिरी.
कुम्भशाला: कुम्भशाला f. (-ला) A pottery, a potter's kiln. E. कुम्भ a jar, and शाला a hall, a shop.
कुम्भसन्धि: कुम्भसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) The hollow on the top of an elephant's head, between the frontal globes. E. कुम्भ the frontal globe, and सन्धि junction.
कुम्भसम्भव: कुम्भसम्भव m. (-वः) The saint AGASTYA: see अगस्त्य. E. कुम्भ a jar, and सम्भव born.
कुम्भाण्ड: कुम्भाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A minister of the Asura, BĀṆA. mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) A pumpkin gourd: see कुष्माण्ड.
कुम्भिका: कुम्भिका f. (-का) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 Trumpet flower. 3 A disease of the eyes, hordeolum or stye. E. कुम्भी as above, and कन् affix, in the fem. form.
कुम्भिन्: कुम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Having a water jar. 2 Shaped like a water jar, &c. E. कुम्भ, and इनि affix. m. (-म्भी) 1 An elephant. 2 A crocodile. 3 A fish. 4 A plant bearing a fragrant resin, Bdellium. E. कुम्भ as above, and इनि aff.
कुम्भिमद: कुम्भिमद m. (-दः) The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples at certain seasons. E. कुम्भि, and मद the exudation.
कुम्भिल: कुम्भिल m. (-लः) 1 A thief. 2 A plagiarist, a paraphrast. 3 A wife's brother. 4 A fish, the gilt-head. 5 A child begotten at undue seasons, or of an imperfect impregnation. E. कुम्भ as above, and इलच् aff.
कुम्भीक: कुम्भीक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, the bark of which furnishes a yellow dye, (Rottleria tinctoria:) see पुन्नाग. 2 An aquatic plant. 3 An affection of the eyes, hordeolum or stye: see कुम्भिका.
कुम्भीधान्य: कुम्भीधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain stored in jars sufficient, according to some, for six days, or to others for one year's consumption. E. कुम्भ, and धान्य grain, च्चि augment.
कुम्भीधान्यक: कुम्भीधान्यक m. (-कः) A householder, preserving grain in store for six days, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
कुम्भीनस: कुम्भीनस m. (-सः) A large, and venomous snake. f. (-सी) The mother of LAVANA, a Rākṣasa or fiend. E. कुम्भी a pitcher, and नस derived from नासा the nose; having wide nostrils.
कुम्भीपाक: कुम्भीपाक m. (-कः) A hell. E. कुम्भी a pot, and पाक what cooks: in which the wicked are baked like potterś vessels.
कुम्भीर: कुम्भीर m. (-रः) The crocodile of the Ganges, the long nosed alligator. E. कुम्भी an elephant, and ईर what resembles; or कुम्भी a fish, and र who seizes, from रा to take or gain: or ल from ला, whence also कुम्भील.
कुम्भीरमक्षिका: कुम्भीरमक्षिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of fly or aquatic insect. E. कुम्भीर a crocodile, and मक्षिका a fly, the crocodile fly, alluding, perhaps, to its size.
कुम्भील: कुम्भील m. (-लः) A crocodile: see कुम्भीर.
कुम्भीवीज: कुम्भीवीज n. (-जं) The nut of the croton.
कुरङ्कर: कुरङ्कर m. (-रः) The Indian crane. E. कुर to sound, क aff., a sound, and कर what makes; also कुरङ्कुर.
कुरङ्ग: कुरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A deer, an antelope. E. कुर to sound, अङ्गच् Uṇādi aff.
कुरङ्गक: कुरङ्गक m. (-कः) A deer. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कुरङ्गनयना: कुरङ्गनयना f. (-ना) A handsome woman. E. कुरङ्ग, and नयना the eye, fawn-eyed.
कुरङ्गम: कुरङ्गम m. (-मः) A deer, an antelope.
कुरट: कुरट m. (-टः) A currier, a leather-seller, a shoe-maker. E. कु bad, रट to speak, अच् affix; being described as a man of low occupation.
कुरण्टक: कुरण्टक m. (-कः) 1 Yellow amaranth. 2 Yellow barleria: see कुरुण्टक.
कुरण्ड: कुरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Enlargement of the testicles or rather of the scrotum, including inguinal hernia, hydrocele, &c. E. कु bad, ill, रम to play, and ड aff.
कुरण्डक: कुरण्डक m. (-कः) Yellow amaranth: see करुण्टक.
कुरर: कुरर f. (-रः-रा) An osprey; also another species of eagle. f. (-री) A sheep, an ewe. 2 A female osprey.
कुररीगण: कुररीगण m. (-णः) A flight of ospreys. E. कुररी, and गण a troop.
कुरल: कुरल m. (-लः) A curl, a lock of hair. 2 An osprey, see कुरुल.
कुरव: कुरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Having a bad voice. m. (-वः) 1 A bad or harsh sound. 2 Red or yellow amaranth: see कुरवक. E. कु bad or ill, and रव what sounds.
कुरवक: कुरवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a bad voice, making a disagreeable sound. m. (-कः) 1 A purple sort of Jhinti or Barleria. 2 A crimson species of amaranth. E. कु bad, रव to sound, क्वुन् aff.
कुरस: कुरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Bad-juiced, of bad essence. m. (-सः) Spirituous or vinous liquor. f. (-सा) A wild creeping plant, a species of hieracium: see गोजिह्वा. E. कु bad, and रस juice.
कुराल: कुराल m. (-लः) A light bay horse, with black legs.
कुरी: कुरी f. (-री) A kind of grass.
कुरीर: कुरीर n. (-रं) Copulation. E. कृ to do, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, उद् inserted.
कुरु: कुरु m. (-रुः) 1 Kuru or Uttara Kuru, the most northerly of the four Mahā Dvīpas, or principal divisions of the known world; by other systems it is considered as one of nine divisions or Varṣas of the same; in both cases it is the country beyond the northern-most range of mountains, extending to the frozen ocean. 2 A proper name, son of AGNĪDHRA, and grandson of PRIYAVRATA. 3 A proper name, a prince of the lunar race, son of SAṂVARAṆA by TAPATĪ; sovereign of the north-west of India or the country about Dehli, and ancestor of both PĀṆḌU and DHṚTARĀṢṬRA; the patronymic however derived from his name is most usually applied to the sons of the latter. 4 A holy place: see कुरुक्षेत्र. 5 Boiled rice. 6 Pricklynightshade: see कण्टकारिका. E. कृ to make, कु affix, and ऋ becomes उ.
कुरुक्षेत्र: कुरुक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) The country near Dehli, the scene of the great battle between the Kurus and Pāṇḍus. E. कुरु the Kuru race, and क्षेत्र a field.
कुरुक्षेत्रीयोग: कुरुक्षेत्रीयोग m. (-गः) A solar day, in the course of which three lunar days, three asterisms and three Yogas occur. E. कुरुक्षेत्र, and योम conjunction.
कुरुण्ट: कुरुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) 1 Yellow amaranth. 2 Yellow Barleria. f. (-ण्टी) 1 A doll, a puppet. 2 The wife of a Brahman or teacher. E. कु bad, रुटि to shine, affix अण्.
कुरुण्टक: कुरुण्टक m. (-कः) 1 Yellow or white amaranth. 2 A yellow species of Barleria, (B. prionitis.) E. कु bad, रुटि to shine, &c. ण्वुल् affix; also कुरण्टक.
कुरुम्ब: कुरुम्ब n. (-म्बं) A large species of orange. f. (-म्बा) Trumpet flower.
कुरुराज्: कुरुराज् m. (-ट्) A name of DURYODHANA. E. कुरु the Kuru race, राज to shine, and क्विप् affix; the Kuru chief.
कुरुरी: कुरुरी f. (-री) A kind of bird with a warbling note.
कुरुल: कुरुल m. (-लः) A curl or lock of hair, especially on the forehead.
कुरुवक: कुरुवक m. (-कः) 1 The crimson amaranth. 2 A purple species of Barleria. 3 Also a yellow kind. E. कु a little, रु to sound, क्वुन् affix, and उवङ् substituted for उ.
कुरुविन्द: कुरुविन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 2 A kind of barley: see कल्माष. 3 A ruby: see कुरुविल्ल. 4 Black salt. E. कुरु Kurudeśa, विन्द to gain, and शः affix; found in that country.
कुरुविन्दक: कुरुविन्दक m. (-कः) A kind of Dolichos biflorus, a wild variety.
कुरुविल्ल: कुरुविल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A ruby; also कुरुविल्व, and कुरुविन्द.
कुरुविल्व: कुरुविल्व m. (-ल्वः) A ruby; also कुरुविन्द.
कुरुविस्त: कुरुविस्त m. (-स्तः) A Pala of gold, a weight of gold equal to about 700 Troy grains. E. कुरु the country, and विस्त, abundant; abounding in Kurudeśa.
कुरूप: कुरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Ugly, ill made, deformed. n. (-षं) Ugliness. E. कु, and रूप form.
कुरूपता: कुरूपता f. (-ता) Ugliness. E. तल् added to the last; also कुरूपत्वं.
कुरूपिन्: कुरूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Ugly, ill made, frightful, deformed. E. कुरूप, and इनि aff.
कुरूप्य: कुरूप्य n. (-प्यं) Tin. E. कु base, रूप्य silver.
कुर्कुर: कुर्क्कुर mf. (-रः-री) A dog or bitch. E. कुर् instead of कु bad, prefixed to कु to sound, and रक् affix: see कुक्कुर.
कुर्क्कुर: कुर्क्कुर mf. (-रः-री) A dog or bitch. E. कुर् instead of कु bad, prefixed to कु to sound, and रक् affix: see कुक्कुर.
कुर्द: कुर्द r. 1st cl. (कूर्दते or कुर्दते) To play; also कूर्द.
कुर्दन: कुर्द्दन n. (-नं) Play, playing, sport: see कूर्दन.
कुर्द्दन: कुर्द्दन n. (-नं) Play, playing, sport: see कूर्दन.
कुर्पर: कुर्पर m. (-रः) 1 The knee. 2 The elbow; also कूर्पर.
कुर्पास: कुर्पास m. (-सः) A sort of bodice or jacket: see कूर्पास; also with कन् added कुर्पासक.
कुर्वाण: कुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Doing, making. E. कृ to make, शानच् aff.
कुर्व्वाण: कुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Doing, making. E. कृ to make, शानच् aff.
कुर्वत्: कुर्व्वत् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वन्ती-र्व्वत) 1 Doing, acting, an agent. 2 A servant. E. कृ to do, शतृ aff.
कुर्व्वत्: कुर्व्वत् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वन्ती-र्व्वत) 1 Doing, acting, an agent. 2 A servant. E. कृ to do, शतृ aff.
कुर्व्वत्रूप: कुर्व्वत्रूप n. (-पं) Cause according to the Cārvākas. E. कुर्व्वत्, and रुप nature.
कुल: कुल r. 1st cl. (कोलति) 1 To accumulate. 2 To be of kin, to act as of kin. 3 To flow homogeneously. 4 To count. With आङ् prefixed, to be attentive; with वि and आङ् to be bewildered, flurried or distressed.

कुल n. (-लं) 1 Family, race, tribe or caste. 2 A herd, a flock, &c. of animals of the same species. 3 An inhabited country. 4 A house, an abode. 5 The body. 6 The front or fore part. 7 A blue stone: see कुलत्थ. m. (-लः) An artist of celebrated descent. f. (-लिः or -ली) A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी, &c. (-ली) A wife's elder sister. E. कुल to accumulate, क affix, or कुङ् to sound, and लक् affix, or कु the earth, and ल who takes or possesses, from ला with ड aff.
कुलक: कुलक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Of a good family, of eminent birth. m. (-कः) 1 A species of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa, Rox.) see काकेन्दु. 2 An artist of eminent birth. 3 An ant or mole hill. 4 A green snake. n. (-कं) 1 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes diaeca.) 2 The connexion of several stanzas, protraction of the government of the noun or verb through several verses, contrary to the practice of closing the sense with each verse. E. कन् added to the preceding, or कुल race, and क who sounds, declares, &c.
कुलकन्या: कुलकन्या f. (-न्या) A girl of good family. E. कुल, and कन्या a maiden.
कुलकर्मन्: कुलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The proper duty of a race or family, any observance customarily held by one. E. कुल, and कर्म्म act; also कुलक्रिया and कुलकार्य्य.
कुलकर्म्मन्: कुलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The proper duty of a race or family, any observance customarily held by one. E. कुल, and कर्म्म act; also कुलक्रिया and कुलकार्य्य.
कुलक्क: कुलक्क m. (-क्कः) Beating time in music.
कुलक्षय: कुलक्षय m. (-यः) Decay or disappearance of a family. f. (-या) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. कुल the body, and क्षय injurious.
कुलगिरि: कुलगिरि m. (-रिः) A mountain, any one of the seven principal mountains of Bhārata Varṣa. E. कुल, and गिरि mountain: see कुलाचल.
कुलङ्गी: कुलङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A thorny plant: see कर्कटशृङ्गी.
कुलज: कुलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Well-born, of a good family. 2 Ancestral, hereditary. E. कुल, and ज born; also कुलजात, कुलोत्पन्न, and similar compounds.
कुलञ्जन: कुलञ्जन m. (-नः) An aromatic plant, (Alpinia galanga;) also कुलञ्ज and गन्धमूल.
कुलट: कुलट m. (-टः) Any son except the one begotten, as one adopted, bought, &c. f. (-टा) An unchaste woman. E. कुल race, and अट who goes, deriv. irr.; by whom the family honour is injured.
कुलटापति: कुलटापति m. (-तिः) The husband of an unchaste woman, a cuckold. E. कुलटा, and पति husband.
कुलतिथि: कुलतिथि mf. (-थिः) The fourth, eighth, twelfth, or fourteenth lunar day. E. कुल, and तिथि a lunation, respectable days.
कुलतिलक: कुलतिलक m. (-कः) The chief of a family, one who does honour to a family. E. कुल, and तिलक frontal mark.
कुलत्थ: कुलत्थ m. (-त्थः) A kind of pulse, (Dolichos biflorus.) f. (-त्था) 1 A blue stone used in medicine, and applied as a collyrium to the eyes; also as an astringent to sores, &c. 2 A wild kind of Dolichos. E. कुल a bank, and स्था to stand or stay, affix ड.
कुलत्थिका: कुलत्थिका f. (-का) 1 A blue stone used as a collyrium, &c. 2 A sort of vetch, considered as a wild sort of the Dolichos biflorus. E. see the preceding, कन् added to कुलत्थ in the fem. form.
कुलधर्म: कुलधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Practice or observance peculiar to a tribe or family, peculiar duty of caste or race. E. कुल family, and धर्म्म virtue.
कुलधर्म्म: कुलधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Practice or observance peculiar to a tribe or family, peculiar duty of caste or race. E. कुल family, and धर्म्म virtue.
कुलधारक: कुलधारक m. (-कः) A son. E. कुल a race, and धृ to hold, in the causal form, वुन् affix; upholding a family.
कुलनक्षत्र: कुलनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) Any propitious asterism. E. कुल, and नक्षत्र asterism.
कुलनायिका: कुलनायिका f. (-का) A girl who is worshipped at the celebration of the orgies of the left hand Śāktas. E. कुल society, and नायिका a female.
कुलनारी: कुलनारी f. (-री) A woman of good family. E. कुल, and नारी a woman.
कुलनाश: कुलनाश m. (-शः) 1 A camel. 2 A reprobate, an outcaste. E. कुल a family, नाश who hurts or destroys.
कुलनिन्दा: कुलनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Family disgrace. E. कुल, and निन्दा reproach.
कुलपति: कुलपति m. (-तिः) Head or chief of a family. E. कुल a family, and पति master.
कुलपर्वत: कुलपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A principal mountain of India, any one of seven so considered: see कुलाचल. E. कुल, and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as कुलगिरि, कुलशैल, &c.
कुलपर्व्वत: कुलपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A principal mountain of India, any one of seven so considered: see कुलाचल. E. कुल, and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as कुलगिरि, कुलशैल, &c.
कुलपालक: कुलपालक mfn. (-लकः-लिका-लकं) Nourishing or providing for a family. n. (-कं) A kind of orange. E. कुल a race, &c. पाल to nourish, and वुन् aff.
कुलपालि: कुलपालि f. (-लिः) A chaste woman. E. कुल race, and पाल who nourishes, इन् fem. affix; also कुलपालिका and कुलपाली.
कुलबधू: कुलबधू f. (-धूः) A virtuous or respectable woman. E. कुल, and बधू a wife.
कुलभृत्या: कुलभृत्या f. (-त्या) A midwife, a nurse. E. कुल family, and भृत्या a servant.
कुलभ्रष्ट: कुलभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Expelled from a family. E. कुल, and भ्रष्ट fallen from.
कुलमर्यादा: कुलमर्य्यादा f. (-दा) Family honour or respectability. E. कुल, and मर्य्यादा propriety.
कुलमर्य्यादा: कुलमर्य्यादा f. (-दा) Family honour or respectability. E. कुल, and मर्य्यादा propriety.
कुलमित्र: कुलमित्र m. (-त्रं) A friend of the family. E. कुल, and मित्र a friend.
कुलम्भर: कुलम्भर m. (-रः) A thief: see कुजम्भल.
कुलयोषित्: कुलयोषित् f. (-त्) A virtuous woman. E. कुल, and योषित् a woman.
कुलवार: कुलवार m. (-रः) Tuesday or Friday. E. कुल, and वार a day.
कुलविप्र: कुलविप्र m. (-प्रः) The family priest. E. कुल race, and विप्र a Brahman.
कुलव्यापिन्: कुलव्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Attaching or applicable to tribe or caste. E. कुल, and व्यापिन् prevailing.
कुलश्रेष्ठिन्: कुलश्रेष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) 1 An artificer or artist of eminent birth. 2 Well-born, of good family. 3 Eminent in a family. E. कुल race, and श्रेष्ठ best, poss. affix इनि.
कुलसङ्ख्या: कुलसङ्ख्या f. (-ङ्ख्या) Ranking or being reckoned as a family, family respectability. E. कुल, and सङ्ख्या enumeration.
कुलसन्तति: कुलसन्तति f. (-तिः) Posterity, descendants. E. कुल, and सन्तति continuance.
कुलसन्निधि: कुलसन्निधि f. (-धिः) 1 Kindred, relations. 2 Presence of witnesses. E. कुल, and सन्निधि proximity.
कुलसम्भव: कुलसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Sprung from family. E. कुल race, and सम्भव born, produced.
कुलसौरभ: कुलसौरभ n. (-भं) A plant, commonly Marüa: see मरुवक.
कुलस्थिति: कुलस्थिति f. (-तिः) Antiquity or prosperity of a family. E. कुल, and स्थिति duration.
कुलस्त्री: कुलस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) 1 A chaste woman. 2 A woman of a good family, a respectable woman. E. कुल a family, and स्त्री a woman.
कुलहण्डक: कुलहण्डक m. (-कः) An eddy: see कूलहण्डक.
कुलाकुल: कुलाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of mixed origin of a mixed character. E. कुल propitious, and आकुल bewildered, or कुल with a neg. prefix.
कुलाकुलतिथि: कुलाकुलतिथि mf. (-थिः) The second, sixth or tenth lunar days. E. कुलाकुल, and तिथि a lunation.
कुलाकुलनक्षत्र: कुलाकुलनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) An asterism of mixed character, as Vāruṇī, Ārdrā, Mūla and Abhijit. E. कुलाकुल, and नक्षत्र asterism.
कुलाकुलवार: कुलाकुलवार m. (-रः) Wednesday. E. कुलाकुल, and वार a day.
कुलाचल: कुलाचल m. (-लः) A mountain, one of a class of seven principal mountains, which are supposed to exist in each Varṣa or division of a continent: those of Bhārata Varṣa or India are Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimān, Ṛkṣa, Vindhya, and Pāripātra. E. कुल a race, and अचल a mountain; also कुलाद्रि, &c.
कुलाचार: कुलाचार m. (-रः) The proper duty or practice of a caste or family. E. कुल, and आचार observance.
कुलाचार्य: कुलाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A family priest. 2 A genealogist. E. कुल, and आचार्य्य teacher.
कुलाचार्य्य: कुलाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A family priest. 2 A genealogist. E. कुल, and आचार्य्य teacher.
कुलाट: कुलाट m. (-टः) A small fish. E. कुल for कूल a bank, and अट who goes; burrowing in the sand and mud.
कुलाधारक: कुलाधारक m. (-कः) A son. E. see कुलधारक, आङ् being here inserted signifying extension.
कुलाभिमान: कुलाभिमान n. (-नं) Pride of birth, family pride. E. कुल, and अभिमान pride.
कुलाभिमानिन्: कुलाभिमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Proud of birth or of family descent. E. कुल, and अमिमानिन् proud.
कुलाय: कुलाय m. (-यः) 1 A nest. 2 A place, a spot in general. n. (-यं) The body. E. कुल family, and अय to go, अच् aff.
कुलायनिलाय: कुलायनिलाय m. (-यः) Sitting in a nest, brooding. E. कुलाय, and निलाय abiding.
कुलायनिलायिन्: कुलायनिलायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Brooding, hatching, (as a bird.) E. कुलाय, and निलायिन् who abides in.
कुलायनिलायिता: कुलायनिलायिता f. (-ता) The act or condition of hatching, &c. E. तल् added to the last.
कुलायस्थ: कुलायस्थ m. (-स्थः) A bird. E. कुलाय a nest, and स्थ who abides.
कुलायिका: कुलायिका f. (-का) An aviary. E. कुलाय a nest, and कन् affix in the fem. form.
कुलाल: कुलाल m. (-लः) 1 A potter. 2 A wild cock. f. (-ली) A species of blue stone, applied as a collyrium to the eyes. 2 The wife of a potter. E. कुल to accumulate, and कालन Uṇādi affix, or कुल family, अल to adorn, &c. अण् and ङीप् or ङीष् affs.
कुलालम्बिन्: कुलालम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) Supporting or maintaining a family. E. कुल, and आलम्बिन् what upholds.
कुलाह: कुलाह m. (-हः) A horse of a light brown colour, with black knees.
कुलाहल: कुलाहल m. (-लः) A small tree, (Conyza terebinthina.)
कुलि: कुलि m. (-लिः) A hand. f. (-लिः) A prickly nightshade: see कुल. E. कुल to accumulate, &c. कि aff.
कुलिक: कुलिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of a good family, well-born. m. (-कः) One of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent race, described as having a half moon on the top of his head, and being of a monkey hue. 2 An artist or artificer of eminent birth. 3 A thorny plant, (Ruellia longifolia.) 4 The chief or headman of a tribe or caste. E. कुल family, &c. कन् affix, and इ substituted for अ.
कुलिकवेला: कुलिकवेला f. (-ला) Certain portions of each day, on which it is improper to begin any business. E. कुलिक, and वेला time.
कुलिङ्ग: कुलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The fork-tailed shrike; also कलिङ्ग.
कुलिर: कुलिर m. (-रः) A crab; also कुलीर.
कुलिश: कुलिश mn. (-शः-शं) 1 The thunderbolt of INDRA. 2 A kind of fish. E. कुलि for कुल a bank, and श what rests, from शीङ् to sleep. &c. and क aff.
कुलिशभृत्: कुलिशभृत् m. (-भृत्) INDRA. E. कुलिश, and भृत् who has.
कुलिशाङ्कुशा: कुलिशाङ्कुशा f. (-शा) A kind of female deity. E. कुलिश the thunderbolt, and अङ्कुश a goad.
कुलिशासन: कुलिशासन m. (-नः) A name of Śākya, a Buddha or Bauddha saint.
कुलीन: कुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Well-born, of high or eminent descent, of a good family. m. (-नः) 1 A horse of a good breed. 2 A Brahman of one of the twenty-two Rārhiya divisions of the five principal tribes, as established by Balāl Sen king of Beṅgal. 3 A worshipper of ŚAKTI, according to the left hand ritual: see कौलीन. E. कुल a family, and ख aff.
कुलीनक: कुलीनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of a good family. m. (-कः) A kind of wild kidney bean. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कुलीनता: कुलीनता f. (-ता) Birth, rank, family respectability. E. कुलीन, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कुलीनत्वं.
कुलीर: कुलीर mf. (-रः-रं) A crab. E. कुल to accumulate, and ईरन् affix; also कुलिर.
कुलीरशृङ्गी: कुलीरशृङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant: see कर्क्कटशृङ्गी.
कुलीराद्: कुलीराद् m. (-द् or त्) A young crab. E. कुलीर a crab, and अद to eat, affix क्विप्; destroying its parent; the old crab being supposed to perish on producing young.
कुलीश: कुलीश mn. (-शः-शं) INDRA'S thunderbolt: see कुलिश.
कुलुक: कुलुक n. (-कं) The fur or foulness of the tongue. E. कुल to accumulate, and उक aff.
कुलेश्वर: कुलेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The chief of a family or race. E. कुल a race, ईश्वर lord.
कुलोत्कट: कुलोत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) High-born. m. (-टः) A horse of a good breed. E. कुल race, and उत्कट eminent.
कुलोत्कर्ष: कुलोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Family respectability. E. कुल, and उत्कर्ष excellence.
कुलोद्गत: कुलोद्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Of good family. E. कुल, and उद्गत exalted.
कुलोत्पन्न: कुलोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Of a good family, well-born. 2 Family, belonging to, inherited by, &c. E. कुल, and उत्पन्न born.
कुलोद्भव: कुलोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Well-born, of good family. 2 Produced in a family. E. कुल, and उद्भव birth.
कुलोद्भूत: कुलोद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-born, of family. E. कुल, and उद्भूत born.
कुलोद्वह: कुलोद्वह m. (-हः) A chief, a leader, the head of a family. E. कुल, and उद्वह who upholds.
कुल्फ: कुल्फ mn. (-ल्फः-ल्फं) A disease. m. (-ल्फः) The ancle; also गुल्फ. E. कल to count, फ Uṇādi affix, and उ inserted.
कुल्मल: कुल्मल n. (-लं) Sin. E. कुष to extract, क्मलन् Uṇādi affix, and ष changed to ल.
कुल्माष: कुल्माष mn. (-षः-षं) Sour gruel prepared by the spontaneous fermentation of the water of boiled rice. n. (-षं) 1 Half ripe barley. 2 Forced rice. 3 A sort of Phaseolus: see राजमाष. 4 A species of Dolichos, (D. biflorus.) see यावक. 5 A disease. m. (-षः) A dish consisting of half boiled rice, with pulse, &c. commonly Khicri. E. कुल a class or race, मष or मस to hurt or kill, अण् affix; hence the word is also written कुल्मास.
कुल्माषाभिसुत: कुल्माषाभिसुत n. (-तं) Sour gruel. see कुल्मास.
कुल्य: कुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Of a good family, well-born, well descended. 2 Of or relating to a family or race. m. (-ल्यः) A counsellor. f. (-ल्या) 1 A river in general. 2 A canal, a channel for irrigation. 3 A ditch, a dyke or trench. 4 A drug or medicinal plant, (Celtis orientalis:) see जीवन्ती. 5 A chaste or virtuous woman. n. (-ल्यं) 1 A bone. 2 A measure of eight Droṇas: see द्रोण. 3 A winnowing basket. 4 Flesh. 5 Friendly inquiry after family affairs or domestic accidents, condolence, congratulation, &c. E. कुल to accumulate, and यत् affix, &c.
कुल्वक: कुल्वक n. (-कः) Fur upon the tongue.
कुव: कुव n. (-वं) A water lily, a lotus.
कुवङ्ग: कुवङ्ग n. (-ङ्गः) Lead. E. कु bad, and वङ्ग tin.
कुवच: कुवच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Abusive, censorious, detracting. E. कु bad, वच to speak, क aff.
कुवज्रक: कुवज्रक n. (-कं) Crystal, a stone resembling a diamond. E. कु inferior, वज्र the diamond, कन् aff.
कुवद: कुवद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Censorious. E. कु bad, वद to speak, क aff.
कुवर: कुवर m. (-रः) An astringent taste: see तुवर.
कुवल: कुवल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) 1 The jujube, the tree. 2 The fruit. n. (-लं) 1 A water lily. 2 A pearl. E. कु the earth, and वल to cover, affix अच्; see the next.
कुवलय: कुवलय n. (-यः) 1 Any water lily. 2 The blue lotus. E. कु the earth, वल to cover, and कयन् affix; also कुवल, and कुव.
कुवलयिनी: कुवलयिनी f. (-नी) A place abounding in water lilies. E. कुवलय, and इनि aff.
कुवलाश्व: कुवलाश्व m. (-श्वः) A proper name of a king; also घुन्धुमार.
कुवाद: कुवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Detracting, censorious. E. कु evil, वद to speak, अण् aff.
कुविन्द: कुविन्द m. (-न्दः) A weaver. E. कुप to spread, किन्दच् Uṇādi affix, and प changed to व; also कुपिन्द.
कुविवाह: कुविवाह m. (-हः) A degrading or improper marriage. E. कु, and विवाह marriage.
कुवृत्तिकृत्: कुवृत्तिकृत् m. (-कृत्) A plant, (Caesalpinia bonduccella:) see पूतिक.
कुवेणी: कुवेणी f. (-णी) 1 A fish basket. 2 An ill braided tress of hair. 3 A woman with her hair ill braided. E. कु bad, वेण to go, घञ् affix, and ङीष् fem. affix; also with टाप् or इन् affixed, कुवेणा and कुवेणि.
कुवेर: कुवेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Deformed, monstrous. 2 Slow, lazy. m. (-रः) KUVERA the son of VISRAVAS by IḌAVIḌĀ, the chief of the Yakṣas, god of wealth and regent of the north. E. कु vile, and वेर body, alluding to the deformity of the god, who is represented as having three legs and but eight teeth. 2 The Tūn tree: see नन्दिवृक्ष. 3 One of the attendants of a Jaina saint. E. as above, or कुवि to cover, &c. and एरच् Uṇādi affix; in this case the word may be read कुबेर.
कुवेरक: कुवेरक m. (-कः) The Tūn tree, (Cedrela tunna.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
कुवेराक्षी: कुवेराक्षी f. (-क्षी) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. कुवेर, and अक्षि the eye.
कुवेराचल: कुवेराचल m. (-लः) Mount Kailāsa. E. कुवेर, and अचल a mountain; the capital of KUVERA, being situated in Kailāsa, which is supposed to be in the Himālaya range.
कुवेराद्रि: कुवेराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) See the preceding. E. as above, अद्रि being a mountain.
कुवेल: कुवेल n. (-लं) Any water lily. E. कु the earth, बेल to shake, अच् affix: see कुवलय.
कुव्र: कुव्र n. (-व्रं) A forest or wood.
कुश: कुश (इर) कुशिर r. 4th cl. (कुश्यति) 1 To embrace, to enfold. 2 To take out or from. (इः) कुशि r. 1st and 10th cl. (कुंशति कुंशयति) To shine: see कुस.

कुश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Wicked, depraved. 2 Mad, inebriate. mn. (-शः-श) A species of grass used in many solemn and religious observances, hence called sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) m. (-शः) 1 The yoke of a plough. 2 A proper name, one of the sons of RĀMA. 3 One of the great Dvīpas or divisions of the universe, surrounded by the sea of spirituous liquor. f. (-शा) 1 A rope. 2 A plant, commonly Maükāṭha. n. (-शं) Water. (-शी) 1 A ploughshare. 2 Wrought iron. mf. (-शः-शी) A bridle, a horse's head rope. E. कु the earth, शीङ् to sleep or rest, and ड affix, or कु bad, and शो to destroy, again कुश to embrace or to enfold, and क aff.
कुशय: कुशय m. (-यः) A drinking vessel, a cup, a goblet. E. कुश to extract, and अय Uṇādi aff.
कुशपुष्प: कुशपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla.
कुशल: कुशल mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं) 1 Happy, well, right. 2 Expert, skilful. 3 Clever. 4 Eloquent. n. (-लं) 1 Adequacy, ability. 2 Virtue, virtuous action. 3 Well-being, happiness. E. कु the earth, and शल to go, affix अच्; also कुषल and कुसल.
कुशलता: कुशलता f. (-ता) 1 Cleverness, ability. 2 Eloquence. 3 Wellbeing. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कुशलत्वं.
कुशलप्रश्न: कुशलप्रश्न m. (-श्नः) Salutation, greeting, friendly inquiry respecting a person's health or welfare. E. कुशल well-being, and प्रश्न asking.
कुशलव: कुशलव du. m. (-वौ) The two sons of RĀMA, or KUŚA and LAVA.
कुशलव m. (-वः) A bundle of Kuśa grass. E. कुश, and स्तव a cluster.
कुशलबुद्धि: कुशलबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Wise, able, intelligent. E. कुशल, and बुद्धि understanding.
कुशलिन्: कुशलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Auspicious, favourable. 2 Virtuous, good. 3 Happy, prosperous. 4 Clever. E. कुशल, and इनि aff.
कुशवारि: कुशवारि n. (-रि) Water in which Kusa grass has been boiled. E. कुश, and वारि water.
कुशस्थल: कुशस्थल nf. (-लं-ली) The country of Kanyakubja or Kanouj. f. (-ली) The residence of KṚṢṆA: see द्वारका. 2 A name of Oujein or Avanti during the Tretā Yuga or second age. E. कुश sacred grass, and स्थल place; abounding in Kuśa grass.
कुशाकर: कुशाकर m. (-रः) Fire. E. कुश the grass, &c. आकर a mine; the sacrificial fire being made upon a tuft of this grass.
कुशाक्ष: कुशाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A monkey, an ape.
कुशाग्र: कुशाग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Sharp, shrewd, intelligent. m. (-ग्रं) The sharp point of the Kusa grass. E. कुश, and अग्र point.
कुशाग्रबुद्धि: कुशाग्रबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Sharp, shrewd, intelligent. f. (-द्धिः) Shrewdness, subtlety. E. कुशाग्र, and बुद्धि understanding; also similar compounds, कुशाग्रधी, कुशाग्रीयमति, &c.
कुशाग्रीय: कुशाग्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Subtile, penetrating: see the next. E. कुश the grass, अग्र point, and छ, affix; implying resemblance.
कुशाग्रीयमति: कुशाग्रीयमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Inspecting minutely, subtile, sharp sighted, intelligent, possessing mental acumen. E. कुश the grass, अग्रीय point, and मति mind; also other similar compounds, as कुशाग्रीयधी, कुशाग्रीयबुद्धि, &c.
कुशाङ्गुरीय: कुशाङ्गुरीय n. (-यं) A ring of Kusa grass, worn at religious ceremonies. E. कुश, and अङ्गुरीय a ring; also कुशाङ्गुरीयकं.
कुशाल्मलि: कुशाल्मलि m. (-लिः) A tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.) E. कु, and शाल्मलि silk cotton tree.
कुशारणि: कुशारणि m. (-णिः) The name of a sage celebrated for his irascibility: see दुर्व्वास. E. कुश the grass, and अरणि wood whose attrition produces fire; using Kusa for this purpose.
कुशासन: कुशासन n. (-नं) A seat of Kuśa grass. E. कुश, and आसन a seat.
कुशिंशपा: कुशिंशपा f. (-पा) A kind of Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) E. कु inferior, and शिंशपा the Sisu tree.
कुशिक: कुशिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Squint-eyed. m. (-कः) 1 A Muni or divine sage so named, the father of JAMADAGNI. 2 A ploughshare. 3 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) 4 Beleric myrobalan: see विभीतक. 5 The sediment of oil. E. कुश the grass, &c. इकन् aff.
कुशित: कुशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed, combined with water, &c. E. कुश or कुष to embrace, to mix, and इतच् Uṇādi affix; hence also कुषित.
कुशिन्: कुशिन् m. (-शी) A name of VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa. E. कुश the son of RĀMA, affix इनि; the poem is supposed to be recited by KUSA and LAVA, the sons of the hero.
कुशीद: कुशीद n. (-दं) 1 The profession of usury. 2 Red saunders: see कुमीद.
कुशील: कुशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Ill-behaved. rude, wicked. 2 Evil disposed, ill-tempered. E. कु, and शील temper, conduct.
कुशीलता: कुशीलता f. (-ता) 1 Misbehaviour, misconduct. 2 Bad disposition, ill-temper. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, कुशीलत्वं.
कुशीलव: कुशीलव n. (-वः) 1 An actor, a dancer, a mime. 2 A bard, a herald. 3 A newsmonger. E. कु bad, शील practice, and वः affix, from वा to go, &c. with क affix, du. m. (-वौ) The two sons of RĀMA: see कुशलव.
कुशीवश: कुशीवश m. (-शः) A name of VĀLMĪKI: see कुशिन्.
कुशूल: कुशूल m. (-लः) A granary, a cupboard, a place in which rice or other grain is kept. 2 Conflagration of chaff. E. कुश to enfold, कूल affix; also कुसूल.
कुशूलधान्य: कुशूलधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain stored for three year's consumption. E. कुशूल, and धान्य grain.
कुशूलधान्यक: कुशूलधान्यक m. (-कः) A householder, &c. who has three year's grain in store. E. कुशूलधान्य, and कन् aff.
कुशेशय: कुशेशय n. (-यं) A lotus in general. m. (-यः) 1 A tree, commonly Kaniyār: see कर्णिकार. 2 The Indian crane. E. कुश water, in the seventh case, शीङ् to sleep or rest, with the affix अच्.
कुशोत्तर: कुशोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having, or being covered with grass. E. कुश and उत्तर beyond.
कुशोदक: कुशोदक n. (-कं) Water in which Kusa grass has been infused. E. कुश, and उदक water.
कुष: कुष r. 9th cl. (कुष्णाति) 1 To expel, to force or draw out, to extract 2 To test, to assay. 3 To shine. With अव, to prove, to display; with निर्, to extract.
कुषल: कुषल mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं) Clever, expert, skilful: see कुशल.
कुषाकु: कुषाकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) 1 Burning, scorching, inflaming. 2 Wicked, detestable. m. (-कुः) 1 A monkey. 2 The sun. 3 Fire. E. कुष to shine, काकु Uṇādi affix; also कुषाकु.
कुषित: कुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed with water, &c. see कुशित. n. (-त) Happy, well, right, fortunate, auspicious, &c.
कुषीद: कुषीद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Indifferent, apathetic, inert. n. (-दं) Usury: see कुसीद. E. कु vile, षद to move, &c. अच् aff.
कुष्ठ: कुष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) 1 Leprosy, of which eighteen varieties are enumerated, seven great or severe, and eleven of minor importance. 2 A plant, a kind of costus, (Costus speciosus:) 3 A sort of poison. E. कुष to extract, and क्थन् Uṇādi affix, or कु bad, ill, and स्थ being, staying.
कुष्ठघ्न: कुष्ठघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A medicinal plant, commonly Hiyāvali: see हितावली. f. (-घ्नी) 1 An esculent root, (Solanum Indicum.) see काकमाची. 2 Opposite leaved fig tree; also काकोडुम्बरिका. E. कुष्ठ the leprosy, and घ्न what destroys.
कुष्ठनाशन: कुष्ठनाशन m. (-नः) 1 White mustard. 2 A sort of yam: see वाराही. E. कुष्ठ the leprosy, and नाशन what destroys.
कुष्ठनाशिनी: कुष्ठनाशिनी f. (-नी) A plant, commonly Hākuca, (Psoralia corylifolia.) E. as above: see कुष्ठनाशन.
कुष्ठल: कुष्ठल n. (-लं) 1 A bad place or spot. 2 The surface of the earth. E. कु bad, or the earth, and स्थल place; स becomes ष, and थ is then changed to ठ.
कुष्ठसूदन: कुष्ठसूदन m. (-नः) The cassia tree, (C. fistula.) E. कुष्ठ, and सूदन destroying.
कुष्ठहृत्: कुष्ठहृत् m. (-हृत्) Catechu, (Mimosa catechu:) see खदिर. E. कुष्ठ leprosy, and हृत् what takes away, from हृ to convey, affix क्विप्.
कुष्ठहन्तृ: कुष्ठहन्तृ m. (-न्ता) A large esculent root, described as possessed of medicinal virtue in leprosy, and other cutaneous affections, (Arum campanulatum:) see हस्तिकन्द. E. कुष्ठ leprosy, and हन्तृ what kills or destroys.
कुष्ठारि: कुष्ठारि m. (-रिः) 1 A fetid mimosa, (M. Farnesiana.) 2 The Khayar or Catechu: (M. catechu.) 3 A kind of Aristolochia: see अर्कपत्र. 4 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) 5 Sulphur. E. कुष्ठ the leprosy, and अरि an enemy.
कुष्ठिन्: कुष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Leprous, a leper, &c. E. कुष्ठ, and इनि aff.
कुष्मल: कुष्मल n. (-लं) Cutting, dividing. E. कुष to extract, and क्मलन् Uṇādi aff.
कुष्माण्ड: कुष्माण्ड mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डा or -ण्डी) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo). m. (-ण्डः) 1 One of a class of demigods attached to ŚIVA. 2 State of the womb in gestation. f. (-ण्डी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A drug. 3 A religious ceremony, a certain rite performed as a penance or expiation; also कुष्माण्डक.
कुष्माण्डक: कुष्माण्डक m. (-कः) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.) E. कु the earth, उष्म heat, अन् to exist or be, ड affix, and the vowel irregularly short, कन् added; also कुष्माण्ड.
कुस: कुस (इर) कुसिर r. 4th cl. (कुस्यति) To embrace. (इ) कुसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंसति कुंसयति) 1 To shine. 2 To talk.
कुसरित्: कुसरित् f. (-रित्) A shallow stream. E. कु bad, सरित् a river.
कुसल: कुसल adv. n. (-लं) Well, happy, &c. see कुशल.
कुसित: कुसित m. (-तः) An inhabited country. E. कुस to shine, and इत Uṇādi aff.
कुसीतायी: कुसीतायी f. (-यी) The wife of a money-lender: see कुसीदायी.
कुसीद: कुसीद n. (-दं) 1 Usury, the profession of usury. 2 Any loan or thing lent to be repaid with interest. mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 A money-lender. 2 Slothful, inert. E. कुस to embrace, ईद Uṇādi affix; or कु bad, and षद to go, affix अच्.
कुसीदपथ: कुसीदपथ m. (-थः) Usury, usurious interest, any exceeding five per cent. E. कुसीद, and पथ for पथिन् road.
कुसीदवृद्धि: कुसीदवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Interest on money. E. कुसीद, and वृद्धि increase.
कुसीदायी: कुसीदायी f. (-यी) The wife of a usurer. E. कुसीद a usurer, ऐ substituted for its final, and ङीष् affix; also कुसीतायी.
कुसीदिक: कुसीदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) One who follows the profession of usury. E. कुसीद usury, and ठक् aff.
कुसुम: कुसुम n. (-मं) 1 A flower in general. 2 Fruit. 3 The menstrual discharge. 4 Ophthalmia, disease of the eyes. E. कुस to shine, उम Uṇādi aff.
कुसुमकार्मुक: कुसुमकार्म्मुक m. (-कः) KĀMA. E. कुसुम, and कार्म्मुक a bow.
कुसुमकार्म्मुक: कुसुमकार्म्मुक m. (-कः) KĀMA. E. कुसुम, and कार्म्मुक a bow.
कुसुमचित: कुसुमचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped with flowers. E. कुसुम, and चित gathered.
कुसुमपुर: कुसुमपुर n. (-रं) A city, the vicinity of the modern Patna: see पाटलिपुत्र. E. कुसुम a flower, and पुर a city.
कुसुममध्य: कुसुममध्य n. (-ध्यं) The name of a tree, bearing a large acid fruit, (Dilenia Indica.) E. कुसुम a flower, and मध्य the centre; the flower blossoming from the fruit.
कुसुमयत्: कुसुमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Producing flowers, causing to flower. E. कुसुम nom. verb, शतृ aff.
कुसुमवत्: कुसुमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) In flower, flowering. f. (-ती) 1 A female during menstruation. 2 A town: see कुसुमपुर. E. कुसुम and मतुप् aff.
कुसुमस्तवक: कुसुमस्तवक m. (-कः) A collection of flowers, a garland, a nosegay. E. कुसुम, and लवक a cluster.
कुसुमाकर: कुसुमाकर m. (-रः) 1 Spring, the vernal season. 2 A quantity of flowers or place abounding with them, a parterre, a garden. E. कुसुम, and आकर a mine.
कुसुमाञ्जन: कुसुमाञ्जन n. (-नं) The calx of brass, used as a collyrium. E. कुसुम a flower, and अञ्जन application to the eyes; resembling a flower.
कुसुमात्मक: कुसुमात्मक n. (-कं) Saffron. E. कुसुम, and आत्मक self; the essential part of the flower.
कुसुमाधिप: कुसुमाधिप m. (-पः) The Campa, a tree which bears a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) E. कुसुम a flower, and अधिप a king; royal amongst flowers.
कुसुमायुध: कुसुमायुध m. (-धः) A name of KĀMADEVA. E. कुसुम a flower, and आयुध a weapon: his shafts being tipped with flowers.
कुसुमावचाय: कुसुमावचाय m. (-यः) Gathering flowers. E. कुसुम, and अवचाय, gathering.
कुसुमावतंसक: कुसुमावतंसक n. (-कं) A chaplet, a crown of flowers. E. कुसुम, and अवतंसक a tiara.
कुसुमासव: कुसुमासव n. (-वं) Honey. E. कुसुम, and आसव spirit.
कुसुमित: कुसुमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowered, budded, in flower. E. कुसुम, and इतच् aff.
कुसुमितलता: कुसुमितलता f. (-ता) A species of the Dhṛti metre.
कुसुमेषु: कुसुमेषु m. (-षुः) A name of the god KĀMA. n. (-षु) The bow of KĀMA. E. कुसुम, and इषु an arrow; whose shafts are flowers.
कुसुम्भ: कुसुम्भ n. (-म्भं) 1 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 2 Gold. m. (-म्भः) The water pot of the student and Sannyāsī. E. कुस to shine, and उम्भः Uṇādi aff.
कुसू: कुसू m. (-सूः) An earthworm. E. कु the earth, सू produced.
कुसूल: कुसूल m. (-लः) A granary, &c. see कुशूल.
कुसृति: कुसृति f. (-तिः) 1 Wickedness, depravity. 2 Conjuring, slight-ofhand, &c. E. कु vile, सृ to go, क्तिन् aff.
कुस्तुभ: कुस्तुभ m. (-भः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. कु the earth, ष्टुभ to stop, क aff.
कुस्तुम्बरी: कुस्तुम्बरी f. (-री) A pungent seed used in condiments, coriander: see the next.
कुस्तुम्बुरु: कुस्तुम्बुरु f. (-रुः) Coriander, a pungent seed. E. कु bad, vile, तुवि to take, उरु affix, deriv. irr.; also कुस्तुम्बरी.
कुस्वप्न: कुस्वप्न m. (-प्नः) A bad dream, nightmare. E. कु, and स्वप्न a vision.
कुस्म: कुस्म r. 10th cl. (कुस्मयति) 1 To smile improperly or blamably. 2 To see mentally, to perceive, to imagine: this is considered by some as a denominative, and to be classed improperly amongst the roots.
कुह: कुह r. 10th cl. (कुहयते) 1 To surprise, to astonish, to excite wonder. 2 To cheat, to impose upon.
कुह m. (-हः) A name of KUVERA. f. (-हा) A medicinal drug: see कटुकी. ind. Where, whither, used in the Vedas in place of कुत्र. E. कु vile, and हा to leave, affix ड.
कुहक: कुहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A cheat, a rogue, a juggler. m. (-कः) Juggling, deception, slight-of-hand, &c. E. कुह to astonish, क्वुन् aff.
कुहककार: कुहककार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Juggling, conjuring, cheating. E. कुहक, and कार who makes; also कुहककारक and कुहककारिन्.
कुहकचकित: कुहकचकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspicious, cautious, wary. E. कुहक, and चकित fearful.
कुहकजीविन्: कुहकजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living by slight-of-hand, a conjuror, a cheat, &c. E. कुहक deception, and जीविन् who lives by.
कुहकवृत्ति: कुहकवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Juggling, conjuring, slight-of-hand. 2 Hypocrisy. E. कुहक, and वृत्ति practice.
कुहकस्वन: कुहकस्वन m. (-नः) A wild cock. E. कुहक deception, and खन who sounds.
कुहकस्वर: कुहकस्वर m. (-रः) A wild cock: see the preceding.
कुहन: कुहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Envious. 2 Hypocritical. m. (-नः) 1 A rat. 2 A snake. f. (-ना) Hypocrisy, assumed and sanctity, the interested performance of religious austerities. n. (-नं) 1 A small earthen vessel. 2 A glass vessel. E. कुह to surprise, युच् aff.
कुहनिका: कुहनिका f. (-का) Hypocrisy: see the preceding. E. कुहन, and इकन् aff.
कुहर: कुहर n. (-रं) 1 A cavity, a hollow. 2 A hole, a rent, &c. 3 The ear. 4 A guttural sound. 5 The throat or larynx. m. (-रः) A kind of snake. E. कु the earth, &c. and हर what takes, &c. from हृ with the affix अप्.
कुहरित: कुहरित n. (-तं) 1 The song, or cry of the Kokila, the Indian cuckoo. 2 Vox congressus in coitu. 3 A sound in general. E. कुहर, and इतच् aff.
कुहलि: कुहलि m. (-लिः) A Pān, the leaf of the Piper betel, with small pieces of the Areca nut, and Catechu and a little lime, which are chewed and eaten by the Oriental nations.
कुहू: कुहू f. (-हूः) 1 New moon; the first day of the first quarter on which the moon rises invisible. 2 The cry of the Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. कुह to astonish, ऊः affix, or with कु affix कुहु.
कुहूक: कुहूक m. (-कः) The Indian cuckoo. E. कन् added to the last.
कुहूकण्ठ: कुहूकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. कुहू the Kokila's cry, and कण्ठ the throat.
कुहूपाल: कुहूपाल m. (-लः) The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world.
कुहूमुख: कुहूमुख m. (-खः) The Kokila: see the preceding.
कुहूरव: कुहूरव m. (-वः) The Kokila. E. कुहू, and रव sound.
कुहूल: कुहूल n. (-लं) A pit, filled with stakes.
कुहेडिका: कुहेडिका f. (-का) A fog, a mist, haze, haziness. E. कु the earth, हेड to surround, वुन् affix; also कुहेलिक and कुहेडी.
कुहेडी: कुहेडी f. (-डी) See the preceding: also कुहेली.
कुहेलिका: कुहेलिका f. (-का) Fog, mist: see कुहेडिका, ल being changed to ड.
कू: कू r. 6th cl. (ङ) कूङ (कुवते) To sound, especially as if in pain, to moan, to groan, &c. (ञ) कूञ् r. 9th cl. (कुनानि-नीते) To sound, &c. as before.
कू f. (-कूः) A female Piśāca or goblin. E. कू to sound, क्विप् aff.
कूकुद: कूकुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who gives a girl in marriage with due ceremony, and suitable decorations. E. कुक to take, deriv. irr.
कूच: कूच m. (-चः) A breast, a female breast, especially that of a young or unmarried woman: see कुच. f. (-ची) A painting brush or pencil. E. कु to sound, चट Uṇādi affix, and the vowel made long.
कूचिका: कूचिका f. (-का) A small brush or hair pencil. E. कुच to be curved, and क्वुन् affix, with the fem. affix टाप्.
कूज: कूज r. 1st cl. (कूजति) To make any inarticulate sound, to utter a cry as a bird, to coo as a pigeon, to caw as a crow, &c. With परि prefixed, to moan.
कूजत्: कूजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Cooing. E. कूज to coo, शतृ aff.
कूजन: कूजन n. (-नं) Cooing, moaning, uttering an inarticulate sound. E. कूज and ल्युट् aff.
कूजित: कूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cooed, uttered inarticulately. n. (-तं) The cry of a bird, cooing. E. कूज to sound, क्त aff.
कूट: कूट r. 10th cl. (कूटयते) 1 To avoid or decline giving, to not give. 2 To render indistinct or unintelligible, to muddle or render confused or foul. (कूटयति) 1 To give pain. 2 To burn. 3 To call or invite, to counsel or advise.

कूट mf. (-टः-टी) A house, a dwelling: see कुट. mn. (-टः-टं) 1 The peak or summit of a mountain. 2 A water-jar. 3 A heap of grain, &c. 4 Uniform and elementary substance. 5 A hammer, a mallet. 6 A ploughshare. 7 The body of a plough. 8 A trap for catching deer. 9 A concealed weapon, as a dagger in a wooden case, a sword-cane, &c. 10 Illusion. 11 Fraud, trick, deceit. 12 Untruth, falsehood, (or attributively,) false, untrue. 13 Vile, low. 14 An ox whose horns are broken. m. (-टः) The name of a saint, also named AGASTYA. E. कूट to confuse, to withhold, अच् aff.
कूटक: कूटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfair, fraudulent. n. (-कं) A ploughshare. m. (-कः) 1 A braid or tress of hair. 2 A perfume: see मुरा. E. कूट to cut, and क्वुन् aff.
कूटकार: कूटकार m. (-रः) 1 A rogue. 2 A cheat, a false witness. E. कूट, and कार who makes.
कूटकारक: कूटकारक m. (-कः) 1 A false witness. 2 A rogue, a cheat. E. कूट, and कारक who makes.
कूटकृत्: कूटकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Fraudulent, dishonest. m. (-कृत्) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A Kāyastha or man of the writer cast. E. कूट illusion, &c. and कृत् who makes.
कूटज: कूटज m. (-जः) A medicinal plant: see कुटज.
कूटता: कूटता f. (-ता) Falsehood, fraud. E. तल् added to कूट; also with त्व, कूटत्वं.
कूटपर्व: कूटपर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Fever occurring in an elephant from vitiation of the three humors; also read कूटपूर्व्व.
कूटपर्व्व: कूटपर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Fever occurring in an elephant from vitiation of the three humors; also read कूटपूर्व्व.
कूटपाकल: कूटपाकल m. (-लः) 1 A bilious fever in an elephant. 2 A potter's kiln. E. कूट a heap, and पाक what ripens, लच् aff.
कूटयन्त्र: कूटयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A trap or snare for deer, birds, &c. E. कूट a trap, and यन्त्र an implement; also simply कूट.
कूटशाल्मलि: कूटशाल्मलि m. (-लिः) A species of the Simul silk cotton tree. E. कूट false, and शाल्मलि the Simul.
कूटशासन: कूटशासन n. (-नं) A forged or false grant or decree. E. कूट, and शासन a grant, &c.
कूटसाक्षिन्: कूटसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A false witness. E. कूट falsehood, and साक्षिन् a witness.
कूटस्थ: कूटस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Uniform, perpetually and universally the same, as spirit, elementary matter, aether, &c. n. (-स्थं) 1 The soul. 2 A sort of perfume, a species of dried shell fish, commonly Nakhi. E. कूट fixed, and स्थ what remains.
कूटस्वर्ण: कूटस्वर्ण n. (-र्णं) Alloyed or counterfeit gold. कूट, and स्वर्ण gold.
कूटाक्ष: कूटाक्ष m. (-क्षः) Loaded or false dice. E. कूट, and अक्ष a die.
कूटागार: कूटागार n. (-रं) An upper room, an apartment on the top of a house. E. कूट a peak, आगार a house.
कूटार्थभाषिता: कूटार्थभाषिता f. (-ता) A tale, a story, a fiction. E. कूट false, अर्थ meaning, and भाषिता spoken.
कूड: कूड r. 6th cl. (कूडति) 1 To be or become firm or solid. 2 To eat. 3 To graze.
कूड्य: कूड्य n. (-ड्यं) A wall: see कुड्यं.
कूण: कूण r. 10th cl. (कूणयते-ति) To contract or close.
कूणि: कूणि mfn. (-णिः णिः-णि) Crooked-armed, having a curved or withered arm: see कुणि.
कूणिका: कूणिका f. (-का) 1 The horn of any animal. 2 The peg of a lute. E. कूण to sound or be crooked, वुन् and टाप् affs.
कूणित: कूणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contracted, shut, closed. E. कूण to contract, affix क्त.
कूदर: कूदर m. (-रः) The offspring of a Brahman woman by a Ṛṣi, begotten during menstruation. E. कु bad, उदर belly.
कूद्दाल: कूद्दाल m. (-लः) Mountain ebony: see कुद्दाल.
कून: कून r. 10th cl. (कूनयति) To contract or close.
कूप: कूप r. 10th cl. (कूपयति) 1 To be weak. 2 To weaken: see कुप.

कूप m. (-पः) 1 A well. 2 A hole, a hollow. 3 A mast. 4 A tree or rock in the midst of a river. f. (-पी) 1 A small well. 2 The navel. 3 A flask, a bottle. E. कु to sound, (frogs croaking in a well, &c.) and प Uṇādi affix: the vowel is made long; also कूपक.
कूपक: कूपक m. (-कः) 1 The mast of a vessel. 2 A stake, &c. to which a boat is moored. 3 A leather oil vessel. 4 The hollow below the loins. 5 A funeral pile. 6 A well. 7 A temporary well, a hole dug for water in the dry bed of a rivulet. 8 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कूपमण्डूक: कूपमण्डूक m. (-कः) A frog in a well, applied to a person of no enterprise, one who never leaves his home. E. कूप, and मण्डूक a frog.
कूपाङ्ग: कूपाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Horripilation, erection of the hairs of the body. E. कूप a well, and अङ्ग the body; some copies read कूपाङ्क, from अङ्क a mark.
कूपार: कूपार m. (-रः) The ocean; also कूवार, and अकूपार, &c.
कूपिका: कूपिका f. (-का) A stone or rock in the middle of a stream: see कूपक.
कूम: कूम n. (-मं) A lake, a pool, a pond.
कूर्च: कूर्च्च mn. (-र्च्चः-र्च्चं) 1 The upper part of the nose, the part between the eye-brows. 2 The beard. 3 Deceit, fraud, circumvention. 4 Hard, solid. 5 The tip of the thumb and middle finger brought in contact, as to pinch, &c. 6 A handful of Kusa grass or peacock's feathers. 7 A bunch, a bundle, as of grass, &c. 8 A brush of the same. 9 The head. 10 False praise, unmerited commendation, either of one's self or another person, boasting, flattery. 11 Hypocrisy. 12 The mystic syllable Hum. E. कूर to sound, चङ् affix, or कृ to do, उर्च्च affix or कूर्च्च Sautra root, to praise, affix घञ्.
कूर्च्च: कूर्च्च mn. (-र्च्चः-र्च्चं) 1 The upper part of the nose, the part between the eye-brows. 2 The beard. 3 Deceit, fraud, circumvention. 4 Hard, solid. 5 The tip of the thumb and middle finger brought in contact, as to pinch, &c. 6 A handful of Kusa grass or peacock's feathers. 7 A bunch, a bundle, as of grass, &c. 8 A brush of the same. 9 The head. 10 False praise, unmerited commendation, either of one's self or another person, boasting, flattery. 11 Hypocrisy. 12 The mystic syllable Hum. E. कूर to sound, चङ् affix, or कृ to do, उर्च्च affix or कूर्च्च Sautra root, to praise, affix घञ्.
कूर्चक: कूर्च्चक n. (-कं) A brush for cleaning the teeth, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
कूर्च्चक: कूर्च्चक n. (-कं) A brush for cleaning the teeth, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
कूर्चशीर्ष: कूर्च्चशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) A drug, commonly Jivaka, one of the eight principal medicaments. E. कूर्च्च the beard, &c. and शीर्ष the head; being bearded: or from कूर्च्च praise, and शिर्ष chief; commendable amongst medicines; also with कन् added कूर्च्चशीर्षक.
कूर्च्चशीर्ष: कूर्च्चशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) A drug, commonly Jivaka, one of the eight principal medicaments. E. कूर्च्च the beard, &c. and शीर्ष the head; being bearded: or from कूर्च्च praise, and शिर्ष chief; commendable amongst medicines; also with कन् added कूर्च्चशीर्षक.
कूर्चशेखर: कूर्च्चशेखर m. (-रः) The cocoa nut tree. E. कूर्च्च a bunch, and शेखर summit.
कूर्च्चशेखर: कूर्च्चशेखर m. (-रः) The cocoa nut tree. E. कूर्च्च a bunch, and शेखर summit.
कूर्चिका: कूर्च्चिका f. (-का) 1 Inspissated milk. 2 A key. 3 A bud, a blossom. 4 A painting brush or pencil. 5 A needle. E. कूर्च्च to praise, &c. वुन् affix, and the fem. form.
कूर्च्चिका: कूर्च्चिका f. (-का) 1 Inspissated milk. 2 A key. 3 A bud, a blossom. 4 A painting brush or pencil. 5 A needle. E. कूर्च्च to praise, &c. वुन् affix, and the fem. form.
कूर्द: कूर्द r. 1st cl. (कूर्दते) To play: see कुर्द.
कूर्दन: कूर्दन n. (-नं) Playing, sport, pastime. f. (-नी) A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held on the day of full moon, in the month Chaitra. E. कूर्द to play, ल्युट् affix, fem. ङीप्.
कूर्प: कूर्प्प n. (-र्प्पं) The space between the eye-brows. E. कॄ to scatter, &c. deriv. irr.: see कूर्च्च.
कूर्प्प: कूर्प्प n. (-र्प्पं) The space between the eye-brows. E. कॄ to scatter, &c. deriv. irr.: see कूर्च्च.
कूर्पर: कूर्प्पर mf. (-रः-रा) 1 The elbow. 2 The knee. E. कुर to sound, with क्विप् affix कुर, पर from पृ to nourish, the first vowel is made long; sometimes also कुर्पर.
कूर्प्पर: कूर्प्पर mf. (-रः-रा) 1 The elbow. 2 The knee. E. कुर to sound, with क्विप् affix कुर, पर from पृ to nourish, the first vowel is made long; sometimes also कुर्पर.
कूर्पास: कूर्प्पास m. (-सः) A cuirass or quilted jacket worn as armour: see कूर्प्पासक.
कूर्प्पास: कूर्प्पास m. (-सः) A cuirass or quilted jacket worn as armour: see कूर्प्पासक.
कूर्पासक: कूर्प्पासक mn. (-कः-कं) A bodice, a jacket with short sleeves worn next the body, by women especially. E. कूर्पर the elbow, आस to abide, घञ् affix, and र dropped, कूर्प्पास, see the preceding; again, कन् pleonastic affix added.
कूर्प्पासक: कूर्प्पासक mn. (-कः-कं) A bodice, a jacket with short sleeves worn next the body, by women especially. E. कूर्पर the elbow, आस to abide, घञ् affix, and र dropped, कूर्प्पास, see the preceding; again, कन् pleonastic affix added.
कूर्म: कूर्म्म mf. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी) 1 A tortoise, a turtle. 2 The descent of VIṢṆU as a tortoise to support the mountain Mandāra at the churning of the ocean. 3 A peculiar gesticulation with the fingers. E. कु implying reverse, ऊर्म्मी speed, अच् aff.
कूर्म्म: कूर्म्म mf. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी) 1 A tortoise, a turtle. 2 The descent of VIṢṆU as a tortoise to support the mountain Mandāra at the churning of the ocean. 3 A peculiar gesticulation with the fingers. E. कु implying reverse, ऊर्म्मी speed, अच् aff.
कूर्मचक्र: कूर्म्मचक्र n. (-क्रं) An astrological diagram. E. कूर्म्म, and चक्र circle.
कूर्म्मचक्र: कूर्म्मचक्र n. (-क्रं) An astrological diagram. E. कूर्म्म, and चक्र circle.
कूर्मपृष्ठ: कूर्म्मपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठः) 1 Globe amaranth, (Gomphrena globosa.) 2 The back or shell of a tortoise. E. कूर्म्म a tortoise, and पृष्ठ the back.
कूर्म्मपृष्ठ: कूर्म्मपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठः) 1 Globe amaranth, (Gomphrena globosa.) 2 The back or shell of a tortoise. E. कूर्म्म a tortoise, and पृष्ठ the back.
कूर्मपृष्ठक: कूर्म्मपृष्ठक n. (-कं) The cover of a dish, a lid. E. कन् added to the preceding, implying resemblance.
कूर्म्मपृष्ठक: कूर्म्मपृष्ठक n. (-कं) The cover of a dish, a lid. E. कन् added to the preceding, implying resemblance.
कूर्मराज: कूर्म्मराज m. (-जः) The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world. E. कूर्म्म tortoise, and राज a king, from राजन् with टच् aff.
कूर्म्मराज: कूर्म्मराज m. (-जः) The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world. E. कूर्म्म tortoise, and राज a king, from राजन् with टच् aff.
कूल: कूल r. 1st cl. (कूलति) To cover, to hide, to screen, to enclose: with अनु prefixed, to protect, to be kind to, as to a follower or dependant.
कूल n. (-लं) 1 A bank, a shore. 2 A heap, a mound. 3 A pond or pool. 4 The rear of an army. E. कूल to cover, अच् aff.
कूलक: कूलक m. (-कः) An anthill. n. (-कं) 1 A mound of earth, a heap, a pile. 2 A bank, a dyke. E. कन् added to the former.
कूलङ्कष: कूलङ्कष m. (-षः) 1 The ocean, the sea. 2 The stream or current of a river. f. (-षा) A river. E. कूल a bank, कष to injure, affix स्वच्.
कूलचर: कूलचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Frequenting the banks of rivers, grazing there, &c. E. कूल, चर what goes.
कूलभू: कूलभू f. (-भूः) A bank, the land upon the bank or shore. E. कूल, and भू earth.
कूलमुद्रुज: कूलमुद्रुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Breaking down banks (as a river, &c.) E. कूल, रुज to make sick, with उत् pre. and खश aff.
कूलमुद्वह: कूलमुद्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Carrying away the banks, (a river, &c.) E. कूल, वह to bear, उत् pre. खश् aff.
कूलवती: कूलवती f. (-ती) A river. E. कूल a bank, and मतुप् poss. affix, fem. ङीष्.
कूलहण्डक: कूलहण्डक m. (-कः) An eddy. E. कूल a bank, and हुडि to collect, वुन् affix, deriv. irr.
कूलिका: कूलिका f. (-का) Base or bottom part of the Indian lute.
कूवर: कूवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Beautiful, agreeable, pleasing. mn. (-रः-रं) The pole of a carriage or wood to which the yoke is fixed. m. (-रः) A humpbacked man. f. (-री) A carriage covered with a cloth or blanket. E. कू to sound, and वर from वृ to cherish, with अप् aff.
कूवरिन्: कूवरिन् m. (-री) A carriage. E. कूवर the pole, इनि
कूष्माण्ड: कूष्माण्ड mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.) m. (-ण्डः) A kind of sprite or imp, of which there exists a Gaṇa or class. f. (-ण्डी) A name of DURGĀ; also कुम्माण्ड and कूष्माण्डक.
कूष्माण्डक: कूष्माण्डक m. (-कः) A pumpkin gourd: see कूष्माण्ड. E. कु bad, उष्म warm, and अण्ड an egg, here put for seed, कन् aff.
कूहना: कूहना f. (-ना) Hypocrisy, affectation of religious zeal or austerity: see कुहना.
कूहा: कूहा f. (-हा) A fog, a mist. E. कुह to astonish, अङ् and टाप् affs.
कृ: कृ r. 5th cl. (ञ्) कृञ् (कृणोति कृणुते) To hurt, to injure, to kill. (डु, ञ,) डुकृञ् r. 8th cl. (करोति कुरुते) To do, to make, to perform any kind of action: this root admits most of the prepositions and a variety of significations; it is also active or deponent, according to its prefix and import; as, 1 With अति, (अतिकुरुते) To exceed, to do more. 2 With अधि, (अधिकुरुते) ^a To surpass or overcome. ^b To superintend, to govern. ^c To hold of right. ^d To bear patiently. ^e To refrain from. 3 With अनु (अनुकरोति) To copy, to imitate, to act like or after. 4 With अप (अपकुरुते) ^a To wrong, to injure. ^b To do evil. 5 With आङ् (आकुरुते) ^a To call. ^b To take shape or form. 6 With उत् (उत्कुरुते) ^a To kill or hurt dangerously. ^b To collect, to assemble. 7 With उद् and आङ् (उदाकुरुते) To reproach. 8 With उप (उपकुरुते) To befriend, to serve or assist. 9 With उप, and स inserted (उपस्कुरुते, or उपस्करोति) To alter. (उपस्करोति) ^a To polish, to adorn. ^b To assemble. ^c To reply. 10 With तिरस् (तिरस्करोति) To abuse, to revile. 11 With दुर् (दुष्करोति) To do evil. 12 With निर् and आङ् (निराकुरुते) ^a To make light of, to contemn. ^b To expel. ^c To annihilate. 13 With परि, and स inserted (परिष्करोति) To polish, to refine, to make elegant or perfect. 14 With पर and आङ् (पराकरोति) To act well. 15 With प्र (प्रकुरुते) ^a To begin. ^b To do any thing quickly. ^c To serve. ^d To allot, to portion. ^e To violate. ^f To chaunt, to recite. 16 With प्रति (प्रतिकुरुते) ^a To counteract. ^b To retaliate. ^c To remedy. 17 With प्रति and उप (प्रत्युपकुरुते) To requite, to return a kindness; with वि (विकुरुते) ^a To utter, to sound. ^b To seek, to strive for. (विकरोति) ^a To alter, to change in form. ^b To disturb or agitate. 18 With वि and आङ् (व्याकुरुते) ^a To explain, to expound. ^b To make manifest or public. 19 With सम (संस्करोति) ^a To polish, to perfect. ^b To assemble, to bring together. 20 With सु (सुकरोति) To do well.
कृक: कृक m. (-कः) The throat, the larynx. E. कृ to make, and क्वुन् affix, what makes or produces sound.
कृकण: कृकण m. (-णः) 1 A kind of partridge, commonly Kaër, (Perdix sylvatica.) 2 A worm. E. कृक the throat, and अण् to sound, affix अच्, the deriv. irr.
कृकणीय: कृकणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a partridge. E. कृकण and छ aff.
कृकर: कृकर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 One of the five vital airs, that which assists in digestion. 3 A kind of partridge: see कृकण. 4 A sort of pepper, (P. chavya.) 5 The oleander tree. E. कृक the throat, and र what gets or receives; or कृ imitative sound, and कर what makes, from कृ to make or do, affix अप्.
कृकलास: कृकलास m. (-सः) A lizard, a chameleon. E. कृक the throat, and लस to play, &c. affix अण्; also कृकलाश.
कृकवाकु: कृकवाकु m. (-कुः) 1 A cock, a gallinaceous fowl. 2 A peacock. 3 A lizard, a chameleon. E. कृक the throat, वच् to speak, Uṇādi affix ञुण्.
कृकवाकुध्वज: कृकवाकुध्वज m. (-जः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. कृकवाकु a peacock, and ध्वज a standard or symbol; the peacock is the vehicle and standard of SKANDA.
कृकाटिका: कृकाटिका f. (-का) 1 The back of the neck. 2 The raised and straight part of the neck. E. कृक the throat, अट to go, वुन् aff.
कृकुलास: कृकुलास m. (-सः) A lizard, a chameleon: see कृकलास.
कृच्छ्र: कृच्छ्र mfn. (-च्छ्रः-च्छ्रा-च्छ्रं) 1 Attended with pain, painful. 2 Wicked, sinful. mn. (-च्छ्रः-च्छ्रं) Bodily pain. 2 Penance, expiation. 3 Sin. 4 Difficulty, labour, trouble. 5 A kind of religious penance, according to some, the same as the Prājāpatya: (see प्राजापत्य;) according to others, as the Sāntapana: (see सान्तपनं) E. कृत to cut, रक् Uṇādi affix, and छ substituted for the final.
कृच्छ्रगत: कृच्छ्रगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Embarrassed, distressed. 2 Pained, suffering pain. E. कृच्छ्र, and गत gone to or in.
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्र: कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्र m. (-च्छ्रः) A kind of penance, taking no sustenance but water for three, nine, twelve, or twenty-one days. E. कृच्छ्र one kind of penance, and अतिकृच्छ्र another; the substance of both.
कृच्छ्रार्द्ध: कृच्छ्रार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) An inferior penance lasting six days. E. कृच्छ्र, and अर्द्ध half.
कृड: कृड r. 6th cl. (कृडति) 1 To be thick or coarse, to be gross, to be solid. 2 To eat.
कृणु: कृणु m. (-णः) A painter. E. कृ to do or make, क्रु aff.
कृत: कृत (ई,) कृती r. 6th cl. (कृन्तति) To cut, to divide. r. 7th cl. (कृणति) To surround, to encompass.

कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done, made, performed. 2 Injured, hurt. 3 Fit, proper. n. (-तं) 1 The first of the four ages of the world, the Satya yug. 2 Fruit, consequence. adv. 1 Enough, sufficient. 2 Enough, completely finished. 3 Enough, have done, no more. E. कृ to do, to injure, &c. affix क्त.
कृतक: कृतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Artificial, factitious, made, not produced spontaneously. 2 Assumed, simulated, not natural. n. (-कं) Factitious salt, produced by boiling and evaporating from saline soils. E. कृत to cut or divide, Uṇādi affix अक.
कृतकपट: कृतकपट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Deceiving, beguiling, fraudulent. E. कृत, and कपट deceit.
कृतकर्तव्य: कृतकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Having done or discharged, or being done, (a duty.) कृत done, कर्त्तव्य what was to be done.
कृतकर्त्तव्य: कृतकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Having done or discharged, or being done, (a duty.) कृत done, कर्त्तव्य what was to be done.
कृतकर्मन्: कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Skilful, clever, able. E. कृत made, and कर्म्मन् act.
कृतकर्म्मन्: कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Skilful, clever, able. E. कृत made, and कर्म्मन् act.
कृतकाल: कृतकाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fixed, settled as to time. 2 Sent or deposited, &c. for a certain time. E. कृत, and काल time.
कृतकूर्च्छक: कृतकूर्च्छक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Tied up as a small bundle or brush. E. कृतकूर्च्छ a bundle, and कन् added.
कृतकृत्य: कृतकृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Having done or discharged any thing to be done. 2 Having accomplished or attained any object. 3 Contented, satisfied. E. कृत done, and कृत्य what was to be done; also कृतकर्त्तव्य, कृतकार्य्य, &c.
कृतकृत्यता: कृतकृत्यता f. (-ता) Success, attainment, accomplishment, the full discharge of any duty or realisation of any object. E. कृतकृत्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, कृतकृत्यत्वं.
कृतकोटि: कृतकोटि m. (-टिः) 1 A name of the saint KAŚYAPA. 2 A name of UPAVARṢA, another divine sage. E. कृत made, कोटि excellence.
कृतकोप: कृतकोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Angry, indignant. E. कृत, and कोप anger.
कृतक्रय: कृतक्रय m. (-यः) A purchaser, a buyer. E. कृत, and क्रय purchase.
