कृतक्रिय: कृतक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Having finished or completed any thing in which one was engaged. 2 Having attained any end or accomplished any object. 3 Having fulfilled one's duty. E. कृत done, क्रिया work, duty, &c.
कृतक्रुध: कृतक्रुध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Angry, resentful. E. कृत, and क्रुधा wrath.
कृतघातयत्न: कृतघातयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Assaulting, attacking, one who tries to kill. E. कृत, घात a blow, यत्न effort.
कृतघ्न: कृतघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) 1 Ungrateful, not acknowledging former good offices. 2 Defeating or rendering vain all previous measures. E. कृत what has been done, and घ्न killing, destroying.
कृतघ्नता: कृतघ्नता f. (-ता) Ingratitude. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कृतघ्नत्वं.
कृतचूड: कृतचूड m. (-डः) A boy on whom the ceremony of tonsure has been performed. E. कृत, and चूडा a crest, a lock of hair being left on the top of the head.
कृतजन्मन्: कृतजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) 1 Born, produced. 2 Generated. E. कृत, and जन्मन् birth.
कृतज्ञ: कृतज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Grateful, remembering former aid or favours. 2 Observant of propriety, correct in conduct. m. (-ज्ञः) A dog. E. कृत what is done, and ज्ञ who knows.
कृतज्ञता: कृतज्ञता f. (-ता) Gratitude. E. कृतज्ञ, and तल् affix; also कृतज्ञत्वं.
कृततीर्थ: कृततीर्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 A guide to holy places, &c. one who frequents them. 2 A councillor, one fertile in expedients. E. कृत, तीर्थ pilgrimage, &c.
कृतत्व: कृतत्व n. (-त्वं) The being done or effected. E. त्व, added to कृत.
कृतदार: कृतदार m. (-रः) A married man. E. कृत, and दार a wife.
कृतदास: कृतदास mf. (-सः-सी) A self-engaged servant, a hired servant. E. कृत made, (spontaneously,) and दास a slave.
कृतधी: कृतधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) 1 Prudent, considerate. 2 Learned, educated. E. कृत, and धी understanding.
कृतध्वंस: कृतध्वंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Defeated, overpowered. 2 Injured, destroyed. 3 Recollecting past transactions. E. कृत, and ध्वंस loss.
कृतध्वस्त: कृतध्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Lost after being once possessed or acquired. E. कृत made, gained, ध्वस्त destroyed.
कृतनाशक: कृतनाशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ungrateful. E. कृत, and नाशक who destroys.
कृतनिर्णेजन: कृतनिर्णेजन m. (-नः) A penitent, one who has performed penance or made expiation. E. कृत, and निर्णेजन cleansing.
कृतनिश्चय: कृतनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Confident, sure, certain. E. कृत, and निश्चय certainly.
कृतपुङ्ख: कृतपुङ्ख mfn. (ङ्खः-ङ्खा-ङ्खं) Skilled in archery. E. कृत done, made, पुङ्ख the feather of an arrow.
कृतपूर्व: कृतपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Done formerly or precedingly. E. कृत, and पूर्व्व prior.
कृतपूर्व्व: कृतपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Done formerly or precedingly. E. कृत, and पूर्व्व prior.
कृतपूर्वनाशन: कृतपूर्व्वनाशन n. (-नं) Ingratitude, forgetting past services. E. कृतपूर्व्व, and नाशन destroying.
कृतपूर्व्वनाशन: कृतपूर्व्वनाशन n. (-नं) Ingratitude, forgetting past services. E. कृतपूर्व्व, and नाशन destroying.
कृतपूर्विन्: कृतपूर्व्विन् mfn. (-र्व्वी-र्व्विणी-र्व्वि) One by whom any thing was done in time past. E. कृत done, पूर्व्व formerly, इनि affix of agency.
कृतपूर्व्विन्: कृतपूर्व्विन् mfn. (-र्व्वी-र्व्विणी-र्व्वि) One by whom any thing was done in time past. E. कृत done, पूर्व्व formerly, इनि affix of agency.
कृतपौरुष: कृतपौरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Behaving gallantly. E. कृत, and पौरुष manhood.
कृतप्रणाम: कृतप्रणाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Saluting, making or having made obeisance. E. कृत, and प्रणाम salute.
कृतप्रयत्न: कृतप्रयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Active, industrious, persevering. E. कृत, and प्रयत्न effort.
कृतफल: कृतफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Successful, fruitful. n. (-लं) 1 Result, consequence of an act. 2 A poisonous substance: see कृक्वोल. E. कृत, and फल fruit.
कृतबाहु: कृतबाहु mfn. (-हुः-हुः-हु) Laying hand upon, touching. E. कृत, and बाहु the arm.
कृतबुद्धि: कृतबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Informed of one's duty, having acquired knowledge. E. कृत, and बुद्धि understanding.
कृतभय: कृतभय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Alarmed, apprehensive. E. कृत, and भय fear.
कृतमङ्गल: कृतमङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Blessed, consecrated. E. कृत, and मङ्गल auspicious.
कृतमन्यु: कृतमन्यु mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु) Angry, offended, indignant. E. कृत, and मन्यु anger.
कृतमाल: कृतमाल m. (-लः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. कृत made, माल a garland, garlands being made of its flowers; also आरग्वध.
कृतमुख: कृतमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Skilled, clever, conversant. E. कृत done, and मुख chief, principal.
कृतरव: कृतरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Sounding, singing. E. कृत, and रव a sound.
कृतरुच्: कृतरुच् mfn. (-रुक्) Splendid, brilliant. E. कृत, and रुच् light; also कृतरुचि.
कृतरुष: कृतरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Angry, displeased. E. कृत, and रुषा wrath.
कृतलक्षण: कृतलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Excellent, amiable, &c. noted for good qualities. 2 Defined, discriminated. 3 Marked, stamped. 4 Branded. E. कृत made, लक्षण a mark, a sign.
कृतवत्: कृतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Making, was making, made. E. कृत, and क्तवतु aff.
कृतवाप: कृतवाप m. (-पः) A penitent who has shaven his head and chin. E. कृत, and वाप tonsure.
कृतविक्रिय: कृतविक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Altered, changed. E. कृत, and विक्रिय change; also कृतविकार.
कृतविद्य: कृतविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Scientific, a philosopher. E. कृत, and विद्या knowledge.
कृतविस्मय: कृतविस्मय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Surpassing, astonishing. E. कृत, and वित्पय wonder.
कृतवेतन: कृतवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Hired as a servant or labourer. E. कृत made, appointed, and वतन wages.
कृतवेदिन्: कृतवेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Grateful. 2 Knowing, observant. E. कृत, and वेदिन् who knows.
कृतवेधन: कृतवेधन m. (-नः) A plant, a sort of Ghosha with white flowers: see घोष.
कृतवेपथु: कृतवेपथु mfn. (-थुः-थुः-थु) Trembling. E. कृत, and वेपथु trembling.
कृतवेश: कृतवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Decorating, adorning. E. कृत, and वेश dress.
कृतव्यलीक: कृतव्यलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Annoyed, vexed, irritated. कृत, and व्यलीक pain, &c.
कृतशक्ति: कृतशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Putting forth one's strength or courage. E. कृत, and शक्ति power.
कृतशोभ: कृतशोभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Splendid, brilliant. 2 Beautiful, beautified. 3 Dexterous, handy. E. कृत, and शोभा splendor.
कृतशौच: कृतशौच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Purified, cleansed, freed from the natural dejections, released from conventional defilement, &c. E. कृत, and शाच purification.
कृतश्रम: कृतश्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Laborious, assiduous, persevering, painstaking, making great or continuous exertions. E. कृत made, श्रम fatigue.
कृतसङ्केत: कृतसङ्केत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Making an agreement or appointment, E. कृत, and सङ्केत agreement.
कृतसंसर्ग: कृतसंसर्ग mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) Approximate, united. E. कृत, and संसर्ग union.
कृतसंस्कार: कृतसंस्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Initiated, having undergone all the purificatory ceremonies. E. कृत, and संस्कार rite.
कृतसज्ञ: कृतसज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Distinguished by appropriate marks, devices, &c. E. कृत, and सज्ञा a signal.
कृतसन्निधान: कृतसन्निधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Contracted, approximated. E. कृत, and सन्निधान proximity.
कृतसम्बन्ध: कृतसम्बन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Connected, allied. E. कृत, and सम्बन्ध alliance.
कृतसापत्निका: कृतसापत्निका f. (-का) A woman whose husband has taken another wife. E. कृक made, स with, together with, पत्नी a wife, affix कन्: or derived from सापत्नक, कृतसापत्नका; also कृतसापत्नी, &c.
कृतस्थिति: कृतस्थिति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Abiding, staying, taking up an abode in or with. E. कृत, and स्थिति stay.
कृतस्वस्त्ययन: कृतस्वस्त्ययन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Recommended to the protection of gods previous to any journey or undertaking. E. कृत, स्वस्त्ययन benediction.
कृतहस्त: कृतहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Skilled in archery. 2 Clever, skilful, dexterous. E. कृत exercised, हस्त the hand; also कृतहस्तक.
कृताकृत: कृताकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done in part, not completed. 2 Committed and omitted. E. कृत, and अकृत undone.
कृतागम: कृतागम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Advanced, proficient. E. कृत, and आगम coming.
कृतागस्: कृतागस् mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः) Criminal, offending, in fault. E. कृत done, अगस् crime.
कृताग्निकार्य: कृताग्निकार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A Brahman who has offered the usual oblations with fire. E. कृत, and अग्निकार्य्य fire-sacrifice.
कृताग्निकार्य्य: कृताग्निकार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A Brahman who has offered the usual oblations with fire. E. कृत, and अग्निकार्य्य fire-sacrifice.
कृताङ्क: कृताङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) 1 Marked. 2 Numbered. 3 Branded. E. कृत, and अङ्क a mark.
कृताञ्जलि: कृताञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) One who joins the palms of the hands, making such a sign of reverence or solicitation, reverent, respectful. m. (-लिः) A shrub used in medicine, also in magical potions, &c. E. कृत made, अञ्जलि the hand joined, &c.
कृताञ्जलिपुट: कृताञ्जलिपुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Joining the palms of the hands for the purpose of doing obeisance, also for holding water, &c. E. कृत, and अञ्जलिपुट the palms joined.
कृतात्मन्: कृतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Subdued, tranquil, of a self-governed spirit. E. कृत, and आत्मन् self.
कृतानति: कृतानति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Bending, bowed, paying homage or respect. E. कृत, and आनति bowing.
कृतानुकूल्य: कृतानुकूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Kind, favouring, compliant. E. कृत, आनुकूल्य favour.
कृतानुव्याध: कृतानुव्याध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Mixed, combined, united. E. कृत, and अनुव्याध mixture.
कृतानुसार: कृतानुसार m. (-रः) Established practice, usage, custom, rate. E. कृत, and अनुसार custom.
कृतान्त: कृतान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A name of YAMA, son of SŪRYA, and regent of the dead, or death personified. 2 Destiny, that is, the inevitable result of actions done in a past existence. 3 A demonstrated conclusion, proved or established doctrine. 4 Sinful or inauspicious action. 5 Saturday, which is considered as an unlucky day. f. (-न्ता) A perfume: see रेणुका. E. कृत act, (actum) done, अन्त end, destruction.
कृतान्तजनक: कृतान्तजनक m. (-कः) A name of the sun. E. कृतान्त YAMA, and जनक progenitor; being the father of YAMA.
कृतापकार: कृतापकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Injured, wronged. 2 Discomfited, overpowered. 3 Doing wrong, offending. E. कृत, and अपकार offence.
कृतापदान: कृतापदान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Completing a task, effecting an object. E. कृत, and अपदान accomplishment.
कृतापराध: कृतापराध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Guilty, culpable, an offender. E. कृत, and अपराध offence.
कृताभिषेक: कृताभिषेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Inaugurated. m. (-कः) A prince, &c. who has been inaugurated. E. कृत, and अभिषेक sprinkling.
कृतार्थ: कृतार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Successful, having attained an end, having accomplished a purpose or desire. E. कृत done, अर्थ object.
कृतार्थता: कृतार्थता f. (-ता) Success, fruitfulness, accomplishment of an object. E. तल् added to the last; also कृतार्थत्व.
कृतार्थीकृत: कृतार्थीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rendered successful. E. कृतार्थ, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
कृतार्थीभूत: कृतार्थीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become successful. E. कृतार्थ, and भूत been, च्चि augment.
कृतालय: कृतालय m. (-यः) A frog. E. कृत made, आलय abode.
कृतावधान: कृतावधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Careful, cautious, prudent, attentive. E. कृत, and अवधान care.
कृतावधि: कृतावधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) 1 Fixed, appointed, agreed upon. 2 Bounded, limited. E. कृत, and अवधि term, &c.
कृतावमर्ष: कृतावमर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) 1 Disregarding, effacing from recollection. 2 Intolerant. E. कृत, and अवमर्ष impatience.
कृतावशक्थिक: कृतावशक्थिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Seated on the hams with the knees tied together, or the hips and knees surrounded by a cloth. E. कृत, and अवशक्थिका the cloth so used.
कृतावस्थ: कृतावस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Summoned, called. 2 Made present. 3 Fixed, settled. E. कृत, and अवस्था condition.
कृतावास: कृतावास m. (-सः) A lodging, a temporary accommodation, an apartment. E. कृत, and आवास abode.
कृताशन: कृताशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Feeding upon. E. कृत, and अशन eating.
कृतास्कन्दन: कृतास्कन्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Assailing, attacking. 2 Effacing from recollection. E. कृत, and आस्कन्दन going to.
कृतास्त्र: कृतास्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Armed. E. कृत, and अस्त्र weapon.
कृतास्पद: कृतास्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Governed, ruled. 2 Supporting, rested upon by any thing. 3 Residing in or on, taking one's abode. E. कृत, and आस्पद place, rule.
कृताहक: कृताहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having performed the daily ceremonies, or devotions. E. कृत, अहन् a day, कन् added.
कृताह्वान: कृताह्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Summoned, called. 2 Challenged. E. कृत, and आह्वान calling.
कृति: कृति f. (-तिः) 1 Act, action, acting, doing, &c. 2 Injuring, hurt, hurting. 3 A sort of metre, a stanza of four lines, with twenty syllables in each. E. कृ to do, to injure, क्तिन् aff.
कृतिकर: कृतिकर m. (-रः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. कृति injuring, कृ to do, ट aff.
कृतिन्: कृतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Wise, learned. 2 Clever, skilful. 3 Good, virtuous. 4 Pure, pious. 5 Following, obeying, doing what is enjoined. E. कृत done, performed, इनि affix; by whom proper acts are done.
कृते: कृते ind. For, on account of.
कृतेर्ष्य: कृतेर्ष्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं) Envious, jealous. E. कृत, and ईर्ष्या envy.
कृतोच्चैस्: कृतोच्चैस् ind. Raised on high. E. कृत, and उच्चैस् high.
कृतोदक: कृतोदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having performed ablutions. E. कृत, and उदक water.
कृतोद्वाह: कृतोद्वाह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Performing penance by standing with uplifted hands. 2 Married. E. कृत, and उद्वाह marriage.
कृतोपकार: कृतोपकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Assisted, befriended. 2 Friendly, giving aid. E. कृत, and उपकार help.
कृतोपनयन: कृतोपनयन m. (-नः) The student invested with the sacrificial cord. E. कृत, and उपनयन investiture.
कृतोपभोग: कृतोपभोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Used, enjoyed. E. कृत, and उपभोग use.
कृत्त: कृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Cut, divided. 2 Desired, sought, wished for. E. कृत to cut, &c. affix क्त.
कृत्ति: कृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 The hide upon which the religious student sits, sleeps, &c. usually the skin of an antelope. 2 The skin. 3 The bark of the Bhojpatra, used for writing upon, for making hooka snakes, &c. 4 One of the lunar mansions: see the next. E. कृत to cut, क्तिन् aff.
कृत्तिका: कृत्तिका f. (-का) 1 The third of the lunar mansions, or constellations in the moon's path, consisting of six stars, and corresponding to the Pleiades. 2 (In mythology,) a nymph; one of six, the nurses of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. कृत to cut, क्तिन् and कन् affixes; the figure of the asterism is a razor or knife.
कृत्तिकाभव: कृत्तिकाभव m. (-वः) A name of CANDRA or the moon. E. कृत्तिका the constellation, and मव who is born.
कृत्तिकासुत: कृत्तिकासुत m. (-तः) A name of SKANDA or KĀRTTIKEYA. E. कृत्तिका, and सुत the son; the nymphs so named being his foster mothers.
कृत्तिवास: कृत्तिवास m. (-सः) ŚIVA: see the next.
कृत्तिवासस्: कृत्तिवासस् m. (-सः) An appellation of MAHĀDEVA. E. कृत्ति a skin or hide, and वासस् clothes; clothes with a tiger's skin; also कृत्तिवास.
कृत्नु: कृत्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) An artist, an artificer or mechanic. E. कृ to make, कत्नु Uṇādi aff.
कृत्य: कृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 To be done or performed. 2 To be rendered murderous or mischievous, hired as an assassin, seduced from allegiance or alliance, hostile through covetousness, &c. f. (-त्या) 1 Action, act. 2 A female deity, to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive and magical purposes. 3 Magic. 4 A pestilence. n. (-त्यं) 1 Motive, cause. 2 The class of affixes in grammar forming nouns corresponding to gerunds and supines, chiefly with a passive signification, but sometimes active, and sometimes abstract nouns. E. कृत to injure, to divide, &c. क्यप् or यत् affixed, or कृत to injure, वुन् affix, and य inserted.
कृत्यज्ञ: कृत्यज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Learned, wise, who knows what is to be done. E. कृत्य, and ज्ञ who knows.
कृत्यवर्त्मन्: कृत्यवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The right way, the manner in which any object is to be effected. E. कृत्य, and वर्त्मन् a road.
कृत्यविद्: कृत्यविद् mf. (-विद्) Learned, wise, who knows what is to be done. E. कृत्य, and विद who knows.
कृत्यविधि: कृत्यविधि f. (-धिः) The way to do any thing, a rule or precept. E. कृत्य, and विधि rule.
कृत्रिम: कृत्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Made, factitious, artificial, the reverse of what is naturally or spontaneously produced. m. (-मः) 1 Incense, olibanum. 2 An adopted son, used for कृत्रिमपुत्र. n. (-मं) A kind of salt, the common Bit Noben or Bit Lavan, E. कृ to make, क्त्रि Uṇādi affix, and मम् added.
कृत्रिमधूप: कृत्रिमधूप m. (-पः) A compound perfume, containing ten or eighteen ingredients. E. कृत्रिम artificial, and धूप resin; also with कन् added कृत्रिमधूपक.
कृत्रिमपुत्र: कृत्रिमपुत्र m. (-त्रः) An adopted son; one of the twelve kinds recognized in law, the son made. E. कृत्रिम, and पुत्र a son.
कृत्रिममित्र: कृत्रिममित्र m. (-त्रः) An acquired friend; one on whom benefits have been conferred, or from whom they have been received. E. कृत्रिम made, and मित्र a friend; also similar compounds in this or other senses, कृत्रिमशत्रु an acquired enemy, कृत्रिमौदसीन one who is indifferent to benefits or injuries, neither an acquired friend nor foe.
कृत्वा: कृत्वा ind. Having done, made, &c. E. कृ to do, क्त्वाच् aff.
कृत्स: कृत्स n. (-त्सं) 1 Water. 2 Entire, whole. E. कृत to surround, and स Uṇādi aff.
कृत्स्न: कृत्स्न mfn. (-त्स्नः-त्स्ना-त्स्नं) All, whole, entire. n. (-त्स्नं) Water. 2 The flank or hip. E. कृत to encompass, क्स्न Uṇādi aff.
कृत्स्नविद्: कृत्स्नविद् mfn. (-वित् or -विद्) Omniscient, acquainted with all things. E. कृत्स्न all, and विद् who knows.
कृत्स्नशस्: कृत्स्नशस् ind. Wholly, entirely, altogether. E. कृत्स्न, and शम् aff.
कृदर: कृदर m. (-रः) A granary, a cupboard, &c. for holding corn, grain, &c. E. कृत to contain, Uṇādi affix अर.
कृदन्त: कृदन्त m. (-न्तः) A noun formed by the application of the affixes termed कृत् to the root. E. कृत, and अन्त a final.
कृन्तत्र: कृन्तत्र n. (-त्रं) A plough. E. कृत to divide or cut, कत्रन् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
कृन्तन: कृन्तन m. (-नं) Cutting. E. कृति to cut, ल्युट् aff.
कृन्तनिका: कृन्तनिका f. (-का) 1 A knife. 2 The edge of a knife. E. कन् added to the last.
कृप: कृप (ऊ, ऌ) ऊकृपॢ r. 1st cl. (कल्पते) To be able. r. 1st and 10th cls. (कल्पति, कल्पयति) 1 To think or imagine. 2 To mix. 3 To paint or colour. r. 1st cl. (कृपति) To have pity or mercy. r. 10th cl. (कृपयति) To be weak. In the first roots ल ॡ is substituted for ऋ.

कृप m. (-पः) 1 The name of a sage, the brother-in-law of DROṆA. 2 A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas. f. (-पा) Tenderness, compassionateness. f. (-पी) The wife of the sage DROṆA. E. कृप to be able, &c. अङ् aff.
कृपण: कृपण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Miserly, avaricious. 2 Low, vile. 3 Poor, feeble, miserable, pitiable. m. (-णः) A worm. E. कृप to be able, क्वुन् or ल्युट् aff.
कृपाण: कृपाण m. (-णः) A sword, a scymitar or sacrificial knife. f. (-णी) 1 A knife. 2 A shears or scissors. 4 A dagger. E. कृपा mercy, नुद to destroy, ड aff.
कृपाणक: कृपाणक m. (-कः) A sword, a scymitar: see the preceding. E. कन् added to कृपाण.
कृपाणिका: कृपाणिका f. (-का) A knife. E. कन् added to कृपाण, and the fem. aff.
कृपाद्वैत: कृपाद्वैत m. (-तः) One of the Buddhas or deified saints of the Bauddhas. E. कृपा compassion, and अद्वैत not second; unequalled for tenderness.
कृपालु: कृपालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Compassionate, tender. E. कृपा tenderness, आलुक् aff.
कृपामय: कृपामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Compassionate: so कृपावत् (-वान्-वती-वत्) कृपान्वित (-तः-ता-तं) &c.
कृपाहीन: कृपाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unfeeling, unkind, hardhearted. E. कृपा, हीन devoid of.
कृपीट: कृपीट n. (-टं) 1 The belly. 2 Water. 3 A wood, a forest. 4 Wood, timber. E. कृप to be able, कीटन् Uṇādi aff.
कृपीटपाल: कृपीटपाल m. (-लः) 1 The ocean. 2 A rudder or large oar used as one. 3 Air, wind. E. कृपीट water, पाल what preserves, &c. अच् aff.
कृपीटयोनि: कृपीटयोनि m. (-निः) Fire. E. कृपीट water, योनि source, place of origin.
कृपीपति: कृपीपति m. (-तिः) A name of DROṆĀCĀRYA. E. कृपी the wife of the sage, and पति master.
कृपीपुत्र: कृपीपुत्र m. (-त्रः) AŚVATTHĀMA a sage, the son of KṚPĪ and DROṆA. E. कृपी, and पुत्र a son, or with other synonyms of a son, as कृपीसुत, &c.
कृब: कृब r. 1st cl. or 5th cl. (इ,) कृवि (कृणोति) 1 To kill, to hurt or injure in any way. 2 To act, to do. 3 To go, to move. 4 To be in pain.
कृमि: कृमि m. (-मिः) 1 A worm, an insect in general. 2 Lac, the red dye, which is in fact an insect. 5 An Asura or demon. 4 One subject to worms. E. क्रम to go, इन् Uṇādi affix, and the corresponding vowel substituted for र; also किमि.
कृमिकण्टक: कृमिकण्टक n. (-कं) 1 A plant used in medicine: see बिडङ्ग. 2 Opposite leaved fig tree. 3 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata:) see मूषिकपर्णी. E. कृमि a worm, and कण्टक a thorn, a foe; also क्रिमिकण्ठक.
कृमिकर्ण: कृमिकर्ण m. (-र्णः) Worms or lice generating in the external ear. E. कृमि, and कर्ण the ear.
कृमिकोशोत्थ: कृमिकोशोत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Silken, silk. E. कृमि a worm, कोश a ball, and उत्थ what comes or rises from.
कृमिग्रन्थि: कृमिग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) Insects generated at the roots of the eyelashes. E. कृमि, and ग्रन्थि a joint.
कृमिघ्न: कृमिघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Vermifuge, anthelmintic. m. (-घ्नः) 1 A shrub used in medicine, as an anthelmintic, commonly Bireṅg, (Erycibe paniculata, Rox.) see बिडङ्ग. 2 The onion. 3 The root of the jujube. 4 The marking nut plant. f. (-घ्नी) Turmeric. E. कृमि a worm, हन् to kill, and टक् affix; also क्रिमिघ्न.
कृमिज: कृमिज n. (-जं) Agallochum: see क्रिमिज. f. (-जा) Lac, a red dye so called. E. कृमि an insect, and ज born, produced.
कृमिदन्तक: कृमिदन्तक m. (-कः) Toothache with decay of the teeth. E. कृमि, and दन्त a tooth, कन् added.
कृमिन्: कृमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Affected with worms. E. कृमि, and इनि aff.
कृमिरिपु: कृमिरिपु n. (-पुः) An anthelmintic plant: see कृमिघ्न. E. कृमि, and रिपु an enemy.
कृमिल: कृमिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having worms, wormy. f. (-ला) A fruitful woman, one bearing many children. E. कृमि a worm, and ला to receive, to get, affix ड.
कृमिशङ्ख: कृमिशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) The fish of the conch. E. कृमि a worm, and शङ्ख a shell.
कृमिशुक्ति: कृमिशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) An oyster. E. कृमि an insect, and शुक्ति oyster-shell.
कृमिशैल: कृमिशैल m. (-लः) An ant or mole hill. E. कृमि a worm, and शैल a hill; also with कन् added, कृमिशैलक.
कृमिहर: कृमिहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Anthelmintic, vermifuge. E. कृमि, and हर what removes; so कृमिहन्तृ (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ.)
कृमीलक: कृमीलक m. (-कः) A wild sort of kidney bean: see बनमुद्ग.
कृवि: कृवि r. 5th cl. (कृविणीति) To want to hurt or kill.
कृवि m. (-विः) A loom. E. कृ to make, (cloth,) and क्विन् Uṇādi aff.
कृश: कृश r. 4th cl. (इर) कृशिर (कृश्यति) To make thin or small.
कृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Small, thin, little, minute. 2 Thin, spare, emaciated. 3 Weak, feeble. E. कृश to pare or make thin, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
कृशता: कृशता f. (-ता) Leanness, thinness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कृशत्वं.
कृशर: कृशर mf. (-रः-रा) 1 A dish composed of milk, sesamum, and rice. 2 Rice and pease boiled together with a few spices, commonly Khichree; also कृसर.
कृशला: कृशला f. (-ला) The hair of the head. E. कृश minute, ल what receives.
कृशाकु: कृशाकु m. (-कुः) 1 Heating. 2 Grieving. E. कृश to make small, and काकु aff.
कृशाक्ष: कृशाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A spider. E. कृश, अक्षि eye, टच् aff.
कृशाङ्ग: कृशाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Spare, thin, emaciate. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 A woman with a slender shape. 2 A plant, commonly Priyangu: see प्रियङ्गु. E. कृश thin, अङ्ग the body, अण् and ङीष् affs.
कृशानु: कृशानु m. (-नुः) 1 A name of fire. 2 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.) E. कृश to make thin, आनुक Uṇādi aff.
कृशानुरेतस्: कृशानुरेतस् m. (-ताः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कृशानु fire, and रेतस् semen virile.
कृशाश्व: कृशाश्व m. (-श्वः) The name of a sage.
कृशाश्विन्: कृशाश्विन् m. (-श्वी) A dancer, an actor, a tumbler. E. कृशाश्व the name of a saint, the author of directions to players, and इनि aff.
कृष: कृष r. 1st cl. (आ) औकृश (कर्षति) and 6th cl. (कृषति-ते) 1 To draw or make furrows. 2 To plough. With अप, 1 To draw down. 2 To debase. 3 To disregard. With अव, 1 To draw out or off. 2 To disregard or contemn. With आङ्, To attract, to draw to. With उत्, 1 To raise, to draw up. 2 To raise, to excite, to make high, proud, loud, &c. With सम, To draw together. With सम and नि, To bring near or close to.
कृषक: कृषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What or who makes furrows or ploughs. 2 Attractive, attrahent. m. (-कः) 1 The ploughshare. 2 A husbandman, a peasant. E. कृष to plough, &c. Uṇādi affix, क्वुन्; also कृषिक.
कृषाणु: कृषाणु m. (-णुः) A name of fire: see कृशानु.
कृषि: कृषि f. (-षिः) 1 Husbandry, agriculture. 2 Ploughing, cultivating the soil, &c. E. कृष to plough, इक् Uṇādi aff.
कृषिक: कृषिक m. (-कः) 1 The ploughshare. 2 A husbandman, a cultivator. E. कृष to plough, Uṇādi affix किकन्; also कृषक.
कृषिजीविन्: कृषिजीविन् m. (-वी) A cultivator, a farmer. E. कृषि, and नीविन् who lives by.
कृषिफल: कृषिफल n. (-लं) Agricultural produce or profit. E. कृषि, and फल fruit.
कृषीबल: कृषीबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who lives by agriculture, &c. m. (-लः) A husbandman. E. कृषि agriculture, वलच् affix, and इ made ई.
कृष्कर: कृष्कर m. (-रः) An appellation of ŚIVA.
कृष्ट: कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ploughed or tilled, a field, &c. E. कृष to plough, affix क्त.
कृष्टपच्य: कृष्टपच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Sown in ripening after ploughing, (rice, &c.) E. कृष्ट ploughed, पच to ripen, and क्यप् affix; in some places the grain is sown without previous ploughing, whence it is called अकृष्टपच्य.
कृष्टपाक्य: कृष्टपाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Sown or rather ripening after ploughing: see कृष्टपच्य.
कृष्टि: कृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A teacher, a learned man or Paṇḍita. f. (-ष्टिः) Ploughing, cultivating the soil. 2 Attracting, drawing. E. कृष to plough, to trace, ति or क्तिन् aff.
कृष्णंश्रित: कृष्णंश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Devoted to Kṛṣṇa. E. कृष्णं second case, श्रित serving; also कृष्णश्रित.
कृष्ण: कृष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Black or dark blue. m. (-ष्णः) 1 Black, the colour, or dark blue, which is often confounded with it by the Hindus. 2 KṚṢṆA, the most celebrated form of VIṢṆU, or rather VIṢṆU himself; he is distinct from the ten Avatāras or incarnations, being identified with the deity. 3 VYĀSA, a sage, the compiler of the Vedas. 4 A name of ARJUNA. 5 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 6 A crow. 7 A fruit, Karonda or Karinda, (Carissa carondas.) 8 The dark half of the lunar month from full to new moon. n. (-ष्णं) 1 Black pepper. 2 Iron. 3 Blue vitriol. 4 Black agallochum. f. (-ष्णा) 1 A name of DRAUPADĪ wife of the PĀṆḌAVAS. 2 The indigo plant. 3 Long pepper. 4 A grape. 5 A drug, commonly Kakoli. 6 Kalonji, (Nigella Indica:) see कृष्णजीरक. 7 Black mustard, (the name is applied to other vegetable substances of a dark colour.) 8 The Kṛṣṇā river in the Dekhin. 9 A black leech, considered poisonous. E. कृष to attract, as the minds of men, &c. नक् Uṇādi affix; (this is applied to KṚṢṆA, &c.) else, कृष to tinge, affix the same; again कृष्ण black, &c. and अच् affix, fem. affix टाप्.
कृष्णकन्द: कृष्णकन्द n. (-न्दं) The red lotus, (Nymphaea rubra.) E. कृष्ण black, and कन्द stalk.
कृष्णकर्मन्: कृष्णकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Criminal, guilty. n. (-र्म्म) 1 Making black. 2 Cauterising. E. कृष्ण black, and कर्म्मन् action.
कृष्णकर्म्मन्: कृष्णकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Criminal, guilty. n. (-र्म्म) 1 Making black. 2 Cauterising. E. कृष्ण black, and कर्म्मन् action.
कृष्णकाक: कृष्णकाक m. (-कः) A raven. E. कृष्ण black, and काक a crow.
कृष्णकाष्ठ: कृष्णकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A black variety of agallochum. E. कृष्ण, and काष्ठ wood.
कृष्णकोहल: कृष्णकोहल m. (-लः) A gamester, a gambler.
कृष्णचतुर्दशी: कृष्णचतुर्द्दशी f. (-शी) The fourteenth day in the dark half of a month. E. कृष्ण dark, चतुर्द्दशी fourteen; it is the day preceding new moon.
कृष्णचतुर्द्दशी: कृष्णचतुर्द्दशी f. (-शी) The fourteenth day in the dark half of a month. E. कृष्ण dark, चतुर्द्दशी fourteen; it is the day preceding new moon.
कृष्णचर: कृष्णचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Formerly or in a former existence, KṚṢṆA. E. कृष्ण, and चरट् affix, implying former state of being; also कृष्णरुप्य.
कृष्णचूर्ण: कृष्णचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Rust of iron, iron filings. E. कृष्ण black, and चूर्णं powder, dust.
कृष्णजटा: कृष्णजटा f. (-टा) Indian spikenard: see जटामांसी. E. कृष्ण black, जटा twisted hair, to which its entangled stalks are compared.
कृष्णजीरक: कृष्णजीरक m. (-कः) Kalonji, a plant having a small black seed, which is used for medical and culinary purposes, (Nigella Indica, Rox.) E. कृष्ण black, and जीरक cummin seed.
कृष्णता: कृष्णता f. (-ता) Blackness. E. तल् added to कृष्ण; with त्व, कृष्णत्वं.
कृष्णताम्र: कृष्णताम्र n. (-म्रं) A kind of Sandal wood. E. कृष्ण, and तास्र copper, of a dusky copper hue.
कृष्णतार: कृष्णतार m. (-रः) A deer, an antelope. E. कृष्ण black, and तार the pupil of the eye, black-eyed.
कृष्णत्रिवृता: कृष्णत्रिवृता f. (-ता) A plant, black Teöri: see चिवृता.
कृष्णदशन: कृष्णदशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having bad or discoloured teeth. E. कृष्ण, and दशन a tooth.
कृष्णदेह: कृष्णदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Black-bodied. m. (-हः) A large black bee. E. कृष्ण black, and देह the body.
कृष्णद्वैपायन: कृष्णद्वैपायन m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas, and Purāṇas. E. a compound of two other names of the sage: see कृष्ण, and द्वैपायन.
कृष्णधत्तूर: कृष्णधत्तूर m. (-रः) A dark species of Datura or thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa:) see घत्तूर.
कृष्णपक्ष: कृष्णपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The dark half of a month, the fifteen days during which the moon is in the wane. E. कृष्ण dark, and पक्ष fortnight or half month.
कृष्णपाक: कृष्णपाक m. (-कः) A tree bearing a small fruit, which, when ripe, is of a black colour, commonly Karinda or Karonda, (Carissa carondas.) E. कृष्ण black, and पाक what is ripe, from पच to ripen, to cook, and घञ् affix; also कृष्णफल, and कृष्णपाकफल.
कृष्णपाकफल: कृष्णपाकफल m. (-लः) The Karonda: see the preceding. E. फल fruit, added to कृष्णपाक.
कृष्णपिङ्गला: कृष्णपिङ्गला f. (-ला) A name of DURGĀ. E. कृष्ण black, and पिङ्गल tawny; being of such of such a colour.
कृष्णपिण्डीतक: कृष्णपिण्डीतक m. (-कः) A dark kind of Māyana, (Vangueria spinosa). E. कृष्ण black, and पिण्डीतक the Mayan or Mayana tree.
कृष्णपिण्डीर: कृष्णपिण्डीर m. (-रः) A dark kind of Mayan: see the preceding.
कृष्णपिपीली: कृष्णपिपीली f. (-ली) The black ant. E. कृष्ण, and पिपील ant.
कृष्णपुष्प: कृष्णपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A black kind of Datūra. f. (-ष्पी) Another plant: see प्रियङ्गु. E. कृष्ण black, and पुष्प a flower.
कृष्णफल: कृष्णफल (-लः) A fruit tree, the Karinda: see कृष्णपाक. f. (-ला) A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica:) see सोमराजी. E. कृष्ण black, and फल fruit.
कृष्णफलपाक: कृष्णफलपाक m. (-कः) A fruit: see the preceding; also कृष्णपाकफल.
कृष्णभूमि: कृष्णभूमि f. (-मिः) A country with a dark soil, one of mould, blue clay, &c. E. कृष्ण black, and भूमि earth; also with a final अ, कृष्णभूमः.
कृष्णभूमिजा: कृष्णभूमिजा f. (-जा) A species of grass, described as a nourishing food for cattle. E. कृष्णभूमि black earth, and ज born, produced.
कृष्णभेदी: कृष्णभेदी f. (-दी) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. कृष्ण black, hence, dirt or excrement, and भेदी what breaks, or dissipates.
कृष्णमुद्ग: कृष्णमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus max.) E. कृष्ण black, मुद्ग phaseolus.
कृष्णमृत्: कृष्णमृत् f. (-मृत्) A country with a soil of a dark colour. E. कृष्ण black, and मृत् earth: see कृष्णभूमि.
कृष्णरुप्य: कृष्णरुप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Formerly KṚṢṆA: see कृष्णचर. E. कृष्ण, and रुप्य affix, implying past state of being.
कृष्णलवण: कृष्णलवण n. (-णं) A factitious salt, either that prepared by evaporation from saline soil, or the medicinal kind, called Bit Loben or Bit Noben, a muriate of soda with a proportion of sulphur and iron. E. कृष्ण black, and लवण salt.
कृष्णल: कृष्णल m. (-लः) A Ratti, a weight, the berry so used; or an artificial weight derived from it, the berry averaging about 1¼ grain, the weight 2(3/16) grains. f. (-ला) A shrub bearing a small black and red berry, the Ratti or Gunja: see गुञ्जा. E. कृष्ण blackness, and ल what gets, from ला to obtain, affix ड and fem. affix टाप्.
कृष्णलक: कृष्णलक m. (-कः) A Ratti, the jeweller's weight, the fifth of a Māṣa. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कृष्णलोह: कृष्णलोह n. (-हं) The loadstone. E. कृष्ण what attracts, and लोह iron.
कृष्णलोहित: कृष्णलोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Of a purple colour. E. कृष्ण black, and लोहित red; of which two colours purple is supposed to consist.
कृष्णवक्त्र: कृष्णवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) The black faced monkey. E. कृष्ण black, and वक्त्र the face.
कृष्णवर्ण: कृष्णवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Black or dark blue. n. (-र्णं) The colour black. E. कृष्ण and वर्ण colour.
कृष्णवर्त्मन्: कृष्णवर्त्मन् m. (-र्त्ना) 1 Fire. 2 RĀHU or the personified ascending node. 3 A low man, an outcaste, a profligate, a blackguard. 4 The marking nut plant. E. कृष्ण black, and वर्त्मन् a path or way; whose way is darkness.
कृष्णवल्ली: कृष्णवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A plant, a dark kind of Babul, (Ocymum pilosum).
कृष्णवानर: कृष्णवानर m. (-रः) A black monkey. E. कृष्ण black, and वानर an ape.
कृष्णवीज: कृष्णवीज m. (-जः) A red variety of the Morunga: see रक्तशीग्र. E. कृष्ण black, and वीज the seed.
कृष्णवृन्ता: कृष्णवृन्ता f. (-न्ता) 1 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 A leguminous plant, (Glycine debilis.) E. कृष्ण black, and वृन्त foot-stalk.
कृष्णवृन्तिका: कृष्णवृन्तिका f. (-का) A tree, (Gmelina arborea:) see गम्भारी.
कृष्णशार: कृष्णशार m. (-रः) The black antelope: see कृष्णसार.
कृष्णशालि: कृष्णशालि m. (-लिः) A sort of rice of a dark colour. E. कृष्ण, and शालि rice.
कृष्णशिम्बी: कृष्णशिम्बी f. (-म्बी) A sort of bean, (Dolichos virosus.) E. कृष्ण, and शिम्बी a Dolichos.
कृष्णशृङ्ग: कृष्णशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A buffalo. E. कृष्ण black, and शृङ्ग a horn, black, horned.
कृष्णश्रित: कृष्णश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipping or devoted to KṚṢṆA. E. कृष्ण, and श्रित attached.
कृष्णसख: कृष्णसख m. (-खः) A friend or follower of KṚṢṆA, especially ARJUNA. E. कृष्ण, and सखि a friend, टच् affix in this class of compounds.
कृष्णसर्प: कृष्णसर्प m. (-र्पः) A black snake. E. कृष्ण, and सर्प a snake.
कृष्णसर्षप: कृष्णसर्षप m. (-पः) Black mustard. E. कृष्ण, and सर्षप mustard.
कृष्णसार: कृष्णसार mf. (-रः-रा) A timber tree, Sisū, (Dalbergia Sisu, Rox.) m. (-रः) 1 The black antelope. 2 Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 A thorny plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli, &c.) E. कृष्ण black, and सार essence.
कृष्णसारङ्ग: कृष्णसारङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The black antelope. E. कृष्ण black, and सारङ्ग a deer.
कृष्णसारथि: कृष्णसारथि m. (-थिः) ARJUNA. E. कृष्ण, and सारथि charioteer; driven by KṚṢṆA.
कृष्णस्कन्ध: कृष्णस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A tree which bears black blossoms, the Tamāla tree. E. कृष्ण black, and स्कन्ध the shoulder: see कालस्कन्ध.
कृष्णागुरु: कृष्णागुरु n. (-रु) Agallochum or aloe wood, the black variety. E. कृष्ण, and अगुरु aloe wood.
कृष्णाचल: कृष्णाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Raivata, part of the western portion of the Vindhya chain; it is also one of the nine principal mountains that separate the same divisions or Varṣas of the known world. E. कृष्ण black, and अचल a mountain.
कृष्णानदी: कृष्णानदी f. (-दी) The name of a river, possibly the Kistṇa in the Dekin. E. कृष्ण, and नदी a river, the river of KṚṢṆA; also other analogous names, as कृष्णसमुद्भवा, कृष्णवेण्या, कृष्णगङ्गा, &c.; also कृष्णा.
कृष्णामिष: कृष्णामिष n. (-षं) Iron. E. कृष्ण black, and आमिप flesh, substance.
कृष्णायस: कृष्णायस n. (-सं) Iron, crude or black iron. E. कृष्ण black, and अयस iron.
कृष्णार्चिस्: कृष्णार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) A name of fire. E. कृष्ण black, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
कृष्णार्च्चिस्: कृष्णार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) A name of fire. E. कृष्ण black, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
कृष्णार्जक: कृष्णार्जक m. (-कः) A black species of basil: see कृष्णवल्ली. E. कृष्ण black, and अर्जक basil.
कृष्णावास: कृष्णावास m. (-सः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. कृष्ण the deity, and आवास abode.
कृष्णाश्रित: कृष्णाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Devoted to or the votary of KṚṢṆA. E. कृष्ण, and आश्रित attached or devoted to.
कृष्णिका: कृष्णिका f. (-का) Black mustard. E. कृष्ण black, कन् affix, the fem. form.
कृष्णिमन्: कृष्णिमन् m. (-मा) Blackness. E. कृष्ण, and इमनिच् aff.
कृष्णीकरण: कृष्णीकरण n. (-णं) Blackening, making black. E. कृष्णं, and करण making, च्चि augment.
कृष्णीकृत: कृष्णीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blackened, made black. E. कृष्ण, कृत made, च्चि augment.
कृष्णीभूत: कृष्णीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being or become black, &c. E. कृष्ण, भूत become, च्चि augment.
कृष्णेक्षु: कृष्णेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A sort of sugar cane. E. कृष्ण black, and इक्षु sugar cane.
कृसर: कृसर m. (-रः) 1 A dish consisting of sesamum and grain. 2 A mixture of rice and peas with a few spices. E. कॄ to scatter, सरः Uṇādi affix; also कृशर.
कॄ: कॄ r. 6th cl. (किरति) To throw, to scatter. r. 9th cl. (कृणति) or (गि, ञ्) गिकॄञ् (कृणाति-कृणीते) To hurt, to injure. r. 10th cl. (कारयते) To know. 1 With अप prefixed, ^a To draw furrows, to make lines. ^b To disperse. 2 With अव, To throw, to cast. 3 With आङ्, To fill up, to cover over. 4 With प्रति, To hurt, to injure. 5 With वि, To throw, to caste, to send, to scatter widely. 6 With सम, To gather, to collect. 7 With अभि, in the passive voice, to be upset, overcome or overwhelmed.
कॄत: कॄत r. 10th cl. (कीर्त्तयति) To celebrate, to glorify, to render renowned or notorious.
कॢप्त: कॢप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Made, formed. 2 Fixed, appointed. 3 Ascertained, determined. 4 Cut, pared, shorn. E. कृप to be able, &c. affix क्ल, and the augment इट् omitted.
कॢप्तकीला: कॢप्तकीला f. (-ला) Title deed, lease of a house, &c. E. कॢप्त fixed, कील a bolt or pin.
कॢप्तधूप: कॢप्तधूप m. (-पः) Frankincense, olibanum. E. कॢप्त made, धूप incense.
केकय: केकय m. (-यः) A prince of the solar race. f. (-यी) The daughter of the preceding, and one of the wives of DAŚARATHA: the mother of BHARATA: see केकेयी.
केकर: केकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Squint-eyed. E. के in the head, कृ to make, टच् affix; also compounded with अक्ष an eye, as केकराक्ष.
केका: केका f. (-का) The cry of a peacock. E. के an imitative sound, and क what sounds, from के to sound, affixes ड and टाप्.
केकाबल: केकाबल m. (-लः) A peacock. E. केका his cry, and बलच् aff.
केकिन्: केकिन् m. (-की) A peacock. E. केका the cry of the bird, and इनि aff.
केकेयी: केकेयी f. (-यी) One of DAŚARATHA'S three wives, the mother of BHARATA.
केचन: केचन ind. Some, some or certain persons. E. के plural of किम्, and चन aff.
केचित: केचित ind. Some, some persons. E. see the last; चिति aff.
केचुक: केचुक n. (-कः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia:) see कचु.
केणिका: केणिका f. (-का) A tent. E. किण to cover (a Sautra root), ण्वुल aff.
केत: केत r. 10th cl. (केतयति) 1 To call or invite. 2 To counsel or advise; some authorities substitute सङ्केत for this root.
केत m. (-तः) A house, an abode. E. कित to abide, affix घञ्.
केतक: केतक mf. (-कः-की) A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. किति to abide, ण्वुल् aff.
केतन: केतन n. (-नं) 1 A flag, a banner. 2 Business, indispensable act. 3 Invitation. 4 A spot or mark, a sign, a symbol. 5 A house, an abode. 6 Place, site, situation, &c. E. कित to abide, affix ल्युट्.
केतित: केतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Called, summoned. 2 Dwelt, inhabited. E. केत to call, or कित to dwell, affix क्त.
केतु: केतु m. (-तुः) KETU the dragon's tail or descending node; in astronomy, the ninth of the planets; in mythology, a demon: the body of SAIṂHIKEYA severed from the head (RĀHU), by VIṢṆU, at the churning of the ocean, but immortal, by having tasted the Amṛta. 2 A banner, a flag. 3 A mark, a sign, a symbol, &c. 4 Light. 5 A comet, a falling star, &c. 6 Disease. 7 A pigmy race inhabiting Kusa Dvīpa, the progeny of JAIMINI. E. चाय to worship, तु Uṇādi affix, कि substituted for the root.
केतुतारा: केतुतारा f. (-रा) A comet. E. केतु, and तारा a star.
केतुभ: केतुभ m. (-भः) A cloud. E. केतु the plant, and भ what resembles it in darkness.
केतुमाल: केतुमाल n. (-लं) One of nine great divisions of the known world, the western portion or Varṣa of Jambu Dvīpa.
केतुयष्टि: केतुयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A flag-staff. E. केतु, and यष्टि a stick.
केतुरत्न: केतुरत्न n. (-त्नं) Lapis lazuli. E. केतु, and रत्न a gem.
केतुवसन: केतुवसन m. (-नः) A flag. E. केतु a standard, and वसन cloth.
केदर: केदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Squint-eyed. m. (-रः) The name of a plant. E. क the earth or the head, दृ to divide, affix अच्.
केदार: केदार m. (-रः) 1 A field, a meadow, a plain. 2 A mountain. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 A particular place, the modern Kedār, part of the Himālaya mountains. 5 A basin for water round the root of a tree. 6 A bed in a garden or field. E. क water, earth, &c. दृ to tear or rend, घञ् aff.
केदारखण्ड: केदारखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A small dyke or mound, earth raised to keep out water. E. केदार, and खण्ड a portion.
केनार: केनार m. (-रः) 1 The head. 2 The temples, the upper part of the cheek. 3 A joint. 4 A division of hell, a hell like a potter's kiln. E. क the head, &c. मृ to guide, घञ् aff.
केनिपात: केनिपात m. (-तः) The helm, a rudder, a large oar used as one. E. क water, निपात who goes or falls; also केनिपातक m. (-कः)
केन्दु: केन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A sort of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa, Rox.) E. क the earth, इन्द to moisten, उ aff.
केन्दुक: केन्दुक m. (-कः) A sort of ebony, that yields a species of tar, (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. कन् implying resemblance, affixed to the preceding.
केन्द्र: केन्द्र n. (-न्दं) 1 The centre of a circle. 2 The argument of an equation. 3 The distance of a planet from the first point of its orbit in the fourth, seventh, or tenth degree. It is variously applied in combination, as पतनकेन्द्रं argument of the latitude; द्वितीयकेन्द्रं the distance of the higher apsis form a planet in any point of its orbit; शीघ्रकेन्द्रं commutation, the distance of  the sun from a superior planet or of an inferior planet from the sun; मन्दकेन्द्रं argument of anomaly.
केप: केप (ऋ) केपृ r. 1st cl. (केपते) 1 To shake or tremble. 2 To go, to move or approach.
केयूर: केयूर n. (-रं) A bracelet worn on the upper arm. E. क the head, here implying the head of the arm, यु to join, ऊर aff.
केरल: केरल m. (-लः) The appellation of a country, Keraladeś or the modern Malabar. f. (-ली) 1 Astronomical science. 2 An astronomical Śāstra or treatise. 2 A Horā or period of time equal to about one hour.
केल: केल r. 1st cl. (ऊ) केलु (केलति) 1 To shake. 2 To go or move.
केलक: केलक m. (-कः) A dancer, a tumbler, one who walks or dances on the edge of a sword. E. किल to sport, ण्वुल् aff.
केलास: केलास m. (-सः) Crystal. E. के in water, लस to shine, अंण aff.
केलि: केलि mf. (-लिः लिः or -ली) Play, sport, pastime, amusement. f. (-लिः) The earth. E. किल to sport, Uṇādi affix इ.
केलिक: केलिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sportive, sporting. m. (-कः) The Asoka tree. E. केलि and कन् added.
केलिकला: केलिकला f. (-ला) 1 The Vīṇā or lute of SARASVATĪ. 2 Amorous or sportive accents or address. 3 Sportive skill, wantonness. E. केलि sport, कल to sound, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
केलिकिल: केलिकिल m. (-लः) One of ŚIVA'S attendant demigods. 2 The confidential companion of the hero of a drama, in general a sort of buffoon. f. (-ला) A name of RATI, the wife of KĀMADEVA. E. केलि sport, किल who plays, from किल to sport, affix क.
केलिकुञ्चिका: केलिकुञ्चिका f. (-का) A wife's younger sister. E. केलि play, कुचि to be crooked, ण्वुल् aff.
केलिकोष: केलिकोष m. (-षः) An actor, a dancer or tumbler: see केलक.
केलिगृह: केलिगृह n. (-हं) A pleasure house, a private apartment. E. केलि sport, and गृह a house; also कलिनिकेतन, &c.
केलिनागर: केलिनागर m. (-रः) A sensualist, an enjoyer of worldly pleasures. E. केलि sport, and नागर a libertine, &c.
केलिपर: केलिपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wanton, sportive. E. केलि, and पर intent on.
केलिमुख: केलिमुख m. (-खः) Pastime, sport. E. केलि play, and मुख chief.
केलिवृक्ष: केलिवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A species of the Kadamba, commonly KeliKadamba, (Nauclea cordifolia.) E. केलि sport, and वृक्ष a tree; being abundant in the scene of KṚṢṆA'S sports with the Gopīs.
केलिशयन: केलिशयन n. (-नं) A couch, a sofa. E. केलि, and शयन a bed.
केलिसचिव: केलिसचिव m. (-वः) Minister of the sports, master of the revels. E. केलि play, सचिव a counsellor, a minister.
केव: केव r. 1st cl. (ऋ) केवृ (केवते) To serve.
केवर्त: केवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A fisherman: see कैवर्त्त.
केवर्त्त: केवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A fisherman: see कैवर्त्त.
केवल: केवल mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं) 1 One, alone, only. 2 All, entire, whole. m. (-लः) An envious or selfish man. n. adv. (-लं) 1 Absolutely, certainly. 2 Only, alone. Subst. 3 A species of knowledge, that of the unity of spirit. E. केव to sprinkle, कल aff.
केवलज्ञानिन्: केवलज्ञानिन् m. (-नी) One of the Jaina saints of the last age. E. केवल unity, and ज्ञानिन् who knows.
केवलद्रव्य: केवलद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Black pepper. E. केवल one, only, द्रव्य thing.
केवलवैयाकरण: केवलवैयाकरण m. (-णः) A grammarian, a mere grammarian, one not versed in any other science. E. केवल only, and वैयाकरण a grammarian; also similar compounds, as केवलनैयायिक a mere logician, &c.
केवलिन्: केवलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) One, only, alone. m. (-ली) A Jaina who has acquired holy knowledge. E. केषल one, इनि affix; a unitarian.
केविका: केविका f. (-का) The name of a flower, commonly Keber.
केश: केश m. (-शः) 1 Hair. 2 A name of VARUṆA. 3 A kind of perfume: see वाला. 4 The name of a demon. 5 A name of VIṢṆU. f. (-शी) 1 A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 2 The indigo plant. 3 Indian spikenard. E. क्लिश to bind, अण् affix, and ल rejected; or क the head, and ईश to rule, affix अच्; again, क water or happiness, and ईश the lord or master.
केशक: केशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Skilful in dressing hair, taking pains with it, &c. E. केश, and कन् aff.
केशकलाप: केशकलाप m. (-पः) A quantity of hair. E. केश hair, and कलाप in this compound implying quantity.
केशकार: केशकार m. (-रः) A sort of sugar cane. E. केश, and कार what makes.
केशकीट: केशकीट m. (-टः) A louse. E. केश, and कीट an insect.
केशगर्ब्भ: केशगर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) 1 A braid of hair. 2 Varuṇa. E. केश, and गर्भ origin.
केशगर्ब्भक: केशगर्ब्भक m. (-कः) A braid or tress of hair. E. केश hair, and गर्ब्भक a chaplet.
केशगृहीत: केशगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pulled or seized by the hair. E. केश, and गृहीत seized.
केशग्रह: केशग्रह m. (-हः) Pulling the hair. E. केश, and ग्रह seizing; also केशग्रहणं.
केशघ्न: केशघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Morbid baldness, falling of the hair. E. केश the hair, and घ्न what destroys, from हन् to injure, affix टच्.
केशच्छिद्: केशच्छिद् m. (-च्छित् or -च्छिद्) A barber, a hair-dresser. E. केश the hair, छिद् to cut, affix क्विप्.
केशट: केशट m. (-टः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A goat. 3 A louse. 5 A brother. 5 One of KĀMA'S arrows. 6 A tree, commonly Sonapat, (शोणक.) E. केश hair, अट to go, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
केशधृत्: केशधृत् m. (-धृत्) The root of sweet flag. E. केश hair, धृ to hold, affix, क्विप्; resembling hair.
केशपक्ष: केशपक्ष m. (-क्षः) Much or ornamented hair. E. केश hair, पक्ष quantity, in this compound.
केशपङ्क्ति: केशपङ्क्ति f. (-ङ्क्तिः) 1 A row or line of hair. 2 A quantity of hair. E. केश, and पंक्ति a line.
केशपर्णी: केशपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera;) also अपामार्ग. E. केश hair, पर्ण a leaf.
केशपाश: केशपाश m. (-शः) Much or ornamented hair. f. (-शी) A lock of hair on the top of the head. E. केश hair, पाश quantity, in this compound.
केशभू: केशभू m. (-भूः) The head. E. केश, and भू place.
केशमार्जक: केशमार्जक m. (-कः) A comb. E. केश hair, मृज to clean, ण्वुल् affix; also केशमार्जन.
केशमार्जन: केशमार्जन n. (-नं) 1 A comb. 2 Cleaning the hair. E. see the preceding, ल्युट् aff.
केशमुष्टि: केशमुष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) 1 A large species of Nimb tree. 2 A handful of hair. E. केश, and मुष्टि the fist.
केशर: केशर mn. (-रः-रं) The filament of a lotus or of any vegetable. m. (-रः) 1 A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) 2 A tree bearing a white strong smelling flower, (Mimusops elengi:) see वकुल. 3 A shrub used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria;) also पुन्नाग. 4 A lion's mane. n. (-रं) Asafoetida. E. क water, &c. in the seventh case के, शृ to go, अप् affix; also with सृ to go केसर.
केशरञ्जन: केशरञ्जन m. (-नः) A plant: see भृङ्गराज, (Verbesina prostrata). E. केश the hair, and रञ्जन what colours.
केशराज: केशराज m. (-जः) A species of Bhringariva: see the preceding. E. केश hair, राज to shine, टच् aff.
केशरिन्: केशरिन् m. (-री) 1 A lion. 2 A horse. 3 A plant used in dying: see पुन्नाग. 4 Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) 5 The citron tree. E. केशर a mane, a filament, &c. इनि aff.
केशव: केशव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Having much or handsome hair. m. (-वः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. 2 A plant, commonly Punnag: see पुन्नाग. E. क BRAHMA, and ईश ŚIVA, व who goes, &c. from वा with ड affix; again केश hair, व who possesses; fine-haired.
केशवत्: केशवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a fine head of hair. E. केश and मतुप् aff.
केशवभक्ति: केशवभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Devotion to KṚṢṆA. E. केशव, and भक्ति faith.
केशवायुध: केशवायुध m. (-धः) 1 The mango tree. 2 Any weapon of KṚṢṆA. E. केशव KṚṢṆA, and आयुध a weapon.
केशवालय: केशवालय m. (-यः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. केशव KṚṢṆA, and आलय abode.
केशवेश: केशवेश m. (-शः) A tress or fillet of hair. E. केश hair, and बेश ornament.
केशहल: केशहल m. (-लः) Much or ornamented hair. E. केश hair, and हल here implying much.
केशाकेशि: केशाकेशि n. (-शि) Pulling the hair mutually, hair to hair. E. केश hair, repeated, affix इञ्.
केशान्त: केशान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Cutting off the hair finally as a religious ceremony, performed upon Brahmans at sixteen years of age; Kṣatriyas at twenty-two; and Vaiśyas at twenty-four. 2 The tip or end of hair. E. केश, and अन्त end.
केशान्तिक: केशान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Extending to the hair. 2 Relating to the ceremony of final tonsure. E. केशान्त, and ठक aff.
केशावमर्षण: केशावमर्षण n. (-णं) Pulling the hair, especially amorously, playing with it, rubbing it, &c. E. केश the hair, अव implying improperly, and मर्षण rubbing.
केशिक: केशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Having fine or luxuriant hair. 2 Relating to the hair. E. केश hair, ठक् aff.
केशिन्: केशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Having fine hair. m. (-शी) 1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 2 The name of a Daitya or demon killed by KṚṢṆA. 3 A lion. f. (-शिनी) 1 A kind of grass, (Andropogon aculeatum.) 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) E. केश hair, इनि aff.
केशिसूदन: केशिसूदन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. केशि a demon, सूदन destroyer; also similar compounds, as केशिहन्, कशिनिसूदन, &c.
केशोच्चय: केशोच्चय m. (-यः) Much or handsome hair. E. केश hair, उच्चय heap, abundance.
केसर: केसर mn. (-रः-रं) A filament, m. (-रः) 1 A lion. 2 A horse. 3 The mane of a horse or lion, &c., see केशर. 4 A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) 5 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) nf. (-रं-री) Asafoetida. n. (-रं) 1 Gold. 2 Sulphate of iron. 3 The flower of the Nagesar. E. के on the head, सृ to go, ट aff.
केसरवर: केसरवर n. (-रं) Saffron. E. केसर, and वर best.
केसराम्ल: केसराम्ल m. (-म्लः) A citron. E. केसर, and अम्ल sour.
केसरिन्: केसरिन् m. (-री) 1 A lion. 2 A horse. 3 A plant used in dying: see पुन्नाग. 4 Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) 5 A monkey the father of HANUMĀN. E. केसर a filament, a mane, इनि aff.
केसरिसुत: केसरिसुत m. (-तः) The monkey HANUMAN. E. केसरि, and सुत son.
कैकेयी: कैकेयी f. (-यी) One of the wives of DAŚARATHA, and the mother of BHARATA. E. केकय a king, father of this lady, and ढक् aff.
कैङ्कर्य: कैङ्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Service, servitude. E. किङ्कर a servant, and ष्यञ् aff.
कैङ्कर्य्य: कैङ्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Service, servitude. E. किङ्कर a servant, and ष्यञ् aff.
कैटभ: कैटभ m. (-भः) A demon slain by VIṢṆU. f. (-भा) A name of DURGĀ. E. कैटभ a demon in whose death the goddess was instrumental, by having at the prayers of BRAHMĀ roused VIṢṆU from his slumbers, during which two demons, Kaitabha and Madhu, were about to demolish BRAHMĀ; also कैटभी.
कैटभजित्: कैटभजित् m. (-जित्) A name of VIṢṆU. E. कैटभ the name of an Asura killed by the deity, and जित् who conquers; also similar compounds, as कैटभहन्, &c.
कैटभारि: कैटभारि m. (-रिः) A name of VIṢṆU: see कैटभजित्.
कैटर्य: कैटर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A plant used in medicine, commonly Kayaphal. 2 The Nimb tree. 3 Mayana, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. कैटर from किट to fear, and रा to cause, alarming by its pungency; pleonastic affix ष्यञ्; also कैडर्य्य.
कैटर्य्य: कैटर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A plant used in medicine, commonly Kayaphal. 2 The Nimb tree. 3 Mayana, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. कैटर from किट to fear, and रा to cause, alarming by its pungency; pleonastic affix ष्यञ्; also कैडर्य्य.
कैतव: कैतव n. (-वं) 1 Deceit, fraud, cheating, roguery. 2 Gambling. 3 The lapis lazuli. E. कितव a cheat, &c. अण् aff.
कैतवप्रयोग: कैतवप्रयोग m. (-गः) A trick, a device. E. कैतव, and प्रयोग application.
कैतववाद: कैतववाद m. (-दः) Evasion, falsehood. E. कैतव, and वाद speech.
कैदार: कैदार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Belonging to a field, a meadow, &c. m. (-रः) Rice, corn. n. (-रं) A multitude of fields. E. केदार a field, and अण् affix; also केदारक, and कैदारिक.
कैदारक: कैदारक n. (-कं) A multitude of fields. E. केदार, and वुञ् affix; also with ठञ् affix कैदारिक.
कैदार्य: कैदार्य्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-री-र्य्यं) Belonging to a field, &c. n. (-र्य्यं) A number of fields. E. केदार, and ष्यञ् aff.
कैदार्य्य: कैदार्य्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-री-र्य्यं) Belonging to a field, &c. n. (-र्य्यं) A number of fields. E. केदार, and ष्यञ् aff.
कैरव: कैरव m. (-बः) 1 A rogue, a cheat. 2 An enemy. f. (-वी) Moonlight. n. (-वं) 1 The white esculent water-lily. 2 Fraud, trick. E. केरव here said to mean, a goose, from के in water, and रु to sound, with अप् affix; again, अण् affix, liked by the geese; or किरव a cheat, &c. or कैरव a lotus, and अण् affix, implying identity or resemblance.
कैरविणी: कैरविणी f. (-णी) A place abounding in lotus flowers, or an assemblage of lotuses. E. कैरव a white lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.
कैरविन्: कैरविन् m. (-वी) The moon. E. कैरवी moonlight, इनि aff.
कैराटक: कैराटक m. (-कः) A species of poison, one of the fixed kinds.
कैरात: कैरात n. (-तं) 1 A sort of gentian, commonly Cherayta, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.) 2 A kind of Sandal. m. (-तः) A strong man. E. किरात gentian, &c. अण् aff.
कैल: कैल n. (-लं) Sport, pleasure. E. केलि, and अञ् pleonasm.
कैलास: कैलास m. (-सः) The mountain Kailāsa, the fabulous residence of KUVERA, and favourite haunt of ŚIVA; it is placed by the Hindus amongst the Himālaya mountains, and the name is given to one of the loftiest peaks lying on the north of the Mānasa lake. E. कैलास crystal, and the affix अण् implying nature or consistence; or कैल pleasure, आस to abide, affix घञ्; the place where beings reside in bliss.
कैलासनिकेतन: कैलासनिकेतन m. (-नः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 KUVERA. E. कैलास, and निकेतन dwelling.
कैलासौकस्: कैलासौकस् m. (-काः) A name of KUVERA. E. कैलास the mountain, औकस् abode; whose abode is mount Kailāsa.
कैवर्त: कैवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A fisherman born of a prostitute by a Kṣatriya, or of an Ayogava female by a Niṣāda father. f. (-र्त्ती) The wife of a fisherman. E. क water, in the seventh case, के and वर्त्त who abides, केवर्त्त a fish, अण् affix, implying enmity.
कैवर्त्त: कैवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A fisherman born of a prostitute by a Kṣatriya, or of an Ayogava female by a Niṣāda father. f. (-र्त्ती) The wife of a fisherman. E. क water, in the seventh case, के and वर्त्त who abides, केवर्त्त a fish, अण् affix, implying enmity.
कैवर्तमुस्तक: कैवर्त्तमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass: see the next.
कैवर्त्तमुस्तक: कैवर्त्तमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass: see the next.
कैवर्तिमुस्तक: कैवर्त्तिमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus). E. कैवर्त्त as above, water-abiding, and मुस्तक cyperus; also कैवर्त्तीमुस्तक, कैवर्त्तंमुस्त, &c.
कैवर्त्तिमुस्तक: कैवर्त्तिमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus). E. कैवर्त्त as above, water-abiding, and मुस्तक cyperus; also कैवर्त्तीमुस्तक, कैवर्त्तंमुस्त, &c.
कैवल्य: कैवल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ली-ल्यं) Sole, only. n. (-ल्यं) 1 Eternal emancipation, future happiness. 2 Exclusiveness, individuality. E. केवल alone, free from all fetters, व्यञ् affix of the abstract.
कैशिक: कैशिक m. (-कः) Love, passion, lust. f. (-की) One of the four varieties of dramatic style, the graceful style, suited especially to the passion of love. n. (-कं) A quantity of hair, the head of hair. E. केशिक having much hair, &c. affix अण्, fem. affix ङीष्.
कैशोर: कैशोर n. (-रं) Youth, boyhood, from the age of ten to that of fifteen. E. किशोर a child, and अञ् aff.
कैश्य: कैश्य n. (-श्यं) A head of hair, much or ornamented hair. E. केश hair, यञ् aff.
कोक: कोक m. (-कः) 1 A wolf. 2 The ruddy goose. 3 A frog. 4 A lizard, a chameleon. 5 The wild date tree. 6 A name of VIṢṆU. E. कुक to seize or take, or क water, उक to go, affix अच्.
कोकड: कोकड m. (-डः) An animal said to be a kind of deer, of a brown colour, with a bushy tail, and lurking in holes, perhaps a hare.
कोकनद: कोकनद n. (-दं) 1 The red lotus. 2 The red water lily. E. कोक a goose, and नद to sound, affix क.
कोकनदच्छवि: कोकनदच्छवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) Red, the colour, or of that colour. E. कोकनद the red lotus, and छवि light, splendor.
कोकबन्धु: कोकबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The sun. E. कोक the ruddy goose, and बन्धु a friend: see चक्रवाक.
कोकिल: कोकिल m. (-लः) 1 The Kokila or Koïl, the black or Indian cuckoo, (Cuculus Indicus.) 2 A firebrand, a lighted coal. E. कुक to seize, (the heart,) and इलच् affix: the Kokila makes a prominent figure in Hindu poetry, and is supposed, by his musical cry, to inspire pleasing and tender emotions.
कोकिलनयन: कोकिलनयन m. (-नः) A plant bearing a dark black flower, (Capparis spinosa); it is also applied to Barleria longifolia. E. कोकिल the Koil, and नयन an eye, to which the flower is compared; also other similar compounds, as कोकिलाक्ष, &c.
कोकिलाक्ष: कोकिलाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A shrub: see the preceding. E. कोकिल, and अक्ष the eye, or with कन् added, कोकिलाक्षक.
कोकिलावास: कोकिलावास m. (-सः) The mango tree. E. कोकिल, and आवास abode.
कोकिलेक्षु: कोकिलेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) The black variety of sugar cane. E. कोकिल, and इक्षु sugar cane.
कोकिलोत्सव: कोकिलोत्सव m. (-वः) The mango tree. E. कोकिल, and उत्सव festival.
कोच: कोच m. (-चः) A man of degraded caste, the offspring of a fisherman by a female of the butcher tribe.
कोङ्कण: कोङ्कण m. (-णः) The name of a country, Konkan, in the peninsula. n. (-णं) A kind of weapon.
कोङ्कणासुत: कोङ्कणासुत m. (-तः) A name of PARAŚURĀMA. E. कोङ्कणा the mother of the hero, or the woman of Konkan, and सुत a son.
कोजागर: कोजागर m. (-रः) The day of full-moon in the month Aśvin, (September-October.) E. कः who, जागर wakeful; who is awake, the call of LAKṢMĪ, who, descending on this night, promised wealth to all that were awake: hence the night is spent in festivity, and games of chance in honour of the goddess.
कोट: कोट m. (-टः) 1 A fort, a strong hold. 2 A shed, a hut. 3 Crookedness, curvature.
कोटक: कोटक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Who or what curves or bends. m. (-कः) A thatcher, a builder of huts, &c. E. कुट to be crooked, ण्वुल aff.
कोटर: कोटर mn. (-रः-रं) The hollow of a tree. f. (-री) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A naked woman: see कोटवी. E. कोट and र, from रा to get, to possess, with the affix ड.
कोटरावण: कोटरावण n. (-णं) A wood in which there are hollow trees. E. कोटर the hollow of a tree, and वन a wood; by special rules, the final vowel of the first word is made long, and न in the second is changed to ण.
कोटवी: कोटवी f. (-वी) 1 A naked woman. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. कोट crookedness, and वा to get or receive, क and ङीष् affixes; also कोट्टवी, and कोटरी.
कोटि: कोटि f. (-टिः) 1 The edge or point of a sword. 2 The end of a bow. 3 A number, a Krore or ten millions. 4 Eminence, excellence. 5 The upright side of a triangle. 6 The complement of an are to 90°. 7 A plant, Piring or Asparac, (Medicago esculenta.) E. कुट to be crooked, and इण् Uṇādi affix; also कोटी.
कोटिक: कोटिक m. (-कः) An insect., coccinella of various kinds; this is most usually read कोटिर.
कोटिजित्: कोटिजित् m. (-जित्) A name of the poet KĀLIDĀSA. E. केटि a crore, (of competitors,) and जित् conqueror.
कोटिज्या: कोटिज्या f. (-ज्या) The cosine of an angle, in a right angled triangle. E. कोटि, and ज्या a sine.
कोटिपात्र: कोटिपात्र m. (-त्रः) A rudder or large oar used as one. E. कोटि an edge, and पात्र a plank.
कोटिर: कोटिर m. (-रः) 1 An ichneumon, (Viverra ichneumon.) 2 An insect, coccinella of various kinds: see इन्द्रगोप. 3 A name of INDRA. E. कोटि excellence, and र what possesses.
कोटिवर्ष: कोटिवर्ष n. (-र्षं) The name of a city, Vāṇapura or Devikote, on the Koromandel coast. f. (-र्षा) A plant used as a medicinal vegetable, (Medicago esculenta:) see पिडिङ्ग. E. कोटि excellence, वर्ष what diffuses.
कोटिश: कोटिश m. (-शः) A harrow. E. कोटि an edge, शो to cut or pare, क aff.
कोटिशस्: कोटिशस् ind. In multitudes, by millions. E. कोटि, and शसि aff.
कोटी: कोटी f. (-टी) 1 The edge or point of a sword. 2 A medicinal plant, (Medicago esculenta.) 3 A Krore, &c.: see कोटि.
कोटीर: कोटीर m. (-रः) 1 Long entangled hair. 2 A crest, a diadem. E. कुट to be crooked, इरन् affix and the radical vowel converted.
कोटीवर्ष: कोटीवर्ष n. (-र्षं) A name of Vāṇapura. f. (-र्षा) Piring, a plant: see कोटिवर्ष.
कोटीश: कोटीश m. (-शः) A harrow: see कोटिश.
कोट्ट: कोट्ट m. (-ट्टः-ट्टं) A fort, a castle, a strong hold. E. कुट्ट to cut or divide, affix घञ्.
कोट्टवी: कोट्टवी f. (-वी) 1 A naked woman. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 The mother of Vāṇa, an asura: see कोटवी.
कोट्टवीपुर: कोट्टवीपुर n. (-रं) Vanapur or Devicotta. E. कोट्टवी the mother of Vāṇa, and पुर a city.
कोट्टार: कोट्टार m. (-रः) 1 A well. 2 The stairs of a pond. 3 A fortified town, a strong hold. 4 A libertine. E. कोट्ट a fort, &c. ऋ to go, affix अप्.
कोठ: कोठ m. (-ठः) 1 A species of leprosy with large round spots. 2 Ringworm, impetigo. E. कुठ to surround, affix घञ्.
कोण: कोण m. (-णः) 1 A corner, an angle. 2 The quill or bow of a lute, a fiddle stick, &c. 3 A drum stick. 4 A sort of stringed musical instrument. 5 The sharp edge of a sword. 6 A stick, a staff, a club. 7 A name of Maṅgala, the planet MARS. 8 A name of the planet SATURN. 9 An intermediate point of the compass. E. कुण to sound, &c. घञ् aff.
कोणकुण: कोणकुण m. (-णः) A bug. E. कुण to cut, affix क, added to कोण the edge of a sword.
कोणि: कोणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Having a crooked arm: see कुणि.
कोथ: कोथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Afflicted with pain. 2 Churned. m. (-थः) 1 Inflammation, and ulceration of the angles of the eyelids. 2 Gangrene. 3 Churning. E. कुथ to afflict or be afflicted, affix घञ्.
कोदण्ड: कोदण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A bow. m. (-ण्डः) 1 An eyebrow. 2 The name of a country. E. कुण to sound, अण्ड Uṇādi affix, &c. दन् inserted; the final radical consonant is rejected; otherwise, कुद to speak false, अण्डच् aff.
कोद्रव: कोद्रव n. (-वं) A species of grain eaten by the poorer people, (Paspalum kora.) E. क wind, उद्रव to go, affix अच्; sown by the wind, or growing wild in many places.
कोप: कोप m. (-पः) 1 Wrath, rage. 2 Morbid irritation or disorder of the humours. E. कुप to be angry, affix घञ्.
कोपक्रम: कोपक्रम m. (-मः) An angry or passionate man. E. कोप rage, and क्रम who goes or has. n. (-मं) The creation by BRAHMĀ. E. क BRAHMĀ, and उपक्रम order, method; also similar compounds, as कोपज्ञ, &c.
कोपज्वलित: कोपज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enraged, inflamed with wrath. E. कोप, and ज्वलित inflamed.
कोपदीप्त: कोपदीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Incensed, inflamed with anger. E. कोप, and दीप्त shining.
कोपन: कोपन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Passionate, wrathful. f. (-ना) A passionate woman. E. कुप to be angry, युच् affix, fem. affix टाप्.
कोपपद: कोपपद n. (-दं) Appearance of anger, pretended wrath. E. कोप, and पद place.
कोपवत्: कोपवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Passionate, angry. E. कोप, and मतुप् aff.
कोपवेग: कोपवेग m. (-गः) Violence, impetuosity of passion. E. कोप, and वेग speed.
कोपाकुल: कोपाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Furious, enraged. E. कोप, and आकुल bewildered.
कोपित: कोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Angry, enraged. E. कोप, and इतच् aff.
कोपिन्: कोपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Angry, passionate, wrathful. m. (-पी) A bird called the water-pigeon. E. कुप to be angry, णिनि aff.
कोमल: कोमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Soft, bland. 2 Soft, low, sweet. 3 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. f. (-ला) A plant: see क्षीरिका. n. (-लं) Water. E. कुट to be curved, कल Uṇādi affix, and मुट् inserted, formative irregular; or कम to desire, कलच् affix, and उ inserted with conversion.
कोमलक: कोमलक n. (-कं) The fibres of the stalk of a lotus. E. कोमल soft, कन् added.
कोमलगीत: कोमलगीत n. (-तं) A pleasing song. E. कोमल, and गीत a song; also with कन् added, कोमलगीतकः.
कोमलता: कोमलता f. (-ता) Softness, tenderness, agreeableness; also with त्व, कोमलत्वं.
कोयष्टि: कोयष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) The lapwing: see the next.
कोयष्टिक: कोयष्टिक m. (-कः) The lapwing. E. क water, यष्टि a line or row, कन् added, deriv, irr.; also कोयष्टि. These birds are found in the vicinity of marshes, &c.
कोर: कोर m. (-रः) 1 Union with little or no motion, as that of the fingers with one another, amphiarthrosis. 2 A bud. E. कुर sound, घञ् aff.
कोरक: कोरक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A bud, an unblown flower. 2 A species of perfume, commonly Chor. 3 Another perfume, a berry containing a resinous and fragrant substance: see कक्कोलक. 4 The fibres of the stalk of the lotus. E. कुर to sound, affix वुन्.
कोरङ्गी: कोरङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) Small cardamoms: see एला. E. कुर to sound, अङ्गच् and ङीष् aff.
कोरदूष: कोरदूष m. (-षः) A kind of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.) E. कोर a bud, दूष to change, अण् affix; also कन् being added, कोरदूषक m. (-कः)
कोरित: कोरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, ground, comminuted. 2 Budded, sprouted. E. कोर, and इतच् aff.
कोल: कोल m. (-लः) 1 A hog. 2 A raft, a float. 3 The haunch, the hip or flank. 4 Embracing, an embrace. 5 The planet Śani or SATURN. 6 Plumbago, (Zeylanica, &c.) 7 A country, Kaliṅga, the modern seacoast from Cuttak to Madras. 8 A kind of weapon. 9 An outcaste, one of a tribe degraded by SAGARA  from the military order. 10 A man of a mixed caste. 11 A barbarian, a Kol, people inhabiting the hills and forests in central India. n. (-लं) 1 The fruit of the jujube. 2 The weight of one Tola. 3 Black pepper. f. (-ला or -ली) 1 The jujube tree. 2 Long pepper. 3 A kind of pepper, (Piper chavya, Rox.) E. कुल to accumulate, affix अच्.
कोलक: कोलक n. (-कं) 1 A kind of perfume: see कक्कोलक. 2 Long pepper. m. (-कः) A plant, (Cordia myxta.) E. कुल to accumulate, वुन् aff.
कोलदल: कोलदल n. (-लं) A kind of perfume: see नखी. E. कोल the jujube, दल a leaf; having a similar leaf.
कोलनासिका: कोलनासिका f. (-का) A plant? also वङ्किनी.
कोलपुच्छ: कोलपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A heron. E. कोल a hog, पुच्छ a tail; hog-tailed.
कोलमूल: कोलमूल n. (-लं) The root of long pepper. E. कोल, and मूल root.
कोलम्बक: कोलम्बक m. (-कः) The body of a lute, the whole of it except the strings. E. कुल to accumulate, अम्बच् and कन् affs.
कोलवल्ली: कोलवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A plant, with a pungent fruit resembling pepper: see गजपिप्पली (Pothos officinalis.) E. कोल a hog, वल्ली a creeper; resembling a hog's bristle.
कोलाञ्च: कोलाञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A name of Kaliṅga, the Coromandel coast, from Cuttak to Madras; according to some, it is in Gangetic Hindustan, with Kanouj for the capital.
कोलाहल: कोलाहल m. (-लः) A loud and confused sound, an uproar, a great and indistinct noise. E. कोल accumulation, from कुल, with घञ्; again, हल to make or plough, आङ् prefixed, and अच् aff.
कोलि: कोलि f. (-लिः or ली) The jujube tree, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. see कोल.
कोविद: कोविद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Wise, learned. E. को who sounds or teaches, (the Shasters,) विद divine knowledge, from विद to know, affix क.
कोविदार: कोविदार m. (-रः) A species of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) E. कु the earth, दॄ to tear or divide, with वि prefixed, deriv. irr.
कोश: कोश m. (-शः) 1 An egg. 2 Wrought or unwrought gold or silver plate, jewellery. 3 An ordeal, &c. f. (-शी) 1 A shoe, a sandal. 2 The beard of corn. E. कुश or कुष to issue, घञ् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; see कोष.
कोशकार: कोशकार m. (-रः) The sugar cane; also कोषकार.
कोशफल: कोशफल n. (-लं) A berry containing a waxy and fragrant substance: see कक्कोल. E. कोश an egg, फल fruit; the berry being egg-shaped.
कोशल: कोशल mf. (-लः-ला) 1 A name of the city Ayodhya (Oude), or the neighbouring district. 2 The name of a prince. E. कुश to shine, अल Uṇādi affix; also कोषल.
कोशलात्मजा: कोशलात्मजा f. (-जा) The wife of DAŚARATHA the mother of RĀMA. E. कोशल the name of a king, and आत्मजा a daughter.
कोशवासिन्: कोशवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Wrapped up in a sheathe or shell, &c. m. (-सी) 1 A shelled animal. 2 A chrysalis or pupa. E. कोश, and वासिन् what abides.
कोशस्थ: कोशस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Sheathed, enveloped in a sheathe, a shell, &c. m. (-स्थः) 1 Any shelled insect or animal, as a snail, &c. 2 A pupa or chrysalis. 3 The silk worm in its cocoon. E. कोश, and स्थ what abides.
कोशलिक: कोशलिक n. (-कं) A bribe. E. कोश or कोष wealth, and ल what takes, ठक् affix; also कोषलिक.
कोशाङ्ग: कोशाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A kind of reed or grass, commonly Ikāda. E. कोश or कोष a sheathe, and अङ्ग body; also कोषाङ्ग.
कोशातक: कोशातक m. (-कः) Hair. f. (-की) Several sorts of cucurbitaceous plants: see कोषातक.
कोशातकिन्: कोशातकिन् f. (-की) 1 Trade, business. 2 A trader, a merchant. 3 Submarine fire.
कोष: कोष mn. (-षः-षं) 1 A bud. 2 A sheathe, a scabbard, &c. 3 A coat, a surrounding cover, any investing sheathe. 4 Judicial trial by oath or ordeal, or by fire, water, poison, the balance, heated balls of iron, boiling oil, &c. attesting a deity, and touching or drinking water three times in which some idol has been washed. 5 Gold or silver, wrought or unwrought, as plate, jewellery, &c. 6 Wealth. 7 Accumulated wealth, treasure. 8 A treasury, the apartment where money or plate is kept. 9 A sacrificial vessel or any drinking vessel. 10 The vulva, the womb. 11 The penis. 12 A testicle or the scrotum. 13 An egg. 14 (In composition,) A ball or globe, as सूत्रकीष a ball of thread, नेत्रकोष the eyeball, &c. 15 The inner part of the Jack-fruit or its like. 16 A nutmeg. 17 A dictionary or vocabulary. f. (-षी) 1 A shoe, a sandal. 2 The beard of corn: see कोश. E. कुश or कुष to issue, affix घञ्; hence the word is optionally कोष or कोश; the meanings may be mostly resolved into, that from which something issues or evolves.
कोषक: कोषक m. (-कः) 1 An egg. 2 A testicle. E. कन् added to the preceding.
कोषकार: कोषकार m. (-रः) 1 Sugar cane, or a variety. 2 The silk worm, or the insect while in its cocoon. 3 A chrysalis, or (pupa.) E. कोश a sheathe, and कार what makes; also कोशकार or with कन् added कोशकारक and कोशकारक.
कोषग्रहण: कोषग्रहण n. (-णं) Undergoing an ordeal. E. कोष, and ग्रहण taking; also कोशग्रहणं.
कोषचञ्चु: कोषचञ्चु m. (-ञ्चुः) The Indian crane. E. कोष a sheathe, &c. and चञ्चु a beak.
कोषनायक: कोषनायक m. (-कः) 1 The Indian Plutus. 2 A treasurer. E. कोष, and नायक chief.
कोषफल: कोषफल n. (-लं) A berry having a fragrant pulp: see कक्वोल. m. (-लः) A kind of creeping plant: see घोषक. f. (-ला) A sort of Ghoṣa with yellow flowers. E. कोष a sheathe, and फल fruit; also कोशफल.
कोषभूत: कोषभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Treasured, stored, accumulated. E. कोष, and भूत been.
कोषला: कोषला f. (-ला) The country south of Ayodhya (Oude), or Ayodhya itself: see कोशला.
कोषवत्: कोषवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Rich, wealthy. E. कोष, and मतुप् aff.
कोषवृद्धि: कोषवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Swelled testicle, enlargement of the scrotum, from hernia or hydrocele, &c. E. कोष a testicle, and वृद्धि increase.
कोषशायिका: कोषशायिका f. (-का) A knife. E. कोष a scabbard, and शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.
कोषशुद्धि: कोषशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Purification by ordeal. E. कोष, and शुद्धि purity; also कोशशृद्धि.
कोषहीन: कोषहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, without treasure. E. कोष, and हीन deprived of.
कोषांश: कोषांश m. (-शः) Part of a treasure, a portion of a person's wealth. E. कोष, and अंश part.
कोषातक: कोषातक m. (-कः) Hair. f. (-की) 1 A small species of cucumber, (Trichosanthes diaeca:) 2 A cucurbitaceous plant, commonly called Turai, (Luffa acutangula.) 3 Another kind, (L. pentangula.) 4 A kind of creeper: see घोष. 5 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera;) also अपामार्ग. 6 Night. E. कोष a sheathe, &c. अत to go, affixes क्वुन् and ङीष्; also कोशातक and कोषातकी.
कोषाध्यक्ष: कोषाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A treasurer. 2 KUVERA. E. कोष, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
कोषापहरण: कोषापहरण n. (-णं) Carrying off treasure. E. कोष, and अपहरण taking away.
कोषिन्: कोषिन् m. (-षी) The mango tree. E. कोष a sheathe, and इनि aff.
कोष्ठ: कोष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Own. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 A granary, a place in which grain is kept. 2 A treasury. 3 An apartment. 4 Any viscus, as the heart, lungs, stomach, bowels, &c. E. कुष to issue, थन् Uṇādi aff.
कोष्ठक: कोष्ठक n. (-कं) 1 A granary. 2 A treasury. 3 A brick trough for watering cattle at. E. कन् added to the last.
कोष्ठपाल: कोष्ठपाल m. (-लः) 1 A municipal officer, a constable. 2 A watch, a guard. 3 A storekeeper, a treasurer. E. कोष्ठ the granary, &c. and पाल who protects.
कोष्ठागार: कोष्ठागार m. (-रः) 1 A store. 2 A treasury. E. कोष्ठ, and आगार a house.
कोष्ठाग्नि: कोष्ठाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The digestive faculty, the gastric juice. E. कोष्ठ stomach, and अग्नि fire.
कोष्ण: कोष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Warm, moderately warm, tepid. n. (-ष्णं) Warmth. E. का diminutive, and उष्ण warm.
कोहल: कोहल m. (-लः) 1 The name of a saint or Muni, the inventor or first preceptor of the drama. 2 A kind of musical instrument. 3 A sort of spirituous liquor.
कौकृत्य: कौकृत्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Evil doing, wickedness. 2 Repentance. E. कु bad, कृत्या action, affix अण्.
कौक्कुटिक: कौक्कुटिक m. (-कः) 1 A hypocrite. 2 A kind of mendicant, one who does not look far before him, or who proceeds with his eyes fixed upon the ground, for fear of treading upon insects, &c. E. कुक्कुटी hypocrisy, or a small part, ठक् aff.
कौक्कुटिकन्दल: कौक्कुटिकन्दल m. (-लः) A species of snake, the Boä or Bor.
कौक्ष: कौक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Abdominal, ventral. E. कुक्षि the belly, अण् aff.
कौक्षेयक: कौक्षेयक m. (-कः) A sword, a scymitar. E. कुक्षि the belly, and ढकञ् affix; in any other sense the affix is अण्, making कौक्ष.
कौङ्क: कौङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The country, the Konkan.
कौङ्किण: कौङ्किण m. (-णः) The district of Konkan in the peninsula: see कोङ्कण.
कौञ्च: कौञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) The name of a mountain, part of the Himāla range: see क्रौञ्च.
कौञ्जायनी: कौञ्जायनी f. (-नी) 1 The wife of a Brahman or any venerable personage. 2 A female descendant of Kuñja. E. कुञ्ज, and फक् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; this word may be masculine, कौञ्जायन. m. (-नः) meaning a male descendant of Kuñja; also कैञ्जायन्य formed from कुञ्ज by च्यञ् affix m. sing. (-न्यः) sense; also plur. (-नाः)
कौट: कौट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) 1 Fraudulent, dishonest. 2 Snared, wired. 3 Domestic, homely, home-born, home-bred. 4 Independent. n. (-टं) Fraud, falsehood. m. (-टः) A medicinal shrub, &c. कुटज. E. कूट fraud, or कुटि a house, अण् aff.
कौटकिक: कौटकिक m. (-कः) A vender of the flesh of birds or beasts, a poacher, a butcher, &c.; also कौटिक. E. कूट or कूटक a snare, a trap, and ठक् aff.
कौटज: कौटज m. (-जः) A medicinal shrub, (Echites antidysenterica:) see कुटज. E. अण् pleonastic affix to कुटज the same.
कौटतक्ष: कौटतक्ष m. (-क्षः) An independent carpenter, one who works at home on his own account, and not for the village or the corporation, &c. E. कौट domestic, and तक्ष a carpenter.
कौटल्य: कौटल्य m. (-ल्यः) The name of a saint; also called Vātsyāyana.
कौटसाक्षिन्: कौटसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A false witness. E. कौट fraud, साक्षिन् a witness.
कौटसाक्ष्य: कौटसाक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) False evidence. E. कौट, and साक्ष्य testimony.
कौटिक: कौटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Fraudulent, dishonest. 2 Relating to a snare or trap. m. (-कः) One who kills animals, and sells their flesh for his own subsistence, a hunter, a poacher, a mountaineer, &c. E. कूट a trap for catching birds, &c. affix ठक्.
कौटिलिक: कौटिलिक m. (-कः) 1 A hunter. 2 A blacksmith. E. कुटिलिका derived from कुटिल crooked, said to mean a forge, or the stooping approach of a hunter on his prey, affix अण्.
कौटिल्य: कौटिल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Crookedness. 2 Dishonesty. E. कुटिल, and ष्यञ् aff.
कौटुम्बिक: कौटुम्बिक m. (-कः) The father or master of a family. E. कुटुम्ब, and ठञ् aff.
कौडविक: कौडविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sown with a certain measure, (a Kuḍava) of grain; (a field, &c.) E. कुडव a measure, and ठक् aff.
कौणप: कौणप m. (-पः) A Rākṣasa or goblin. E. कुणप a corpse, and अण् affix; these beings are supposed to eat human flesh.
कौणपदन्त: कौणपदन्त m. (-न्तः) A name of BHĪṢMA uncle of the Pāṇḍus.
कौण्डिन्य: कौण्डिन्य m. (-न्यः) The name of a Muni or divine sage.
कौण्य: कौण्य n. (-ण्यं) Being maimed, being handless. E. कुणि a cripple, यञ् aff.
कौतुक: कौतुक n. (-कं) 1 Eagerness, vehemence, impatience. 2 Joy, pleasure, happiness. 3 Sport, pastime. 4 A festival, festivity. 5 Wish, inclination. 6 Curiosity. 7 Kind or friendly greeting, civility, salutation. 8 The marriage thread or ring. 9 The enjoyment of public diversions. 10 Song, dance, shew or spectacle. 11 Season of enjoyment. E. कुतुक, and अण् aff.
कौतूहल: कौतूहल n. (-लं) 1 Eagerness, vehemence. 2 Curiosity. E. कुतूहल and अण् pleonastic affix; also with ष्यञ् affix, कौतूहल्य n. (-ल्यं)
कौतूहलान्वित: कौतूहलान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eager, vehement. 2 Curious. E. कौतूहल, and अन्वित having.
कौदालिक: कौदालिक m. (-कः) A man of a mixed caste, the son of a fisherman by a woman of the washerman caste.
कौद्रवीण: कौद्रवीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A field, &c. of a particular grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.) E. कोद्रव a species of grain, and खञ् aff.
कौनख्य: कौनख्य n. (-ख्यं) Ugliness of the nails. E. कुनख, and ष्यञ् aff.
कौनख्यादिक: कौनख्यादिक n. (-कं) Neglect of personal decoration. E. कु bad, नखी a nail, आदि etcetera, कन् added, and अण् affix; allowing the nails to grow, &c.
कौन्तिक: कौन्तिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a soldier armed with a spear. E. कुन्त a spear, affix ठक्.
कौन्ती: कौन्ती f. (-न्ती) A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā. E. कुन्ति here said to mean a country, affixes अण् and ङीष्; produced in that district.
कौन्तेय: कौन्तेय m. (-यः) Either of the Pāṇḍu princes. E. कुन्ती, and ढक् affix, son of KUNTĪ.
कौन्द: कौन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दी-न्दं) Relating to the jasmine. E. कुन्द, and अण् aff.
कौप: कौप n. (-पं) Water of a well. E. कूप, and अण् aff.
कौपीन: कौपीन n. (-नं) A small piece of cloth worn over the privities. 2 A privity, a privy part. 3 A wrong or improper at. 4 Sin. E. कूप a well, &c. खञ् aff.
कौपोदकी: कौपोदकी f. (-की) The mace of KṚṢṆA: see कौमोदकी.
कौमार: कौमार mfn. adj. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Maiden, virgin. 2 Juvenile. 3 Soft, tender. f. (-री) One of the seven Mātṛs, the divine mothers or personified energies of the gods; the energy or Śakti of KUMĀRA or KĀRTTIKEYA. n. (-रं) 1 Youth, childhood, from birth to the age of five. 2 Maidenhood to the age of sixteen. E. कुमार a youth, and अञ् aff.; or कुमार the deity KĀRTTIKEYA, अण् and ङीष् affixes.
कौमुद: कौमुद m. (-दः) The month Kartik, (Oct.-Nov.) f. (-दी) 1 Moonlight. 2 A festival. 3 A festival in honour of KĀRTTIKEYA, held on the full moon of the month Kartik. 4 Day of full moon in the month Aśvin. 5 The same in the month Kartik. E. कुमुद a white lotus, अण् and ङीष् affixes, कौमुदी moonlight, equally white or brilliant; the other senses come from this.
कौमुदिक: कौमुदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a water lily, abounding with them, &c. कुमुद, and ठञ् aff.
कौमुदीका: कौमुदीका f. (-का) A companion and confidant of DURGĀ.
कौमुदीचार: कौमुदीचार mn. (-रः-रं) Day of full moon in the month of Aśvin. E. कौमुदी a festival, and चार what proceeds.
कौमुदीपति: कौमुदीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. कौमुदी moonlight, and पति lord.
कौमुदीवृक्ष: कौमुदीवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) the stick or stand of a lamp. E. कौमुदी here light in general, and वृक्ष a tree.
कौमोदकी: कौमोदकी f. (-की) The club or mace of KṚṢṆA. E. कुमुदक what gives the earth pleasure, here said to be VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, affixes अण् and ङीष्; also कौमुदी.
कौरव: कौरव m. (-वः) A Kaurava, a descendant of KURU. E. कुरु, and अण् affix; also with वुञ् affix कौरवक.
कौरव्य: कौरव्य m. (-व्यः) An ancestor or descendant of KURU. E. कुरु, and ण्य aff.
कौर्म: कौर्म्म mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी-र्म्मं) 1 Relating to a tortoise. 2 Acting as a tortoise. 3 Belonging or relating to the Avatar of VIṢṆU, as a tortoise, as the Kaurmma or Kūrma Purāṇa. E. कूर्म्म, and अण् aff.
कौर्म्म: कौर्म्म mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी-र्म्मं) 1 Relating to a tortoise. 2 Acting as a tortoise. 3 Belonging or relating to the Avatar of VIṢṆU, as a tortoise, as the Kaurmma or Kūrma Purāṇa. E. कूर्म्म, and अण् aff.
कौल: कौल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Of a good family, well-born. m. (-लः) A worshipper of Śakti according to the left hand ritual. n. (-लं) The doctrine and practices of the left hand Śāktas. E. कुल a family, and अञ् aff.
कौलकेय: कौलकेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Of a good family, well-born. m. (-यः) The son of an unchaste woman. E. कुलक family, and ढक् aff.
कौलटिनेय: कौलटिनेय mf. (-यः-यी) 7 The son or daughter of a female beg gar. 2 A bastard. E. कुलटा a female beggar, ढक् affix, and इनञ् inserted; also without the augment कौलटेय.
कौलटेय: कौलटेय mf. (-यः-यी) 1 The child of a female beggar. 2 A bastard, the child of an unchaste wife: see the preceding.
कौलटेर: कौलटेर mf. (-रः-रा) A bastard son or daughter of a disloyal wife. 2 The child of a beggar. E. कुलटा an unchaste woman, द्रक aff.
कौलत्थ: कौलत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्थी-त्थं) Made, prepared, consisting of a kind of vetch. E. कुलत्थ Dolichos biflorus, अण् aff.
